cartdetails CREATE procedure [dbo].[cartdetails]
(

   @email1 nvarchar(50),
   @style nvarchar(20),
   @color nvarchar(20),
   @color_code nvarchar(20),
   @UPrice decimal(18,2),
   @size1 nvarchar(10),
  @size2 nvarchar(10),
    @size3 nvarchar(10),
   @size4 nvarchar(10),
 @size5 nvarchar(10),
   @size6 nvarchar(10),
    @size7 nvarchar(10),
   @size8 nvarchar(10),
    @size9 nvarchar(10),
   @size10 nvarchar(10),
    @size11 nvarchar(10),
   @size12 nvarchar(10),
   @quantity1 int,
   @quantity2 int,
   @quantity3 int,
  @quantity4 int,
   @quantity5 int,
   @quantity6 int,
   @quantity7 int,
   @quantity8 int,
   @quantity9 int,
   @quantity10 int,
   @quantity11 int,
   @quantity12 int,
   @totalqty int,
   @totalprice decimal(18,2),
   @rowid int,
   @custcode nvarchar(10),
   @storecode nvarchar(10)


)
as 
Begin

declare @count int
declare @overallqty int
declare @overallamt decimal(18,2)

if (@rowid = 000)
Begin
select @count = COALESCE(count(*),0) from cart  where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode and style = @style
if (@count > 0)
Begin 
update cart set UPrice = @UPrice  ,quantity1 = @quantity1 + quantity1,quantity2 = @quantity2 + quantity2,quantity3 =  @quantity3 + quantity3,quantity4  = @quantity4 + quantity4,quantity5 =  @quantity5 + quantity5,quantity6 =  @quantity6 + quantity6,
quantity7  = @quantity7 + quantity7,quantity8 =  @quantity8,quantity9  = @quantity9 + quantity9,quantity10 =  @quantity10 + quantity10,quantity11 = @quantity11 + quantity11,quantity12 =  @quantity12 + quantity12,
totalqty = @totalqty + totalqty,totalprice = @totalprice + totalprice from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode and style = @style and color_code = @color_code

select @overallqty = COALESCE(sum(totalqty),0),@overallamt = COALESCE(sum(totalprice),0) from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode


update cart set overallqty = @overallqty, overallamt = @overallamt where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode 
End
End

select @count = COALESCE(count(*),0) from cart  where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode and style = @style and color_code = @color_code

--select @count = COALESCE(count(*),0) from cart  where email1 = '1234' and style = '1108' and color_code = 'RED'
--print @count
 if (@count > 0)
Begin 
update cart set UPrice = @UPrice  ,quantity1 = @quantity1 + quantity1,quantity2 = @quantity2 + quantity2,quantity3 =  @quantity3 + quantity3,quantity4  = @quantity4 + quantity4,quantity5 =  @quantity5 + quantity5,quantity6 =  @quantity6 + quantity6,
quantity7  = @quantity7 + quantity7,quantity8 =  @quantity8,quantity9  = @quantity9 + quantity9,quantity10 =  @quantity10 + quantity10,quantity11 = @quantity11 + quantity11,quantity12 =  @quantity12 + quantity12,
totalqty = @totalqty + totalqty,totalprice = @totalprice + totalprice from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode and style = @style and color_code = @color_code

select @overallqty = COALESCE(sum(totalqty),0),@overallamt = COALESCE(sum(totalprice),0) from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode


update cart set overallqty = @overallqty, overallamt = @overallamt where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
End


Else

Begin
insert into cart(email1,style,color,color_code,UPrice,size1,size2,size3,size4,size5,size6,size7,size8,size9,size10,size11,size12,
quantity1,quantity2,quantity3,quantity4,quantity5,quantity6,quantity7,quantity8,quantity9,quantity10,quantity11,quantity12,totalqty,
totalprice,rowid,customer,store)
values(@email1,@style,@color,@color_code,@UPrice,@size1,@size2,@size3,@size4,@size5,@size6,@size7,@size8,@size9,@size10,@size11,@size12,
@quantity1,@quantity2,@quantity3,@quantity4,@quantity5,@quantity6,@quantity7,@quantity8,@quantity9,@quantity10,@quantity11,@quantity12,@totalqty,
@totalprice,@rowid,@custcode,@storecode)

select @overallqty = COALESCE(sum(totalqty),0),@overallamt = COALESCE(sum(totalprice),0) from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode


update cart set overallqty = @overallqty, overallamt = @overallamt where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode 
End

End

change_cutno create procedure change_cutno (@from int, @to int )
as
if exists (select * from cutheader where cutno=@to )
	select 'TO Cut#'+convert(char(10), @to)+' already exists! Not Changed.'
else 
BEGIN 
	if NOT exists (select * from cutheader where cutno=@from )
		select 'FROM Cut#'+convert(char(10), @from)+' does NOT exist! Not Changed.'
	else
	BEGIN	
	update cutheader set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update cutdetail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update logfdetail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update sodetail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update invdetail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update pickdetail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	/* */
	update aphead set cutno = @to where cutno=@from
	update vendor_cb set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update Webcutheaderpdm set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update webcutdetailpdm set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update soheader_workorder set Production_Cutno=@to where Production_Cutno=@from
	update bartender_upc set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update bartender_upc_sample set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update bundle_tkt set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update cbdetail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update Container_cut set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update container_detail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update cut_milestone set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update cutheader_docs set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update cutheader_image set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update cutheader_notes set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update cutpodetail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update cutpoheader set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update epdmcutheader set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update import_box set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update import_detail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update import_logfdetail set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update import_packlist set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update ivtf_lot set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update  ivtf_lot_bartender set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update ivtf_patterncard set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update ivtr_reserved set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update logfheader set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update logr set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update packlist_import set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update podetail set cutno =@to	where cutno=@from
	update poheader set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update PR set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update process set cutno=@to where cutno=@from
	update sodetail_findbulk_log set bulk_cutno=@to where bulk_cutno=@from

	END 
END

 ,@ErrorState     tinyint

    SET @ErrorMessage  = ERROR_MESSAGE()

charindex_test CREATE procedure charindex_test
@id int=0
as begin 
while (@id <=10)
begin
select charindex('a','jaisonraja',@id+1) as Value
end
end
check_invheader_subtotal create procedure check_invheader_subtotal as
select invoiceno,invoicedate,customer,custpo, subtotal,
 detail_subtotal=(select sum(qty*price) from invdetail where invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno), 
 difference = subtotal - (select sum(qty*price) from invdetail where invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno) 
from invheader where subtotal <> (select sum(qty*price) from 
 invdetail where invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno) order by invoiceno

check_pickheader_subtotal create procedure check_pickheader_subtotal as
select pickno,pickdate,customer,custpo, subtotal,
 detail_subtotal=(select sum(qty*price) from pickdetail where pickno=pickheader.pickno), 
 difference = subtotal - (select sum(qty*price) from pickdetail where pickno=pickheader.pickno) 
from pickheader where subtotal <> (select sum(qty*price) from 
 pickdetail where pickno=pickheader.pickno) order by pickno

check_soheader_subtotal create procedure check_soheader_subtotal as
select orderno,orderdate,customer,custpo, total,
 detail_total=(select sum(qty*price) from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno), 
 difference = total - (select sum(qty*price) from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno) ,
	subtotal, detailQty=(select sum(qty) from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno)

from soheader where total <> (select sum(qty*price) from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno) or 
	 	subtotal <> ( select sum(qty) from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno )
order by orderno


chk_ivtf_onhand create procedure chk_ivtf_onhand as
select a.code,a.color, ivtf_onhand = sum(a.qty1+a.qty2+a.qty3+a.qty4+a.qty5+a.qty6+a.qty7+a.qty8+a.qty9+a.qty10+a.qty11+a.qty12), 
 view_onhand=sum(v.qty1+v.qty2+v.qty3+v.qty4+v.qty5+v.qty6+v.qty7+v.qty8+v.qty9+v.qty10+v.qty11+v.qty12)  , difference=sum(a.qty1+a.qty2+a.qty3+a.qty4+a.qty5+a.qty6+a.qty7+a.qty8+a.qty9+a.qty10+a.qty11+a.qty12) - sum(v.qty1+v.qty2+v.qty3+v.qty4+v.qty5+v.qty6+v.qty7+v.qty8+v.qty9+v.qty10+v.qty11+v.qty12)
 from ivtf a, v_ivtf_onhand v 
  where a.code=v.code and a.color=v.color
group by a.code, a.color
having sum(a.qty1+a.qty2+a.qty3+a.qty4+a.qty5+a.qty6+a.qty7+a.qty8+a.qty9+a.qty10+a.qty11+a.qty12) - sum(v.qty1+v.qty2+v.qty3+v.qty4+v.qty5+v.qty6+v.qty7+v.qty8+v.qty9+v.qty10+v.qty11+v.qty12)<>0

close_pick CREATE PROC close_pick (@pickno INT)
AS 
exec sp_close_pick @pickno,'Y'

create_invoice_from_pickticket 
/* procedure for ecommerce pick to auto Invoice */ 
/*200428 Arun - added Country, Shcountry, companyname, shcompanyname*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[create_invoice_from_pickticket] (@pickno int)
as 
declare @invoiceno int 
declare @total money , @currency nvarchar(10), @exchange_rate decimal(9,3), 
@nonfactinv int, @factinv int, @maxInvno int = 99999999, @minInvNo int = 1, @div nvarchar(4), 
@factored char(1), @invfrom int, @invf_from int, @nextInvoiceno int, @orderno int

if Exists(select pickno FROM pickheader WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(closed, 'N') = 'Y')
begin
return
end
if Exists(select pickno FROM invheader WHERE pickno = @pickno)
begin
return
end
SELECT @div = isnull(user4, 'A'), @factored = isnull(factored, 'N') FROM pickheader WHERE pickno = @pickno
SELECT @nonfactinv = IsNull(inv, 0), @factinv = IsNull(inv_factored, 0), @invfrom = IsNull(inv_from, 0), 
@invf_from = IsNull(invf_from, 0) FROM div WHERE code = @div

if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
begin
select @invoiceno=max(invoiceno)+1 from invheader 
end
Else 
begin
if @factored = 'N'
begin
	SET @maxInvno = @nonfactinv
	SET @minInvNo = @invfrom
end
else
begin
	SET @maxInvno = @factinv
	SET @minInvNo = @invf_from
end
end

SELECT @invoiceno = coalesce(Max(invheader.invoiceno),0) + 1 FROM invheader where invoiceno between  @minInvNo AND @maxInvno

if @invoiceno = 0 
begin
select @invoiceno=max(invoiceno)+1 from invheader
end

If @factored = 'N' 
begin
SET @invoiceno = dbo.InlineMax(@invfrom, @invoiceno)
end
else
begin
SET @invoiceno = dbo.InlineMax(@invf_from, @invoiceno)
end
if @invoiceno = 0 
begin
 SET @invoiceno = @nextInvoiceno
end

SELECT @orderno = isnull(orderno, 0) FROM pickheader WHERE pickno = @pickno
insert into invheader(invoiceno, pickno, orderno, invoicedate, shipdate, canceldate, customer, closed, custpo, user4, 
	blname, bladdr1, bladdr2, blcity, blstate, blzip, store, exchange_rate,
	shname, shaddr1, shaddr2, shcity, shstate, shzip, freight, memo , created_user, CREATED_DATE,create_date,
	misc, miscdesc, tax, shipvia, terms, user1, user2, user3, user5, season, box_mode, boxes,
	 volume, weight, dropship, salesrep1, salesrep2, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, vendorno, ref_event,  releaseno, 
	distri, discountdays, discountrate, INVH_discpercent, pricelevel, product_grp, phone, fax,contactno, warehouse,
	x_warehouse_date, ups_shipper, authorize_transtype, edi_po_type, bolno, inhouse_memo, shdept, memo_code,
	discountdate, merchandiser, REF_PHC, freight_cost, freight_published,cash_chk, factored,
	shipto_store, factor_approval, currency, taxagency, taxrate, wh_batch, billoflading, jcploadid, shipto754, 
	shipvia_ref, cust_div, facility_id, confirm_no, EDI_3PL, can_no, country, shcountry, companyname, shcompanyname,
	receipt_id, misc2, miscdesc2)

  select @invoiceno, @pickno, orderno, getdate(), shipdate, canceldate, customer,'N', custpo, isnull(user4,'A'),  
  	blname, bladdr1, bladdr2, blcity, blstate, blzip, store, exchange_rate, 
	shname, shaddr1, shaddr2, shcity, shstate, shzip,  isnull(freight,0), memo, 'SQL', getdate(), getdate(), 
	misc, miscdesc, tax, shipvia, terms, user1, user2, user3, user5, season, box_mode,	boxes,
	volume,weight, isnull(dropship,'N'), salesrep1, salesrep2, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, vendorno, ref_event,  releaseno, 
	distri, discountdays, discountrate, PICKH_DiscPercent, pricelevel, product_grp, phone, fax,contactno, isnull(warehouse,'00'), 
	x_warehouse_date, ups_shipper, authorize_transtype,isnull(edi_po_type,''), bolno, inhouse_memo, shdept, memo_code,
	discountdate, merchandiser, REF_PHC, freight_cost, freight_published,cash_chk, factored,
	shipto_store, factor_approval, currency, taxagency, taxrate, wh_batch, billoflading, jcploadid, shipto754, 
	shipvia_ref,  cust_div, facility_id, confirm_no, EDI_3PL, can_no, country, shcountry, companyname, shcompanyname,
	receipt_id, isnull(misc2,0.00), isnull(miscdesc2,'')
 from pickheader where pickno=@pickno 

insert into invdetail (invoiceno,  line, style, color, royaltor, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6,
	qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12, price, memo, PO1_UP, PO1_IN, PO1_CB, sodetail_id, orderno, 
	commpcnt1, commpcnt2, warehouse,cutdetail_id, cutno, actual_price, actual_cost, ordered_style, 
	ordered_color, org_qty1, org_qty2, org_qty3, org_qty4, org_qty5, org_qty6, org_qty7, org_qty8, 
	org_qty9, org_qty10, org_qty11, org_qty12, orig_price, packaging_code, packaging_descript, 
	packaging_type, prepack_code, prepack_qty, sku_cb, sku_in, INVD_DiscPercent, currency, exchange_rate,
	pickdetail_id, cost, Setid, carton_type, line_mode, msn_no, gift_from_name, gift_to_name, gift_message )
select @invoiceno,  line, style, color, isnull(royaltor,''),qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, 
	qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12, price, memo, PO1_UP, PO1_IN, po1_cb, sodetail_id, orderno,
	commpcnt1, commpcnt2, isnull(warehouse, '00'), cutdetail_id, cutno,actual_price, actual_cost, ordered_style, 
	ordered_color, org_qty1, org_qty2, org_qty3, org_qty4, org_qty5, org_qty6, org_qty7, org_qty8, org_qty9, 
	org_qty10, org_qty11, org_qty12, orig_price, packaging_code, packaging_descript, packaging_type, 
	prepack_code, prepack_qty, sku_cb, sku_in, PICKD_DiscPercent, currency, isnull(exchange_rate, 1), 
	pickdetail_id, cost, Setid, carton_type, line_mode, msn_no, gift_from_name, gift_to_name, gift_message
 from pickdetail where pickno =@pickno and isnull(closed,'N')='N'

select @total = sum(qty*price) from invdetail where invoiceno=@invoiceno
update invheader set subtotal=@total, total=@total + isnull(freight,0)+isnull(misc,0)+isnull(tax,0) where invoiceno=@invoiceno

UPDATE invhead_box SET invoiceno = @invoiceno WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(invoiceno, 0) = 0
UPDATE packlist SET invoiceno = @invoiceno WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(invoiceno, 0) = 0
/*191107 Arun added to update pickheader as closed */
update pickheader SET closed = 'Y', invoiceno = @invoiceno, invoicedate = getdate() WHERE pickno = @pickno
update pickdetail SET closed = 'Y' WHERE pickno = @pickno
UPDATE sodetail SET shipped_qty1 = isnull(shipped_qty1,0) + isnull(invdetail.qty1, 0), 
shipped_qty2 = isnull(shipped_qty2,0) + isnull(invdetail.qty2, 0) , 
shipped_qty3 = isnull(shipped_qty3, 0) + isnull(invdetail.qty3,0), 
shipped_qty4 = isnull(shipped_qty4,0) + isnull(invdetail.qty4, 0) ,
shipped_qty5 = isnull(shipped_qty5,0) + isnull(invdetail.qty5, 0), 
shipped_qty6 = isnull(shipped_qty6, 0) + isnull(invdetail.qty6, 0), 
shipped_qty7 = isnull(shipped_qty7,0) + isnull(invdetail.qty7, 0), 
shipped_qty8 = isnull(shipped_qty8, 0) + isnull(invdetail.qty8, 0), 
shipped_qty9 = isnull(shipped_qty9, 0) + isnull(invdetail.qty9, 0), 
shipped_qty10 = isnull(shipped_qty10, 0) + isnull(invdetail.qty10, 0), 
shipped_qty11 = isnull(shipped_qty11, 0) + isnull(invdetail.qty11, 0), 
shipped_qty12 = isnull(shipped_qty12, 0) + isnull(invdetail.qty12 ,0)--, 
--pick_qty1 = isnull(pick_qty1, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty1, 0), 
--pick_qty2 = isnull(pick_qty2, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty2, 0), 
--pick_qty3 = isnull(pick_qty3, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty3, 0), 
--pick_qty4 = isnull(pick_qty4, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty4, 0), 
--pick_qty5 = isnull(pick_qty5, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty5, 0), 
--pick_qty6 = isnull(pick_qty6, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty6, 0), 
--pick_qty7 = isnull(pick_qty7, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty7, 0), 
--pick_qty8 = isnull(pick_qty8, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty8, 0), 
--pick_qty9 = isnull(pick_qty9, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty9, 0), 
--pick_qty10 = isnull(pick_qty10, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty10, 0), 
--pick_qty11 = isnull(pick_qty11, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty11, 0), 
--pick_qty12 = isnull(pick_qty12, 0) - isnull(invdetail.qty12, 0)

FROM invdetail JOIN sodetail ON invdetail.sodetail_id = sodetail.sodetail_id WHERE invdetail.invoiceno = @invoiceno
AND invdetail.line > 1

exec [recalc_sodetail_pickedqty_orderno] @orderno

UPDATE sodetail SET CLOSED = 'Y' FROM invdetail JOIN sodetail ON invdetail.sodetail_id = sodetail.sodetail_id WHERE invdetail.invoiceno = @invoiceno
AND isnull(sodetail.qty, 0) <= isnull(sodetail.shipped_qty,0)
update soheader set shipped = (select sum(isnull(shipped_qty,0)) FROM sodetail WHERE sodetail.orderno = soheader.orderno) WHERE soheader.orderno = @orderno
update soheader set picked = (select sum(isnull(pick_qty,0)) FROM sodetail WHERE sodetail.orderno = soheader.orderno) WHERE soheader.orderno = @orderno

SELECT @Invoiceno 


create_new_ivtf_sample create procedure create_new_ivtf_sample 
as 
declare @newUPC nchar(13) 
select @newUPC = convert(decimal, max(upc)) + 1 from ivtf_sample 
insert into ivtf_sample (upc, code, color)  values ( @newUPC, 'NEW.CLONED' , '.' )
select @newUPC 

create_pick_from_salesorder 
/* procedure for ecommerce order to auto pick ticket */ 
/*221007 Arun - added dropship_tax2 for COLORADO tax for SAKS*/
/*211203 Arun - added dropship_misc, dropship_misc2 */
/*200428 Arun - added Country, Shcountry, companyname, shcompanyname*/
/*200319 Arun added AutoBox optional*/
/*200114 Arun added refno, cust_orderno*/
/*191010 Arun added some of the fields like Warehouse, x_warehouse_date, DiscPercent etc. */
/*190422 Arun added misc, miscdesc - sometimes shopify comes with discount */
/* 180115 dan - added calc of total, custpo, shipdate, canceldate, exchange_rate */ 
/*180521 Arun added created_date, created_user, pick_no */
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[create_pick_from_salesorder] (@orderno int, @autoBox int = null)
as 
declare @pickno int 
declare @total money , @orderid nvarchar(50) 
/*check if order has already been picked */
if exists(select pickno from pickheader WHERE orderno = @orderno) 
begin
return
end

select @pickno=max(pickno)+1 from pickheader 

insert into pickheader (pickno, orderno, pickdate, shipdate, canceldate, customer, closed, custpo, user4, 
	blname, bladdr1, bladdr2, blcity, blstate, blzip, store, exchange_rate,
	shname, shaddr1, shaddr2, shcity, shstate, shzip, priority_level, freight, memo , created_user, CREATED_DATE,create_date,
	misc, miscdesc, tax, shipvia, terms, user1, user2, user3, user5, season, box_mode, boxes,
	boxqty, volume, weight, dropship, salesrep1, salesrep2, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, vendorno, ref_event, REF_PHC, releaseno, 
	distri, discountdays, discountrate, PICKH_DiscPercent, pricelevel, product_grp, phone, fax,contactno, warehouse,
	x_warehouse_date, memo_code, refno, cust_orderno, country, shcountry, companyname, shcompanyname,receipt_id,
	misc2, miscdesc2, taxrate, prepay_refno, dropship_misc, dropship_misc2,
	dropship_tax2)
  select @pickno, @orderno, getdate(), shipdate, canceldate, customer,'N', custpo, isnull(user4,'A'),  
  	blname, bladdr1, bladdr2, blcity, blstate, blzip, store, exchange_rate, 
	shname, shaddr1, shaddr2, shcity, shstate, shzip, 5, isnull(freight,0), memo, created_user, getdate(), getdate(), 
	misc, miscdesc, tax, shipvia, terms, user1, user2, user3, user5, season, 1,0,
	0,0,0, isnull(dropship,'N'), salesrep1, salesrep2, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, vendorno, ref_event, REF_PHC, releaseno, 
	distri, discountdays, discountrate, soh_discPercent, pricelevel, product_grp, phone, fax,contactno, isnull(warehouse,'00'), 
	x_warehouse_date, memo_code, isnull(refno, ''), isnull(cust_orderno, ''), country, shcountry, companyname, shcompanyname,receipt_id,
	isnull(misc2,0.00), isnull(miscdesc2,''), isnull(taxrate,0.00), prepay_refno, isnull(dropship_misc,0.00), isnull(dropship_misc2,0.00),
	isnull(dropship_tax2,0.00)
 from soheader where orderno=@orderno 

if Not exists(select pickno from pickheader WHERE orderno = @orderno) 
begin
return
end

insert into pickdetail (pickno, line, style, color, royaltor, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6,
	qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12, price, memo, PO1_UP, PO1_IN, PO1_CB, sodetail_id, orderno, 
	commpcnt1, commpcnt2, warehouse,cutdetail_id, cutno, actual_price, actual_cost, ordered_style, 
	ordered_color, org_qty1, org_qty2, org_qty3, org_qty4, org_qty5, org_qty6, org_qty7, org_qty8, 
	org_qty9, org_qty10, org_qty11, org_qty12, orig_price, packaging_code, packaging_descript, 
	packaging_type, prepack_code, prepack_qty, sku_cb, sku_in, PICKD_DiscPercent, gift_message, item_memo, gift_to_name , gift_from_name)
select @pickno, line, style, color, isnull(royaltor,''),qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, 
	qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12, price, memo, PO1_UP, PO1_IN, po1_cb, sodetail_id, @orderno,
	commpcnt1, commpcnt2, isnull(warehouse, '00'), cutdetail_id, cutno,actual_price, actual_cost, ordered_style, 
	ordered_color, org_qty1, org_qty2, org_qty3, org_qty4, org_qty5, org_qty6, org_qty7, org_qty8, org_qty9, 
	org_qty10, org_qty11, org_qty12, orig_price, packaging_code, packaging_descript, packaging_type, 
	prepack_code, prepack_qty, sku_cb, sku_in, discpercent, gift_message, item_memo, gift_to_name , gift_from_name
	 from sodetail where orderno=@orderno and isnull(closed,'N')='N'

select @total = sum(qty*price) from pickdetail where pickno=@pickno
/*20210408 Arun added to check if it's from DSCO order, no need to apply discount and tax again, since 
it's already been applied in the retailers website. Refer Ticket# 12059*/
SELECT @orderid = isnull(orderid, '') FROM soheader WHERE orderno = @orderno

If Exists(Select order_id FROM Ecommerce_Orders WHERE ecomm_platform = 'DSCO' and order_id = @orderid)
begin
	update pickheader set subtotal=@total, total=@total  where pickno=@pickno 
End
else
begin
	update pickheader set subtotal=@total, total=@total + isnull(freight,0)+isnull(misc,0)+isnull(tax,0) where pickno=@pickno 
end

update sodetail set pick_qty1=qty1, pick_qty2=qty2, pick_qty3=qty3, pick_qty4=qty4,  pick_qty5=qty5, pick_qty6=qty6,  
pick_qty7=qty7, pick_qty8=qty8,  pick_qty9=qty9, pick_qty10=qty10,  pick_qty11=qty11, pick_qty12=qty12, pick_no = @pickno   
 where orderno=@orderno 
update soheader set picked=subtotal where orderno=@orderno 
/*200319 Arun added Auto Boxing */
declare @code_box nvarchar(20), @customer nvarchar(10), @storecode nvarchar(20)
declare @invhead_box_id int, @length decimal(8,3), @width decimal(8,3), @height decimal(8,3), @volume decimal(8,3),
@total_wt int, @boxqty int
if isnull(@autoBox,0) = 1
begin
	waitfor delay '00:00:03'
	SELECT @pickno = isnull(max(pickno),0) FROM pickheader WHERE orderno = @orderno
	SELECT @customer = customer, @storecode = isnull(store, '00') FROM pickheader WHERE pickno = @pickno
	if @pickno > 0 
	DELETE FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno AND invoiceno = 0 
	DELETE FROM packlist WHERE pickno = @pickno AND invoiceno = 0
	begin
	insert into packlist([line],[invoiceno],[store],[style],[color],[qty1],[qty2],[qty3],[qty4],[qty5]
           ,[qty6],[qty7],[qty8],[qty9],[boxno],[invhead_box_id],[pickno],[ordered_style],[ordered_color]
           ,[qty10],[qty11],[qty12],[royaltor],[PO1_IN],[multipick],[sodetail_id],[sku_cb],[prepack_code]
           ,[sku_in],[line_mode],[msn_no],[prepack_qty],[packaging_type],[packaging_code],[packaging_descript])
	(SELECT line, 0, @storecode, style, color, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, 1, 0, @pickno, 
		ordered_style, ordered_color, qty10, qty11, qty12, royaltor, po1_in, '', sodetail_id, sku_cb, 
		prepack_code, sku_in, line_mode, msn_no, prepack_qty, packaging_type,packaging_code,packaging_descript
		FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @orderno)
--SET @code_box = 'D1' 
SELECT @code_box = isnull(box_code,'') FROM customer WHERE code = LEFT(@customer,10)
if @code_box = '' 
begin
	SELECT @code_box = code FROM code_box WHERE isnull(default_box, 'N') = 'Y'
end
SELECT @length = length, @width = width , @height = height  FROM code_box WHERE code = @code_box
--SELECT @total_wt = ceiling(sum(isnull(Nullif(isnull(ivtf.weight,0),0),1))) FROM pickdetail 
--JOIN ivtf ON pickdetail.style = ivtf.code AND pickdetail.color = ivtf.color 
--AND isnull(pickdetail.royaltor, '') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor, '') and pickdetail.pickno = @pickno
SELECT @total_wt = SUM(ceiling(CASE WHEN isnull(ivtf.weight, 0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE ivtf.weight END))
FROM pickdetail JOIN ivtf ON pickdetail.style = ivtf.code AND pickdetail.color = ivtf.color 
AND isnull(pickdetail.royaltor, '') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor, '') and pickdetail.pickno = @pickno
if isnull(@total_wt,0) = 0
begin
SET @total_wt = 1
end
SET  @volume= Round(@length * @width * @height / 1728,2)
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[invhead_box]([invoiceno],[boxno],[weight],[store], [length],[width],[height],[begbox],[endbox]
           ,[pickno],[boxes],[volume],[code_box],[prepack_bk],[ucc128_no])
	VALUES(0, 1, @total_wt, @storecode, @length, @width, @height, 1, 1,
			@pickno, 1, @volume, @code_box, 'N', '')
	end
	SELECT @invhead_box_id = isnull(max(invhead_box_id),0) FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno
	UPDATE packlist SET invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id WHERE pickno = @pickno
	SELECT @boxqty = totalqty FROM uv_total_box_qty WHERE pickno = @pickno 
	UPDATE pickheader SET boxqty = @boxqty , weight = @total_wt, boxes = 1, volume = @volume, totqty = @boxqty WHERE pickno = @pickno
end
/*20210225 run commented to not do Auto Print as Timmy Slack*/

delete_cartitem CREATE procedure [dbo].[delete_cartitem]
(

@Rowid int=NULL,
--@email1 nvarchar(50), 
@isdeleteall char(1)='N',
 @custcode nvarchar(10),
 @storecode nvarchar(10)
)
as
Begin
declare @overallqty int
declare @overallamt decimal

if @isdeleteall='N'
begin
delete from cart where Rowid = @Rowid and customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
select @overallqty = COALESCE(sum(totalqty),0),@overallamt = COALESCE(sum(totalprice),0) from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
update cart set overallqty = @overallqty, overallamt = @overallamt where  customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
end

else
begin
delete from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
end
End


delete_cartitems 

CREATE procedure [dbo].[delete_cartitems]
(

@Rowid int=NULL,
@email1 nvarchar(50), 
@isdeleteall char(1)='N'
)
as
Begin
declare @overallqty int
declare @overallamt decimal

if @isdeleteall='N'
begin
delete from cart where Rowid = @Rowid and email1 = @email1
select @overallqty = COALESCE(sum(totalqty),0),@overallamt = COALESCE(sum(totalprice),0) from cart where email1 = @email1
update cart set overallqty = @overallqty, overallamt = @overallamt where email1 = @email1 
end

else
begin
delete from cart where email1 = @email1
end
End







delete_cartitemscs create procedure [dbo].[delete_cartitemscs]
(

@Rowid int=NULL,
--@email1 nvarchar(50), 
@isdeleteall char(1)='N',
 @custcode nvarchar(10),
 @storecode nvarchar(10)
)
as
Begin
declare @overallqty int
declare @overallamt decimal

if @isdeleteall='N'
begin
delete from cart where Rowid = @Rowid and customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
select @overallqty = COALESCE(sum(totalqty),0),@overallamt = COALESCE(sum(totalprice),0) from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
update cart set overallqty = @overallqty, overallamt = @overallamt where  customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
end

else
begin
delete from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
end
End


delete_order_detail CREATE PROCEDURE delete_order_detail(@orderno int ) AS

/* declare cursor to loop */
declare order_curs cursor for
	select sodetail_id
	from sodetail
	where orderno = @orderno
	for read only

/* local variable to hold columns returned from cursor */
declare @sodetail_id int

/* open the cursor and loop it!! */
open order_curs
fetch order_curs into @sodetail_id

while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin
	/* do your thing .. */
	delete sodetail where sodetail_id = @sodetail_id

	/* fetch next row */
	fetch order_curs into @sodetail_id     
end

/* clean up */
close order_curs
deallocate order_curs

entry_ivtf 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[entry_ivtf] (@from_userdate nchar(25), @to_userdate nchar(25), @xuserid nchar(10) )
as
select code,color,descript,sku,user4,grp,category,season,division, 
sewing=(select cost from bom where style_code=ivtf.code and style_color=ivtf.color and raw_code='SEWING' and BOMkey=1 ), created_user, created_date  from ivtf 
where (created_date between @from_userdate and @to_userdate) and rtrim(created_user) like rtrim(@xuserid)+'%'
order by code, color

entry_ivtr 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[entry_ivtr] (@from_userdate nchar(25), @to_userdate nchar(25), @xuserid nchar(10) ) as
select type,code,color,descript,fabcontent, actualwidth, 
vendor1, vendpart1, vendcolor1, cost1, stdcost, 
leadtime, min_production, count_of_origin , created_user, created_date
from ivtr 
where (created_date between @from_userdate and @to_userdate) and rtrim(created_user) like rtrim(@xuserid)+'%'
order by code,color

FactoryIOS_code_sku create procedure FactoryIOS_code_sku (@vendor nchar(10))
as
select sku, style, color, isnull(pack1,0) as pack1, isnull(pack2,0) as pack2, isnull(pack3,0) as pack3, 
				isnull(pack4,0) as pack4, isnull(pack5,0) as pack5, isnull(pack6,0) as pack6,
			isnull(pack7,0) as pack7, isnull(pack8,0) as pack8, isnull(pack9,0) as pack9, 
			isnull(pack10,0) as pack10, isnull(pack11,0) as pack11, isnull(pack12,0) as pack12, 
			size_desc, isnull(date_created, getdate()) as date_created 
	 from code_sku 
	 where style in 
	(select cutdetail.style from cutdetail join cutheader on cutdetail.cutno=cutheader.cutno 
		where cutheader.contractor=@vendor)

fix_invheader_subtotal create procedure fix_invheader_subtotal as
update invheader set subtotal=(select sum(qty*price) from invdetail where invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno) ,
 total= isnull(misc,0)+isnull(tax,0)+isnull(freight,0)+(select sum(qty*price) from invdetail where invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno)
 where subtotal <> (select sum(qty*price) from invdetail where invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno) 

fix_pickheader_subtotal create procedure fix_pickheader_subtotal as
update pickheader set subtotal=(select sum(qty*price) from pickdetail where pickno=pickheader.pickno) ,
 total= isnull(misc,0)+isnull(tax,0)+isnull(freight,0)+(select sum(qty*price) from pickdetail where 
	pickno=pickheader.pickno)
 where subtotal <> (select sum(qty*price) from pickdetail where pickno=pickheader.pickno) 

fix_sample_image_to_style_master 

/* 2002dan.sql */

/* blank out the style,color from ivtf_image those that came from sample master */ 
create procedure fix_sample_image_to_style_master as 
update ivtf_image set style='', color='' 
 where sample_upc in (
select sample_upc
from ivtf_image join 
   ivtf_sample on ivtf_image.sample_upc = ivtf_sample.upc 
   where ivtf_image.style<>ivtf_sample.customer_style )

fix_soheader_subtotal create procedure fix_soheader_subtotal as
update soheader set total=(select sum(qty*price) from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno),
    subtotal=( select sum(qty) from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno )
   
 where total <> (select sum(qty*price) from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno) or 
 	subtotal <> ( select sum(qty) from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno )

Update Code_DataSet set is_itradeshow='Y' where isnull(is_itradeshow,'N')='N' 
Update store set is_ios='Y' where isnull(is_ios,'N')='N' 
Update customer set is_web='Y' where isnull(is_web,'N')='N' 






GenerateBSKU CREATE PROC GenerateBSKU 
AS
declare @style nchar(13)
declare @color nchar(12)
declare @royaltor nchar(10)

delete from code_sku where custid='BSKU'

DECLARE con_curs CURSOR FOR
	SELECT code, color, isnull(royaltor,''), isnull(b_sku1,''), isnull(b_sku2,''), isnull(b_sku3,''), isnull(b_sku4,''), isnull(b_sku5,''),

	FOR READ ONLY  

OPEN con_curs
FETCH con_curs INTO @style, @color, @royaltor, @sku1, @sku2, @sku3, @sku4, @sku5, @sku6, @sku7, @sku8, @sku9, @sku10, @sku11, @sku12  

-- loop until meet end of selected row
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN

		if @sku4<>''

Gerber_image_get 
create procedure Gerber_image_get as
/* declare cursor to loop */
declare code_curs cursor for
	select code	from ivtf where color='.' 
	    for read only

/* local variable to hold columns returned from cursor */
declare @code  nchar(13)
declare @imagetype nchar(4) 
declare @image_size int
declare @imageserialnumber int 
declare @cnt int

/* open the cursor and loop it!! */
open code_curs
fetch code_curs into @code 

select @cnt = 0
while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin
	/* do your thing .. */


	select @imageserialnumber=0
	select @imagetype=upper(right(RepFileName,4)) , @imageserialnumber= imageserialnumber  
			 from WebPDM_DZ..PPFImages where imageserialnumber in
				(select min(ImageSerialNumber) from WebPDM_DZ..VPPFIMAGELINKS
				   where folderpage in 
				(select folderID from WebPDM_DZ..FolderHeaders where style = @code ) )

	if @imagetype='.JPG' and @imageserialnumber<>0 
		update ivtf_image set 
		style_image1 = (select imageBLOB from WebPDM_DZ..PPFRepresentatives where imageserialnumber=@imageserialnumber ),
		image_size1 =(select imageSize from WebPDM_DZ..PPFRepresentatives where imageserialnumber=@imageserialnumber ) 
		where style=@code 

	if @imagetype='.WMF' and @imageserialnumber<>0 
		update ivtf_image set 
		style_image1 = (select imageBLOB from WebPDM_DZ..PPFThumbnails where imageserialnumber=@imageserialnumber ),
		image_size1 =(select imageSize from WebPDM_DZ..PPFThumbnails where imageserialnumber=@imageserialnumber ) 
		where style=@code 		

	/* select @code */
	select @cnt = @cnt + 1

	/* fetch next row */
	fetch code_curs into @code
end

/* clean up */
close code_curs

select @cnt
deallocate code_curs

GetGeoDetails 

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetGeoDetails] 
(
@ZipCode varchar(10)
)
AS

     Declare @Object as Int;
Declare @ResponseText as Varchar(8000);
Declare @serviceUrl as varchar(500)
  set @serviceUrl = 'http://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/xml?address=' + @ZipCode 
Exec sp_OACreate 'MSXML2.XMLHTTP', @Object OUT;
Exec sp_OAMethod @Object, 'open', NULL, 'get',
                @serviceUrl, --Your Web Service Url (invoked)
                 'false'
Exec sp_OAMethod @Object, 'send'
Exec sp_OAMethod @Object, 'responseText', @ResponseText OUTPUT

Declare @Response as XML

--Select @ResponseText as XMLList

SET @Response = CAST(@ResponseText AS XML);

  Declare @Status as varchar(20)
   Declare @City as varchar(20)
   Declare @State as varchar(20)
   Declare @Country as varchar(20)
   Declare @Result as varchar(20)
   Declare @Lat as varchar(20)
   Declare @Lng as varchar(20)
   Declare @formatted_address as varchar(200)
   Declare @CheckNull6 as varchar(10)
   Declare @CheckNull5 as varchar(10)
  set @Status= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/status)[1]', 'varchar(20)') 
  
  print @Status

  set @CheckNull6=@Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[6]', 'varchar(20)') 
  set @CheckNull5=@Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[5]', 'varchar(20)') 
  
  if(@Status='ZERO_RESULTS')

   Begin

                     set @Result=@Status
   End
   else

   Begin   
   
   if(@CheckNull6 is null)
   begin

   if(@CheckNull5 is null)
   begin
		set @City= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[2]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @State= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[3]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @Country= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[4]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @Lat= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/geometry/location/lat)[1]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @Lng= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/geometry/location/lng)[1]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @formatted_address= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/formatted_address)[1]', 'varchar(200)') 		
   end
   else
   begin
		set @City= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[2]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @State= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[4]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @Country= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[5]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @Lat= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/geometry/location/lat)[1]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @Lng= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/geometry/location/lng)[1]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @formatted_address= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/formatted_address)[1]', 'varchar(200)') 		
   end
		
   end

   else
   begin
		set @City= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[3]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @State= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[5]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @Country= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/address_component/short_name)[6]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @Lat= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/geometry/location/lat)[1]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @Lng= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/geometry/location/lng)[1]', 'varchar(20)') 
		set @formatted_address= @Response.value('(GeocodeResponse/result/formatted_address)[1]', 'varchar(200)') 		
   end
   
   End
   
 select @Status as [Status], @City as City,@State as [State],@Country as Country,@Lat as Latitude,@Lng as Longitude, @formatted_address as [Formatted_Address]

GetImagesPageWise CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetImagesPageWise]
--[dbo].[GetImagesPageWise] 2, 10, null
	@PageIndex INT 
   ,@PageSize INT
 ,@grp nvarchar(20)
 ,@category  nvarchar(20)
  ,@customer nvarchar(40)
  ,@fromprice nvarchar(40)
    ,@toprice nvarchar(40)
	,@color as colortable readonly
  ,@filter char(1)
   ,@PageCount INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN	
-- This is for to work with array
--create type colortable as table
--(
--      color nvarchar(200)
--);
--go
-- Created By Raja on 02/14/14  for fetching the Records on Page wise
create table #Results  (Rownumber int,id int,code char(50),descript char(80),price2 decimal(10,2),searchfrom char(500))

Declare @var1 char(100)
Declare @clgrp char(100)
Declare @clctg char(100)
Declare @frompriceclm nchar(1000)
Declare @topriceclm nchar(1000)
declare @sqll nvarchar(1000)

	DECLARE @price nvarchar(10)
	if (@customer <> 'N/A')
	begin
 select @price = (select case when customer.pricelevel='A' then 'price'  when customer.pricelevel='B' then 'priceb' when customer.pricelevel='C' then 'pricec' when customer.pricelevel='D' then 'priced' when customer.pricelevel='E' then 'pricee' when customer.pricelevel='F' then 'pricef' else 'price' end as price from customer where customer.code=@customer)
 print @price
 end
 else
 begin
set @price = 'price'
end

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
set @var1 = 'view_list_styleonly.'+ rtrim(@price)
set @clgrp = 'view_list_styleonly.grp=''' + @grp 
set @clctg = 'view_list_styleonly.category=''' + @category
set @frompriceclm = rtrim(@var1) + '>=' + rtrim(@fromprice)
set @topriceclm = rtrim(@var1) + '<=' + rtrim(@toprice)
if @filter = 'Y'
begin

	insert into #Results(RowNumber,id,code,descript,price2) select  distinct ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by view_list.code desc ) AS RowNumber,id,code,descript,price as price2
from view_list where color in (SELECT color FROM @color) and grp=@grp  and category=@category and price >= @fromprice and price <= @toprice 
end
else if @filter = 'N'
begin
set @sqll = ' SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER 
            (
                 order by view_list_styleonly.code desc
            )AS RowNumber,' + 
      'view_list_styleonly.id,rtrim(view_list_styleonly.code) as code,view_list_styleonly.descript,convert(decimal(10,2),' + rtrim(@var1) + ')' + 'as price2,'''' as ''searchfrom''' +
	  
    'from view_list_styleonly where 1=1  and '+ rtrim(@clgrp) + ''' and '+ rtrim(@clctg) +'''and ' + rtrim(@frompriceclm) + ' and ' + @topriceclm + 'order by view_list_styleonly.code desc'
	insert #Results
	EXEC sp_executesql @sqll
	--exec(@sqll)
	print @sqll
End

	DECLARE @RecordCount INT
    SELECT @RecordCount = COUNT(*) FROM #Results 
	print @RecordCount
	SET @PageCount = CEILING(CAST(@RecordCount AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) / CAST(@PageSize AS DECIMAL(10, 2)))
    PRINT    @PageCount
           
    SELECT * FROM #Results 
    WHERE  RowNumber BETWEEN(@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1 AND(((@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1) + @PageSize) - 1
     
  DROP TABLE #Results
END

iConsumer_CreateCustomer CREATE PROCEDURE iConsumer_CreateCustomer
@email1 nchar(50),
@web_password nchar(12),
@name nchar(30),
@addr1 nchar(30),
@addr2 nchar(30),
@city nchar(20),
@state nchar(3),
@zip nchar(10),
@card nchar(30),
@csv char(5),
@credit_expdate char(5),
@card2 nchar(30),
@csv2 char(5),
@credit_expdate2 char(5),
@usePrimaryCard char(1) , 
@mobileno char(15) = NULL,
@provider char(10) = NULL  
AS
BEGIN

	declare @CustomerID int 

	if not exists ( select code from store where web_user=@email1 ) 
	BEGIN  
		select  @CustomerID = max(convert(integer,code))+1 from customer where isnumeric(code)=1
		if @credit_expdate='' 
			select @credit_expdate = '01/01/00'
		if @credit_expdate2=''
			select @credit_expdate2 = '01/01/00'

		INSERT INTO customer(code, name, contact1, addr1, addr2, state, city, country, zip, web_password, default_wh, email1, status, user4, shipvia, currency,
			credit_cardno, creditcard_csv, credit_expdate, credit_cardno2, creditcard_csv2, credit_expdate2,
			creditcard_name, creditcard_addr, creditcard_zip, creditcard_default, 
			creditcard_name2, creditcard_addr2, creditcard_zip2, creditcard_default2, phone2,  terms   
			 )
		VALUES
		(@CustomerID, @name, @name, @addr1, @addr2, @state, @city, 'USA', @zip, @web_password, '00', @email1, 'A', 'I', '5FEDEX', 'USD',
			@card, @csv, '01/'+@credit_expdate, @card2, @csv2, '01/'+@credit_expdate2,
			@name, @addr1, @zip, case when @usePrimaryCard='P' then 'Y' else 'N' end, 
			@name, @addr1, @zip, case when @usePrimaryCard<>'P' then 'Y' else 'N' end , @mobileno, 'C'
		) 
	END 

	select @CustomerID = max(customer) from store where web_user=@email1 and web_password=@web_password 
	if @CustomerID is null
		select '0000' as SQLResult_CustomerID
	else 
		select @customerID as SQLResult_CustomerID 
END

iConsumer_getTaxRate 
create procedure [dbo].[iConsumer_getTaxRate] @taxAgency char(4)
AS
BEGIN
 declare @taxpercent money
 select @taxpercent = isnull(taxpercent,0) from TaxAgency where code=@taxAgency
 select isnull(@taxpercent,0.00) as SQLTaxRate
END



iConsumer_GetUser create procedure iConsumer_GetUser
@email1 nchar(50)
AS
BEGIN
  declare @password nchar(12), @customerID char(10) 

  select @customerID=customer, @password=web_password from store where web_user=@email1 and code='00'
  if @customerID is null
	select @customerID='0000', @password='' 

  select @customerID as SQLGetUser_CustomerID, @password as SQLGetUser_Password 

END

iConsumer_GetUser2 Create procedure [dbo].[iConsumer_GetUser2]
@email1 nchar(50), @password nchar(12) 
AS
BEGIN
  declare @customerID char(10) 

  select customer as Cust_code, isnull(name,'') as Cust_name, isnull(addr1,'') as Cust_addr1, isnull(addr2,'') as Cust_addr2, 
	isnull(city,'') as Cust_city, isnull(state,'') as Cust_state, isnull(zip,'') as Cust_zip,
	isnull(phone2,'') as Cust_cellphone,taxagency,
	phone1,fax1
  from store where web_user=@email1 and web_password=@password 
END


iDashboardInvoices create procedure iDashboardInvoices as 
	select invoiceno, invoicedate, customer, invheader.salesrep1, 
	LTRIM(convert(char(10),total)) as total, customer.customer_logo  
			from invheader  left outer join customer on invheader.customer=customer.code 
			where invheader.user_date > dateadd(dd, -3, getdate()) 

iDashboardOrders create procedure iDashboardOrders as 
	select soheader.orderno, shipdate, customer, soheader.salesrep1, 
	LTRIM(convert(char(10),total)) as total, customer.customer_logo 
			from soheader left outer join customer on soheader.customer=customer.code 
	where soheader.CREATED_DATE > dateadd(dd, -3, getdate()) 

iDashboardOrdersDetail /* 170811 dan - also show the WebOrders */ 
create procedure [dbo].[iDashboardOrdersDetail] as 
	select top 7 DataSource='SO', created_date=soheader.created_date, 
	sodetail.style, sodetail.color, sodetail.qty, thumbnail1=v_ivtf_image_icon1.icon1 
		from sodetail join soheader on soheader.orderno=sodetail.orderno 
		left outer join v_ivtf_image_icon1 on sodetail.style=v_ivtf_image_icon1.code 
			and sodetail.color=v_ivtf_image_icon1.color 
	where convert(char(10),soheader.CREATED_DATE,21) >= convert(char(10), dateadd(dd, -1, getdate()),21)
	order by soheader.Created_date desc 

	/* select top 3 DataSource='HFC', created_date=soheader_hfc.orderdate, 
	sodetail_hfc.style, sodetail_hfc.color, sodetail_hfc.qty, thumbnail1=v_ivtf_image_icon1.icon1 
		from sodetail_hfc join soheader_hfc on soheader_hfc.orderno=sodetail_hfc.orderno 
		left outer join v_ivtf_image_icon1 on sodetail_hfc.style=v_ivtf_image_icon1.code 
			and sodetail_hfc.color=v_ivtf_image_icon1.color 
	where convert(char(10),soheader_hfc.orderdate,21) >= convert(char(10), dateadd(dd, -1, getdate()),21)
	order by created_date desc   */

   @email1 nvarchar(30),

 @size5 nvarchar(10),
   @size6 nvarchar(10),
    @size7 nvarchar(10),
   @size8 nvarchar(10),
    @size9 nvarchar(10),
   @size10 nvarchar(10),
    @size11 nvarchar(10),
   @size12 nvarchar(10),
   @quantity1 int,
   @quantity2 int,
   @quantity3 int,
   @quantity4 int,
   @quantity5 int,
   @quantity6 int,
   @quantity7 int,
   @quantity8 int,
   @quantity9 int,
   @quantity10 int,
   @quantity11 int,
   @quantity12 int,
   @totalqty int,
   @totalprice decimal(18,2),
   @pricetype nvarchar(10)
   ,@custcode nvarchar(10),
   @storecode nvarchar(10)
)
as 
Begin

declare @count int
declare @overallqty int
 declare  @rowid int
declare @overallamt decimal(18,2)

select @count = COALESCE(count(*),0) from cart  where email1 = @email1 and style = @style and color_code = @color_code and pricetype=@pricetype
if (@count > 0)
Begin 



update cart set 
UPrice = @UPrice,
size1 = (case when @size1 <> '' then @size1 else size1 end), 
size2 = (case when @size2 <> '' then @size2 else size2 end), 
size3 = (case when @size3 <> '' then @size3 else size3 end), 
size4 = (case when @size4 <> '' then @size4 else size4 end), 
size5 =(case when @size5 <> '' then @size5 else size5 end) , 
size6 = (case when @size6 <> '' then @size6 else size6 end), 
size7 = (case when @size7 <> '' then @size7 else size7 end), 
size8 = (case when @size8 <> '' then @size8 else size8 end), 
size9 = (case when @size9 <> '' then @size9 else size9 end),
size10 = (case when @size10 <> '' then @size10 else size10 end), 
size11 = (case when @size11 <> '' then @size11 else size11 end), 
size12 = (case when @size12 <> '' then @size12 else size12 end),
quantity1 = @quantity1 + quantity1,
quantity2 = @quantity2 + quantity2,
quantity3 = @quantity3 + quantity3,
quantity4 = @quantity4 + quantity4,
quantity5 = @quantity5 + quantity5,
quantity6 = @quantity6 + quantity6,
quantity7 = @quantity7 + quantity7,
quantity8 = @quantity8 + @quantity8,
quantity9 = @quantity9 + quantity9,
quantity10 = @quantity10 + quantity10,
quantity11 = @quantity11 + quantity11,
quantity12 = @quantity12 + quantity12,
totalqty = @totalqty + totalqty,
totalprice = @totalprice + totalprice 
from cart t1 where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode and style = @style and color_code = @color_code and pricetype=@pricetype


End

else
Begin

--select @rowid = COALESCE(count(*),0) from cart  where email1 = @email1 
select @rowid = COALESCE(count(*),0) from cart  where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode

insert into cart(email1,style,color,color_code,UPrice,size1,size2,size3,size4,size5,size6,size7,size8,size9,size10,size11,size12,
quantity1,quantity2,quantity3,quantity4,quantity5,quantity6,quantity7,quantity8,quantity9,quantity10,quantity11,quantity12,totalqty,
totalprice,pricetype,rowid,customer,store)
values(@email1,@style,@color,@color_code,@UPrice,@size1,@size2,@size3,@size4,@size5,@size6,@size7,@size8,@size9,@size10,@size11,@size12,
@quantity1,@quantity2,@quantity3,@quantity4,@quantity5,@quantity6,@quantity7,@quantity8,@quantity9,@quantity10,@quantity11,@quantity12,@totalqty,
@totalprice,@pricetype,@rowid + 1,@custcode,@storecode)


End

--select @overallqty = COALESCE(sum(totalqty),0),@overallamt = COALESCE(sum(totalprice),0) from cart where email1 = @email1 
  select @overallqty = COALESCE(sum(totalqty),0),@overallamt = COALESCE(sum(totalprice),0) from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode


--update cart set overallqty = @overallqty, overallamt = @overallamt where email1 = @email1 
update cart set overallqty = @overallqty, overallamt = @overallamt where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode
End


insertOrder 

CREATE procedure [dbo].[insertOrder]
(
@customer nvarchar(20),
@shaddress1 nvarchar(40),
@shaddress2 nvarchar(40),
@shcity nvarchar(20),
@shstate char(3),
@shzipcode nvarchar(15),
@bladdress1 nvarchar(40),
@bladdress2 nvarchar(40),
@blcity nvarchar(20),
@blstate char(3),
@blzipcode nvarchar(15),
@custpo nchar(20),
@memo ntext,
@shipdate datetime,
@canceldate datetime
--@overallamt decimal(18,2),
--@overallqty int
)
AS
begin


declare @orderno int
declare @subtotal decimal

select @orderno = isnull(max(orderno),0) + 1 from soheader_hfc

select @subtotal = sum(isnull(cart.quantity1,0)+isnull(cart.quantity2,0)+isnull(cart.quantity3,0)+isnull(cart.quantity4,0)+isnull(cart.quantity5,0)+isnull(cart.quantity6,0)+isnull(cart.quantity7,0)+
isnull(cart.quantity8,0)+isnull(cart.quantity9,0)+isnull(cart.quantity10,0)+isnull(cart.quantity11,0)+isnull(cart.quantity12,0)) from cart where cart.customer = @customer

insert into soheader_hfc(orderno,orderDate,customer,blname,bladdr1,bladdr2,blcity,blstate,country,blzip,shname,shaddr1,shaddr2,shcity,shstate,shcountry,shzip, 
phone,fax,store,total,closed,totalnum2,shipvia,freight,userid,custpo,memo,salesrep1,salesrep2,commpcnt1,commpcnt2,factored,user1,user2,user3,user4,user5,pricelevel,
memo_code,terms,warehouse,exchange_rate,shipdate,canceldate, subtotal
)

select top 1 @orderno,GETDATE(), @customer,customer.name, @bladdress1,@bladdress2,@blcity,@blstate,customer.country,@blzipcode,store.billname,@shaddress1,@shaddress2,@shcity,@shstate,customer.country,@shzipcode,
customer.phone1,customer.fax1,'00', A.overallamt,'H',A.overallqty,customer.shipvia,
0.00,userid,@custpo,@memo,customer.salesrep1,customer.salesrep2,customer.comm_rate1,customer.comm_rate2,factored,customer.user1,customer.user2,customer.user3,user4,user5,pricelevel,memo_code,terms,
store.warehouse,code_currency.conversion,@shipdate,@canceldate, @subtotal
 from (select top 1 overallamt, overallqty,email1 FROM cart) A,customer,store,code_currency
 where customer.code=store.customer and A.email1 = customer.email1 and store.customer= @customer and store.code = '00'     
 
 insert into sodetail_hfc(orderno,line,style,color,price, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,commpcnt1,commpcnt2,royaltor)
 select @orderno,rowid,style,color_code,cart.UPrice,cart.quantity1,cart.quantity2,cart.quantity3,cart.quantity4,cart.quantity5,cart.quantity6,cart.quantity7,cart.quantity8,cart.quantity9,
 cart.quantity10,cart.quantity11,cart.quantity12,customer.comm_rate1,customer.comm_rate2,ivtf.royaltor
 from cart,ivtf,customer where ivtf.code = cart.style and ivtf.color = cart.color_code and  customer.code = @customer and cart.email1 = ( select email1 from customer where code = @customer)

 delete from cart where email1 = ( select email1 from customer where code = @customer)

end

InsertUpdatePushNotifyDetails CREATE procedure [dbo].[InsertUpdatePushNotifyDetails]
@DeviceType nvarchar(50),
@DeviceToken nvarchar(max),
@LoginID nvarchar(50),
@App_Name nvarchar(max),
@IMME_Number bigint
As
Begin
if(select count(*) from [Push_NotifyDetails] where login_id=@LoginID and App_Name=@App_Name and IMME_Number=@IMME_Number)>0
begin
update [Push_NotifyDetails] set Device_Type=@DeviceType ,Device_Token=@DeviceToken where login_id=@LoginID and App_Name=@App_Name and IMME_Number=@IMME_Number 
end
else
begin
insert into [Push_NotifyDetails] (login_id,App_Name,IMME_Number,Device_Type,Device_Token)values(@LoginID,@App_Name,@IMME_Number,@DeviceType,@DeviceToken)
end
End
ios_add_ios_order CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ios_add_ios_order] (@style char(40), @voidreason char(1), @ios_device nchar(40), @qty char(6), @price char(10),
@customer char(10)=NULL,@item_memo varchar(200)=NULL,@sodetailid int=0,@WH varchar(2)='00')
 AS
/* save scanned items to table 'ios_order' to be later used to create either SalesOrder or CutTkt/PO */ 
BEGIN
	insert into ios_order (style,voidreason,ios_device,qty, price, posted, created,customer,item_memo,sodetail_id,warehouse) 
	values (@style , @voidreason , @ios_device , @qty, @price, 'N', getdate(),@customer,@item_memo,@sodetailid,@WH)
END
ios_CreateAccount create procedure ios_CreateAccount (@username char(20), @password char(20), @email char(100), 
	@UserType char(20), @FamilyName nchar(40), @GivenName nchar(40), @Employer nchar(40), 
	@WorkPhone char(15), @MobilePhone char(15), @AvatarImageBase64 varchar(max) ) 
AS
BEGIN
	if exists (select code from customer where code=left(@username,10) ) 
		select 0, 'Username already exists.' 
	else
		BEGIN
			insert into customer (code, web_password, email1, 
				title1, contact1, contact2, name, phone1, phone2, im_note1, user4  )
			values
				( LEFT(@username,10), @password, @email, 
				@UserType, @FamilyName, @GivenName, @Employer, @WorkPhone, @MobilePhone, @AvatarImageBase64,'A' )
			select 1, 'Account Created.' 
		END 
END

ios_createBoard 
/* 130425 dan - added created user populated to ivtf */ 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[ios_createBoard](@username char(20), @password char(20), @BoardName nchar(13), 
		@BoardDescription nchar(100), @BoardImageBase64 varchar(max) )  
AS
BEGIN
	insert into ivtf (code, color, user4, descript, long_desc, userid)
		values (@BoardName, '.', 'A', LEFT(@BoardDescription,50) , @BoardDescription, @username)

	insert into ivtf_image (style,color, id1, id2, type, royaltor) 
		values (@BoardName, '.', 1, 2, '.jpg', '')

	update ivtf_image set style_image1=dbo.f_Base64ToBinary(@BoardImageBase64), Thumbnail1=dbo.f_Base64ToBinary(@BoardImageBase64), icon1=dbo.f_Base64ToBinary(@BoardImageBase64)
		where style=@BoardName and color='.' 

	select ivtf_image_id from ivtf_image where style=@BoardName and color='.' 
END

ios_createContact create procedure ios_createContact (@username char(20), @password char(20),
		 @name nchar(30), @title nchar(30), @addr1 nchar(30), @addr2 nchar(30), @city nchar(20), @state nchar(3), @zip nchar(10),
		 @phone1 nchar(15), @phone2 nchar(15), @email nchar(40) , 
		 @AvatarBase64 varchar(max), @BusinessCardBase64 varchar(max) )  
AS
BEGIN	
		insert into contacts (code, name, title, addr1, addr2, city, state, zip, phone1, phone2, email , 
			businesscard1, businesscard2)
		values 
		(  upper(@username), @name , @title , @addr1 , @addr2 , @city , @state , @zip, @phone1 , @phone2 , @email ,  
			dbo.f_Base64ToBinary(@AvatarBase64), dbo.f_Base64ToBinary(@BusinessCardBase64)  )
		select max(contacts_id) from contacts 
END

ios_createImage CREATE procedure [dbo].[ios_createImage](@username char(20), @password char(20), @BoardID int, @description nchar(500),
		@ImageBase64 varchar(max) )
AS
BEGIN
	insert into ivtf_docs (style, doctype, code, description, object, filetype, filesize)
		 select code, 'GIGABASE', 'GIGABASE', left(@description,50) , dbo.f_Base64ToBinary(@ImageBase64), 'JPG', datalength(@ImageBase64)
		     from ivtf where id=@BoardID  
	 select max(ivtf_docs_id) As ivtf_docs_id  from ivtf_docs 
END

( @deviceno nchar(40) )

    deviceno=@deviceno and ISNULL(posted_flag,'N')='N'
    END

AS

END

AS
BEGIN
	delete from ivtf_docs where ivtf_docs_id = @ImageID 
	select 1 
END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[ios_Get_SpecSheet2] (@style nchar(25) = NULL) 
as

/* 160501 dan - moved 1st & 2nd image to top of list,  */ 
/* 160413 dan - added '		'$. Sales Order Docs' as spec41, */

/* 150727 dan - added '!Z. FitComment additional images ' option */

/* 150627 dan - added '7. Docs to Sample Master as AI/SVG' */
/* 150602 dan - added '5. QC Report to CutTicket', '6. Docs to Sample Master' */ 
/* 150324 dan - added option for the 4 stlye images */ 

declare @upc nchar(20)

if left(@style,1)='4' and len(@style)=11 and TRY_PARSE(@style as bigint) is not null 
	select @upc = upc, @style=code from ivtf_sample where upc=@style  
else		
	select @upc = max(upc) from ivtf_sample where code=@style

if not exists (select code from ivtf_sample where code=@style or upc=@style)
	select '1. 1st Main Image' as spec0, '2. 2nd Main Image' as spec1, spec2,spec3,spec4,spec5,spec6,spec7,spec8,spec9,spec10,spec11,spec12,

		'9. To BuySheet (enter Order# in Style# field)' as spec36, 
		'Z. Fit/Design Comment' as spec37,

		'@. QC Module' as spec43, 

		@style as style  
	from wfsystem2 
else 
  BEGIN

	select @mark2 = (case when datalength(isnull(spec_page2_thumbnail,0x))>100 then ' *' else '' end),

ios_getBoards CREATE procedure [dbo].[ios_getBoards](@username char(20), @password char(20) )
AS
BEGIN
	select id as BoardID, dbo.f_BinaryToBase64(ivtf_image.icon1) as BoardImageBase64,
			rtrim(isnull(descript,''))+' : '+ isnull(long_desc,'') as BoardDescription  
		from ivtf join ivtf_image on ivtf.code=ivtf_image.style and ivtf.color=ivtf_image.color 
		where ivtf.created_user=@username order by id desc
END

ios_getContacts create procedure ios_getContacts (@username char(20), @password char(20) ) 
AS
BEGIN
	select contacts_id as ContactID, name, title, addr1, addr2, city, state, zip, phone1, phone2, email , 
		dbo.f_BinaryToBase64(businesscard1) as AvatarBase64, dbo.f_BinaryToBase64(businesscard2) as BusinessCardBase64  
		from contacts where code=@username 
END

ios_getImage CREATE procedure [dbo].[ios_getImage] (@username char(20), @password char(20), @BoardID int)
AS
BEGIN
  select ivtf_docs.ivtf_docs_id as ImageID, ivtf_docs.description as ImageDescription, 
		dbo.f_BinaryToBase64(ivtf_docs.object) as ImageBase64    
    from ivtf join ivtf_docs on ivtf.code=ivtf_docs.style where ivtf.id = @BoardID  order by ivtf_docs_id desc 	
END

ios_invdetail 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ios_invdetail] 
(@line int, @style char(13), @color char(12), @qty1 int, @qty2 int, @qty3 int, @qty4 int,
  @qty5 int, @qty6 int, @qty7 int, @qty8 int,
  @qty9 int, @qty10 int, @qty11 int, @qty12 int,
  @price money, @voidreason char(10), @deviceno char(40), @customer char(10), @memo ntext ) 
AS 
BEGIN

 insert into invdetail_ios 
 ( line, style , color, qty1 , qty2 , qty3 , qty4 ,qty5 , qty6 , qty7 , 
 qty8 , qty9 , qty10 , qty11 , qty12 , price , voidreason , deviceno, customer, memo ) 
 values 
 ( @line, @style, @color , @qty1 , @qty2 , @qty3 , @qty4, @qty5 , @qty6 , @qty7 , 
  @qty8 ,@qty9 , @qty10 , @qty11 , @qty12 , @price , @voidreason , @deviceno, @customer,@memo  )

ios_invheader 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ios_invheader] 
(	@deviceno nchar(40), @customer char(10),
	@orderdate char(10), @shipdate char(10),
	@canceldate char(10), 
	@blname nchar(30), @bladdr1 nchar(30),
	@bladdr2 nchar(30), @blcity nchar(20),
	@blstate nchar(3),	@blzip nchar(10) ,
	@store nchar(10) ,	@shname nchar(30),
	@shaddr1 nchar(30) ,	@shaddr2 nchar(30) ,
	@shcity nchar(20) ,	@shstate nchar(3),
	@shzip nchar(10) ,	@phone nchar(15) ,
	@fax nchar(15) , @salesrep1 nchar(4) ,
	@custpo nchar(20) , @misc money ,
	@terms nchar(4) , @shipvia nchar(4) ,
	@memo nchar(500),  @businesscard varchar(max) , @signature varchar(max) , @user char(10) = NULL, @device_refno int = NULL) 
AS 
BEGIN
	declare @nextInvoiceno int 
	declare @checkInvoiceno int
	declare @count int
	declare @division nchar(1)
	declare @storecount int

	-- 130223 dan : signature and businesscard is received in base64 format, convert here. 
	select @nextInvoiceno = max(invoiceno)+1 from invheader 
	/* 8235 */ 

	/*140103 Arun:Check if Customer Code exists in Customer Table if not Insert Into Customer Table */
	SELECT @count = count(*) FROM customer WHERE code = @customer
	If @count = 0 
	BEGIN
	/*Check Default division , if multiples are checked Take the min */
	SELECT @division = min(code) FROM div WHERE isnull(default_div, 'N') = 'Y'
	/*Insert the Contacts as "iOS" . insert trigger tends to insert into Contacts table where code cannot be NULL */
	INSERT INTO CUSTOMER(code, name, addr1, addr2, city, state, zip, user4, contact1, terms, salesrep1, shipvia) values 
	(UPPER(@customer), UPPER(isnull(@blname, '')), UPPER(isnull(@bladdr1, '')), UPPER(isnull(@bladdr2, '')), UPPER(isnull(@blcity, '')), UPPER(isnull(@blstate, '')), isnull(@blzip, ''), UPPER(isnull(@division, 'A')), 'iOS', isnull(@terms, ''), UPPER(isnull(@salesrep1, '')), UPPER(isnull(@shipvia, '')))
	END

	If isnull(@store, '') <> '' 
	BEGIN
	SELECT @storecount = count(*) FROM store WHERE customer = @customer and code = @store
	IF @storecount = 0 
	BEGIN
	
	INSERT INTO STORE(customer, code, name, addr1, addr2, city, state, zip, shipvia) VALUES (UPPER(@customer), UPPER(isnull(@store, 00)), UPPER(isnull(@shname, '')),UPPER(isnull(@shaddr1, '')), UPPER(isnull(@shaddr2, '')), 
	UPPER(isnull(@shcity, '')), UPPER(isnull(@shstate, '')), isnull(@shzip, ''), UPPER(isnull(@shipvia, '')))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	UPDATE STORE SET name = UPPER(isnull(@shname, '')),addr1 = UPPER(isnull(@shaddr1,'')), addr2= UPPER(isnull(@shaddr2, '')), city = UPPER(isnull(@shcity, '')), state = UPPER(isnull(@shstate, '')), zip = isnull(@shzip, ''), shipvia=UPPER(isnull(@shipvia, ''))
	WHERE code = @store and CUSTOMER = @customer

	END
	END

	insert into invheader_ios 
	(	deviceno , customer ,
	invoicedate ,  shipdate ,
	canceldate , 
	blname ,   bladdr1 ,
	bladdr2 , blcity ,
	blstate ,	blzip ,
	store ,	shname ,
	shaddr1 ,	shaddr2 ,
	shcity ,	shstate ,
	shzip ,	phone ,
	fax , salesrep1 ,
	custpo , misc ,
	terms , shipvia ,
	memo, memo_char, businesscard, signature_base64, CREATED_USER, CREATED_DATE, device_refno) 
	values 
	(	replace(@deviceno,'''','') , @customer ,
	case when @orderdate='(null)' then getdate() else @orderdate end , 
	case when @shipdate='(null)' then getdate() else @shipdate end  ,
	case when @canceldate='(null)' then dateadd(dd,3,getdate()) else @canceldate end , 
	@blname , @bladdr1 ,
	@bladdr2 , @blcity ,
	@blstate ,	@blzip ,
	@store ,	@shname ,
	@shaddr1 ,	@shaddr2 ,
	@shcity ,	@shstate ,
	@shzip ,	@phone ,
	@fax , @salesrep1 ,
	@custpo , @misc ,
	@terms , @shipvia ,
	@memo, @memo, @businesscard, @signature, @user, getdate(), @device_refno) 

	/* return the orderno to calling program */ 
	/*  return -1 if not sucess */ 
	select @checkInvoiceno = max(invoiceno) from invheader 

	if @nextInvoiceno = @checkInvoiceno 
		select @nextInvoiceno as Orderno
	else
		select -1 as Orderno 

END



ios_login create PROCEDURE ios_login (@username char(20), @password char(20) )  
AS 
BEGIN
	
	if exists (select name from wfuser where name=@username and password=@password) 
		select 1
	else
		select 0 
END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[ios_SmartSearch]  @itemno char(40)  
AS
select  TOP 100 id, code,color,size1,size2,size3,size4,size5,size6,size7,size8,size9,size10,size11,size12,descript, price,Thumbnail1,washing_instruction1,media_url

	If @count = 0

if NOT (isnull(@shname,'')='' and isnull(@shaddr1,'')='' and isnull(@shaddr2,'')='' and isnull(@shcity,'')='' and isnull(@shstate,'')='' and isnull(@shzip,'')='')

		print @storecount

		IF @storecount = 0 

			BEGIN

				INSERT INTO STORE(customer, code, name, addr1, addr2, city, state, zip, shipvia) 

				VALUES (UPPER(@customer), UPPER(isnull(@store, 00)), UPPER(isnull(@shname, '')),

				UPPER(isnull(@shaddr1, '')), UPPER(isnull(@shaddr2, '')),

else

	insert into soheader_ios

ios_TotalNumberOfBoards CREATE procedure [dbo].[ios_TotalNumberOfBoards](@username char(20), @password char(20) ) 
AS
BEGIN
	select count(*) as TotalNumberOfBoards from ivtf join ivtf_image on ivtf.code=ivtf_image.style 
	and ivtf.color=ivtf_image.color where created_user=@username 
END

ios_TotalNumberOfImages CREATE procedure [dbo].[ios_TotalNumberOfImages](@username char(20), @password char(20) ) 
AS
BEGIN
	select count(*) as TotalNumberOfImages from ivtf join ivtf_docs on ivtf.code=ivtf_docs.style 
		 where ivtf.created_user=@username 
END

ios_UpdateAvatar create procedure ios_UpdateAvatar (@username char(20), @password char(20), @imageBase64 varchar(max) ) 
AS
BEGIN
	update customer set im_note1=@imageBase64  
		where code = @username  
	select 1 
END

ios_updateBoardTitleImage create procedure ios_updateBoardTitleImage (@username char(20), @password char(20), @BoardID int, @ImageBase64 varchar(max) )
AS
BEGIN
	update ivtf_image set style_image1=dbo.f_Base64ToBinary(@ImageBase64), Thumbnail1=dbo.f_Base64ToBinary(@ImageBase64)
		from ivtf where ivtf_image.style=ivtf.code and ivtf_image.color='.' and ivtf.id=@BoardID 
	select 1 
END

ios_updateContact create procedure ios_updateContact (@username char(20), @password char(20) ,
    @ContactID int, @name nchar(30), @title nchar(30), @addr1 nchar(30), @addr2 nchar(30), @city nchar(20), @state nchar(3), @zip nchar(10),
		 @phone1 nchar(15), @phone2 nchar(15), @email nchar(40) )
AS
BEGIN
	update contacts set name=@name, title=@title, addr1=@addr1, addr2=@addr2, city=@city, state=@state, zip=@zip, 
			phone1=@phone1, phone2=@phone2, email=@email  
		where contacts_id=@ContactID 
	select 1 
END

ios_updateContactAvatar create procedure ios_updateContactAvatar (@username char(20), @password char(20), @ContactID int, @AvatarImageBase64 varchar(max) )

BEGIN

		where contacts_id = @ContactID 
	select 1 
END

ios_updateImage create procedure ios_updateImage(@username char(20), @password char(20), @imageID int, @ImageBase64 varchar(max) ) 
AS
BEGIN
	update ivtf_docs set object=dbo.f_Base64ToBinary(@ImageBase64), filesize=datalength(@ImageBase64)
		 where ivtf_docs_id=@imageID 
	select 1 
END

	select 1 
END

iPDM_check_one_item 
/* 150725 dan - added 'Done' value parameter */ 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[iPDM_check_one_item] (@cutno int, @task nvarchar(20), @memo nvarchar(150)=NULL,  @donedate datetime = NULL, @done char(1)=NULL ) AS
if @donedate is NULL
	set @donedate = getdate() 
if @memo is NULL
	set @memo=''
if @done is NULL
	set @done='Y'

if @memo = '' 
BEGIN 
	update Webcutheaderpdm set date1=@donedate, status1=@done  where cutno=@cutno and heading1=@task 
	update Webcutheaderpdm set date2=@donedate, status2=@done where cutno=@cutno and heading2=@task 
	update Webcutheaderpdm set date3=@donedate, status3=@done where cutno=@cutno and heading3=@task

iPDM_check_one_item_color /* 150830 dan - by Color checking, created from [iPDM_check_one_item] */ 
create procedure [dbo].[iPDM_check_one_item_color] (@cutno int, @task nvarchar(20), @memo nvarchar(150)=NULL,  @donedate datetime = NULL, @done char(1)=NULL, @stylecolor nchar(30) ) AS
if @donedate is NULL
	set @donedate = getdate() 
if @memo is NULL
	set @memo=''
if @done is NULL
	set @done='Y'

BEGIN

iPDM_colors_tasks CREATE procedure [dbo].[iPDM_colors_tasks] ( @email varchar(100), @begDate date=NULL, @endDate date=NULL, @status char(2)=NULL, @styles nvarchar(500) )
as
/* @stats = 'YN' if want both Done and NotDone items */ 
/* set the default value to NULLable optional parameters */
select @begDate = isnull(@begDate, '1990-01-01')
select @endDate = isnull(@endDate, getdate() ) 
select @status = isnull(@status, 'N')  

select * from 
(
select Webcutdetailpdm.memo1 as task, Webcutheaderpdm.cutno, isnull(cutheader.contractor,'') as Vendor, 
isnull(cutheader.terms,'') as terms, convert(char(10),cutheader.completiondate,101) as inHouseDate,  
isnull(cutheader.customer,'') as Customer, rtrim(isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.style,''))+' / '+rtrim(isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.color,'')) as StyleCutHead, 
convert(char(10),Webcutdetailpdm.date1,101) as DueDate, isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.note1,'') as Note, Webcutdetailpdm.status1 as donestatus ,
convert(char(10),cutheader.duedate,101) as xFactory
from Webcutheaderpdm join cutheader on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=cutheader.cutno 
					 join Webcutdetailpdm on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=Webcutdetailpdm.cutno 
where ( Webcutdetailpdm.memo1 in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and 
	cutheader.customer=(case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end) and
	cutheader.contractor=(case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end) and
	cutheader.merchandiser_header=(case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' then cutheader.merchandiser_header else PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser end) )
   or '*' in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and 
	cutheader.customer=(case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end) and
	cutheader.contractor=(case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end) and
	cutheader.merchandiser_header=(case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' then cutheader.merchandiser_header else PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser end) )
)
and Webcutdetailpdm.DATE1 between @begDate and @endDate AND isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.memo1,'')<>'' and 
	charindex(Webcutdetailpdm.status1,@status)>0 and isnull(webcutheaderpdm.closed,'N')<>'Y' and CHARINDEX(cutheader.style_header, @styles)>0 
UNION
select Webcutdetailpdm.memo2 as task, Webcutheaderpdm.cutno, isnull(cutheader.contractor,'') as Vendor, 
isnull(cutheader.terms,'') as terms, convert(char(10),cutheader.completiondate,101) as inHouseDate,  
isnull(cutheader.customer,'') as Customer, rtrim(isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.style,''))+' / '+rtrim(isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.color,'')) as StyleCutHead, 
convert(char(10),Webcutdetailpdm.date2,101) as DueDate, isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.note2,'') as Note, Webcutdetailpdm.status2 as donestatus ,
convert(char(10),cutheader.duedate,101) as xFactory
from Webcutheaderpdm join cutheader on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=cutheader.cutno 
					 join Webcutdetailpdm on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=Webcutdetailpdm.cutno 
where ( Webcutdetailpdm.memo2 in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and 
	cutheader.customer=(case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end) and
	cutheader.contractor=(case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end) and
	cutheader.merchandiser_header=(case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' then cutheader.merchandiser_header else PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser end) )
   or '*' in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and 
	cutheader.customer=(case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end) and
	cutheader.contractor=(case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end) and
	cutheader.merchandiser_header=(case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' then cutheader.merchandiser_header else PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser end) )
)
and Webcutdetailpdm.DATE2 between @begDate and @endDate AND isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.memo2,'')<>'' and 
	charindex(Webcutdetailpdm.status2,@status)>0 and isnull(webcutheaderpdm.closed,'N')<>'Y' and CHARINDEX(cutheader.style_header, @styles)>0 
UNION
select Webcutdetailpdm.memo3 as task, Webcutheaderpdm.cutno, isnull(cutheader.contractor,'') as Vendor, 
isnull(cutheader.terms,'') as terms, convert(char(10),cutheader.completiondate,101) as inHouseDate,  
isnull(cutheader.customer,'') as Customer, rtrim(isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.style,''))+' / '+rtrim(isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.color,'')) as StyleCutHead, 
convert(char(10),Webcutdetailpdm.date3,101) as DueDate, isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.note3,'') as Note, Webcutdetailpdm.status3 as donestatus ,
convert(char(10),cutheader.duedate,101) as xFactory
from Webcutheaderpdm join cutheader on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=cutheader.cutno 
					 join Webcutdetailpdm on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=Webcutdetailpdm.cutno 
where ( Webcutdetailpdm.memo3 in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and 
	cutheader.customer=(case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end) and
	cutheader.contractor=(case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end) and
	cutheader.merchandiser_header=(case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' then cutheader.merchandiser_header else PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser end) )
   or '*' in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and 
	cutheader.customer=(case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end) and
	cutheader.contractor=(case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end) and
	cutheader.merchandiser_header=(case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' then cutheader.merchandiser_header else PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser end) )
)
and Webcutdetailpdm.DATE2 between @begDate and @endDate AND isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.memo2,'')<>'' and 
	charindex(Webcutdetailpdm.status2,@status)>0 and isnull(webcutheaderpdm.closed,'N')<>'Y' and CHARINDEX(cutheader.style_header, @styles)>0 
UNION
select Webcutdetailpdm.memo4 as task, Webcutheaderpdm.cutno, isnull(cutheader.contractor,'') as Vendor, 
isnull(cutheader.terms,'') as terms, convert(char(10),cutheader.completiondate,101) as inHouseDate,  
isnull(cutheader.customer,'') as Customer, rtrim(isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.style,''))+' / '+rtrim(isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.color,'')) as StyleCutHead, 
convert(char(10),Webcutdetailpdm.date4,101) as DueDate, isnull(Webcutdetailpdm.note4,'') as Note, Webcutdetailpdm.status4 as donestatus ,
convert(char(10),cutheader.duedate,101) as xFactory
from Webcutheaderpdm join cutheader on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=cutheader.cutno 
					 join Webcutdetailpdm on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=Webcutdetailpdm.cutno 
where ( Webcutdetailpdm.memo4 in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and

iPDM_email_user 

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iPDM_email_user] ( @email varchar(100) ) AS
declare @mybody nvarchar(max)
select @mybody = dbo.f_iPDM_users_tasks( @email, dateadd(dd,-60,getdate()), getdate(),  'N')   
EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail 
	@recipients =  @email, 
	@subject = 'iPDM Past Due Items', 
	@body = @mybody , 
	@body_format = 'HTML'

iPDM_email_user_daily 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iPDM_email_user_daily] ( @email varchar(100) ) AS
declare @mybody nvarchar(max)
declare @subject1 nvarchar(max)

	select @mybody = '<p  style="color: #ffffff; background-color: #ff0000">DONE TODAY:</p>'+dbo.f_iPDM_users_tasks(@email,getdate(),dateadd(dd,1,getdate()),'Y')   
	select @mybody = @mybody+'<p style="color: #ffffff; background-color: #ff0000"> NEXT 7 DAYS:</p>'+dbo.f_iPDM_users_tasks(@email, getdate(), dateadd(dd,7,getdate()),'N')  
	select @mybody = @mybody+'<p style="color: #ffffff; background-color: #ff0000"> PAST DUE:</p>'+dbo.f_iPDM_users_tasks(@email,dateadd(dd,-60,getdate()),getdate(),'N') 
	
	DECLARE con_curs3 CURSOR FOR
	select company + '-' + ' iPDM Daily Summary' from div where company = (select min(company) from div)  
	FOR READ ONLY
	OPEN con_curs3
FETCH con_curs3 INTO @subject1
CLOSE con_curs3
DEALLOCATE con_curs3


EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail 
	@recipients =  @email, 	
	@subject = @subject1 , 
	@body = @mybody , 
	@body_format = 'HTML'
