iPDM_email_user_task_action 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iPDM_email_user_task_action] (@taskitem nchar(25), @cutno nchar(10), @style nchar(13),
	@div nchar(1), @customer nchar(10), @note nchar(100)  ) 
AS
/* 150711 dan - made into 'TEXT' format, instead of 'HTML' due to SMS */ 
declare @bodytext nchar(500)
declare @emails nvarchar(max) 
declare @oneRowEmails nvarchar(max) 

select @emails='', @oneRowEmails='' 

DECLARE con_curs CURSOR FOR
	select instant_email from PDMTask_notifications where code=@taskitem 
	and (div=(select user4 from cutheader where cutno=@cutno) or div='*') 
	and (customer=(select customer from cutheader where cutno=@cutno) or customer='*') 
	FOR READ ONLY
OPEN con_curs
FETCH con_curs INTO @oneRowEmails

-- loop until meet end of selected row
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN 
		select @emails = @emails + @oneRowEmails +';' 
		FETCH con_curs INTO @oneRowEmails
	END
CLOSE con_curs
DEALLOCATE con_curs

if isnull(@emails,'')<>'' 
BEGIN
	select @bodytext =  RTRIM(isnull(@taskitem,'')) +'| Cut#'+RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(8),isnull(@cutno,'0')))+'|Style:'+
		RTRIM(isnull(@style,'')) +'|Customer:'+RTRIM(isnull(@customer,''))+'|Note:'+RTRIM(isnull(@note,''))  
	EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail 
	@recipients =  @emails, 
	@subject = 'Task Done', 
	@body = @bodytext, 
	@body_format = 'TEXT' 
END 

iPDM_styles_tasks CREATE procedure [dbo].[iPDM_styles_tasks] ( @email varchar(100), @begDate date=NULL, @endDate date=NULL, @status char(2)=NULL, @styles nvarchar(500) )
as
/* @stats = 'YN' if want both Done and NotDone items */ 
/* set the default value to NULLable optional parameters */
select @begDate = isnull(@begDate, '1990-01-01')
select @endDate = isnull(@endDate, getdate() ) 
select @status = isnull(@status, 'N')  

select * from 
(select Webcutheaderpdm.heading1 as task, Webcutheaderpdm.cutno, isnull(cutheader.contractor,'') as Vendor, 
isnull(cutheader.terms,'') as terms, convert(char(10),cutheader.completiondate,101) as inHouseDate,  
isnull(cutheader.customer,'') as Customer, isnull(cutheader.style_header,'') as StyleCutHead, 
convert(char(10),Webcutheaderpdm.date1,101) as DueDate, isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.memo1,'') as Note, Webcutheaderpdm.status1 as donestatus ,
convert(char(10),cutheader.duedate,101) as xFactory
from Webcutheaderpdm join cutheader on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=cutheader.cutno 
where ( Webcutheaderpdm.heading1 in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and 
	cutheader.customer=(case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end) and
	cutheader.contractor=(case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end) and
	cutheader.merchandiser_header=(case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' then cutheader.merchandiser_header else PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser end) )
   or '*' in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and 
	cutheader.customer=(case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end) and
	cutheader.contractor=(case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end) and
	cutheader.merchandiser_header=(case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' then cutheader.merchandiser_header else PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser end) )
)
and Webcutheaderpdm.DATE1 between @begDate and @endDate AND isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.heading1,'')<>'' and 
	charindex(Webcutheaderpdm.status1,@status)>0 and isnull(webcutheaderpdm.closed,'N')<>'Y' and CHARINDEX(cutheader.style_header, @styles)>0 
UNION
select Webcutheaderpdm.heading2 as task, Webcutheaderpdm.cutno, isnull(cutheader.contractor,'') as Vendor, 
isnull(cutheader.terms,'') as terms, convert(char(10),cutheader.completiondate,101) as inHouseDate,  
isnull(cutheader.customer,'') as Customer, isnull(cutheader.style_header,'') as StyleCutHead, 
convert(char(10),Webcutheaderpdm.date2,101) as DueDate, isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.memo2,'') as Note, Webcutheaderpdm.status2 as donestatus ,
convert(char(10),cutheader.duedate,101) as xFactory
from Webcutheaderpdm join cutheader on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=cutheader.cutno 
where ( Webcutheaderpdm.heading2 in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	cutheader.user4=(case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end) and 
	cutheader.customer=(case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end) and

iTechPack_Ivtf_Style_Timestamp CREATE  procedure [dbo].[iTechPack_Ivtf_Style_Timestamp] (@lastSyncDateTime nchar(50)=NULL) as 
if isnull(@lastSyncDateTime,'') = '' 
	select @lastSyncDateTime = '1980-01-01' 

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ivtf.code,ivtf.color DESC) as rowno,ivtf.id, ivtf.code AS code,ivtf.iosImageTS,		
                     ivtf.iosDataTS, ivtf.color AS color, isnull(ivtf.descript,'') as descript,
				isnull(ivtf.price,0) as price,isnull(ivtf.priceb,0) as priceb,
                      isnull(ivtf.pricec,0) as pricec,isnull(ivtf.priced,0) as priced,isnull(ivtf.pricee,0) as pricee,isnull(ivtf.pricef,0) as pricef,
                      isnull(ivtf.grp,'') as grp, isnull(ivtf.season,'') as season, ivtf.division,  ivtf.user4,
                      isnull(ivtf_image.icon1,0xFF) as icon1, 
                       division.size1, division.size2, division.size3,  
                      division.size4, division.size5, division.size6, division.size7, division.size8, division.size9, division.size10, division.size11,  
                      division.size12, ivtf.long_desc, ivtf.qty1 AS onhand_qty1, ivtf.qty2 AS onhand_qty2, ivtf.qty3 AS onhand_qty3, ivtf.qty4 AS onhand_qty4,  
                      ivtf.qty5 AS onhand_qty5, ivtf.qty6 AS onhand_qty6, ivtf.qty7 AS onhand_qty7, ivtf.qty8 AS onhand_qty8, ivtf.qty9 AS onhand_qty9,  
                      ivtf.qty10 AS onhand_qty10, ivtf.qty11 AS onhand_qty11, ivtf.qty12 AS onhand_qty12, ivtf.subcategory, ivtf_image.style_sketch AS style_icon,  
                      ivtf.weight AS style_weight, ivtf.wip_qty1, ivtf.wip_qty2, ivtf.wip_qty3, ivtf.wip_qty4, ivtf.wip_qty5, ivtf.wip_qty6, ivtf.wip_qty7,  
                      ivtf.wip_qty8, ivtf.wip_qty9, ivtf.wip_qty10, ivtf.wip_qty11, ivtf.wip_qty12, ivtf.onorder_qty1, ivtf.onorder_qty2, ivtf.onorder_qty3,  
                      ivtf.onorder_qty4, ivtf.onorder_qty5, ivtf.onorder_qty6, ivtf.onorder_qty7, ivtf.onorder_qty8, ivtf.onorder_qty9, ivtf.onorder_qty10,  
                      ivtf.onorder_qty11, ivtf.onorder_qty12, dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty1 - ivtf.onorder_qty1, 0) AS ats_qty1, dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty2 - ivtf.onorder_qty2,  
                      0) AS ats_qty2, dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty3 - ivtf.onorder_qty3, 0) AS ats_qty3, dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty4 - ivtf.onorder_qty4, 0) AS ats_qty4,  
                      dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty5 - ivtf.onorder_qty5, 0) AS ats_qty5, dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty6 - ivtf.onorder_qty6, 0) AS ats_qty6,  
                      dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty7 - ivtf.onorder_qty7, 0) AS ats_qty7, dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty8 - ivtf.onorder_qty8, 0) AS ats_qty8,  
                      dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty9 - ivtf.onorder_qty9, 0) AS ats_qty9, dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty10 - ivtf.onorder_qty10, 0) AS ats_qty10,  
                      dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty11 - ivtf.onorder_qty11, 0) AS ats_qty11, dbo.InlineMax(ivtf.qty12 - ivtf.onorder_qty12, 0) AS ats_qty12,                          
                       case when cast(round(ivtf.qty1-ivtf.onorder_qty1,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty1-ivtf.onorder_qty1,0)as int) end as stock1,  
             case when cast(round(ivtf.qty2-ivtf.onorder_qty2,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty2-ivtf.onorder_qty2,0)as int) end as stock2,  
              case when cast(round(ivtf.qty3-ivtf.onorder_qty3,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty3-ivtf.onorder_qty3,0)as int) end as stock3,  
            case when cast(round(ivtf.qty4-ivtf.onorder_qty4,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty4-ivtf.onorder_qty4,0)as int) end as stock4,  
            case when cast(round(ivtf.qty5-ivtf.onorder_qty5,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty5-ivtf.onorder_qty5,0)as int) end as stock5,  
             case when cast(round(ivtf.qty6-ivtf.onorder_qty6,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty6-ivtf.onorder_qty6,0)as int) end as stock6,  
            case when cast(round(ivtf.qty7-ivtf.onorder_qty7,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty7-ivtf.onorder_qty7,0)as int) end as stock7,  
             case when cast(round(ivtf.qty8-ivtf.onorder_qty8,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty8-ivtf.onorder_qty8,0)as int) end as stock8,   
              case when cast(round(ivtf.qty9-ivtf.onorder_qty9,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty9-ivtf.onorder_qty9,0)as int) end as stock9,   
              case when cast(round(ivtf.qty10-ivtf.onorder_qty10,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty10-ivtf.onorder_qty10,0)as int) end as stock10,   
             case when cast(round(ivtf.qty11-ivtf.onorder_qty11,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty11-ivtf.onorder_qty11,0)as int) end as stock11,  
             case when cast(round(ivtf.qty12-ivtf.onorder_qty12,0)as int)< 0 then 0 else cast(round(ivtf.qty12-ivtf.onorder_qty12,0)as int) end as stock12  ,          
             ivtf.category, ivtf.ios_show, ivtf.tradeshow , ivtf.sku, ivtf.user1,
			 ivtf.prepack_qty1,ivtf.prepack_qty2,ivtf.prepack_qty3,ivtf.prepack_qty4,ivtf.prepack_qty5,ivtf.prepack_qty6,ivtf.prepack_qty7,
		ivtf.prepack_qty8,ivtf.prepack_qty9,ivtf.prepack_qty10,ivtf.prepack_qty11,ivtf.prepack_qty12	
             
FROM         ivtf LEFT OUTER JOIN ivtf_image ON ivtf.code = ivtf_image.style and ivtf.color=ivtf_image.color 
					  Left Outer join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
					  Left Outer join color on ivtf.color=color.code 
					  where ivtf.user_date >= left(@lastSyncDateTime,19) and ivtf.active>=1
	order by code,color
iTechPack_iWatch 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[iTechPack_iWatch] (@vendor char(10)='') as 
if @vendor=''
  SELECT top 25 isnull(ivtf_sample.code,'') as code, isnull(ivtf_sample.design,'') as designer, 
	isnull(ivtf_sample.upc,'') as upc, isnull(ivtf_image.icon1,0xFF) as icon1,
	convert(char(20), isnull(created_date,'1900-01-01')) as created_date 
  FROM ivtf_sample left outer join ivtf_image on ivtf_image.sample_upc=ivtf_sample.upc 
  where created_date >= dateadd(dd, -90, getdate()) 
	order by created_date desc 
else
  SELECT top 25 isnull(ivtf_sample.code,'') as code, isnull(ivtf_sample.design,'') as designer, 
	isnull(ivtf_sample.upc,'') as upc, isnull(ivtf_image.icon1,0xFF) as icon1,
	convert(char(20), isnull(created_date,'1900-01-01')) as created_date 
  FROM ivtf_sample left outer join ivtf_image on ivtf_image.sample_upc=ivtf_sample.upc 
  where created_date >= dateadd(dd, -90, getdate()) and isnull(vendor,'')=@vendor 
	order by created_date desc

iWMS_check_UCC128 
create procedure [dbo].[iWMS_check_UCC128]  (@ucc128 nchar(20)) 
as
declare @upc nchar(20) 
declare @result nvarchar(1000)
declare @shortQty int 
declare @shortString nvarchar(35) 
set @result=''

CREATE TABLE #temp (pickno int, style nchar(13), color nchar(12), royaltor nchar(10), qty int, sizedesc nchar(5), upc nchar(20))
insert into #temp Exec iWMS_get_ucc128_content_simple @ucc128 

DECLARE con_curs CURSOR FOR
	SELECT barcode from scan_generic where refno=@ucc128 and isnull(posted,'N')='N'
	FOR READ ONLY

OPEN con_curs
FETCH con_curs INTO @upc 

-- loop until meet end of selected row
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
BEGIN
	if exists (select upc from #temp where upc=@upc and qty>0) 
		update #temp set qty=qty-1 where upc=@upc 
	else 
		set @result = @result + 'No '+RTRIM(@upc)+char(13) 

	FETCH con_curs INTO @upc 
END

CLOSE con_curs
DEALLOCATE con_curs

select @shortQty = sum(convert(int,qty)) from #temp 

if @shortQty>0 
	BEGIN 
		select @result = @result + 'Short '+RTRIM(Convert(nvarchar(10), @shortQty)) + ' Pieces!!' + char(13) 
		-- 170410 dan - add the rest of missing style/color/sizes to result string to display in iOS device 
		DECLARE short_cursor CURSOR FOR
			SELECT style+color+sizedesc+convert(char(5), qty) from #temp FOR READ ONLY
		OPEN short_cursor
		FETCH short_cursor INTO @shortString 

		-- loop until meet end of selected row
		WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
		BEGIN
			set @result = @result + @shortString + char(13) 
			FETCH short_cursor INTO @shortString 
		END

		CLOSE short_cursor
		DEALLOCATE short_cursor	
	END 

else 
	if @result<>''  
		set @result = @result + '!!'
	else
		set @result = 'OK.'  

/* flag as posted */ 
update scan_generic set posted='Y' where refno=@ucc128 

select @result as SQLResult 

iWMS_create_boxing /* 200522 dan - update the #boxes of pick header */ 
/* 200513 dan - fix bug QTY5 being used as QTY6 bug, and was shifted up to QTY9, QTY9 was not there */ 
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[iWMS_create_boxing] (@pickno int, @boxno int, @weight int) 
AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @upc nchar(20)
	DECLARE @style nchar(13)
	DECLARE @color nchar(12)
	DECLARE @store nchar(10) 
	DECLARE @qty int 
	DECLARE @qty1 int
	DECLARE @qty2 int
	DECLARE @qty3 int
	DECLARE @qty4 int
	DECLARE @qty5 int
	DECLARE @qty6 int
	DECLARE @qty7 int
	DECLARE @qty8 int
	DECLARE @qty9 int
	DECLARE @qty10 int
	DECLARE @qty11 int
	DECLARE @qty12 int
	DECLARE @currentLineNo int 
	set @currentLineNo = 1 


	DECLARE mycursor CURSOR FOR
    SELECT upc, qty from iWMS_Boxing where pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno and posted='N'
	-- 200306 dan - insert invhead_box header 
	if NOT exists (select pickno from invhead_box where pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno)
	BEGIN 
		select @store = store from pickheader where pickno=@pickno
		insert into invhead_box (invoiceno, pickno, boxno, weight, store, begbox, endbox, boxes)
				values (0, @pickno, @boxno, @weight, @store, @boxno, @boxno, 1)
		-- 200522 dan - update the #boxes of pick header 
		update pickheader set boxes=@boxno where pickno=@pickno 
	END 

    OPEN mycursor
    FETCH NEXT FROM mycursor INTO @upc, @qty 
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
		select @style=style, @color=color, @qty1=isnull(pack1,0), @qty2=isnull(pack2,0), @qty3=isnull(pack3,0), 
			@qty4=isnull(pack4,0), @qty5=isnull(pack5,0), @qty6=isnull(pack6,0), 
			@qty7=isnull(pack7,0), @qty8=isnull(pack8,0), @qty9=isnull(pack9,0), 
			@qty10=isnull(pack10,0), @qty11=isnull(pack11,0), @qty12= isnull(pack12,0)
			from code_sku where sku=@upc and custid='UPC' 


		if not exists (select style from packlist where pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno and style=@style and color=@color) 
			BEGIN -- must multiply that pack qty by the @qty which was sent from iOS Device 
				insert into packlist (line, invoiceno, pickno, store, style, color, boxno, 
						qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12)
				values (@currentLineno, 0, @pickno, @store, @style, @color, @boxno, @qty1 * @qty, @qty2 * @qty, @qty3 * @qty, 
				@qty4 * @qty, @qty5 * @qty, @qty6 * @qty, @qty7 * @qty, @qty8 * @qty, @qty9 * @qty, @qty10 * @qty, 
				@qty11 * @qty, @qty12 * @qty ) 
				set @currentLineNo = @currentLineNo + 1 
			END 
		else
			update packlist set 
			qty1 = qty1 + (@qty1 * @qty), qty2 = qty2 + (@qty2 * @qty), qty3 = qty3 + (@qty3 * @qty), 
			qty4 = qty4 + (@qty4 * @qty), qty5 = qty5 + (@qty5 * @qty), qty6 = qty6 + (@qty6 * @qty), 
			qty7 = qty7 + (@qty7 * @qty), qty8 = qty8 + (@qty8 * @qty), qty9 = qty9 + (@qty9 * @qty), 
			qty10 = qty10 + (@qty10 * @qty), qty11 = qty11 + (@qty11 * @qty), qty12 = qty12 + (@qty12 * @qty)  
				where pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno and style=@style and color=@color

		
       FETCH NEXT FROM mycursor INTO @upc, @qty 
    END
    CLOSE mycursor
    DEALLOCATE mycursor
	
	/* flag the IOS detail rows as posted */ 
	update iWMS_Boxing set posted='Y' where pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno 
END


iWMS_createPallet Create procedure iWMS_createPallet ( @logfdetail_id char(20), @numberOfBoxes char(20), @bin nchar(10), @memo varchar(1000), @user nchar(10)=NULL )
AS
BEGIN
	declare @pallet_id int 

	BEGIN TRANSACTION
		insert into wh_pallet (cartons, wh_bin, memo, created_user) values  (@numberOfBoxes, @bin, @memo, @user) 
		select @pallet_id = max(pallet_id) from wh_pallet 

		insert into wh_pallet_detail (pallet_id, fileno, logfdetail_id, cutdetail_id, cartons)	
		  select @pallet_id, fileno, logfdetail_id, cutdetail_id, @numberOfBoxes 
			from logfdetail where logfdetail_id=@logfdetail_id 
	COMMIT 
	select convert(varchar(25),@pallet_id) as SQLResult 
END

iwms_CreateShippingLog 

CREATE procedure [dbo].[iwms_CreateShippingLog] 
as
 -- dan added 170203, user was creating a new line without filling in 
 delete from ShippingLog where isnull(customer,'')='' and isnull(custpo,'')='' 
  
 insert into ShippingLog (request_by, request_date, customer, custpo, shipdate, canceldate, shipvia, cartons, distri, pickno, pick_count,qty, closed)
  select max(userid), max(create_date), customer, custpo, shipdate, canceldate, max(shipvia), sum(boxes), distri, min(pickno), count(pickno),sum(isnull(totqty,0)), 'H'  
from pickheader where CLOSED='N' and 
(rtrim(customer)+rtrim(isnull(custpo,''))+rtrim(isnull(distri,'')) not in (select rtrim(customer)+rtrim(isnull(custpo,''))+rtrim(isnull(distri,'')) from ShippingLog)  ) 
and customer <>'JCPENNYR' 
 group by customer, custpo, distri, shipvia,  shipdate, canceldate, distri

 insert into ShippingLog (request_by, request_date, customer, custpo, shipdate, canceldate, shipvia, cartons, distri, pickno, pick_count, qty, closed)
  select max(userid), max(create_date), customer, releaseno, shipdate, canceldate, max(shipvia), sum(boxes), distri, min(pickno), count(pickno), sum(isnull(totqty,0)), 'H'  
from pickheader where closed='N' and 
(rtrim(customer)+rtrim(isnull(releaseno,''))+rtrim(isnull(distri,'')) not in (select rtrim(customer)+rtrim(isnull(custpo,''))+rtrim(isnull(distri,'')) from ShippingLog)  ) 
and customer ='JCPENNYR' 
 group by customer, releaseno, distri, shipvia,  shipdate, canceldate, distri

iWMS_FlagPacked CREATE procedure [dbo].[iWMS_FlagPacked] (@pickno nchar(10), @weight nchar(10) = NULL)
AS
BEGIN
	update pickheader set isPacked='Y', Packed_date=getdate() where pickno=@pickno 
--	if NOT( @weight = NULL or @weight='' ) 170908 Arun commented, this check fails
-- use isnull(@weight,'') instead
	if isnull(@weight,'') <> '' 
		--update pickheader set weight = @weight where pickno=@pickno 
		/*170908 Arun- also convert nchar to decimal*/
		update pickheader set weight = Cast (@weight as decimal) where pickno=@pickno 

	select 'Flagged.' as SQLResult 
END


iWMS_get_pick_content 
/* 171206 dan - no null SizeDesc */ 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[iWMS_get_pick_content] (@pickno int)
as
select x.pickno as pickno, 
x.pickdetail_id as pickdetail_id,
x.line as line, 
x.columnmatrix as columnmatrix,
x.style as style,
x.color as color,
x.royaltor as royaltor, 
x.qty as qty,
0 as price,
x.sizedesc as sizedesc,
x.upc as upc,
x.bsku as bsku,
x.asku as asku,
x.bin as bin, 
v_ivtf_image_icon1.icon1 as icon 

from 
(
select  pickdetail.style as style, pickdetail.color as color, pickdetail.royaltor as royaltor, pickdetail.line as line, pickdetail.pickdetail_id , 
	pickdetail.pickno as pickno,   1 as columnmatrix, pickdetail.qty1 as qty, isnull(division.size1,'') as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc,'') as upc, 
	isnull(ivtf.b_sku1,'') as bsku, isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin, isnull(ivtf.a_sku1,'') as asku   
	from pickdetail  join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on pickdetail.style=ivtf.code and pickdetail.color=ivtf.color and isnull(pickdetail.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where pickdetail.qty1 <> 0  and pickno=@pickno 
union 
select   pickdetail.style as style, pickdetail.color as color, pickdetail.royaltor as royaltor,  pickdetail.line as line,  pickdetail.pickdetail_id,
 pickdetail.pickno as pickno,   2 as columnmatrix, pickdetail.qty2 as qty, isnull(division.size2,'')  as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc2,'') as upc , 
 isnull(ivtf.b_sku2,'') as bsku, isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin, isnull(ivtf.a_sku2,'') as asku    
	from pickdetail  join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on pickdetail.style=ivtf.code and pickdetail.color=ivtf.color and isnull(pickdetail.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where pickdetail.qty2 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno 
union 
select    pickdetail.style as style, pickdetail.color as color, pickdetail.royaltor as royaltor,  pickdetail.line as line,  pickdetail.pickdetail_id,
pickdetail.pickno as pickno,   3 as columnmatrix, pickdetail.qty3 as qty, isnull(division.size3,'')  as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc3,'') as upc, 
isnull(ivtf.b_sku3,'') as bsku, isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin, isnull(ivtf.a_sku3,'') as asku      
	from pickdetail  join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on pickdetail.style=ivtf.code and pickdetail.color=ivtf.color and isnull(pickdetail.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where pickdetail.qty3 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno 
union 
select    pickdetail.style as style, pickdetail.color as color, pickdetail.royaltor as royaltor,  pickdetail.line as line,  pickdetail.pickdetail_id,
pickdetail.pickno as pickno,   4 as columnmatrix, pickdetail.qty4 as qty, isnull(division.size4,'')  as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc4,'') as upc, 
isnull(ivtf.b_sku4,'') as bsku , isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin, isnull(ivtf.a_sku4,'') as asku     
	from pickdetail  join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on pickdetail.style=ivtf.code and pickdetail.color=ivtf.color and isnull(pickdetail.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where pickdetail.qty4 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno 
union 
select    pickdetail.style as style, pickdetail.color as color, pickdetail.royaltor as royaltor,  pickdetail.line as line,  pickdetail.pickdetail_id,
pickdetail.pickno as pickno,   5 as columnmatrix, pickdetail.qty5 as qty, isnull(division.size5,'')  as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc5,'') as upc , 
isnull(ivtf.b_sku5,'') as bsku , isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin, isnull(ivtf.a_sku5,'') as asku     
	from pickdetail  join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on pickdetail.style=ivtf.code and pickdetail.color=ivtf.color and isnull(pickdetail.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where pickdetail.qty5 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno 
union 
select    pickdetail.style as style, pickdetail.color as color, pickdetail.royaltor as royaltor,  pickdetail.line as line,  pickdetail.pickdetail_id,
pickdetail.pickno as pickno,   6 as columnmatrix, pickdetail.qty6 as qty, isnull(division.size6,'')  as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc6,'') as upc , 
isnull(ivtf.b_sku6,'') as bsku , isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin, isnull(ivtf.a_sku6,'') as asku    
	from pickdetail  join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on pickdetail.style=ivtf.code and pickdetail.color=ivtf.color and isnull(pickdetail.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where pickdetail.qty6 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno 
union 
select    pickdetail.style as style, pickdetail.color as color, pickdetail.royaltor as royaltor,  pickdetail.line as line,  pickdetail.pickdetail_id,
pickdetail.pickno as pickno,   7 as columnmatrix, pickdetail.qty7 as qty, isnull(division.size7,'')  as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc7,'') as upc, 
isnull(ivtf.b_sku7,'') as bsku  , isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin, isnull(ivtf.a_sku7,'') as asku  
	from pickdetail  join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on pickdetail.style=ivtf.code and pickdetail.color=ivtf.color and isnull(pickdetail.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where pickdetail.qty7 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno 
union 
select    pickdetail.style as style, pickdetail.color as color, pickdetail.royaltor as royaltor,  pickdetail.line as line,  pickdetail.pickdetail_id,
	pickdetail.pickno as pickno,   8 as columnmatrix, pickdetail.qty8 as qty, isnull(division.size8,'')  as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc8,'') as upc, 
	isnull(ivtf.b_sku8,'') as bsku  , isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin, isnull(ivtf.a_sku8,'') as asku  
	from pickdetail  join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on pickdetail.style=ivtf.code and pickdetail.color=ivtf.color and isnull(pickdetail.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where pickdetail.qty8 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno

iWMS_get_pick_qty_Packed CREATE procedure [iWMS_get_pick_qty_Packed] (@pickno int)
as
declare @totalBoxedQty int
declare @numberOfBoxes int 

select @totalBoxedQty = sum(qty1+qty2+qty3+qty4+qty5+qty6+qty7+qty8+qty9+qty10+qty11+qty12) from packlist where pickno=@pickno 
select @numberOfBoxes = sum(isnull(boxes,1)) from invhead_box where pickno=@pickno 
select isnull(@totalBoxedQty,0) as totalBoxedQty, isnull(@numberOfBoxes,0) as numberOfBoxes 

iWMS_get_ucc128_content /* 170414 dan - also be able to use UPS Tracking# */ 
create procedure [dbo].[iWMS_get_ucc128_content] (@ucc128 nchar(20))
as
declare @invhead_box_seq_id int 
declare @invhead_box_id int 
declare @boxno int
declare @pickno int 

if left(UPPER(@ucc128),2)<>'1Z' 
	BEGIN
		select @invhead_box_seq_id = convert(int, substring(@ucc128,12,8)) 
		select @invhead_box_id = invhead_box_id from invhead_box_seq where invhead_box_seq_id=@invhead_box_seq_id 
		select @pickno=pickno, @boxno=boxno from invhead_box where invhead_box_id=@invhead_box_id 
	END
else
	BEGIN
		select @pickno=pickno, @boxno=boxno from invhead_box where trackno=@ucc128  
	END


--select * from packlist where pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno 
select x.pickno as pickno, 
x.boxno as pickdetail_id,
x.line as line, 
x.columnmatrix as columnmatrix,
x.style as style,
x.color as color,
x.royaltor as royaltor, 
x.qty as qty,
0 as price,
x.sizedesc as sizedesc,
x.upc as upc,
x.bsku as bsku, 
x.bin as bin, 
v_ivtf_image_icon1.icon1 as icon 

from 
(
select  packlist.style as style, packlist.color as color, packlist.royaltor as royaltor, packlist.line as line, 
	packlist.pickno as pickno, packlist.boxno as boxno, 1 as columnmatrix, packlist.qty1 as qty, division.size1 as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc,'') as upc ,

			on packlist.style=ivtf.code and packlist.color=ivtf.color and isnull(packlist.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')

packlist.pickno as pickno, packlist.boxno as boxno, 9 as columnmatrix, packlist.qty9 as qty, division.size9 as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc9,'') as upc , 
isnull(ivtf.b_sku9,'') as bsku , isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin 
	from packlist join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on packlist.style=ivtf.code and packlist.color=ivtf.color and isnull(packlist.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where packlist.qty9 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno 
union 
select    packlist.style as style, packlist.color as color, packlist.royaltor as royaltor,  packlist.line as line, 
packlist.pickno as pickno, packlist.boxno as boxno, 10 as columnmatrix, packlist.qty10 as qty, division.size10 as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc10,'') as upc , 
isnull(ivtf.b_sku10,'') as bsku , isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin 
	from packlist join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on packlist.style=ivtf.code and packlist.color=ivtf.color and isnull(packlist.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where packlist.qty10 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno 
union 
select    packlist.style as style, packlist.color as color, packlist.royaltor as royaltor,  packlist.line as line, 
packlist.pickno as pickno, packlist.boxno as boxno, 11 as columnmatrix, packlist.qty11 as qty, division.size11 as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc11,'') as upc , 
isnull(ivtf.b_sku11,'') as bsku , isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin 
	from packlist join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on packlist.style=ivtf.code and packlist.color=ivtf.color and isnull(packlist.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where packlist.qty11 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno 
union 
select    packlist.style as style, packlist.color as color, packlist.royaltor as royaltor,  packlist.line as line, 
packlist.pickno as pickno, packlist.boxno as boxno, 12 as columnmatrix, packlist.qty12 as qty, division.size12 as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc12,'') as upc , 
isnull(ivtf.b_sku12,'') as bsku , isnull(ivtf.bin_location,'') as bin 
	from packlist join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on packlist.style=ivtf.code and packlist.color=ivtf.color and isnull(packlist.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where packlist.qty12 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno  
) as x outer apply (select top(1)  v_ivtf_image_icon1.icon1 from v_ivtf_image_icon1 
			where v_ivtf_image_icon1.code=x.style and v_ivtf_image_icon1.color=x.color) as v_ivtf_image_icon1 	

iWMS_get_ucc128_content_simple 
/* used in iWMS_check_UCC128: CREATE TABLE #temp (pickno int, style nchar(13), color nchar(13), royaltor nchar(10), qty int, sizedesc nchar(5), upc nchar(20)) */
CREATE procedure [dbo].[iWMS_get_ucc128_content_simple] (@ucc128 nchar(20))
as
declare @invhead_box_seq_id int 
declare @invhead_box_id int 
declare @boxno int
declare @pickno int 

select @invhead_box_seq_id = convert(int, substring(@ucc128,12,8)) 
select @invhead_box_id = invhead_box_id from invhead_box_seq where invhead_box_seq_id=@invhead_box_seq_id 
select @pickno=pickno, @boxno=boxno from invhead_box where invhead_box_id=@invhead_box_id 

--select * from packlist where pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno 
select x.pickno as pickno, 
x.style as style,
x.color as color,
x.royaltor as royaltor, 
x.qty as qty,
x.sizedesc as sizedesc,
x.upc as upc 

from 
(
select  packlist.style as style, packlist.color as color, packlist.royaltor as royaltor, 
	packlist.pickno as pickno,  packlist.qty1 as qty, division.size1 as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc,'') as upc 
	from packlist join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on packlist.style=ivtf.code and packlist.color=ivtf.color and isnull(packlist.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where packlist.qty1 <> 0  and pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno 
union 
select   packlist.style as style, packlist.color as color, packlist.royaltor as royaltor, 
 packlist.pickno as pickno,  packlist.qty2 as qty, division.size2 as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc2,'') as upc 
	from packlist join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on packlist.style=ivtf.code and packlist.color=ivtf.color and isnull(packlist.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where packlist.qty2 <> 0   and pickno=@pickno and boxno=@boxno 
union 
select    packlist.style as style, packlist.color as color, packlist.royaltor as royaltor, 
packlist.pickno as pickno,  packlist.qty3 as qty, division.size3 as sizedesc, isnull(ivtf.upc3,'') as upc 
	from packlist join ivtf join division on ivtf.division=division.code 
			on packlist.style=ivtf.code and packlist.color=ivtf.color and isnull(packlist.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')

union

union 
select    packlist.style as style, packlist.color as color, packlist.royaltor as royaltor,

iWMS_get_upc 
create procedure [iWMS_get_upc] (@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @size nchar(5) )
as
select sku from code_sku where custid='UPC' and style=@style and color=@color and size_desc=@size 

iWMS_getBinInfo CREATE procedure iWMS_getBinInfo (@bin nchar(10))
AS
BEGIN
declare @style nchar(13)
declare @color nchar(13)
declare @royaltor nchar(10)

  SELECT @style = cutdetail.style, @color=cutdetail.color, @royaltor=cutdetail.royaltor 
    FROM {oj wh_pallet LEFT OUTER JOIN wh_pallet_detail ON wh_pallet.pallet_id = wh_pallet_detail.pallet_id 
							  LEFT OUTER JOIN cutdetail ON wh_pallet_detail.cutdetail_id = cutdetail.cutdetail_id 
							  LEFT OUTER JOIN cutheader ON cutdetail.cutno = cutheader.cutno }   
	WHERE wh_pallet.wh_bin = @bin
	
	select ivtf.*, v_ivtf_size.size1,v_ivtf_size.size2,v_ivtf_size.size3,v_ivtf_size.size4,
		v_ivtf_size.size5,v_ivtf_size.size6,v_ivtf_size.size7,v_ivtf_size.size8,
		v_ivtf_size.size9,v_ivtf_size.size10,v_ivtf_size.size11,v_ivtf_size.size12  
		 from ivtf left outer join v_ivtf_size on v_ivtf_size.style=ivtf.code and v_ivtf_size.color=ivtf.color and isnull(v_ivtf_size.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where ivtf.code=@style and ivtf.color=@color and isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')=isnull(@royaltor,'') 
END

iWMS_getImageThumbnail 
/* 171221 dan - handle "STYLE/COLOR" format also */ 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[iWMS_getImageThumbnail] (@barcode char(30))
AS
BEGIN
	declare @style nchar(13)
	declare @color nchar(12)

	/*  see if UPC/SKU   */ 
	if exists(select sku from code_sku where sku=@barcode) 
		select v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1.thumbnail1 from v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1 join code_sku on 
			v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1.code=code_sku.style and v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1.color=code_sku.color  and 
				isnull(v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1.royaltor,'')=isnull(code_sku.royaltor,'') 
		where code_sku.sku=@barcode 
	else 
		if charindex('/',@barcode)>1 and  charindex('/',@barcode)<LEN(RTRIM(@barcode))  
		BEGIN
			set @color = substring(@barcode, charindex('/',@barcode)+1,30) 
			set @style = left(@barcode,charindex('/',@barcode)-1) 
			select v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1.thumbnail1 from v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1 where  
			v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1.code=@style and v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1.color=@color and 
				isnull(v_ivtf_image_thumbnail1.royaltor,'')='' 
		END

	/* later add here if user scanned the Pallet or Carton label */ 
END

iWMS_getLogfdetail Create procedure iWMS_getLogfdetail ( @barcode char(20) )
AS
BEGIN
  select top 1 
	  logfdetail.style as style, 
	  logfdetail.color as color,
	  isnull(logfdetail.royaltor,'') as royaltor, 
	  isnull(logfdetail.cutno,0) as cutno,
	  isnull(logfdetail.fileno,0) as fileno,  
	  dbo.f_BinaryToBase64(ivtf_image.icon1) as icon1     
  from logfdetail left outer join ivtf_image on ivtf_image.style=logfdetail.style and ivtf_image.color=logfdetail.color and isnull(ivtf_image.royaltor,'')=isnull(logfdetail.royaltor,'')  
	 where logfdetail.logfdetail_id = convert(int, @barcode)  	
END

iWMS_getOnePickheader create procedure [dbo].[iWMS_getOnePickheader] (@pickno nchar(10) = NULL )
as
declare @pickCount int

select @pickCount=count(*) from pickheader where 
	 isnull(pickheader.closed,'N')='N' and isnull(pickheader.isPacked,'N')<>'Y' 
	and pickheader.pickno = @pickno  
if @pickCount>0 
	select isnull(pickheader.user4,'') as div,
	pickheader.pickno as pickno, 
	isnull(pickheader.priority_level, '0') as priority_level, 
	isnull(pickheader.pickdate,'2000-01-01') as pickdate,
	isnull(pickheader.shipdate,'2000-01-01') as shipdate,
	isnull(pickheader.canceldate,'2000-01-01') as canceldate,
	isnull(pickheader.user_date,'2000-01-01') as user_date,
	isnull(pickheader.customer,'') as customer,
	isnull(pickheader.store,'') as store,
	LTRIM(convert(char(12),pickheader.total)) as total, 
	isnull(pickheader.distri,'') as distri,
	isnull(pickheader.blname,'') as blname,
	isnull(pickheader.shname,'') as shname,
	isnull(pickheader.shcity,'') as shcity,
	isnull(pickheader.shstate,'') as shstate,
	isnull(pickheader.shzip,'') as shzip,
	isnull(pickheader.shipvia,'') as shipvia,
	isnull(pickheader.phone,'') as phone,
	isnull(pickheader.salesrep1,'') as salesrep1,
	isnull(pickheader.totqty,0) as qty,
	isnull(pickheader.created_user,'') as created_user ,
	customer.customer_logo as customer_logo,
	isnull(pickheader.inhouse_memo,'') as inhouse_memo 
	from pickheader left outer join customer on customer.code = pickheader.customer 
	where isnull(pickheader.closed,'N')='N' and isnull(pickheader.isPacked,'N')<>'Y' 
				and pickheader.pickno = @pickno  
else 
	select isnull(pickheader.user4,'') as div,
	pickheader.pickno as pickno, 
	'9' as priority_level, 
	isnull(pickheader.pickdate,'2000-01-01') as pickdate,
	isnull(pickheader.shipdate,'2000-01-01') as shipdate,
	isnull(pickheader.canceldate,'2000-01-01') as canceldate,
	isnull(pickheader.user_date,'2000-01-01') as user_date,
	isnull(pickheader.customer,'') as customer,
	isnull(pickheader.store,'') as store,
	LTRIM(convert(char(12),pickheader.total)) as total, 
	isnull(pickheader.distri,'') as distri,
	'Pick CLOSED or Picked!!!' as blname,
	'Pick CLOSED or Picked!!!' as shname,
	isnull(pickheader.shcity,'') as shcity,
	isnull(pickheader.shstate,'') as shstate,
	isnull(pickheader.shzip,'') as shzip,
	isnull(pickheader.shipvia,'') as shipvia,
	isnull(pickheader.phone,'') as phone,
	isnull(pickheader.salesrep1,'') as salesrep1,
	isnull(pickheader.totqty,0) as qty,
	isnull(pickheader.created_user,'') as created_user ,
	customer.customer_logo as customer_logo ,
	'Pick CLOSED or Already Picked!!!' + convert(nvarchar(500),isnull(pickheader.inhouse_memo,'')) as inhouse_memo 

	from pickheader left outer join customer on customer.code = pickheader.customer 
	where pickheader.pickno = @pickno  

iWMS_getPalletFromCutno CREATE procedure iWMS_getPalletFromCutno (@cutno nchar(10))
AS
BEGIN
select wh_pallet.pallet_id, wh_pallet.cartons, wh_pallet.wh_bin as bin, wh_pallet.memo, 
  wh_pallet.date_created, logfdetail.style, logfdetail.color 
  from wh_pallet join logfdetail on wh_pallet.logfdetail_id=logfdetail.logfdetail_id
    where wh_pallet.logfdetail_id in (select logfdetail_id from logfdetail where cutno=@cutno)

END

iWMS_getPalletInfo CREATE procedure [iWMS_getPalletInfo] ( @pallet_id nchar(20) )
AS
BEGIN
	declare @palletLeft int
	declare @shippinglog_id int 
	declare @customer nchar(10)
	declare @custpo nchar(40)
	declare @distri nchar(10)
	declare @totalCartons int 
	declare @cartonsLeft int 
	declare @thisPalletCartons int 
	declare @totalPallets int 

	select @shippinglog_id = shippinglog_id, @thisPalletCartons=isnull(cartons,0) from ShippingLog_pallet where pallet_id=@pallet_id 

	/* 190515 dan - added */ 
	select @customer=isnull(customer,''), @custpo=isnull(custpo,''), @distri=isnull(distri,''), 
	  @totalCartons=(select sum(isnull(cartons,0)) from ShippingLog_Pallet where shippinglog_id=@shippinglog_id) 
	from ShippingLog where shippinglog_id=@shippinglog_id 
	
	select @totalPallets = count(*) from ShippingLog_Pallet where shippinglog_id = @shippinglog_id  and 
		isnull(cartons,0)<>0  
	select @palletLeft = count(*), @cartonsLeft = isnull(sum(isnull(cartons,0)),0) from ShippingLog_Pallet where shippinglog_id = @shippinglog_id  and 
		isnull(cartons,0)<>0 and isnull(pallet_shipped,'N')<>'Y'

	select RTRIM(convert(char(5),@palletLeft))+' Pallet(s) Left!  '+ RTRIM(convert(char(6),@cartonsLeft))+ ' Cartons Left!  Customer:'+
	  @customer+' PO#:'+@custpo+' DC#:'+@distri+' TotalCartons:'+convert(char(6),@totalCartons)+' TotPallets:'+convert(char(4),@totalPallets)+
	  ' ThisPalletCtns:'+ convert(char(4),@thisPalletCartons)  as SQLResult 
END

iWMS_getPickDetailDematrix 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[iWMS_getPickDetailDematrix] ( @pickno char(20) )
AS
BEGIN
	if len(rtrim(@pickno))<20 and left(UPPER(@pickno),2)<>'1Z' 
		exec iWMS_get_pick_content @pickno 
	else 
		exec iWMS_get_ucc128_content @pickno 
END


iWMS_getPickDetailDematrix2 CREATE procedure [dbo].[iWMS_getPickDetailDematrix2] ( @pickno char(20) )
AS
BEGIN
	if len(rtrim(@pickno))<20 and left(UPPER(@pickno),2)<>'1Z' 
		exec iWMS_get_pick_content_notPacked @pickno 
	else 
		exec iWMS_get_ucc128_content @pickno 
END

iWMS_getPicklistTVOS 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[iWMS_getPicklistTVOS] (@fromDateString nchar(10) = NULL )
as
if @fromDateString is NULL 
	set @fromDateString =  convert(char(10), dateadd(dd, -3, getdate()), 21) 

select 'COLORS' as dbname, 
isnull(pickheader.user4,'') as div,
pickheader.pickno as pickno, 
isnull(pickheader.priority_level, '0') as priority_level, 
isnull(pickheader.pickdate,'2000-01-01') as pickdate,
isnull(pickheader.shipdate,'2000-01-01') as shipdate,
isnull(pickheader.canceldate,'2000-01-01') as canceldate,
isnull(pickheader.user_date,'2000-01-01') as user_date,
isnull(pickheader.customer,'') as customer,
isnull(pickheader.store,'') as store,
LTRIM(convert(char(12),isnull(pickheader.total,0))) as total, 
isnull(pickheader.distri,'') as distri,
isnull(pickheader.blname,'') as blname,
isnull(pickheader.shname,'') as shname,
isnull(pickheader.shcity,'') as shcity,
isnull(pickheader.shstate,'') as shstate,
isnull(pickheader.shzip,'') as shzip,
isnull(pickheader.shipvia,'') as shipvia,
isnull(pickheader.phone,'') as phone,
isnull(pickheader.salesrep1,'') as salesrep1,
isnull(pickheader.totqty,0) as qty,
isnull(pickheader.created_user,'') as created_user ,
dbo.f_BinaryToBase64(customer.customer_logo) as customer_logo,
convert(nchar(1000),isnull(pickheader.inhouse_memo,'')) as inhouse_memo 
from wf125sr_Colors..pickheader pickheader  left outer join customer on customer.code = pickheader.customer 
where isnull(pickheader.closed,'N')='N' and isnull(pickheader.isPacked,'N')<>'Y' 
			and convert(char(10),pickheader.CREATE_DATE,21) >= @fromDateString 
/* replace below to 2nd DB */ 
UNION 
select 'MOSHITA' as dbname,
isnull(pickheader.user4,'') as div,
pickheader.pickno as pickno, 
isnull(pickheader.priority_level, '0') as priority_level, 
isnull(pickheader.pickdate,'2000-01-01') as pickdate,
isnull(pickheader.shipdate,'2000-01-01') as shipdate,
isnull(pickheader.canceldate,'2000-01-01') as canceldate,
isnull(pickheader.user_date,'2000-01-01') as user_date,
isnull(pickheader.customer,'') as customer,
isnull(pickheader.store,'') as store,
LTRIM(convert(char(12),pickheader.total)) as total, 
isnull(pickheader.distri,'') as distri,
isnull(pickheader.blname,'') as blname,
isnull(pickheader.shname,'') as shname,
isnull(pickheader.shcity,'') as shcity,
isnull(pickheader.shstate,'') as shstate,
isnull(pickheader.shzip,'') as shzip,
isnull(pickheader.shipvia,'') as shipvia,
isnull(pickheader.phone,'') as phone,
isnull(pickheader.salesrep1,'') as salesrep1,
isnull(pickheader.totqty,0) as qty,
isnull(pickheader.created_user,'') as created_user ,
dbo.f_BinaryToBase64(customer.customer_logo) as customer_logo,
convert(nchar(1000),isnull(pickheader.inhouse_memo,'')) as inhouse_memo 
from wf125sr_Moshita..pickheader pickheader left outer join customer on customer.code = pickheader.customer 
where isnull(pickheader.closed,'N')='N' and isnull(pickheader.isPacked,'N')<>'Y' 
			and convert(char(10),pickheader.CREATE_DATE,21) >= @fromDateString 

iWMS_getPrepackUPC create procedure [iWMS_getPrepackUPC] ( @barcode char(20) )
AS
BEGIN
declare @style nchar(13)
declare @color nchar(12)
declare @royaltor nchar(10)
declare @pack1 int
declare @pack2 int
declare @pack3 int
declare @pack4 int
declare @pack5 int
declare @pack6 int
declare @pack7 int
declare @pack8 int
declare @pack9 int
declare @pack10 int
declare @pack11 int
declare @pack12 int

select @style=style, @color=color, @royaltor=isnull(royaltor,''),
	@pack1=isnull(qty1,0), 
	@pack2=isnull(qty2,0), 
	@pack3=isnull(qty3,0), 
	@pack4=isnull(qty4,0), 
	@pack5=isnull(qty5,0), 
	@pack6=isnull(qty6,0), 
	@pack7=isnull(qty7,0), 
	@pack8=isnull(qty8,0), 
	@pack9=isnull(qty9,0), 
	@pack10=isnull(qty10,0), 
	@pack11=isnull(qty11,0), 
	@pack12=isnull(qty12,0)
from ivtf_prepack where upc=@barcode 

select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack1 as qty, 1 as size_bucket 
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack1=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack1>=1
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack2 as qty, 2 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack2=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack2>=1 
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack3 as qty, 3 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack3=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack3>=1
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack4 as qty, 4 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack4=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack4>=1 
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack5 as qty, 5 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack5=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack5>=1 
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack6 as qty, 6 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack6=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack6>=1 
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack7 as qty, 7 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack7=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack7>=1 
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack8 as qty, 8 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack8=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack8>=1 
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack9 as qty, 9 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack9=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack9>=1 
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack10 as qty, 10 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack10=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack10>=1 
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack11 as qty, 11 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack11=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack11>=1 
UNION 
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,'') as royaltor, sku, @pack12 as qty, 12 as size_bucket   
	from code_sku where custid='UPC' and pack12=1 and style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'')=@royaltor and @pack12>=1 

END

iWMS_getStyleColorSize_fromUPC create procedure [dbo].[iWMS_getStyleColorSize_fromUPC] ( @upc nchar(20) )
As
	select code_sku.style, code_sku.color, code_sku.size_desc as size , 
	isnull(code_sku.pack1,0) as pack1, isnull(code_sku.pack2,0) as pack2, isnull(code_sku.pack3,0) as pack3,
	isnull(code_sku.pack4,0) as pack4, isnull(code_sku.pack5,0) as pack5, isnull(code_sku.pack6,0) as pack6, 
	isnull(code_sku.pack7,0) as pack7, isnull(code_sku.pack8,0) as pack8, isnull(code_sku.pack9,0) as pack9, 
	isnull(code_sku.pack10,0) as pack10, isnull(code_sku.pack11,0) as pack11, isnull(code_sku.pack12,0) as pack12,
	v_ivtf_image_icon1.icon1 
	from code_sku left outer join v_ivtf_image_icon1 on v_ivtf_image_icon1.code=code_sku.style and 
				v_ivtf_image_icon1.color = code_sku.color 
	where sku = @upc and custid='UPC' 

iWMS_getStyleInfo /* 210423 dan - handle 13 digit UPC (take out 1st and last check digit char) */
/* 200227 dan - use prepack code instead of 'PRPAK' if prepack UPC is scanned */ 
/* 200117 dan - added SIZE returning if UPC is passed */ 
create procedure [dbo].[iWMS_getStyleInfo] (@style nchar(30), @color nchar(13)=NULL, @royaltor nchar(10) = NULL)
AS
BEGIN
declare @memo nvarchar(400)
declare @cartons char(10)
declare @size_desc nchar(5) 
declare @prepack_code nchar(10) = '' 
declare @upc_parameter nchar(20) 
	
	-- 210423 dan - added 
	select @style=rtrim(@style)

	if charindex('/',@style)>1 and  charindex('/',@style)<LEN(RTRIM(@style)) and @color is null 
		BEGIN
			set @color = substring(@style, charindex('/',@style)+1,30) 
			set @style = left(@style,charindex('/',@style)-1) 
		END
	else  
		if @color is null 
			BEGIN
				-- 210423 dan - check if 13digits and 1st digit is '0'
				if len(@style)=13 and left(@style,1)='0' 
					select @style = substring(@style,2,11)

				select @upc_parameter = @style 
				select top 1 @style=style, @color=color, @royaltor=isnull(royaltor,''), @size_desc=isnull(size_desc,'') 
					from code_sku where sku=@style 
			END

	-- 180404 dan - check if @style exists, if not @style is PALLET#
	if not exists (select code from ivtf where ivtf.code=@style) 	
		select @style=logfdetail.style, @color=logfdetail.color, @memo=wh_pallet.memo, @cartons=wh_pallet.cartons, @size_desc='' 
			from wh_pallet join logfdetail on wh_pallet.logfdetail_id=logfdetail.logfdetail_id
			where wh_pallet.pallet_id=@style 

	-- 200227 dan - added to get the prepack code if prepack UPC
		if @size_desc='PREPK' 
			select @prepack_code=isnull(prepack,'') from ivtf_prepack where upc=@upc_parameter 
	
	select ivtf.*, v_ivtf_size.size1,v_ivtf_size.size2,v_ivtf_size.size3,v_ivtf_size.size4,
		v_ivtf_size.size5,v_ivtf_size.size6,v_ivtf_size.size7,v_ivtf_size.size8,
		v_ivtf_size.size9,v_ivtf_size.size10,v_ivtf_size.size11,v_ivtf_size.size12,
		@memo as pallet_memo, @cartons as pallet_cartons, @size_desc as size_desc, @prepack_code as prepack_code   
		 from ivtf left outer join v_ivtf_size on v_ivtf_size.style=ivtf.code and v_ivtf_size.color=ivtf.color and isnull(v_ivtf_size.royaltor,'')=isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')  
		 where ivtf.code=@style and ivtf.color=@color and isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')=isnull(@royaltor,'') 
END

iWMS_getUPC /* 210510 dan - created for iRFID app */ 
create procedure [dbo].[iWMS_getUPC] (@style nchar(30), @color nchar(13)=NULL, @size nchar(5) = NULL)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @column nchar(20)
	DECLARE @upc nchar(20)
	declare @sql nvarchar(max)

	select @column = 'pack'+substring(qty,4,2) from v_dematrix_style_size
			where v_dematrix_style_size.code=@style and v_dematrix_style_size.color=@color and
				v_dematrix_style_size.size1=@size 

	set @sql = 'select sku,' + @column + ' from code_sku where style=''' + @style + ''' and color=''' + @color + ''' and ' +
				@column +' = 1 ' 
	
	EXEC sp_sqlexec  @sql 

END

iWMS_sendBoxingBatch CREATE procedure [iWMS_sendBoxingBatch] ( @pickno int, @boxno int, @deviceno nvarchar(20), @bin nvarchar(20), @barcode nvarchar(max) )
AS
declare @oneBarcode nchar(20)
BEGIN
	WHILE CHARINDEX(';',@barcode) > 0  
	BEGIN
		set @oneBarcode=left(@barcode, CHARINDEX(';',@barcode) - 1 )
		insert into iWMS_Boxing (deviceno, pickno, boxno, upc, qty, bin)
				values (@deviceno, @pickno, @boxno, @oneBarcode, 1, @bin) 
		set @barcode = right(@barcode, len(@barcode) - CHARINDEX(';',@barcode) ) 
	END 
	/* last barcode */ 
	insert into iWMS_Boxing (deviceno, pickno, boxno, upc, qty, bin)
				values (@deviceno, @pickno, @boxno, @barcode, 1, @bin) 

END

		values (@refno, @barcode, 'N', 1, @bin) 
END


iWMS_sendScanGenericBatch create procedure [dbo].[iWMS_sendScanGenericBatch] ( @refno nchar(20), @bin nvarchar(20), @barcode nvarchar(max) )
AS
declare @oneBarcode nchar(20)
BEGIN
	WHILE CHARINDEX(';',@barcode) > 0  
	BEGIN
		set @oneBarcode=left(@barcode, CHARINDEX(';',@barcode) - 1 )
		insert into scan_generic (refno, barcode, posted, qty, bin)
				values (@refno, @oneBarcode, 'N', 1, @bin) 
		set @barcode = right(@barcode, len(@barcode) - CHARINDEX(';',@barcode) ) 
	END 
	/* last barcode */ 
	insert into scan_generic (refno, barcode, posted, qty, bin)
				values (@refno, @barcode, 'N', 1, @bin) 

END


iWMS_ShipBOL create procedure iWMS_ShipBOL (@bol nchar(30))
AS
BEGIN
	if exists (select ShippingLog.pickno FROM ShippingLog left outer join PickHeader on ShippingLog.pickno = PickHeader.pickno where 
			 PickHeader.BillOfLading=@bol)
		BEGIN 
			update ShippingLog set closed='Y' 
			FROM ShippingLog left outer join PickHeader on ShippingLog.pickno = PickHeader.pickno 
			where PickHeader.BillOfLading=@bol  
			return 'OK'
		END
	else 
		return 'BOL Not Found.'
END 

iWMS_updateBin 
/* 180404 dan - be able to CLEAR a bin (i.e: @palletID='') */ 
/* 171222 dan - overwrite exiting bin, instead of adding to it */ 
/* 170427 dan - allow user to scan the Receiving Form detail barcode (which is logfdetail_id) */ 
/* 170426 dan - allow user to scan the BOX/Pallet and update IVTF.bin also */ 
/* 170418 dan - also update IVTF location if UPC */ 
CREATE procedure iWMS_updateBin (@bin nchar(10), @palletID char(15), @cartons char(10)=NULL, @memo nchar(500)=NULL )
AS
BEGIN
 	if @palletID='' and  @bin<>''
		update wh_pallet set wh_bin='' where wh_bin=@bin 
	else   
		if exists(select sku from code_sku where sku=@palletID) 
			update ivtf set bin_location=left(RTRIM(@bin),22) from code_sku 
				where ivtf.code=code_sku.style and ivtf.color=code_sku.color and 
					isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')=isnull(code_sku.royaltor,'') 
						and code_sku.sku=@palletID  
		else 
			if exists(select pallet_id from wh_pallet where pallet_id=@palletID ) 
				BEGIN  
					-- update wh_pallet set wh_bin='' where wh_bin=@bin  
					update wh_pallet set wh_bin=@bin, cartons=@cartons, memo=@memo where pallet_id=@palletID 
					-- also update the IVTF bin location 
					 update ivtf set bin_location=left(RTRIM(@bin),22) from wh_pallet_detail 
						join cutdetail on wh_pallet_detail.cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id  
						where ivtf.code=cutdetail.style and ivtf.color=cutdetail.color and 
							isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')=isnull(cutdetail.royaltor,'') 
							and wh_pallet_detail.pallet_id=@palletID  
				END  
			 else 
				BEGIN
					update ivtf set bin_location=left(RTRIM(@bin),22) 
					from logfdetail where ivtf.code=logfdetail.style and ivtf.color=logfdetail.color and 
							isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')=isnull(logfdetail.royaltor,'') 
							and logfdetail.logfdetail_id=@palletID  
				END  

	select 'Updated' as SQLResult 
END

iWMS_updatePalletCartons CREATE procedure iWMS_updatePalletCartons ( @pallet_id nchar(20), @numberOfCartons nvarchar(20), @userid nvarchar(20) )
AS
BEGIN
	if @numberOfCartons<>'' 
	begin 
		update ShippingLog_Pallet set cartons=@numberOfCartons, pallet_staged='Y', pallet_staged_user=left(@userid,10),
		pallet_staged_date=getdate()  where pallet_id=@pallet_id 

		update ShippingLog set staged='Y', staged_date=getdate(), staged_user=@userid from ShippingLog_pallet 
		join ShippingLog on ShippingLog.shippinglog_id = ShippingLog_Pallet.shippinglog_id where 
		ShippingLog_Pallet.pallet_id=@pallet_id 

		select 'Posted!' as SQLResult 
	end 
END

iWMS_updatePalletShipped CREATE procedure [iWMS_updatePalletShipped] ( @pallet_id nchar(20), @userid nvarchar(20) )
AS
BEGIN
	declare @palletLeft int
	declare @shippinglog_id int 
	declare @customer nchar(10)
	declare @custpo nchar(40)
	declare @distri nchar(10)
	declare @totalCartons int 
	declare @cartonsLeft int 
	declare @thisPalletCartons int 
	declare @totalPallets int 

	select @shippinglog_id = shippinglog_id, @thisPalletCartons=isnull(cartons,0) from ShippingLog_pallet where pallet_id=@pallet_id 
	update ShippingLog_Pallet set pallet_shipped='Y', pallet_shipped_user=left(@userid,10),
		pallet_shipped_date=getdate()  where pallet_id=@pallet_id 

	update ShippingLog set completed_by='SCANSHIP' where shippinglog_id = @shippinglog_id 
	
	/* 190515 dan - added */ 
	select @customer=isnull(customer,''), @custpo=isnull(custpo,''), @distri=isnull(distri,''), 
	  @totalCartons=(select sum(isnull(cartons,0)) from ShippingLog_Pallet where shippinglog_id=@shippinglog_id) 
	from ShippingLog where shippinglog_id=@shippinglog_id 
	
	select @totalPallets = count(*) from ShippingLog_Pallet where shippinglog_id = @shippinglog_id  and 
		isnull(cartons,0)<>0  
	select @palletLeft = count(*), @cartonsLeft = isnull(sum(isnull(cartons,0)),0) from ShippingLog_Pallet where shippinglog_id = @shippinglog_id  and 
		isnull(cartons,0)<>0 and isnull(pallet_shipped,'N')<>'Y'

	select RTRIM(convert(char(5),@palletLeft))+' Pallet(s) Left!  '+ RTRIM(convert(char(6),@cartonsLeft))+ ' Cartons Left!  Customer:'+
	  @customer+' PO#:'+@custpo+' DC#:'+@distri+' TotalCartons:'+convert(char(6),@totalCartons)+' TotPallets:'+convert(char(4),@totalPallets)+
	  ' ThisPalletCtns:'+ convert(char(4),@thisPalletCartons)  as SQLResult 

END

market_codeblockval 
CREATE proc [dbo].[market_codeblockval] @insertby nvarchar ( 15 ) , @accountcode nvarchar ( 6 ) = null , @costcenter nvarchar ( 5 ) = null , @internalorder nvarchar ( 7 ) = null as
begin declare @myerror int , @rc int , @param1 nvarchar ( 80 ) , @param2 nvarchar ( 80 ) select @myerror = 0 , @param1 = '' , @param2 = '' , @rc = 0 , @insertby = rtrim ( @insertby ) , @accountcode = rtrim ( @accountcode ) , @costcenter = rtrim ( @costcenter ) , @internalorder = rtrim ( @internalorder ) if ( @accountcode is null ) or ( 1 <> isnumeric ( @accountcode ) ) begin select @myerror = 700009 , @param1 = @accountcode goto lblreturn end if ( @costcenter is null ) begin if ( @internalorder is null ) begin select @myerror = 700010 , @param1 = 'null' goto lblreturn end if ( 1 <> isnumeric ( @internalorder ) ) begin select @myerror = 700010 , @param1 = @internalorder goto lblreturn end end else begin if ( 1 <> isnumeric ( @costcenter ) ) begin select @myerror = 700011 , @param1 = @costcenter goto lblreturn end else begin select @rc = 1 from market_accode_costctr where costcenter = @costcenter and accountcode = @accountcode if ( 1 != @rc ) begin select @myerror = 700013 , @param2 = @costcenter , @param1 = @accountcode goto lblreturn end end end lblreturn: if @myerror > 0 begin exec market_errorraise @insertby = @insertby , @errorid = @myerror , @procname = 'market_codeblockval' , @param1 = @param1 , @param2 = @param2 return @myerror end end

market_errorraise 
CREATE proc [dbo].[market_errorraise] @insertby nvarchar ( 10 ) , @errorid int , @procname nvarchar ( 30 ) , @param1 nvarchar ( 80 ) = ' ' , @param2 nvarchar ( 80 ) = ' ' , @param3 nvarchar ( 80 ) = ' ' , @defaultmessage nvarchar ( 225 ) = null as
begin declare @msg nvarchar ( 255 ) , @userid nvarchar ( 10 ) select @userid = @insertby if @param1 is null select @param1 = ' ' if @param2 is null select @param2 = ' ' if @param3 is null select @param3 = ' ' select @msg = case @errorid when 700001 then 'The Email Alias `%s` is not recognized as a valid account. Please check this entry.' when 700002 then 'Failed to change the status for order #%s based on your action. Please try again.' when 700003 then 'Requisition #%s, created by %s, cannot be amended by the current user.' when 700004 then 'Database error while updating requisition #%s. Please try again.' when 700005 then 'Cannot save  line-item because requisition #%s does not exist.' when 700006 then 'Database error while inserting new line item for requisition #%s.' when 700007 then 'Sorry, but the required entry Submit By EMail Alias `%s` is invalid. Please check your entry.' when 700008 then 'Sorry, but the required entry ApprovalMgr EMail Alias `%s` is invalid. Please check your entry.' when 700009 then 'The account code `%s` is not numeric.' when 700010 then 'The internal order `%s` is not numeric.' when 700011 then 'The costcenter `%s` is not numeric' when 700012 then 'Database error in obtaining a requisition #. Please try again.' when 700013 then 'Combination of account code `%s` and cost center `%s` is invalid.' when 700014 then 'Invalid employee number.' when 700015 then 'Entry for this requestor `%s` already exists in the database.' when 700016 then 'Invalid character in Email Alias.' else 'Undetermined error from procedure `%s`, param1=`%s`: param2=`%s`: param3=`%s`.' end raiserror ( @msg , 11 , 1 , @param1 , @param2 , @param3 ) return end

pdm_boxing CREATE procedure pdm_boxing
( @fileno int ,@vendor nvarchar(40) )
as
begin
---- @fileno int
---declare @vendor nvarchar(40)
declare @filno_count int
declare @i int
set @i = 1
--drop table #sizes1
--drop table #sizes2
--set @fileno = 1032
--set @vendor = 'HARMONY'

select DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY size1,size2,size3,size4,size5,size6,size7,size8,size9,size10,size11,size12) AS RowFilter ,
size1,size2,size3,size4,size5,size6,size7,size8,size9,size10,size11,size12 into #sizes1  from pdm_AutoBoxing  where fileno = @fileno group by  size1,size2,size3,size4,size5,size6,size7,size8,size9,size10,size11,size12
select @filno_count = max(RowFilter) from #sizes1
print @filno_count

select DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY size1,size2,size3,size4,size5,size6,size7,size8,size9,size10,size11,size12) AS RowFilter ,
*  into #sizes2  from pdm_AutoBoxing  where fileno = @fileno 

while @i <= @filno_count
begin

insert into tblboxing(fileno,vendor,size1,size2,size3,size4,size5,size6,size7,size8,size9,size10,size11,size12)
select @fileno,@vendor,size1,size2,size3,size4,size5,size6,size7,size8,size9,size10,size11,size12 from #sizes1 where RowFilter=@i 

insert into tblboxing(fileno,vendor,cutno,line,boxno,number_of_boxes,style,color,qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,
qty,total,prepack,packlist_id,prepack_code,division,import_box_id)
select @fileno,@vendor,cutno,line,boxno,number_of_boxes,style,color,qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,
qty,total,prepack,packlist_id,prepack_code,division,import_box_id from #sizes2 where RowFilter=@i
--select * from #sizes2

set @i = @i +1
end
select * from tblboxing  where vendor = @vendor and fileno = @fileno
delete from tblboxing where vendor = @vendor and fileno = @fileno
End
pickdetail_close 

CREATE PROCEDURE pickdetail_close(@pickno int) AS
/* declare cursor to loop */
declare curs cursor for
  select pickdetail_id from pickdetail where pickno=@pickno

/* local variable to hold columns returned from cursor */
declare @pickdetail_id  int
/* open the cursor and loop it!! */

open curs
fetch curs into @pickdetail_id
while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin
	/* do your thing .. */
	update pickdetail set closed='Y' where pickdetail_id=@pickdetail_id
	fetch curs into @pickdetail_id
end
/* clean up */
close curs
deallocate curs



POS_invheader_update_arcash create procedure POS_invheader_update_arcash (@invoiceno INT)
AS
declare	@customer nchar(10)
declare @TenderCash money  -- amount customer gave
declare @CashToPost money  -- amount cash less change given: i.e. amount to post to ARCASH 
declare @CashRefno nchar(15)
declare @TenderCC money 
declare @TenderCCRefno nchar(15)
declare @TenderCredit money
declare @TenderCreditRefno nchar(15)
declare @currency nchar(4)
declare @exchange_rate money
declare @current_exchange_rate money
declare @invoicetotal money 
declare @changeGiven money 

select 
@customer = isnull(customer,''),
@TenderCash=isnull(TenderCash,0),
@TenderCC=isnull(TenderCC,0),
@TenderCredit=isnull(TenderCredit,0),
@TenderCCRefno=isnull(TenderCCRefno,''),
@TenderCreditRefno=isnull(TenderCreditRefno,''),
@currency=isnull(currency,'USD'),
@exchange_Rate=isnull(exchange_rate,1.00),
@invoicetotal = isnull(total,0) 
from invheader where invoiceno=@invoiceno 

select @current_exchange_rate = isnull(conversion,1.00) from code_currency where code=@currency 
select @current_exchange_rate = isnull(@current_exchange_rate,1.00) 


select @CashToPost = @invoicetotal - @TenderCC - @TenderCredit 
if @CashToPost > @TenderCash 
	select @CashToPost = @TenderCash 

select @changeGiven = @TenderCash - @CashToPost 
if @changeGiven<0 
	select @CashRefno = '!Not Paid Full!'
else
	select @CashRefno = 'Change:'+convert(char(8),@changeGiven) 


if exists (select invoiceno from arcash where invoiceno=@invoiceno and pmt_code='CASH')
	update arcash set paidamt = @CashToPost, refno=@CashRefno where invoiceno=@invoiceno and pmt_code='CASH'
else
	insert into arcash (invoiceno, paidamt, paiddate, pmt_code, refno, customer, currency, exchange_rate, current_exchange_rate, create_date)
		values (@invoiceno, @CashToPost, GetDate(), 'CASH', @CashRefno, @customer, @currency, @exchange_rate, @current_exchange_rate, getdate() ) 

if exists (select invoiceno from arcash where invoiceno=@invoiceno and pmt_code='CC')
	update arcash set paidamt = @TenderCC, refno=left(@TenderCCRefno,15)  where invoiceno=@invoiceno and pmt_code='CC'
else
	insert into arcash (invoiceno, paidamt, refno, paiddate, pmt_code, customer, currency, exchange_rate, current_exchange_rate, create_date)
		values (@invoiceno, @TenderCC, left(@TenderCCRefno,15), GetDate(), 'CC', @customer, @currency, @exchange_rate, @current_exchange_rate, getdate() ) 

if exists (select invoiceno from arcash where invoiceno=@invoiceno and pmt_code='STCR')
	BEGIN 
		update arcash set paidamt = @TenderCredit, refno=left(@TenderCreditRefno,15) where invoiceno=@invoiceno and pmt_code='STCR'
		update arcash set paidamt = -@TenderCredit, refno=@invoiceno where invoiceno=@TenderCreditRefno and pmt_code='STCR'
	END 
else
	BEGIN 
		insert into arcash (invoiceno, paidamt, refno, paiddate, pmt_code, customer, currency, exchange_rate, current_exchange_rate, create_date)
			values (@invoiceno, @TenderCredit, left(@TenderCreditRefno,15), GetDate(), 'STCR', @customer, @currency, @exchange_rate, @current_exchange_rate, getdate() ) 
		insert into arcash (invoiceno, paidamt, refno, paiddate, pmt_code, customer, currency, exchange_rate, current_exchange_rate, create_date)
			values (@TenderCreditRefno, -@TenderCredit, @INVOICENO, GetDate(), 'STCR', @customer, @currency, @exchange_rate, @current_exchange_rate, getdate() ) 
	END 

qsum 
CREATE proc [dbo].[qsum] (@col nvarchar(25), @tbl nvarchar(25))
as
declare @qty1 nvarchar(25), @qty2 nvarchar(25), @qty3 nvarchar(25), @qty4 nvarchar(25),
@qty5 nvarchar(25), @qty6 nvarchar(25), @qty7 nvarchar(25), @qty8 nvarchar(25),
@qty9 nvarchar(25), @qty10 nvarchar(25), @qty11 nvarchar(25), @qty12 nvarchar(25)

/* get column name */
  if @col = 'qty' or @col = ''
    begin
      declare cur_sum scroll cursor for 
      select name from syscolumns 
      where object_name(id)=@tbl and substring(name,1,3)='qty'  
    end
  else
    begin
      declare cur_sum scroll cursor for 
      select name from syscolumns 
      where object_name(id)=@tbl and charindex(@col,name)>0  
    end

 open cur_sum 
 fetch absolute 1 from cur_sum into @qty1
 fetch absolute 2 from cur_sum into @qty2
 fetch absolute 3 from cur_sum into @qty3
 fetch absolute 4 from cur_sum into @qty4
 fetch absolute 5 from cur_sum into @qty5
 fetch absolute 6 from cur_sum into @qty6
 fetch absolute 7 from cur_sum into @qty7
 fetch absolute 8 from cur_sum into @qty8
 fetch absolute 9 from cur_sum into @qty9
 fetch absolute 10 from cur_sum into @qty10
 fetch absolute 11 from cur_sum into @qty11
 fetch absolute 12 from cur_sum into @qty12

select 'select sum('+@qty1+'+'+@qty2+'+'+@qty3+'+'+@qty4+'+'+@qty5+'+'+@qty6
+'+'+@qty7+'+'+@qty8+'+'+@qty9+'+'+@qty10+'+'+@qty11+'+'+@qty12+') from '+@tbl

close cur_sum
deallocate cur_sum

recalc_alloc_qty 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_alloc_qty](@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10))
as
declare @al1 int, /*place holder for sodetail table*/
	@al2 int,
	@al3 int,
	@al4 int,
	@al5 int,
	@al6 int,
	@al7 int,
	@al8 int,
	@al9 int,
	@al10 int,
	@al11 int,
	@al12 int

update ivtf set
	alloc_qty1 =  0,
	alloc_qty2 =  0,
	alloc_qty3 =  0,
	alloc_qty4 =  0,
	alloc_qty5 =  0,
	alloc_qty6 =  0,
	alloc_qty7 =  0,
	alloc_qty8 =  0,
	alloc_qty9 =  0,
	alloc_qty10 =  0,
	alloc_qty11 =  0,
	alloc_qty12 =  0
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

/* populate @al */
/* aggregate functions ignore nulls */
select  @al1 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty1), 0),
	@al2 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty2), 0),
	@al3 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty3), 0),
	@al4 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty4), 0),
	@al5 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty5), 0),
	@al6 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty6), 0),
	@al7 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty7), 0),
	@al8 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty8), 0),
	@al9 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty9), 0),
	@al10 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty10), 0),
	@al11 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty11), 0),
	@al12 = ISNULL(SUM(alloc_qty12), 0)
from sodetail, warehouse
where   style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor AND ISNULL(closed, '') <> 'Y'  and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' 
AND warehouse = warehouse.code

/* now recalculate allocated values in ivtf table */
update ivtf set
	alloc_qty1 =  @al1,
	alloc_qty2 =  @al2,
	alloc_qty3 =  @al3,
	alloc_qty4 =  @al4,
	alloc_qty5 =  @al5,
	alloc_qty6 =  @al6,
	alloc_qty7 =  @al7,
	alloc_qty8 =  @al8,
	alloc_qty9 =  @al9,
	alloc_qty10 =  @al10,
	alloc_qty11 =  @al11,
	alloc_qty12 =  @al12
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
return

recalc_customer_onorder CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_customer_onorder] as
/*first needs to zero out*/
update customer set onorder = 0;
UPDATE customer SET onorder = 
(SELECT SUM(backorder*price) FROM v_backorderdetail where v_backorderdetail.customer = customer.code);


recalc_customer_onorder_customercode /*190517 Arun added to update based on each customer can be used in the triggers*/
Create Procedure [recalc_customer_onorder_customercode] (@code nvarchar(10)) as
/*first needs to zero out*/
update customer set onorder = 0 WHERE code = @code;
UPDATE customer SET onorder = 
(SELECT SUM(backorder*price) FROM v_backorderdetail where v_backorderdetail.customer = customer.code ) 
WHERE customer.code = @code

recalc_invheader_emptyduedates create proc recalc_invheader_emptyduedates 
as
update i set i.canceldate = dateadd(day,isnull(t.cutoffday,0),i.invoicedate)
from invheader i, terms t
where i.terms = t.code
and (i.canceldate is null or i.canceldate < 1900-01-01)

recalc_invheader_totqty 


create procedure recalc_invheader_totqty as
update invheader set totqty=(select sum(v.qty) from
 v_inv_total v where v.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno
 group by v.invoiceno)

CREATE PROCEDURE recalc_ivtf_alloc as

UPDATE SODETAIL SET ALLOC_QTY1=0,ALLOC_QTY2=0,ALLOC_QTY3=0,
ALLOC_QTY4=0,ALLOC_QTY5=0,ALLOC_QTY6=0,
ALLOC_QTY7=0,ALLOC_QTY8=0,ALLOC_QTY9=0,
ALLOC_QTY10=0,ALLOC_QTY11=0,ALLOC_QTY12=0 WHERE CLOSED='Y' AND 
(ISNULL(ALLOC_QTY1,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(ALLOC_QTY2,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(ALLOC_QTY3,0)<>0 OR 
ISNULL(ALLOC_QTY4,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(ALLOC_QTY5,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(ALLOC_QTY6,0)<>0 OR

recalc_onhand_qty 
/* 080922 dan - Royaltor */
CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_onhand_qty](@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10))
as
exec recalc_ivtf_wh @style, @color, @royaltor

/* Pre-Process for Recalculation (10/29/01 - Jeon) */

update ivtf set 	qty1 =  0, qty2 =  0,
	qty3 =  0,	qty4 =  0,	qty5 =  0,	qty6 =  0,
	qty7 =  0,	qty8 =  0,	qty9 =  0,	qty10 =  0,
	qty11 =  0,	qty12 =  0 
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor


/* now recalculate onhand values in ivtf table */
update ivtf set 
qty1=(select sum(isnull(qty1,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty2=(select sum(isnull(qty2,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty3=(select sum(isnull(qty3,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty4=(select sum(isnull(qty4,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty5=(select sum(isnull(qty5,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty6=(select sum(isnull(qty6,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty7=(select sum(isnull(qty7,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty8=(select sum(isnull(qty8,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty9=(select sum(isnull(qty9,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse), 
qty10=(select sum(isnull(qty10,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty11=(select sum(isnull(qty11,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse),
qty12=(select sum(isnull(qty12,0)) from ivtf_wh, warehouse where style=ivtf.code and 
	color=ivtf.color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse) 
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
return

recalc_onhand_qty_all 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.recalc_onhand_qty_all    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.recalc_onhand_qty_all    Script Date: 6/11/98 1:18:41 AM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.recalc_onhand_qty_all    Script Date: 12/2/97 10:30:14 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.recalc_onhand_qty_all    Script Date: 11/29/97 9:43:30 AM ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[recalc_onhand_qty_all] AS
/* declare cursor to loop */
declare code_curs cursor for
	select code, color, isnull(royaltor,'')
	from ivtf
	for read only

/* local variable to hold columns returned from cursor */
declare @code  nchar(13),
	@color nchar(12),
	@royaltor nchar(10),
	@cnt int

/* open the cursor and loop it!! */
open code_curs
fetch code_curs into @code, @color, @royaltor

select @cnt = 0
while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin
	/* do your thing .. */
	exec recalc_onhand_qty @code, @color, @royaltor

	/* select @code, @color */
	select @cnt = @cnt + 1

	/* fetch next row */
	fetch code_curs into @code, @color, @royaltor
end

/* clean up */
close code_curs

select @cnt
deallocate code_curs

recalc_onorder_qty 

CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_onorder_qty](@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10))
as
/* revised by dan on 11/29/97 - take CLOSED into account, take Shipped_QTY > QTY into account */
/* first execute recalc_shipped_qty to reset sodetail.shipped_qty1..9 */
/*exec recalc_shipped_qty  @style,  @color, @royaltor */

declare @qty1 int,
	@qty2 int,
	@qty3 int,
	@qty4 int,
	@qty5 int,
	@qty6 int,
	@qty7 int,
	@qty8 int,
	@qty9 int,
	@qty10 int,
	@qty11 int,
	@qty12 int

/* assign local variables */
select @qty1 = sum(case  when isnull(qty1,0) < isnull(shipped_qty1,0) then 0 else isnull(qty1,0)-isnull(shipped_qty1,0) end),
 @qty2 = sum(case  when isnull(qty2,0) < isnull(shipped_qty2,0) then 0 else isnull(qty2,0)-isnull(shipped_qty2,0) end),
 @qty3 = sum(case  when isnull(qty3,0) < isnull(shipped_qty3,0) then 0 else isnull(qty3,0)-isnull(shipped_qty3,0) end),
 @qty4 = sum(case  when isnull(qty4,0) < isnull(shipped_qty4,0) then 0 else isnull(qty4,0)-isnull(shipped_qty4,0) end),
 @qty5 = sum(case  when isnull(qty5,0) < isnull(shipped_qty5,0) then 0 else isnull(qty5,0)-isnull(shipped_qty5,0) end),
 @qty6 = sum(case  when isnull(qty6,0) < isnull(shipped_qty6,0) then 0 else isnull(qty6,0)-isnull(shipped_qty6,0) end),
 @qty7 = sum(case  when isnull(qty7,0) < isnull(shipped_qty7,0) then 0 else isnull(qty7,0)-isnull(shipped_qty7,0) end),
 @qty8 = sum(case  when isnull(qty8,0) < isnull(shipped_qty8,0) then 0 else isnull(qty8,0)-isnull(shipped_qty8,0) end),
 @qty9 = sum(case  when isnull(qty9,0) < isnull(shipped_qty9,0) then 0 else isnull(qty9,0)-isnull(shipped_qty9,0) end),
 @qty10 = sum(case  when isnull(qty10,0) < isnull(shipped_qty10,0) then 0 else isnull(qty10,0)-isnull(shipped_qty10,0) end),
 @qty11 = sum(case  when isnull(qty11,0) < isnull(shipped_qty11,0) then 0 else isnull(qty11,0)-isnull(shipped_qty11,0) end),
 @qty12 = sum(case  when isnull(qty12,0) < isnull(shipped_qty12,0) then 0 else isnull(qty12,0)-isnull(shipped_qty12,0) end)
from sodetail, warehouse
where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor and 
closed<>'Y'  and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG' and warehouse.code = warehouse

update ivtf
set     onorder_qty1 = 0,
	onorder_qty2 = 0,
	onorder_qty3 = 0,
	onorder_qty4 = 0,
	onorder_qty5 = 0,
	onorder_qty6 = 0,
	onorder_qty7 = 0,
	onorder_qty8 = 0,
	onorder_qty9 = 0,
	onorder_qty10 = 0,
	onorder_qty11 = 0,
	onorder_qty12 = 0
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

update ivtf
set     onorder_qty1 = isnull(@qty1,0),
	onorder_qty2 = isnull(@qty2,0),
	onorder_qty3 = isnull(@qty3,0),
	onorder_qty4 = isnull(@qty4,0),
	onorder_qty5 = isnull(@qty5,0),
	onorder_qty6 = isnull(@qty6,0),
	onorder_qty7 = isnull(@qty7,0),
	onorder_qty8 = isnull(@qty8,0),
	onorder_qty9 = isnull(@qty9,0),
	onorder_qty10 = isnull(@qty10,0),
	onorder_qty11 = isnull(@qty11,0),
	onorder_qty12 = isnull(@qty12,0)
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

return

recalc_pick_qty /* 1910dan.sql */ 


CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_pick_qty](@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10))
as
declare @qty1 int,
	@qty2 int,
	@qty3 int,
	@qty4 int,
	@qty5 int,
	@qty6 int,
	@qty7 int,
	@qty8 int,
	@qty9 int,
	@qty10 int,
	@qty11 int,
	@qty12 int

/* 191002 dan - check only pickheader for OPEN/CLOSED */ 
select 
@qty1=sum(isnull(qty1,0)),
@qty2=sum(isnull(qty2,0)),
@qty3=sum(isnull(qty3,0)),
@qty4=sum(isnull(qty4,0)),
@qty5=sum(isnull(qty5,0)),
@qty6=sum(isnull(qty6,0)),
@qty7=sum(isnull(qty7,0)),
@qty8=sum(isnull(qty8,0)),
@qty9=sum(isnull(qty9,0)),
@qty10=sum(isnull(qty10,0)),
@qty11=sum(isnull(qty11,0)),
@qty12=sum(isnull(qty12,0))
from pickdetail join pickheader on pickdetail.pickno=pickheader.pickno 
where style=@style and color=@color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor and pickheader.closed='N' 
group by style,color, royaltor

/*zero out first*/
update ivtf
set     pick_qty1 = 0,
	pick_qty2 = 0,
	pick_qty3 = 0,
	pick_qty4 = 0,
	pick_qty5 = 0,
	pick_qty6 = 0,
	pick_qty7 = 0,
	pick_qty8 = 0,
	pick_qty9 = 0,
	pick_qty10 = 0,
	pick_qty11 = 0,
	pick_qty12 = 0
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

update ivtf
