	pick_qty3 = @qty3,
	pick_qty4 = @qty4,
	pick_qty5 = @qty5,
	pick_qty6 = @qty6,
	pick_qty7 = @qty7,
	pick_qty8 = @qty8,
	pick_qty9 = @qty9,
	pick_qty10 = @qty10,
	pick_qty11 = @qty11,
	pick_qty12 = @qty12
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

return

recalc_pick_qty_all 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[recalc_pick_qty_all] AS
/* declare cursor to loop */
declare code_curs cursor for
	select code, color,royaltor
	from ivtf
	for read only
/* local variable to hold columns returned from cursor */
declare @code  nchar(13),
	@color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10),
	@cnt int
/* open the cursor and loop it!! */open code_curs
fetch code_curs into @code, @color, @royaltor
select @cnt = 0
while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin
	/* do your thing .. */
	exec recalc_pick_qty @code, @color,@royaltor
	/* select @code, @color */
	select @cnt = @cnt + 1
	/* fetch next row */
	fetch code_curs into @code, @color,@royaltor
end
/* clean up */
close code_curs
select @cnt
deallocate code_curs

recalc_received_qty 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_received_qty](@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10))
as
update cutdetail
set received_qty1 = (select isnull(sum(qty1), 0)
			from logfdetail where cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and location='HOUS' ), 
    received_qty2 = (select isnull(sum(qty2), 0)
			from logfdetail where cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and location='HOUS' ), 
    received_qty3 = (select isnull(sum(qty3), 0)
			from logfdetail where cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and location='HOUS' ), 
    received_qty4 = (select isnull(sum(qty4), 0)
			from logfdetail where cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and location='HOUS' ), 
    received_qty5 = (select isnull(sum(qty5), 0)
			from logfdetail where cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and location='HOUS' ), 
    received_qty6 = (select isnull(sum(qty6), 0)
			from logfdetail where cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and location='HOUS' ), 
    received_qty7 = (select isnull(sum(qty7), 0)
			from logfdetail where cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and location='HOUS' ), 
    received_qty8 = (select isnull(sum(qty8), 0)
			from logfdetail where cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and location='HOUS' ), 
    received_qty9 = (select isnull(sum(qty9), 0)

    received_qty10 = (select isnull(sum(qty10), 0)

    received_qty12 = (select isnull(sum(qty12), 0)

where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

recalc_required_qty 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_required_qty](@type nchar(1), @code nchar(15), @color nchar(12))
as
declare @qty int
select @qty=required from v_ivtr_req_notcut 
where v_ivtr_req_notcut.raw_type=@type and v_ivtr_req_notcut.raw_code=@code and 
v_ivtr_req_notcut.raw_color=@color


update ivtr
set required = @qty
where code = @code and color = @color and location = 'HOUS' AND isnull(ivtr.lot,'')=''

return

recalc_required_qty_all 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[recalc_required_qty_all] AS
/* declare cursor to loop */
declare code_curs cursor for
	select type, code, color
	from ivtr
	for read only

/* local variable to hold columns returned from cursor */
declare 
	@type nchar(1),
	@code  nchar(15),
	@color nchar(12),
	@cnt int

/* open the cursor and loop it!! */
open code_curs
fetch code_curs into @type, @code, @color

select @cnt = 0
while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin
	/* do your thing .. */	exec recalc_required_qty @type, @code, @color

	/* select @code, @color */
	select @cnt = @cnt + 1

	/* fetch next row */
	fetch code_curs into @type, @code, @color      
end

/* clean up */
close code_curs

select @cnt
deallocate code_curs

recalc_reserved_qty 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_reserved_qty](@code nchar(15), @color nchar(12))
as
declare @qty int
select @qty = sum(reserve)
from ivtr_reserved
where code = @code and color = @color

update ivtr
set reserve = @qty
where code = @code and color = @color

return

recalc_shipped_qty 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_shipped_qty](@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10))
as
update sodetail
set shipped_qty1 = (select isnull(sum(qty1), 0)
			from invdetail
			where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
			and orderno = sodetail.orderno),
    shipped_qty2 = (select isnull(sum(qty2), 0)
			from invdetail 
			where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
			and orderno = sodetail.orderno),
    shipped_qty3 = (select isnull(sum(qty3), 0)
			from invdetail
			where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
			and orderno = sodetail.orderno),
    shipped_qty4 = (select isnull(sum(qty4), 0)
			from invdetail 
			where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
			and orderno = sodetail.orderno),
    shipped_qty5 = (select isnull(sum(qty5), 0)
			from invdetail
			where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
			and orderno = sodetail.orderno),
    shipped_qty6 = (select isnull(sum(qty6), 0)
			from invdetail 
			where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
			and orderno = sodetail.orderno),
    shipped_qty7 = (select isnull(sum(qty7), 0)
			from invdetail 
			where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
			and orderno = sodetail.orderno),
    shipped_qty8 = (select isnull(sum(qty8), 0)
			from invdetail
			where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
			and orderno = sodetail.orderno),
    shipped_qty9 = (select isnull(sum(qty9), 0)
			from invdetail 
			where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor
			and orderno = sodetail.orderno),
    shipped_qty10 = (select isnull(sum(qty10), 0)
			from invdetail

recalc_soheader 



/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.recalc_soheader    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
create procedure recalc_soheader as
update soheader set total = (select sum( ( sodetail.qty1+sodetail.qty2+sodetail.qty3+sodetail.qty4+sodetail.qty5+sodetail.qty6+
sodetail.qty7+sodetail.qty8+sodetail.qty9+sodetail.qty10+sodetail.qty11+sodetail.qty12 ) * sodetail.price )
 from sodetail where sodetail.orderno=soheader.orderno ) ,
  subtotal= (select sum(sodetail.qty1+sodetail.qty2+sodetail.qty3+sodetail.qty4+sodetail.qty5+sodetail.qty6+
sodetail.qty7+sodetail.qty8+sodetail.qty9+sodetail.qty10+sodetail.qty11+sodetail.qty12 )
 from sodetail where sodetail.orderno=soheader.orderno )





recalc_soheader_shipped /* update soheader shipped */
create procedure recalc_soheader_shipped as
update soheader set shipped= (select sum(shipped_qty1+shipped_qty2+
shipped_qty3+shipped_qty4+shipped_qty5+
shipped_qty6+shipped_qty7+shipped_qty8+
shipped_qty9+shipped_qty10+shipped_qty11+
shipped_qty12) from sodetail where soheader.orderno=sodetail.orderno )



recalc_soheader_shipped_orderno 
/*230728 Arun update soheader shipped for each order*/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_soheader_shipped_orderno] (@orderno INT) as
update soheader set shipped= (select sum(shipped_qty1+shipped_qty2+
shipped_qty3+shipped_qty4+shipped_qty5+
shipped_qty6+shipped_qty7+shipped_qty8+
shipped_qty9+shipped_qty10+shipped_qty11+
shipped_qty12) from sodetail where soheader.orderno=sodetail.orderno )
WHERE soheader.orderno = @orderno


recalc_transit_qty 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_transit_qty](@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10))
as
declare @qty1 int,
	@qty2 int,
	@qty3 int,
	@qty4 int,
	@qty5 int,
	@qty6 int,
	@qty7 int,
	@qty8 int,
	@qty9 int,
	@qty10 int,
	@qty11 int,
	@qty12 int

/* assign local variables */
select 
@qty1 =  isnull(sum(qty1),0),
@qty2 =  isnull(sum(qty2),0),
@qty3 =  isnull(sum(qty3),0),
@qty4 =  isnull(sum(qty4),0),
@qty5 =  isnull(sum(qty5),0),
@qty6 =  isnull(sum(qty6),0),
@qty7 =  isnull(sum(qty7),0),
@qty8 =  isnull(sum(qty8),0),
@qty9 =  isnull(sum(qty9),0),
@qty10 =  isnull(sum(qty10),0),
@qty11 =  isnull(sum(qty11),0),
@qty12 =  isnull(sum(qty12),0)
from v_wip_location, location, warehouse
where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'')= @royaltor and
v_wip_location.location=location.code and location.type='I'  and warehouse.wh_type <> 'DG'
and v_wip_location.warehouse = warehouse.code


update ivtf
set     transit_qty1 = 0,
	transit_qty2 = 0,
	transit_qty3 = 0,
	transit_qty4 = 0,
	transit_qty5 = 0,
	transit_qty6 = 0,
	transit_qty7 = 0,
	transit_qty8 = 0,
	transit_qty9 = 0,
	transit_qty10 = 0,
	transit_qty11 = 0,
	transit_qty12 = 0
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

update ivtf
set     transit_qty1 = @qty1,
	transit_qty2 = @qty2,
	transit_qty3 = @qty3,
	transit_qty4 = @qty4,
	transit_qty5 = @qty5,
	transit_qty6 = @qty6,
	transit_qty7 = @qty7,
	transit_qty8 = @qty8,
	transit_qty9 = @qty9,
	transit_qty10 = @qty10,
	transit_qty11 = @qty11,
	transit_qty12 = @qty12
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

return

recalc_transit_qty_all 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[recalc_transit_qty_all] AS
/* declare cursor to loop */
declare code_curs cursor for
	select code, color, isnull(royaltor,'')
	from ivtf
	for read only

/* local variable to hold columns returned from cursor */
declare @code  nchar(13),
	@color nchar(12),@royaltor nchar(10),
	@cnt int

/* open the cursor and loop it!! */open code_curs
fetch code_curs into @code, @color,@royaltor

select @cnt = 0
while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin
	/* do your thing .. */
	exec recalc_transit_qty @code, @color, @royaltor

	/* select @code, @color */
	select @cnt = @cnt + 1

	/* fetch next row */
	fetch code_curs into @code, @color ,@royaltor     
end

/* clean up */
close code_curs

select @cnt
deallocate code_curs

recalc_wip_qty 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[recalc_wip_qty](@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10))
as
/* first execute recalc_shipped_qty to reset sodetail.shipped_qty1..9 */
exec recalc_received_qty  @style,  @color, @royaltor

declare @qty1 int,
	@qty2 int,
	@qty3 int,
	@qty4 int,
	@qty5 int,
	@qty6 int,
	@qty7 int,
	@qty8 int,
	@qty9 int,
	@qty10 int,
	@qty11 int,
	@qty12 int


/* assign local variables */
select @qty1 = sum(case  when qty1 < received_qty1 then 0 else qty1-received_qty1 end),
@qty2 = sum(case  when qty2 < received_qty2 then 0 else qty2-received_qty2 end),
@qty3 = sum(case  when qty3 < received_qty3 then 0 else qty3-received_qty3 end),
@qty4 = sum(case  when qty4 < received_qty4 then 0 else qty4-received_qty4 end),
@qty5 = sum(case  when qty5 < received_qty5 then 0 else qty5-received_qty5 end),
@qty6 = sum(case  when qty6 < received_qty6 then 0 else qty6-received_qty6 end),
@qty7 = sum(case  when qty7 < received_qty7 then 0 else qty7-received_qty7 end),
@qty8 = sum(case  when qty8 < received_qty8 then 0 else qty8-received_qty8 end),
@qty9 = sum(case  when qty9 < received_qty9 then 0 else qty9-received_qty9 end),
@qty10 = sum(case  when qty10 < received_qty10 then 0 else qty10-received_qty10 end),
@qty11 = sum(case  when qty11 < received_qty11 then 0 else qty11-received_qty11 end),
@qty12 = sum(case  when qty12 < received_qty12 then 0 else qty12-received_qty12 end)
from cutdetail 
where style = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor and closed<>'Y'

/*zero out first*/
update ivtf
set     wip_qty1 = 0,
	wip_qty2 = 0,
	wip_qty3 = 0,
	wip_qty4 = 0,
	wip_qty5 = 0,
	wip_qty6 = 0,
	wip_qty7 = 0,
	wip_qty8 = 0,
	wip_qty9 = 0,
	wip_qty10 = 0,
	wip_qty11 = 0,
	wip_qty12 = 0
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

/* For a given, specific style + color, update ivtf.onorder_qty1..9 */
/* orderno doesn't matter as long as style + color combo matches */
update ivtf
set     wip_qty1 = @qty1,
	wip_qty2 = @qty2,
	wip_qty3 = @qty3,
	wip_qty4 = @qty4,
	wip_qty5 = @qty5,
	wip_qty6 = @qty6,
	wip_qty7 = @qty7,
	wip_qty8 = @qty8,
	wip_qty9 = @qty9,
	wip_qty10 = @qty10,
	wip_qty11 = @qty11,
	wip_qty12 = @qty12
where code = @style and color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = @royaltor

return

rename_customer

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rename_customer](@oldcode nchar(13), @newcode nchar(13))
AS
UPDATE arcash SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE archeck SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE billto SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE bundle_tkt SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE code_sku SET custid = @newcode WHERE custid = @oldcode
UPDATE comheader SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE contacts SET code = @newcode WHERE code = @oldcode
UPDATE customer_edi SET customer_code = @newcode WHERE customer_code = @oldcode
UPDATE customer_status SET code = @newcode WHERE code = @oldcode
UPDATE cutheader SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE dept SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE distri SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE edi_997 SET edi_customer = @newcode WHERE edi_customer = @oldcode
UPDATE edi_po SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE edi_po_sku_qty SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE factor_customer SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE invheader SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE ivtf_activity SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE pickheader SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE rmaheader SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE soheader SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE store SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE bol SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE worktable SET customer = @newcode WHERE customer = @oldcode
UPDATE customer SET code = @newcode WHERE code = @oldcode
RETURN

replace_customer 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.replace_customer    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[replace_customer](@oldcode nchar(10), @newcode nchar(10))
as
if exists (select * from sysobjects where id = object_id('dbo.tg_cust_update') and sysstat & 0xf = 8)
	drop trigger dbo.tg_cust_update

UPDATE	arcash
SET	customer = @newcode
WHERE	customer = @oldcode

UPDATE	billto
SET	customer = @newcode
WHERE	customer = @oldcode

UPDATE	customer
SET	code = @newcode
WHERE	code = @oldcode

UPDATE	cutheader
SET	customer = @newcode
WHERE	customer = @oldcode

UPDATE	distri
SET	customer = @newcode
WHERE	customer = @oldcode

UPDATE	invheader
SET	customer = @newcode
WHERE	customer = @oldcode

UPDATE	rmaheader
SET	customer = @newcode
WHERE	customer = @oldcode

UPDATE	soheader
SET	customer = @newcode
WHERE	customer = @oldcode

UPDATE	store
SET	customer = @newcode
WHERE	customer = @oldcode

replication_email_user CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[replication_email_user] ( @email varchar(100) ) AS
declare @mybody nvarchar(max)
select @mybody = ''   
EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail 
	@recipients =  @email, 
	@subject = 'Replication Status', 
	@body = @mybody, 
	@body_format = 'HTML'

reseed_ivtf_sample_upc create PROCEDURE [dbo].[reseed_ivtf_sample_upc] (@from INT,@to INT)
AS
	UPDATE  dbo.ivtf_sample SET upc=REPLACE(upc,LEFT(upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(upc,6)=@from 
	UPDATE  dbo.ivtf_sample_docs SET upc=REPLACE(upc,LEFT(upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(upc,6)=@from

	UPDATE  dbo.ivtf_sample_vendor_cost SET sample_upc=REPLACE(sample_upc,LEFT(sample_upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(sample_upc,6)=@from
	UPDATE  dbo.Sample_Request SET upc=REPLACE(upc,LEFT(upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(upc,6)=@from

	UPDATE  dbo.SAMPLE_TRAN SET sample_upc=REPLACE(sample_upc,LEFT(sample_upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(sample_upc,6)=@from
	UPDATE  dbo.spec_sheet SET upc=REPLACE(upc,LEFT(upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(upc,6)=@from

	UPDATE  dbo.Fit_Comment SET upc=REPLACE(upc,LEFT(upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(upc,6)=@from
	UPDATE  dbo.bom_sample SET upc=REPLACE(upc,LEFT(upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(upc,6)=@from	

	UPDATE  dbo.ivtf_image SET sample_upc=REPLACE(sample_upc,LEFT(sample_upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(sample_upc,6)=@from
	UPDATE  dbo.ivtf_image_file SET sample_upc=REPLACE(sample_upc,LEFT(sample_upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(sample_upc,6)=@from

	UPDATE  dbo.bartender_upc_sample SET upc=REPLACE(upc,LEFT(upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(upc,6)=@from
	UPDATE  dbo.webprodpattern_detail1 SET upc=REPLACE(upc,LEFT(upc,6),@to) WHERE LEFT(upc,6)=@from

SalesOrders2 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SalesOrders2]  AS
/* ordered & shipped */  select orderno,customer,store, custpo,
cast(orderdate as nchar(12)) Ordered  ,cast(shipdate as nchar(12)) Ship,
 cast(canceldate as nchar(12)) Cancel,cast(total as decimal(10,2)) Total$, 
  cast(subtotal as decimal(8,0)) Ordered  ,
 coalesce((select sum(qty1+qty2+qty3+qty4+qty5+QTY6+qty7+qty8+qty9+qty10+qty11+qty12
-shipped_qty1-shipped_qty2-shipped_qty3-shipped_qty4-shipped_qty5-shipped_qty6
-shipped_qty7-shipped_qty8-shipped_qty9-shipped_qty10-shipped_qty11-shipped_qty12)  from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno),0) shipped,  
 coalesce((select sum(qty1+qty2+qty3+qty4+qty5+QTY6+qty7+qty8+qty9+qty10+qty11+qty12
-shipped_qty1-shipped_qty2-shipped_qty3-shipped_qty4-shipped_qty5-shipped_qty6
-shipped_qty7-shipped_qty8-shipped_qty9-shipped_qty10-shipped_qty11-shipped_qty12)  from sodetail where orderno=soheader.orderno and closed<>'Y'),0)
 OpenQty   from soheader where closed='N' order by customer,store

sku_boxing 	CREATE procedure [dbo].[sku_boxing]
@skuopde nchar(30),
@fileno int,
@cutno int,
@boxno int
as
begin

declare  @style nchar(13)
declare  @color nchar(12)
declare @count int
declare @lineno int


--select @boxno = isnull(max(boxno),0) + 1 from import_box where fileno = @fileno and cutno = @cutno
--set @boxno = 1
 
select @style= style, @color = color from code_sku where sku = @skuopde

select @count = isnull(count(*),0) from packlist_import where style = @style and color = @color and fileno = @fileno and boxno = @boxno

select @lineno = isnull(max(line),0) from packlist_import where  boxno = @boxno and fileno = @fileno

if @boxno = 0
begin
select @boxno = isnull(max(boxno),0) + 1 from import_box where  fileno = @fileno

insert into import_box(fileno,cutno,boxno,begbox) values(@fileno,@cutno,@boxno,@boxno) 

insert into packlist_import(fileno,cutno,line,boxno,style,color,qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12) 
select @fileno,@cutno,@lineno,@boxno,@style,@color, pack1,pack2,pack3,pack4,pack5,pack6,pack7,pack8,pack9,pack10,pack11,pack12 
from code_sku where sku = @skuopde
end
else
begin

if @count >= 1

update packlist_import 
set
packlist_import.qty1 = isnull(code_sku.pack1,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty1,0),
packlist_import.qty2 = isnull(code_sku.pack2,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty2,0),
packlist_import.qty3 = isnull(code_sku.pack3,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty3,0) ,
packlist_import.qty4 = isnull(code_sku.pack4,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty4,0),
packlist_import.qty5 = isnull(code_sku.pack5,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty5,0),
packlist_import.qty6 = isnull(code_sku.pack6,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty6,0),
packlist_import.qty7 = isnull(code_sku.pack7,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty7,0),
packlist_import.qty8 = isnull(code_sku.pack8,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty8,0) ,
packlist_import.qty9 = isnull(code_sku.pack9,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty9,0) ,
packlist_import.qty10 = isnull(code_sku.pack10,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty10,0) ,
packlist_import.qty11 = isnull(code_sku.pack11,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty11,0),
packlist_import.qty12 = isnull(code_sku.pack12,0) + isnull(packlist_import.qty12,0) 
from packlist_import
join
code_sku on packlist_import.style = code_sku.style and packlist_import.color = code_sku.color
where packlist_import.cutno = @cutno and packlist_import.fileno = @fileno  and packlist_import.style = @style 
and packlist_import.color = @color and packlist_import.boxno = @boxno


else
begin
insert into packlist_import(fileno,cutno,line,boxno,style,color,qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12) 
select @fileno,@cutno,@lineno,@boxno,@style,@color, pack1,pack2,pack3,pack4,pack5,pack6,pack7,pack8,pack9,pack10,pack11,pack12 
from code_sku where sku = @skuopde
end
end
end
SmartSearch2 CREATE procedure [SmartSearch2]  @itemno char(40)  
AS
select  TOP 100 id, code, descript, price,Thumbnail1,washing_instruction1  
from  ios_view_list_styleonly where  code like RTRIM(@itemno)+'%' OR 
descript like RTRIM(@itemno)+'%' OR color like RTRIM(@itemno)+'%'
/* end */

SmartSearch2_tradeshow CREATE procedure [dbo].[SmartSearch2_tradeshow]  @itemno char(40), @pricelevel char(1) ,@color char(1)=NULL
AS
/* 140202 dan - added SEASON to search */ 
IF @color='Y'
BEGIN
select  TOP 200 id, code, descript, 
case @pricelevel 
WHEN 'B' Then priceb
When 'C' Then pricec 
WHEN 'D' Then priced 
WHEN 'E' Then pricee 
WHEN 'F' Then pricef else price end as price,Thumbnail1,washing_instruction1,color  
from  ios_view_list_tradeshow
where color<>'.' and  color like RTRIM(@itemno)+'%'
ORDER BY code, descript, color
END

ELSE
BEGIN
select  TOP 200 id, code, descript, 
case @pricelevel 
WHEN 'B' Then priceb
When 'C' Then pricec 
WHEN 'D' Then priced 
WHEN 'E' Then pricee 
WHEN 'F' Then pricef else price end as price,Thumbnail1,washing_instruction1,color  
from  ios_view_list_tradeshow
where color<>'.' and ( season like RTRIM(@itemno)+'%' OR code like '%'+RTRIM(@itemno)+'%' OR 
descript like '%'+RTRIM(@itemno)+'%' OR color like '%'+RTRIM(@itemno)+'%')
ORDER BY code, descript, color
END
sp_activity_summary CREATE PROCEDURE mon.sp_activity_summary (@minutes INT = 60)
WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @since DATETIME2(3) = DATEADD(MINUTE, -@minutes, SYSDATETIME());

    RAISERROR('=== Data manipulation in the last %d minutes ===', 0, 1, @minutes) WITH NOWAIT;
    SELECT TOP 50 schema_name, table_name, event_type,
                  COUNT(*) AS statements, SUM(row_count) AS rows_affected,
                  MIN(changed_at) AS first_seen, MAX(changed_at) AS last_seen
    FROM mon.dml_audit WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE changed_at >= @since
    GROUP BY schema_name, table_name, event_type
    ORDER BY last_seen DESC;

    RAISERROR('=== Users active in the window ===', 0, 1) WITH NOWAIT;
    SELECT DISTINCT changed_by, host_name, app_name
    FROM mon.dml_audit WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE changed_at >= @since;

    RAISERROR('=== DDL in the last %d minutes ===', 0, 1, @minutes) WITH NOWAIT;
    SELECT TOP 50 event_type, object_schema, object_name, object_type,
                  login_name, host_name, changed_at
    FROM mon.ddl_audit WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE changed_at >= @since
    ORDER BY changed_at DESC;

    RAISERROR('=== Row-count deltas between two most recent snapshots ===', 0, 1) WITH NOWAIT;
    SELECT TOP 100 prev.schema_name, prev.table_name,
                   prev.row_count AS before_rows, curr.row_count AS after_rows,
                   curr.row_count - prev.row_count AS delta
    FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY schema_name, table_name ORDER BY snapshot_id DESC) AS rn
          FROM mon.rowcount_history) curr
    JOIN (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY schema_name, table_name ORDER BY snapshot_id DESC) AS rn
          FROM mon.rowcount_history) prev
        ON curr.schema_name = prev.schema_name AND curr.table_name = prev.table_name AND prev.rn = 2
    WHERE curr.rn = 1 AND curr.row_count <> prev.row_count
    ORDER BY ABS(curr.row_count - prev.row_count) DESC;
END;
sp_alterdiagram 
	CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_alterdiagram
	(
		@diagramname 	sysname,
		@owner_id	int	= null,
		@version 	int,
		@definition 	varbinary(max)
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		set nocount on
	
		declare @theId 			int
		declare @retval 		int
		declare @IsDbo 			int
		
		declare @UIDFound 		int
		declare @DiagId			int
		declare @ShouldChangeUID	int
	
		if(@diagramname is null)
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Invalid ARG', 16, 1)
			return -1
		end
	
		execute as caller;
		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();	 
		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner'); 
		if(@owner_id is null)
			select @owner_id = @theId;
		revert;
	
		select @ShouldChangeUID = 0
		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname 
		
		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @theId <> @UIDFound))
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1);
			return -3
		end
	
		if(@IsDbo <> 0)
		begin
			if(@UIDFound is null or USER_NAME(@UIDFound) is null) -- invalid principal_id
			begin
				select @ShouldChangeUID = 1 ;
			end
		end

		-- update dds data			
		update dbo.sysdiagrams set definition = @definition where diagram_id = @DiagId ;

		-- change owner
		if(@ShouldChangeUID = 1)
			update dbo.sysdiagrams set principal_id = @theId where diagram_id = @DiagId ;

		-- update dds version
		if(@version is not null)
			update dbo.sysdiagrams set version = @version where diagram_id = @DiagId ;

		return 0
	END
	
SP_AR_STATEMENT_EMAIL CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_AR_STATEMENT_EMAIL] (@invdate  varchar(max)=null,@cuscode varchar(max), @EMAIL varchar(max),@subject nvarchar(255),@cc varchar(max)=null)
AS

BEGIN

DECLARE @tableHTML  NVARCHAR(MAX) ;
/*rbalance*/

--	select * from #temp1
--	select * from #temptable

	--drop table #temptable
	--drop table  #temp1

/*for R.Balance -Christhu 140819*/
select CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),isnull(invheader.total,0.00) - 
				  isnull((select sum(coalesce(arcash.paidamt,0)) 
							from arcash where arcash.paiddate < dateadd(day,1,isnull(CONVERT(date,@invdate),getdate())) and invheader.invoiceno = arcash.invoiceno
                  ) ,0)) as balace,row_number()over(order by invheader.invoiceno)as rowno,isnull(invoiceno,0) as tempinv into #temptable
	from invheader LEFT OUTER join terms on isnull(invheader.terms, '') = isnull(terms.code, '') where customer=@cuscode and 
	isnull(invheader.closed, 'N')<>'Y' and ( invheader.invoicedate < dateadd(day,1,isnull(CONVERT(date,@invdate),getdate())) ) order by invoiceno asc

select a.tempinv, (select sum(b.balace)
						from #temptable b
						where b.rowno<=a.rowno )as rbalance
into #temp1 from #temptable a order by a.tempinv asc

/* for balance -Christhu 140819 */
select format(CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),isnull(invheader.total,0.00) - 
				  isnull((select sum(coalesce(arcash.paidamt,0)) 
				
			      from arcash where arcash.paiddate < dateadd(day,1,isnull(CONVERT(date,@invdate),getdate())) and invheader.invoiceno = arcash.invoiceno

sp_auto_close_received_cuts CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_auto_close_received_cuts] 
as
BEGIN
DECLARE @cutdetail_id int
DECLARE @cutno int
DECLARE @c int
DECLARE @d int

DECLARE con_cursor CURSOR FOR
 SELECT cutdetail_id FROM cutdetail WHERE closed <>'Y' and  isnull(received_qty,0) >= isnull(qty,0) and isnull(qty,0) > 0
OPEN con_cursor
FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor INTO @cutdetail_id
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
	  UPDATE cutdetail SET closed = 'Y'  WHERE cutdetail_id = @cutdetail_id 
	  FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor INTO @cutdetail_id
	END
CLOSE con_cursor
DEALLOCATE con_cursor

DECLARE con_cursor1 CURSOR FOR
 SELECT cutno FROM cutdetail WHERE isnull(cutno,'') <> ''
OPEN con_cursor1
FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor1 INTO @cutno
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @c =  count(@@rowcount) FROM cutdetail WHERE cutno = @cutno
		SELECT @d = count(*) FROM cutdetail WHERE closed = 'y' and cutno =@cutno  and (isnull(received_qty,0) >= isnull(qty,0))
		IF @c = @d  
		   BEGIN 
			 UPDATE cutheader SET closed = 'Y' WHERE cutheader.cutno = @cutno 
		   END  
	FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor1 INTO @cutno
	END

CLOSE con_cursor1
DEALLOCATE con_cursor1
END

sp_autohold_customer 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_autohold_customer] as
update customer set hold='Y', credit_expdate=convert(nchar(8),getdate(),1) where 
  code in (select customer  from invheader where datediff(dd, canceldate, getdate()) >75 and total-isnull(payment,0)  > 0  group by customer)
  and isnull(credit_expdate,'2001-01-01') < getdate()

update soheader set closed = 'H'  where customer in 
(select customer from invheader where datediff(dd, canceldate, getdate() ) > 75  and  total-isnull(payment,0)  > 0 and  closed='N'  group by customer)
 and closed='N' and customer in (select code from customer where isnull(credit_expdate,'2001-01-01')< getdate())

sp_automail_sale 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_automail_sale]
as
DECLARE @email nvarchar(128)
DECLARE @CRLF nchar(10)
DECLARE @code nvarchar(50)
DECLARE @Bodytext nvarchar(512)
Declare @count int
DECLARE @URL nchar(250)
Select @URL=isnull(email_url,'') from webconfig
DECLARE rcpt_cursor CURSOR FOR 
SELECT TOP 1 rtrim(email1)
FROM zzcustomer where charindex('@', isnull(email1,'')) > 0 and (email2 is null or  email2='')
OPEN rcpt_cursor
FETCH NEXT FROM rcpt_cursor 
INTO @email
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	Set @BodyText =' <body><table>                    
                <tr> <td valign="top" align="left"><a href="'+rtrim(@url)+'"><img src="http://wholesale.focus2000.com/image/vip-sale.jpg" width="652px" alt="center"></a></td><tr>
				</tr></table></body>'

	SET @count = @count + 1 
	EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail 
	@recipients =email,
	--'SDEPILLO@ASHLEY STEWART.COM',
	--@email,
	--'manikandan@winfashion.com;geetha@winfashion.com',
	--@email,
	--@from_address='info@wr9000.com',
	@subject = 'Special Offers',
	@body = @BodyText,
	@body_format = 'HTML';
	--@profile_name = 'gmail';
	PRINT @email + space (2) + @code	
	WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:10'
	FETCH NEXT FROM rcpt_cursor
	INTO @email
END 
CLOSE rcpt_cursor
DEALLOCATE rcpt_cursor

sp_autorelease_customer 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_autorelease_customer] as
update customer set hold='N', credit_expdate=convert(nchar(8),getdate(),1) where 
  code not in (select customer  from invheader where 
datediff(dd, canceldate, getdate()) >75 and total-isnull(payment,0)  > 0  group by customer)
  and isnull(credit_expdate,'2001-01-01') < getdate() and hold='Y'

update soheader set closed = 'N'  where customer in 
(select code from customer where hold='N') and closed='H'

sp_bartender_bysize48 

CREATE PROC [dbo].[sp_bartender_bysize48] (@s_bar nvarchar(30), @note nchar(30) = NULL, @bar_userid nvarchar(10) = NULL  )
AS
DECLARE @invoiceno INT, @pickno INT, @boxno INT
DECLARE @invhead_box_id INT 
DECLARE @customer nchar(10), @style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @sku nvarchar(30) 
DECLARE @qty1 int, @qty2 int, @qty3 int, @qty4 int, @qty5 int, @qty6 int
DECLARE @qty7 int, @qty8 int, @qty9 int, @qty10 int, @qty11 int, @qty12 int   
DECLARE @columnCounter int = 1 
DECLARE @sqlStatement nvarchar(max) = 'update bartender_bysize48 set '
DECLARE @sizeCategory nchar(10)
DECLARE @size1 nchar(15), @size2 nchar(15), @size3 nchar(15), @size4 nchar(15), @size5 nchar(15), @size6 nchar(15) 
DECLARE @size7 nchar(15), @size8 nchar(15), @size9 nchar(15), @size10 nchar(15), @size11 nchar(15), @size12 nchar(15) 
DECLARE @bar_user nvarchar(10), @upc nvarchar(50), @custpo nvarchar(20), @releaseno nvarchar(30)
DECLARE @bar_no INT
/* get the latest row in case there is more than one same UCC128# */ 
--select TOP 1 @invoiceno=isnull(invoiceno,0), @pickno=isnull(pickno,0), @boxno=isnull(boxno,1), 
--	@invhead_box_id=invhead_box_id
--	from invhead_box where ucc128_no = @s_bar order by invhead_box_id desc 

Set @sqlStatement = @sqlStatement + ' date_created=getdate(), note='''+isnull(@note,'')+''', ' 

/*200514 Arun added to update bar_user */
SELECT top 1 @bar_user = CASE WHEN isnull(@bar_userid,'') <> '' THEN @bar_userid ELSE isnull(bar_user, '') END , @Bar_no = bar_no, @boxno = left(carton, CHARINDEX(' ', carton)) FROM bartender WHERE s_bar = @s_bar
SELECT top 1 @invoiceno = isnull(Invoiceno, 0),@pickno = isnull(pickno, 0), @invhead_box_id = invhead_box_id FROM bartender2 WHERE bar_no =  @bar_no AND bar_user = @bar_user

select TOP 1 @boxno =boxno  
from invhead_box where invoiceno=isnull(@invoiceno,0) AND @pickno=isnull(@pickno,0) AND invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id


/* get the customer code, later to get the SKU# */ 
if @invoiceno=0 
	select @customer=customer from pickheader where pickno=@pickno
else
	select @customer=customer from invheader where invoiceno=@invoiceno

/* for Andrew's the SKU is setup under customer code 'SAMSC' */
/* !!! comment below line out if want to get from PickHeader/InvHeader */ 
/* set @customer='SAMSCDSV' */ 
/* 200709 dan -  changed to RPSAMSC per Anand */ 
set @customer='RPSAMSC'


/* insert a blank (with key @s_bar UCC128#), so it can be used for the last UPDATE command */ 
delete from bartender_bysize48 where s_bar = @s_bar 
insert into bartender_bysize48 (s_bar, pickno, invoiceno, boxno,bar_user) values (@s_bar, @pickno, @invoiceno, @boxno, @bar_user) 


DECLARE con_curs CURSOR FOR
	SELECT style, color, isnull(qty1,0), isnull(qty2,0), isnull(qty3,0), isnull(qty4,0), isnull(qty5,0), isnull(qty6,0), isnull(qty7,0), isnull(qty8,0), 
	isnull(qty9,0), isnull(qty10,0), isnull(qty11,0), isnull(qty12 ,0)
	FROM packlist WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE isnull(pickno,0) = @pickno and boxno=@boxno 
	FOR READ ONLY

OPEN con_curs
FETCH con_curs INTO @style, @color, @qty1, @qty2, @qty3, @qty4, @qty5, @qty6, 
						@qty7, @qty8, @qty9, @qty10, @qty11, @qty12 

-- loop until meet end of selected row
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN

		/* get the size categor and size1-12 descript */ 
		select @sizeCategory=division from ivtf where code=@style and color=@color 
		select @size1=isnull(size1,''), @size2=isnull(size2,''), @size3=isnull(size3,''), @size4=isnull(size4,''),
				@size5=isnull(size5,''), @size6=isnull(size6,''), @size7=isnull(size7,''), @size8=isnull(size8,''),
				@size9=isnull(size9,''), @size10=isnull(size10,''), @size11=isnull(size11,''), @size12=isnull(size12,'') 
		from division where code=@sizeCategory 

		
		/* go through each size, checking if qty <> 0 */ 
		if @qty1 > 0 
			BEGIN 
				select @sku=COALESCE(sku,'') from code_sku where custid=@customer and style=@style and color=@color and pack1=1 
				SET @sku = isnull(nullif(@sku,''),'')
				set @sqlStatement = @sqlStatement + 'style'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @style +''','+
				'color'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @color +''','+
				'size'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @size1 +''','+
				'qty'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='+ convert(nvarchar(6), @qty1) +',' +
				'sku'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @sku +''',' 
				set @columnCounter = @columnCounter + 1 
			END 

		if @qty2 > 0 
			BEGIN 
				select @sku=COALESCE(sku,'') from code_sku where custid=@customer and style=@style and color=@color and pack2=1 
				SET @sku = isnull(nullif(@sku,''),'')
				set @sqlStatement = @sqlStatement + 'style'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @style +''','+
				'color'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @color +''','+
				'size'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @size2 +''','+				
				'qty'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='+ convert(nvarchar(6), @qty2) +',' +
				'sku'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @sku +''',' 
				set @columnCounter = @columnCounter + 1 
			END 

		if @qty3 > 0 
			BEGIN 
				select @sku=COALESCE(sku,'') from code_sku where custid=@customer and style=@style and color=@color and pack3=1 
				SET @sku = isnull(nullif(@sku,''),'')
				set @sqlStatement = @sqlStatement + 'style'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @style +''','+
				'color'+convert(nvarchar(200), @columnCounter)+'='''+ @color +''','+

sp_Callerid CREATE PROCEDURE sp_Callerid ( @callerid nvarchar(40) ) 
AS
BEGIN	
	Declare @result nvarchar(50)
	select @callerid = dbo.fn_strip_special_char(@callerid) 
	select @result = rtrim(code)+':'+ rtrim(left(contact1,12))+' '+rtrim(left(contact2,12))+' Bal$'+ isnull(convert(varchar(10),(total - payment)), '') from 
		customer left outer join v_customer_total on customer.code= v_customer_total.customer 
			where dbo.fn_strip_special_char(customer.phone1)=@callerid
			 or dbo.fn_strip_special_char(customer.phone2)=@callerid 
	if @result is null
		set @result='Not Found'
	select @result 
END

sp_capture_snapshot CREATE PROCEDURE mon.sp_capture_snapshot
WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO mon.rowcount_history (schema_name, table_name, row_count)
    SELECT s.name, t.name, SUM(p.rows)
    FROM sys.tables t
    JOIN sys.schemas s    ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
    JOIN sys.partitions p ON t.object_id = p.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1)
    WHERE s.name <> 'mon'
    GROUP BY s.name, t.name;

    SELECT COUNT(*) AS tables_captured, MAX(snapshot_time) AS snapshot_time
    FROM mon.rowcount_history r
    WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_id) FROM mon.rowcount_history r2
                         WHERE r2.schema_name = r.schema_name AND r2.table_name = r.table_name);
END;
sp_check_exchangerate 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_check_exchangerate] (@MasterName nchar(20)) 

      AS
BEGIN

	IF @MasterName = 'SALESORDER' 
	                SELECT d.orderno, d.exchange_rate FROM soheader h, sodetail d GROUP BY d.orderno, d.exchange_rate 
	                HAVING ISNULL(d.exchange_rate,0)=0 
 
      IF  @MasterName = 'INVOICE' 
                   SELECT d.invoiceno, d.exchange_rate FROM invheader h, invdetail d GROUP BY d.invoiceno, d.exchange_rate 
                   HAVING ISNULL(d.exchange_rate,0)=0

      IF  @MasterName = 'PICKTICKET' 
	              SELECT d.pickno, d.exchange_rate FROM pickheader h, pickdetail d GROUP BY d.pickno, d.exchange_rate 
                  HAVING ISNULL(d.exchange_rate,0)=0

      IF  @MasterName = 'RAWMATERIAL' 
				SELECT invoiceno,exchange_rate FROM rmaheader WHERE ISNULL(exchange_rate,0)=0

	
END

sp_check_sample_upc CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_check_sample_upc] (@style char(13) )
as
/* 130408 dan - fixed problem with inserting blank UPC when NEW */ 
/* 130301 dan - created for iPDM inserting into DOCS */ 
declare @nextUPC bigint
declare @desc char(50) 
/* is scanned */
if len(@style)=13 and left(@style,1)='0' or (len(@style)=12 and left(@style,2)='48')
	begin
		/* 130330 dan - get the 11 digit UPC */ 
		if (len(@style)=13)  
			set @nextUPC=substring(@style,2,11)
		if (len(@style)=12)  
			set @nextUPC=substring(@style,1,11)
		select @style=code, @desc=RTRIM(sample_desc)+':'+descript from ivtf_sample where upc=@nextUPC
	end
else
	/* style# passed */ 
	select  @desc=max(descript) from ivtf_sample where code=@style 

select 'Style:'+RTRIM(@style)+' '+@desc as SQLresult

invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno)
sp_cld_detail_open_header_list 
create PROC [dbo].[sp_cld_detail_open_header_list]
AS
select distinct orderno from soheader where orderno in (select distinct orderno from sodetail where  closed = 'Y' and orderno 
	not in (select orderno from sodetail where closed  = 'N') ) and closed = 'N' order by orderno

sp_close_cut 
CREATE PROC [dbo].[sp_close_cut] (@cutno INT, @closed nchar(1))
AS
DECLARE @cutdetail_id INT

DECLARE con_curs CURSOR FOR
	SELECT cutdetail_id 
	FROM cutdetail WHERE cutno = @cutno
	FOR READ ONLY

OPEN con_curs
FETCH con_curs INTO @cutdetail_id

-- loop until meet end of selected row
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN
	--160510 Arun added isnull condition because with NULL data comparison can't be done.
		UPDATE cutdetail SET closed = @closed
			WHERE cutdetail_id = @cutdetail_id and isnull(closed,'') <>@closed 

		FETCH con_curs INTO @cutdetail_id
	END
CLOSE con_curs
DEALLOCATE con_curs

sp_close_cut_new CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_close_cut_new] 
as
DECLARE @cutdetail_id int
DECLARE @cutno int
DECLARE @count int 
DECLARE con_cursor CURSOR FOR
 SELECT cutdetail_id  
 FROM cutdetail WHERE closed <>'Y' and  isnull(received_qty,0) >= isnull(qty,0) and isnull(qty,0) > 0
OPEN con_cursor
FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor INTO @cutdetail_id
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
  UPDATE cutdetail SET closed = 'Y'
   WHERE cutdetail_id = @cutdetail_id 
  FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor INTO @cutdetail_id
END
 CLOSE con_cursor
DEALLOCATE con_cursor
DECLARE con_cursor1 CURSOR FOR
 SELECT cutno  
 FROM cutheader WHERE isnull(cutno,'') <> ''
OPEN con_cursor1
FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor1 INTO @cutno
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
   select @count=count(*) from view_cutdetail_close where cutno=@cutno 
   IF @count = 1 
   begin 
   UPDATE cutheader SET closed = 'Y'
   WHERE cutheader.cutno = @cutno 
   end 
  FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor1 INTO @cutno
END

CLOSE con_cursor1
DEALLOCATE con_cursor1

			WHERE cutdetail_id = @cutdetail_id 
			print @cutdetail_id
		
	END
CLOSE con_curs
DEALLOCATE con_curs
sp_close_cut_new1 CREATE
 procedure [dbo].[sp_close_cut_new1] 
as
DECLARE @cutdetail_id int
DECLARE @cutno int
DECLARE @c int
DECLARE @d int

DECLARE con_cursor CURSOR FOR
 SELECT cutdetail_id FROM cutdetail WHERE closed <>'Y' and  isnull(received_qty,0) >= isnull(qty,0) and isnull(qty,0) > 0
OPEN con_cursor
FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor INTO @cutdetail_id
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
	  UPDATE cutdetail SET closed = 'Y'  WHERE cutdetail_id = @cutdetail_id 
	  FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor INTO @cutdetail_id
	END
CLOSE con_cursor
DEALLOCATE con_cursor

DECLARE con_cursor1 CURSOR FOR
 SELECT cutno FROM cutdetail WHERE isnull(cutno,'') <> ''
OPEN con_cursor1
FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor1 INTO @cutno
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @c =  count(@@rowcount) FROM cutdetail WHERE cutno = @cutno
		SELECT @d = count(*) FROM cutdetail WHERE closed = 'y' and cutno =@cutno  and (isnull(received_qty,0) >= isnull(qty,0))
		IF @c = @d  
		   BEGIN 
			 UPDATE cutheader SET closed = 'Y' WHERE cutheader.cutno = @cutno 
		   END  
	FETCH NEXT FROM con_cursor1 INTO @cutno
	END

CLOSE con_cursor1
DEALLOCATE con_cursor1

sp_close_cutheader_if_all_detail_closed create PROC [dbo].[sp_close_cutheader_if_all_detail_closed]  (@cutno INT)
AS

declare @closed char(1)
declare @count int 

/* check if already CLOSED */ 
select @closed = isnull(closed,'N') from cutheader where cutno=@cutno 
if @closed='Y'
  return 

/* check if there is any CLOSED detail */ 
select @count = count(cutno) from cutdetail where cutno=@cutno and isnull(closed,'N')='Y' 
if @count= 0  
	return

/* check if there is any OPEN detail */ 
select @count = count(cutno) from cutdetail where cutno=@cutno and isnull(closed,'N')<>'Y' 
if @count<>0  
	return

/* if all passed, now close header */
update cutheader set closed='Y' where cutno=@cutno

create PROC [dbo].[sp_close_soheader_if_all_detail_closed]  (@orderno INT)
AS

declare @count int

select @closed = isnull(closed,'N') from soheader where orderno=@orderno 
if @closed='Y'
  return 

/* check if there is any CLOSED detail */

	return

/* check if there is any OPEN detail */ 
select @count = count(cutno) from sodetail where orderno=@orderno and isnull(closed,'N')<>'Y' 
if @count<>0  
	return

/* if all passed, now close header */
update soheader set closed='Y' where orderno=@orderno

sp_concurrent_users CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_concurrent_users](@max_connection int, @dbname varchar(20))
AS 
DECLARE @count int

SET @count = (select count(*) from (
select original_login_name,host_name FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions where original_login_name = 'sa' and host_name is not NULL and database_id = db_id(@dbname)
and program_name = '.Net SqlClient Data Provider'
GROUP BY original_login_name, host_name ) a)

IF 
(SELECT count(*) FROM sys.messages WHERE message_id = 50001) < 1 
BEGIN
	EXEC sp_addmessage 50001, 1, N'CONCURRENT USER LOGIN EXCEEDED'
END 
if @count > @max_connection 

	--RAISEERROR (50001, 1,1,'CONCURRENT USER LOGIN EXCEEDED')
	-- THROW 50001,'CONCURRENT USER LOGIN EXCEEDED.', 1
	 RAISERROR('CONCURRENT USER LOGIN EXCEEDED.',
                11,-1) --WITH SETERROR

ELSE
	PRINT @COUNT

sp_copy_all_ivtf_sample 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_copy_all_ivtf_sample] ( @fromUPC char(13), @toUPC char(13) ) 
AS 
declare @checkStyle nchar(20) 
select @checkStyle = code from ivtf_sample where upc=@toUPC 
-- the to style must be 'NEW.CLONED' (created from proceudre create_new_ivtf_sample) 
if @checkStyle<>'NEW.CLONED' 
	raiserror('Next BARCODE cannot be issues. Please try again.', 15, 10)
else 
if @@trancount = 0 
/*170420 Arun - create a separate transaction inside*/
begin transaction
	BEGIN

		exec sp_copy_ivtf_sample2 @fromUPC, @toUPC 
		exec sp_copy_spec_sheet @fromUPC, @toUPC 
		exec sp_copy_ivtf_image @fromUPC, @toUPC 
		exec sp_copy_prod_card  @fromUPC, @toUPC 

	END 
if @@trancount > 0 
begin
commit
end

sp_copy_image_file /*161014 Arun - Copy from DB and Write to File using BCP Utility
AMAZON EXPORT - WR9000 */
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_copy_image_file] (@ivtf_image_id INT, @filelocation nvarchar(255),@format nvarchar(50) = null)
AS 
BEGIN
DECLARE @style nvarchar(13) 
DECLARE @color nvarchar(12)
DECLARE @royaltor nvarchar(10)

DECLARE @filename nvarchar(255) 
DECLARE @filename2 nvarchar(255) 
DECLARE @filename3 nvarchar(255) 
DECLARE @filename4 nvarchar(255) 


if Right(rtrim(@filelocation),1) <>'\' 
begin
	SET @filelocation = @filelocation+'\'
End

SELECT @style = style, @color = color FROM ivtf_image WHERE ivtf_image_id = @ivtf_image_id

SET @filename = @filelocation + 'Style1\' + Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(@style),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_')+
				Case WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE '_' END +
				Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(CASE WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE @color END),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_') +'.jpg'
SET @filename2 = @filelocation + 'Style2\' + Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(@style),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_')+
				Case WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE '_' END +
				Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(CASE WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE @color END),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_') +'.jpg'

SET @filename3 = @filelocation + 'Style3\' + Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(@style),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_')+
				Case WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE '_' END +
				Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(CASE WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE @color END),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_') +'.jpg'

SET @filename4 = @filelocation + 'Style4\' + Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(@style),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_')+
				Case WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE '_' END +
				Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(CASE WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE @color END),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_') +'.jpg'

declare @cmdshell nvarchar(255)
declare @cmdshell2 nvarchar(255)
declare @cmdshell3 nvarchar(255)
declare @cmdshell4 nvarchar(255)
declare @datal1 INT, @datal2 INT, @datal3 INT,@datal4 INT

SELECT @datal1=isnull(datalength(style_image1),0),@datal2=isnull(datalength(style_image2),0),@datal3=isnull(datalength(style_image3),0),@datal4=isnull(datalength(style_image4),0) FROM ivtf_image WHERE ivtf_image_id = @ivtf_image_id

set @cmdshell = 'bcp "select style_image1 from wf125sr..ivtf_image where ivtf_image_id='+convert(varchar(20), @ivtf_image_id)+' " queryout "'+@filename+'" -S .\SQL2014 -Usa -P15848 -T -f ' +@format
set @cmdshell2 = 'bcp "select style_image2 from wf125sr..ivtf_image where ivtf_image_id='+convert(varchar(20), @ivtf_image_id)+' " queryout "'+@filename2+'" -S .\SQL2014 -Usa -P15848 -T -f '+@format
set @cmdshell3 = 'bcp "select style_image3 from wf125sr..ivtf_image where ivtf_image_id='+convert(varchar(20), @ivtf_image_id)+' " queryout "'+@filename3+'" -S .\SQL2014 -Usa -P15848 -T -f '+@format
set @cmdshell4 = 'bcp "select style_image4 from wf125sr..ivtf_image where ivtf_image_id='+convert(varchar(20), @ivtf_image_id)+' " queryout "'+@filename4+'" -S .\SQL2014 -Usa -P15848 -T -f '+@format

if @datal1 > 0 
EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmdshell 
if @datal2 > 0
EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmdshell2
if @datal3 > 0
EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmdshell3

sp_copy_image_fileall 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_copy_image_fileall] (@filelocation varchar(255), @format nvarchar(50) = null)
as 
DECLARE @ivtf_image_id int  

DECLARE cur_copy_image_file CURSOR FOR
	SELECT ivtf_image_id FROM ivtf_image where isnull(sample_upc,'') = '' order by ivtf_image_id DESC
	 FOR READ ONLY

OPEN cur_copy_image_file
FETCH cur_copy_image_file INTO @ivtf_image_id

-- loop until meet end of selected row
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN
		exec sp_copy_image_file @ivtf_image_id , @filelocation, @format
		FETCH cur_copy_image_file INTO @ivtf_image_id 
	END
CLOSE cur_copy_image_file
DEALLOCATE cur_copy_image_file


sp_copy_image_fileall_noloc CREATE procedure sp_copy_image_fileall_noloc(@format nvarchar(50)) 
as 
DECLARE @ivtf_image_id INT
DECLARE @filelocation varchar(255)
DECLARE @icount int 

set @icount = 0
DECLARE cur_copy_image_file CURSOR FOR
	SELECT ivtf_image_id, div.web_prod_image_url FROM ivtf_image 
	JOIN ivtf ON ivtf_image.style = ivtf.code 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN div ON ivtf.user4 = div.code 
	order by ivtf_image_id DESC
	 FOR READ ONLY
OPEN cur_copy_image_file
FETCH cur_copy_image_file INTO @ivtf_image_id, @filelocation
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN
		exec sp_copy_image_file @ivtf_image_id , @filelocation, @format
		set @icount = @icount + 1
		FETCH cur_copy_image_file INTO @ivtf_image_id ,@filelocation
	END
	SELECT @icount
CLOSE cur_copy_image_file
DEALLOCATE cur_copy_image_file

sp_copy_salesorderdetail_850 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_copy_salesorderdetail_850] (@realorderno int, @orderno_850 INT) 
AS 
DECLARE @style nchar(13)
DECLARE @color nchar(12)
DECLARE @royaltor nchar(10)
DECLARE @price decimal 
DECLARE @sodetail_id INT
DECLARE @ll_count INT
DECLARE @po1_IN nchar(20)
DECLARE @po1_UP nchar(20)
DECLARE @sku_sk nvarchar(20),@sku_cb nchar(20),@sku_in nchar(20)


DECLARE SODETAIL_INSERT CURSOR FOR
select style, color, isnull(royaltor,''),price, sodetail_id, isnull(po1_IN,''), isnull(PO1_UP,''), isnull(sku_cb,''), isnull(sku_in,'') FROM sodetail_850 WHERE orderno = @orderno_850
OPEN sodetail_insert 
FETCH sodetail_insert INTO @style, @color, @royaltor,@price, @sodetail_id ,@po1_in, @po1_up,@sku_cb,@sku_in

While @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
BEGIN

	SELECT @ll_count = count(*) FROM sodetail WHERE orderno=@realorderno AND style=@style AND color =@color AND isnull(royaltor,'') =@royaltor AND price = @price AND isnull(po1_IN,'') = @po1_IN AND isnull(PO1_UP,'') = @po1_up
	AND isnull(sku_cb,'') = @sku_cb AND isnull(sku_in,'') = @sku_in

	if @ll_count = 0 
	BEGIN 
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[sodetail]
			   ([orderno],[line],[style],[color],[qty1],[qty2],[qty3],[qty4],[qty5],[qty6],[qty7],[qty8],[qty9],[price],[memo],[commpcnt1],[commpcnt2],[alloc_qty1],[alloc_qty2],[alloc_qty3],[alloc_qty4],[alloc_qty5],[alloc_qty6]
			   ,[alloc_qty7],[alloc_qty8],[alloc_qty9],[shipped_qty1],[shipped_qty2],[shipped_qty3],[shipped_qty4],[shipped_qty5],[shipped_qty6],[shipped_qty7],[shipped_qty8],[shipped_qty9],[closed],[setid],[cutno],[cut_qty1]
			   ,[cut_qty2],[cut_qty3],[cut_qty4],[cut_qty5],[cut_qty6],[cut_qty7],[cut_qty8],[cut_qty9],[alloc_date],[pt_printdate],[det_canceldate],[ordered_style],[ordered_color],[pick_qty1],[pick_qty2],[pick_qty3],[pick_qty4]
			   ,[pick_qty5],[pick_qty6],[pick_qty7],[pick_qty8],[pick_qty9],[royaltor],[royalty],[qty10],[qty11],[qty12],[alloc_qty10],[alloc_qty11],[alloc_qty12],[shipped_qty10],[shipped_qty11],[shipped_qty12],[cut_qty10]
			   ,[cut_qty11],[cut_qty12],[pick_qty10],[pick_qty11],[pick_qty12],[currency],[exchange_rate],[warehouse],[pick_hold],[alloc_wh],[WH_transferno],[pick_no],[cancel_reason],[sodetail_user],[cancelreason_date],[reorder]
			   ,[prepack_code],[reforderno],[ticket_price],[PO1_UP],[PO1_IN],[po1_cb],[bulk_orderno],[cutdetail_id],[actual_cost],[pono],[podetail_id],[sku_sk],[PID_memo],[pack_sum],[discpercent],[orig_price],[sku_cb],[seqnosku]
			   ,[label],[carton_type],[sku_in],[edi_unit],[line_mode],[msn_no],[sln_pl],[prepack_qty],[po1_iz])
	(SELECT @realorderno,[line],[style],[color],[qty1],[qty2],[qty3],[qty4],[qty5],[qty6],[qty7],[qty8],[qty9],[price],[memo],[commpcnt1],[commpcnt2],[alloc_qty1],[alloc_qty2],[alloc_qty3],[alloc_qty4],[alloc_qty5],[alloc_qty6]
			   ,[alloc_qty7],[alloc_qty8],[alloc_qty9],[shipped_qty1],[shipped_qty2],[shipped_qty3],[shipped_qty4],[shipped_qty5],[shipped_qty6],[shipped_qty7],[shipped_qty8],[shipped_qty9],[closed],[setid],[cutno],[cut_qty1]
			   ,[cut_qty2],[cut_qty3],[cut_qty4],[cut_qty5],[cut_qty6],[cut_qty7],[cut_qty8],[cut_qty9],[alloc_date],[pt_printdate],[det_canceldate],[ordered_style],[ordered_color],[pick_qty1],[pick_qty2],[pick_qty3],[pick_qty4]
			   ,[pick_qty5],[pick_qty6],[pick_qty7],[pick_qty8],[pick_qty9],[royaltor],[royalty],[qty10],[qty11],[qty12],[alloc_qty10],[alloc_qty11],[alloc_qty12],[shipped_qty10],[shipped_qty11],[shipped_qty12],[cut_qty10]
			   ,[cut_qty11],[cut_qty12],[pick_qty10],[pick_qty11],[pick_qty12],[currency],[exchange_rate],[warehouse],[pick_hold],[alloc_wh],[WH_transferno],[pick_no],[cancel_reason],[sodetail_user],[cancelreason_date],[reorder]
			   ,[prepack_code],[reforderno],[ticket_price],[PO1_UP],[PO1_IN],[po1_cb],[bulk_orderno],[cutdetail_id],[actual_cost],[pono],[podetail_id],[sku_sk],[PID_memo],[pack_sum],[discpercent],[orig_price],[sku_cb],[seqnosku]
			   ,[label],[carton_type],[sku_in],[edi_unit],[line_mode],[msn_no],[sln_pl],[prepack_qty],[po1_iz]
		FROM sodetail_850 sd WHERE sd.orderno =@orderno_850 AND sd.sodetail_id = @sodetail_id)
	--	PRINT 'INSERT' +convert(char(10), @sodetail_id) for debugging purpose
	END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
		UPDATE sodetail SET [line]=sd.[line],[style]=sd.[style],[color]=sd.[color],[qty1]=sd.[qty1],[qty2]=sd.[qty2],[qty3]=sd.[qty3],[qty4]=sd.[qty4],[qty5]=sd.[qty5],[qty6]=sd.[qty6],[qty7]=sd.[qty7],[qty8]=sd.[qty8],[qty9]=sd.[qty9]
			   ,[price]=sd.[price],[memo]=sd.[memo],[commpcnt1]=sd.[commpcnt1],[commpcnt2]=sd.[commpcnt2],[closed]=sd.[closed],[setid]=sd.[setid],[det_canceldate]=sd.[det_canceldate],[royaltor]=sd.[royaltor],[royalty]=sd.[royalty] ,[qty10]=sd.[qty10]
			   ,[qty11]=sd.[qty11],[qty12]=sd.[qty12],[currency]=sd.[currency],[exchange_rate]=sd.[exchange_rate],[warehouse]=sd.[warehouse],[pick_hold]=sd.[pick_hold],[alloc_wh]=sd.[alloc_wh],[pick_no]=sd.[pick_no],[cancel_reason]=sd.[cancel_reason]
			   ,[sodetail_user]=sd.[sodetail_user],[cancelreason_date]=sd.[cancelreason_date],[reorder]=sd.[reorder],[prepack_code]=sd.[prepack_code],[reforderno]=sd.[reforderno],[ticket_price]=sd.[ticket_price],[PO1_UP]=sd.[PO1_UP],[PO1_IN]=sd.[PO1_IN]
			   ,[po1_cb]=sd.[po1_cb],[bulk_orderno]=sd.[bulk_orderno],[pono]=sd.[pono],[podetail_id]=sd.[podetail_id],[sku_sk]=sd.[sku_sk],[PID_memo]=sd.[PID_memo],[pack_sum]=sd.[pack_sum],[discpercent]=sd.[discpercent],[sodetail_hfc_id]=sd.[sodetail_hfc_id]
			   ,[sku_cb]=sd.[sku_cb],[seqnosku]=sd.[seqnosku],[label]=sd.[label],[carton_type]=sd.[carton_type],[sku_in]=sd.[sku_in],[edi_unit]=sd.[edi_unit],[line_mode]=sd.[line_mode],[msn_no]=sd.[msn_no],[sln_pl]=sd.[sln_pl],[prepack_qty]=sd.[prepack_qty]
			   ,[po1_iz]=sd.[po1_iz] 
		FROM sodetail_850 sd JOIN sodetail ON 
		sodetail.style = sd.style AND sodetail.color = sd.color AND isnull(sodetail.royaltor,'') = isnull(sd.royaltor,'')
		AND sodetail.price = sd.price AND isnull(sodetail.po1_IN,'') = isnull(sd.po1_in,'') AND isnull(sodetail.po1_up,'') = isnull(sd.po1_up,'')
		AND isnull(sodetail.sku_cb,'') = isnull(sd.sku_cb,'') AND isnull(sodetail.sku_in,'') = isnull(sd.sku_in,'')
		WHERE sd.sodetail_id = @sodetail_id AND sodetail.orderno = @realorderno
	--	PRINT 'UPDATE' + convert(char(10), @sodetail_id) for debugging purpose

		END
	FETCH sodetail_insert INTO @style, @color, @royaltor,@price, @sodetail_id ,@po1_in, @po1_up,@sku_cb,@sku_in
END
CLOSE SODETAIL_INSERT
DEALLOCATE SODETAIL_INSERT

	from spec_sheet where upc=@toUPC

sp_Create_AP_from_Import 
/* called from Import Module Form View's 'Post AP' button */ 
/* 161103 dan - if cut Payment_Terms is blank, use Vendor Payment_Terms */ 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_Create_AP_from_Import] (@fileno int, @userid nchar(10) ) as
declare @firstCutno int 
declare @currentPostedFlag char(1)
declare @apnum int 
declare @vendor nchar(10)

select @currentPostedFlag=isnull(AP_prod_vend_posted,'N'), @vendor=vendor  from import where fileno=@fileno

if @currentPostedFlag <> 'Y'
BEGIN 
	select @firstCutno=max(isnull(cutno,0)) from logfdetail where fileno=@fileno

	insert into aphead (apnum, user4, ap_source, cutno, ponum, vendno, apdate, aptotal, recamount, 
		closed, currency, exchange_rate, created_user, created_date, recqty, appaid, descrip, vinvno, 
		terms, 
		vend_inv_date, 
		duedate, 
		podate )  
	select (select isnull(max(apnum),1000)+1 from aphead), div, 'IMPORT', @firstCutno, @fileno, vendor, rec_date, amount, amount, 
		'N', 'USD', 1.0,  @userid, getdate(), totalqty, 0 , 'Import Module Product Shipped/Received' , left(vendor_invoiceno,15), 
		isnull((select payment_terms from cutheader where cutno=@firstCutno), (select payment_terms from manufacturer where code=@vendor) ) ,
		 invoicedate ,
		dateadd(dd,isnull((select days from terms where code=(select payment_terms from cutheader where cutno=@firstCutno)), 
			isnull((select days from terms where code=(select payment_terms from manufacturer where code=@vendor)),0) ) ,rec_date),
		(select issuedate from cutheader where cutno=@firstCutno)

	  from IMPORT where fileno=@fileno 

	select @apnum = max(apnum) from aphead where ap_source='IMPORT' and ponum=@fileno 
	update import set AP_prod_vend_posted = 'Y', AP_prod_vend_post_date=getdate(), AP_prod_APNUM=@apnum where fileno=@fileno 

	/* return the value to calling procedure */ 
	--select max(apnum) from aphead where ap_source='IMPORT' and ponum=@fileno 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_create_buysheet] (@orderno int , @line int ) AS

insert into soheader_buysheet (orderno, line, buysheet_date, wh_delivery, 
samplereq1_label,
samplereq2_label,
samplereq3_label,
samplereq4_label,
samplereq1,
samplereq2,
samplereq3,
samplereq4,
SizerReq,
HangerReq,
InspectionReq,
ShippingAuthReq,
qty,
price,
retail ,
customers_rn,
our_rn , 
TestReq1,
TestReq2,
TestReq3,
TestReq4  )

select @orderno, @line, getdate(), soheader.canceldate,
customer.samplereq1_label,
customer.samplereq2_label,
customer.samplereq3_label,
customer.samplereq4_label,
customer.samplereq1,
customer.samplereq2,
customer.samplereq3,
customer.samplereq4,
customer.SizerReq,
customer.HangerReq,
customer.InspectionReq,
customer.ShippingAuthReq,
(select max(price) from sodetail where orderno=@orderno),
(select sum(qty) from sodetail where orderno=@orderno) , 
(select max(ticket_price) from  sodetail where orderno=@orderno),
customer.rn_number, 
div.rn_number ,
customer.TestReq1,
customer.TestReq2,
customer.TestReq3,
customer.TestReq4

 from soheader left outer join customer on soheader.customer=customer.code 
				left outer join div on soheader.user4=div.code 
   where soheader.orderno=@orderno

sp_creatediagram 
	CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_creatediagram
	(
		@diagramname 	sysname,
		@owner_id		int	= null, 	
		@version 		int,
		@definition 	varbinary(max)
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		set nocount on
	
		declare @theId int
		declare @retval int
		declare @IsDbo	int
		declare @userName sysname
		if(@version is null or @diagramname is null)
		begin
			RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1);
			return -1
		end
	
		execute as caller;
		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(); 
		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner');
		revert; 
		
		if @owner_id is null
		begin
			select @owner_id = @theId;
		end
		else
		begin
			if @theId <> @owner_id
			begin
				if @IsDbo = 0
				begin
					RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1);
					return -1
				end
				select @theId = @owner_id
			end
		end
		-- next 2 line only for test, will be removed after define name unique
		if EXISTS(select diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @theId and name = @diagramname)
		begin
			RAISERROR ('The name is already used.', 16, 1);
			return -2
		end
	
		insert into dbo.sysdiagrams(name, principal_id , version, definition)
				VALUES(@diagramname, @theId, @version, @definition) ;
		
		select @retval = @@IDENTITY 
		return @retval
	END
	
sp_cursor_soh_total_update CREATE  procedure [dbo].[sp_cursor_soh_total_update] (@fromorderno int, @toorderno int = NULL) 
AS 
DECLARE @ordno INT 
DECLARE @sum_total MONEY
DECLARE @header_total MONEY 
DECLARE @soh_orderno INT

SET @ordno = @fromorderno
if isnull(@toorderno , 0) = 0
	SET @toorderno = @fromorderno

DECLARE soh_cursor CURSOR FOR 
 
SELECT total, orderno FROM soheader WHERE orderno = @ordno
--IF EXISTS (SELECT Orderno FROM soheader WHERE orderno = @ordno) 
--BEGIN 
OPEN soh_cursor 
FETCH soh_cursor 
INTO @header_total,@soh_orderno  

SELECT @sum_total = sum((coalesce(qty1,0)+coalesce(qty2,0)+coalesce(qty3,0)+
coalesce(qty4,0) + coalesce(qty5,0) + coalesce(qty6,0)+coalesce(qty7,0)+coalesce(qty8,0)+coalesce(qty9,0)
+coalesce(qty10,0) + coalesce(qty11,0) +coalesce(qty12,0)) * isnull(price,0)) FROM sodetail 
WHERE orderno = @soh_orderno 
PRINT convert(varchar(20),@header_total) + '- ' +CONVERT(varchar(10), @sum_total)
--GROUP BY orderno 
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 and @ordno <= @toorderno
BEGIN
	if @header_total <> @sum_total
		
		UPDATE SOHEADER SET total = @sum_total WHERE orderno = @ordno 

		SET @ordno = @ordno + 1 

		FETCH NEXT FROM soh_cursor 
		INTO @ordno, @header_total

END
CLOSE soh_cursor 
DEALLOCATE soh_cursor
PRINT convert(varchar(20),@header_total) + '- ' +CONVERT(varchar(10), @sum_total)
--END 


sp_customer_status /*190329 Arun - made changes from smallint to int */
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_customer_status] (@customer nchar(10) ) as
declare @so_month money ,@so_year0 money ,@so_year1 money, @so_year2 money
declare @so_monthq int, @so_year0q int ,@so_year1q int, @so_year2q int

declare @inv_month money ,@inv_year0 money ,@inv_year1 money, @inv_year2 money
declare @inv_monthq int, @inv_year0q int ,@inv_year1q int, @inv_year2q int

declare @ret_month money ,@ret_year0 money ,@ret_year1 money, @ret_year2 money
declare @ret_monthq int, @ret_year0q int ,@ret_year1q int, @ret_year2q int

declare @cb_month money ,@cb_year0 money ,@cb_year1 money, @cb_year2 money
declare @cb_monthq int, @cb_year0q int ,@cb_year1q int, @cb_year2q int

declare @pmt_month money ,@pmt_year0 money ,@pmt_year1 money, @pmt_year2 money
declare @pmt_monthq int, @pmt_year0q int ,@pmt_year1q int, @pmt_year2q int

declare @postdated money
declare @postdatedq int
declare @last_so datetime, @last_inv datetime, @last_pmt datetime
declare @last_so_amt money, @last_inv_amt money, @last_pmt_amt money
declare @age_a money,@age_b money,@age_c money,@age_d money,@age_e money, @age_f money
declare @age_aq int,@age_bq int,@age_cq int,@age_dq int, @age_eq int
declare @age_fq int

declare @gp_month money, @gp_year0 money, @gp_year1 money, @gp_year2 money

declare @avg_pmtmonth int,@avg_pmtyear0 int,@avg_pmtyear1 int,@avg_pmtyear2 int
/* Sales Orders Month - Today */
SELECT	@so_month=SUM(total), @so_monthq=count(*) 
FROM	soheader
WHERE	orderdate >= (SELECT DATEADD(day, -(SELECT DATEPART(day, GETDATE())) + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	orderdate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	customer = @customer

/* Sales Orders Year - Today */
SELECT	@so_year0=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @so_year0q=count(*)
FROM	soheader
WHERE	orderdate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,GETDATE()))
AND	orderdate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	customer = @customer

/* Sales Orders Last - Year */
SELECT	@so_year1=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @so_year1q=count(*) 
FROM	soheader
WHERE	orderdate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	orderdate <= (SELECT '12/31/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	customer = @customer

/* Sales Orders Prev - Year */
SELECT	@so_year2=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @so_year2q=count(*) 
FROM	soheader
WHERE	orderdate < (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	customer = @customer

/* Invoices Month - Today */
SELECT	@inv_month=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @inv_monthq=count(*)  
FROM	invheader
WHERE	invoicedate >= (SELECT DATEADD(day, -(SELECT DATEPART(day,GETDATE())) + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	invoicedate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	total > 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* Invoices Year - Today */
SELECT	@inv_year0=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @inv_year0q=count(*)  
FROM	invheader
WHERE	invoicedate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,GETDATE()))
AND	invoicedate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	total > 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* Invoices Last - Year */
SELECT	@inv_year1=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @inv_year1q=count(*)  
FROM	invheader
WHERE	invoicedate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	invoicedate <= (SELECT '12/31/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	total > 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* Invoices Prev - Year */
SELECT	@inv_year2=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @inv_year1q=count(*)  
FROM	invheader
WHERE	invoicedate < (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	total > 0
AND	customer = @customer

/*140828 Arun added GP as per Dan email- used invdetail.cost*/
/* GP% Month - Today */
SELECT	@gp_month=  ( sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0) * isnull(invdetail.price,0)) - sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0) * isnull(invdetail.cost,0) ) ) /
 (case when sum(isnull(qty,0) * isnull(price,0)) = 0 then 1 else sum(isnull(qty,0) * isnull(price,0)) end) * 100.00  
FROM	invheader join invdetail on invheader.invoiceno = invdetail.invoiceno 
WHERE	invoicedate >= (SELECT DATEADD(day, -(SELECT DATEPART(day,GETDATE())) + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	invoicedate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	total > 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* GP% Year - Today */
SELECT	@gp_year0= ( sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0) * isnull(invdetail.price,0)) - sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0) * isnull(invdetail.cost,0) ) ) /
 (case when sum(isnull(qty,0) * isnull(price,0)) = 0 then 1 else sum(isnull(qty,0) * isnull(price,0)) end) * 100.00  
FROM	invheader join invdetail on invheader.invoiceno = invdetail.invoiceno 
WHERE	invoicedate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,GETDATE()))
AND	invoicedate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	total > 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* GP% Last - Year */
SELECT	@gp_year1= ( sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0) * isnull(invdetail.price,0)) - sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0) * isnull(invdetail.cost,0) ) ) /
 (case when sum(isnull(qty,0) * isnull(price,0)) = 0 then 1 else sum(isnull(qty,0) * isnull(price,0)) end) * 100.00  
FROM	invheader join invdetail on invheader.invoiceno = invdetail.invoiceno 
WHERE	invoicedate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	invoicedate <= (SELECT '12/31/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	total > 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* GP% Prev - Year */
SELECT	@gp_year2= ( sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0) * isnull(invdetail.price,0)) - sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0) * isnull(invdetail.cost,0) ) ) /
 (case when sum(isnull(qty,0) * isnull(price,0)) = 0 then 1 else sum(isnull(qty,0) * isnull(price,0)) end) * 100.00  
FROM	invheader join invdetail on invheader.invoiceno = invdetail.invoiceno 
WHERE	invoicedate < (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	total > 0
AND	customer = @customer




/* Return Month - Today */
SELECT	@ret_month=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @ret_monthq=count(*) 
FROM	invheader
WHERE	invoicedate >= (SELECT DATEADD(day, -(SELECT DATEPART(day,GETDATE())) + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	invoicedate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	total < 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* Return Year - Today */
SELECT	@ret_year0=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @ret_year0q=count(*) 
FROM	invheader
WHERE	invoicedate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,GETDATE()))
AND	invoicedate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	total < 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* Return Last - Year */
SELECT	@ret_year1=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @ret_year1q=count(*) 
FROM	invheader
WHERE	invoicedate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	invoicedate <= (SELECT '12/31/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	total < 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* Return Prev - Year */
SELECT	@ret_year2=SUM(isnull(total,0)), @ret_year2q=count(*)  
FROM	invheader
WHERE	invoicedate < (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	total < 0
AND	customer = @customer

/* Cash Payments Month - Today */
SELECT	@pmt_month=SUM(isnull(arc.paidamt,0)), @pmt_monthq=count(*) 
FROM	arcash arc LEFT JOIN code_pmt pmt ON arc.pmt_code = pmt.code
WHERE	paiddate >= (SELECT DATEADD(day, -(SELECT DATEPART(day,GETDATE())) + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	paiddate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	pmt.actual_cash = 'Y'
AND	arc.customer = @customer

/* Cash Payments Year - Today */
SELECT	@pmt_year0=SUM(isnull(arc.paidamt,0)), @pmt_year0q=count(*)
FROM	arcash arc  LEFT JOIN code_pmt pmt ON arc.pmt_code = pmt.code
WHERE	paiddate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,GETDATE()))
AND	paiddate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	pmt.actual_cash = 'Y'
AND	arc.customer = @customer

/* Cash Payments Last - Year */
SELECT	@pmt_year1=SUM(isnull(arc.paidamt,0)), @pmt_year1q=count(*)

WHERE	paiddate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))

/* Cash Payments Prev - Year */

/* Chargebacks Month - Today */

AND	arc.customer = @customer

/* Chargebacks Year - Today */
SELECT	@cb_year0=SUM(isnull(arc.paidamt,0)), @cb_year0q=count(*)

WHERE	paiddate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,GETDATE()))
AND	paiddate < (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	isnull(pmt.actual_cash,'Y') = 'N'
AND	arc.customer = @customer

/* Chargebacks Last - Year */
SELECT	@cb_year1=SUM(isnull(arc.paidamt,0)), @cb_year1q=count(*)  
FROM	arcash arc  LEFT JOIN code_pmt pmt ON arc.pmt_code = pmt.code
WHERE	paiddate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	paiddate <= (SELECT '12/31/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	isnull(pmt.actual_cash,'Y') = 'N'

/* Chargebacks Prev - Year */
