AND	isnull(pmt.actual_cash,'Y') = 'N'
AND	arc.customer = @customer

/* Last Sales Order Date */
SELECT	@last_so_amt=total, @last_so=orderdate 
FROM	soheader
WHERE	orderdate = (SELECT MAX(orderdate) FROM soheader WHERE customer = @customer)
AND	customer = @customer

/* Last Invoices Date */
SELECT	@last_inv_amt=total, @last_inv=invoicedate 
FROM	invheader
WHERE	invoicedate = (SELECT MAX(invoicedate) FROM invheader WHERE customer = @customer)
AND	customer = @customer

/* Last Payment Date */
SELECT	@last_pmt_amt=arc.paidamt, @last_pmt=paiddate 
FROM	arcash arc  LEFT JOIN code_pmt pmt ON arc.pmt_code = pmt.code
WHERE	paiddate = (SELECT MAX(arcash.paiddate) FROM arcash WHERE customer = @customer)
AND	arc.customer = @customer


/* AGEINGS */
declare @age1 int, @age2 int, @age3 int, @age4 int
select @age1=aging1, @age2=aging2, @age3=aging3, @age4=aging4
  from wfsystem2 where wfsystem=1


/* Current  */
SELECT	@age_a=(SUM(isnull(total,0)) - sum(isnull(payment,0))), @age_aq=count(*) 
FROM invheader 
WHERE customer = @customer
and	canceldate >=   GETDATE() and   (total - payment) <> 0

/* 1 - 30 Balance Current */
SELECT	@age_b=(SUM(isnull(total,0)) - sum(isnull(payment,0))), @age_bq=count(*) FROM invheader
WHERE	canceldate <= GETDATE()
AND	canceldate > DATEADD(day, - @age1 , GETDATE())
AND	customer = @customer
and   (total - payment) <> 0

/* 30 - 60 Balance Current */
SELECT	@age_c=(SUM(isnull(total,0)) - sum(isnull(payment,0))), @age_cq=count(*)  FROM invheader
WHERE	canceldate <=  DATEADD(day, - @age1, GETDATE())
AND	canceldate >  DATEADD(day, - @age2, GETDATE())
AND	customer = @customer
and   (total - payment) <> 0

/* 60 - 90 Balance Current */
SELECT	@age_d=(SUM(isnull(total,0)) - sum(isnull(payment,0))), @age_dq= count(*)  FROM invheader
WHERE	canceldate <=  DATEADD(day, - @age2, GETDATE())
AND	canceldate >  DATEADD(day, - @age3, GETDATE())
AND	customer = @customer
and   (total - payment) <> 0

/* 90 - 120 Balance Current */
SELECT	@age_e=(SUM(isnull(total,0)) - sum(isnull(payment,0))), @age_eq=count(*)  FROM invheader
WHERE	canceldate <=  DATEADD(day, - @age3, GETDATE())
AND	canceldate >  DATEADD(day, - @age4, GETDATE())
AND	customer = @customer
and   (total - payment) <> 0

/* 120 over Current */
SELECT	@age_f=(SUM(isnull(total,0)) - sum(isnull(payment,0))), @age_fq=count(*)  FROM invheader
WHERE	canceldate <= DATEADD(day, - @age4, GETDATE())
AND	customer = @customer
and   (total - payment) <> 0

/* avg payment This month*/
select @avg_pmtmonth=avg(datediff(dd,invoicedate, arcash.paiddate))
from arcash join invheader on arcash.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno
and invoicedate >= (SELECT DATEADD(day, -(SELECT DATEPART(day, GETDATE())) + 1, GETDATE()))
AND	invoicedate <= (SELECT DATEADD(day, + 1, GETDATE()))
group by invheader.customer having invheader.customer = @customer

/* avg payment this year*/
select @avg_pmtyear0=avg(datediff(dd,invoicedate,arcash.paiddate))
from arcash join invheader on arcash.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno
and invoicedate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,GETDATE()))
AND	invoicedate <= (SELECT '12/31/' + DATENAME(year,GETDATE()))
group by invheader.customer having invheader.customer = @customer

/* avg payment Last year*/
select @avg_pmtyear1=avg(datediff(dd,invoicedate,arcash.paiddate))
from arcash join invheader on arcash.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno
and invoicedate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	invoicedate <= (SELECT '12/31/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, - 1, GETDATE()))))
group by invheader.customer having invheader.customer = @customer

/* avg payment prev year*/
select @avg_pmtyear2=avg(datediff(dd,invoicedate,arcash.paiddate))
from arcash join invheader on arcash.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno
and invoicedate >= (SELECT '1/1/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, 1, GETDATE()))))
AND	invoicedate <= (SELECT '12/31/' + DATENAME(year,(SELECT DATEADD(year, 1, GETDATE()))))
group by invheader.customer having invheader.customer = @customer



update customer_status set so_month=@so_month, so_monthq=@so_monthq,
 so_year0=@so_year0, so_year0q=@so_year0q,
 so_year1=@so_year1, so_year1q=@so_year1q,
 so_year2=@so_year2, so_year2q=@so_year2q,
 inv_month=@inv_month, inv_monthq=@inv_monthq,
 inv_year0=@inv_year0, inv_year0q=@inv_year0q,
 inv_year1=@inv_year1, inv_year1q=@inv_year1q,
 inv_year2=@inv_year2, inv_year2q=@inv_year2q,
 ret_month=@ret_month, ret_monthq=@ret_monthq,
 ret_year0=@ret_year0, ret_year0q=@ret_year0q,
 ret_year1=@ret_year1, ret_year1q=@ret_year1q,
 ret_year2=@ret_year2, ret_year2q=@ret_year2q,
 pmt_month=@pmt_month, pmt_monthq=@pmt_monthq,
 pmt_year0=@pmt_year0, pmt_year0q=@pmt_year0q,
 pmt_year1=@pmt_year1, pmt_year1q=@pmt_year1q,
 pmt_year2=@pmt_year2, pmt_year2q=@pmt_year2q,
 cb_month=@cb_month, cb_monthq=@cb_monthq,
 cb_year0=@cb_year0, cb_year0q=@cb_year0q,
 cb_year1=@cb_year1, cb_year1q=@cb_year1q,
 cb_year2=@cb_year2, cb_year2q=@cb_year2q,
 postdated=@postdated, postdatedq=@postdatedq,
 last_so=@last_so, last_inv=@last_inv, last_pmt=@last_pmt,
 last_so_amt=@last_so_amt, last_inv_amt=@last_inv_amt, last_pmt_amt=@last_pmt_amt,
 age_a=@age_a,age_b=@age_b,age_c=@age_c,age_d=@age_d,age_e=@age_e,age_f=@age_f,
 age_aq=@age_aq,age_bq=@age_bq,age_cq=@age_cq, age_dq=@age_dq, age_eq=@age_eq, age_fq=@age_fq,
 asof= getdate(),
avg_pmtmonth=@avg_pmtmonth,avg_pmtyear0=@avg_pmtyear0,avg_pmtyear1=@avg_pmtyear1,avg_pmtyear2=@avg_pmtyear2,
gp_month=@gp_month, gp_year0=@gp_year0, gp_year1=@gp_year1, gp_year2=@gp_year2  

 where code=@customer


-- Customer Evaluation data collection 
declare @ActualCost money
declare @InvAmt money 
declare @InvQty int

-- This Year 
select @ActualCost = sum(isnull(invdetail.actual_cost,0) * isnull(invdetail.qty,0)),
		@InvQty = sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0)) ,
	   @InvAmt = sum(isnull(invdetail.qty,0)*isnull(invdetail.price,0))  
from invdetail join invheader on invdetail.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno 
where datename(year, invheader.invoicedate)=DATENAME(year,GETDATE()) and 
	invheader.customer = @customer

update customer_evaluation 
 set invoice_amt=@InvAmt, invoice_qty=@InvQty , invoice_cost = @ActualCost, 
   gross_margin =  case when isnull(@InvAmt,0)>0 then (isnull(@InvAmt,0) - isnull(@actualCost,0))/isnull(@InvAmt,1) else 0 end 
where customer = @customer and [year]= DATENAME(year,GETDATE())

declare @Sample money
declare @SampleBilled money
declare @testing money
declare @mailing money
declare @fitting money
declare @other money
declare @ChargeBack money 
declare @ReturnProfit money  /* need to deduct from GP */


select	@sample = sum(isnull(cbdetail.AMOUNT,0)) , 
		@samplebilled=sum(isnull(cbdetail.recovered_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year, cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year,GETDATE()) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in (select code from code_cb where expense_code='SAMPLE' )

select @testing = sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year, cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year,GETDATE()) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in (select code from code_cb where expense_code='TESTING' )

select @mailing =  sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year, cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year,GETDATE()) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in  (select code from code_cb where expense_code='MAILING' )

select @FITTING = sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year, cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year,GETDATE()) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in  (select code from code_cb where expense_code='FITTING' )

select @OTHER =  sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year, cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year,GETDATE()) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in  (select code from code_cb where expense_code='OTHER' )

/* 090106 dan - added */
select @ChargeBack  =  sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year, cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year,GETDATE()) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code  in  (select code from code_cb where 
				not (isnull(expense_code,'')='SAMPLE' or isnull(expense_code,'')='TESTING' or isnull(expense_code,'')='MAILING' or 
					isnull(expense_code,'')='FITTING' or isnull(expense_code,'')='OTHER' ) )

select @ReturnProfit = sum( - isnull(qty,0) * ( isnull(actual_cost,0)- isnull(price,0) ) )  from invdetail
	join invheader on invdetail.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno 
   where  invheader.customer = @customer and invheader.invoicetype='RET' and
				datename(year, invheader.invoicedate ) = DATENAME(year,GETDATE())
/* end - dan 090106 */

update customer_evaluation
 set sample_cost=@sample, sample_billed=@sampleBilled, testing_cost=@testing, mailing_cost=@mailing,
		fitting_cost = @fitting, misc_cost=@other , Return_Disc_allow=isnull(@ChargeBack,0) + isnull(@ReturnProfit,0) 
 where customer=@customer and [year]= DATENAME(year,GETDATE())

update customer_evaluation
 set net_margin=  case when isnull(invoice_amt,0) > 0 then (isnull(invoice_amt,0) - isnull(invoice_cost,0) - isnull(sample_cost,0) + isnull(sample_billed,0) - 
			isnull(testing_cost,0)-isnull(mailing_cost,0)-isnull(fitting_cost,0)-isnull(Return_Disc_Allow,0)-
			isnull(misc_cost,0) ) / invoice_amt else 0 end 
 where customer=@customer and [year]= DATENAME(year,GETDATE())

 /*170509 Arun - update ytdsales, Year to Date*/
 update customer set ytdsales = (SELECT sum(isnull(invheader.total,0.00))
FROM invheader WHERE invheader.customer = customer.code 
AND invheader.invoicedate >= DATEADD(yy,DateDiff(yy,0,GetDate()),0) 
and invheader.invoicedate <= DateAdd(dd,DateDiff(dd,1, Getdate()),1)) 
WHERE customer.code = @customer
/*170509 end - Arun update ytdsales */

-- Last Year 
exec sp_customer_status_lastYear @customer 


-- end 

sp_customer_status_all CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_customer_status_all] AS
/* add the customers to customer_status table if not found */
insert into customer_status (code) select code from customer where code not in (select code from customer_status)

/* declare cursor to loop */
declare code_curs cursor for
	select code from customer for read only
/* local variable to hold columns returned from cursor */
declare @code  nchar(10)
/* open the cursor and loop it!! */
open code_curs
fetch code_curs into @code
while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin
	/* do your thing .. */
	exec sp_customer_status @code
	fetch code_curs into @code
end
/* clean up */
close code_curs
deallocate code_curs
/* add [recalc_customer_onorder] */
exec [recalc_customer_onorder]

sp_customer_status_lastYear create procedure [dbo].[sp_customer_status_lastYear] (@customer nchar(10) ) as

-- Customer Evaluation data collection 
declare @ActualCost money
declare @InvAmt money 
declare @InvQty int
declare @Sample money
declare @SampleBilled money
declare @testing money
declare @mailing money
declare @fitting money
declare @other money
declare @ChargeBack money 
declare @ReturnProfit money  /* need to deduct from GP */

-- Last Year 
select @ActualCost = sum(isnull(invdetail.actual_cost,0) * invdetail.qty ),
		@InvQty = sum( invdetail.qty ) ,
	   @InvAmt = sum( invdetail.qty * invdetail.price )  
from invdetail join invheader on invdetail.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno 
where datename(year,  invheader.invoicedate) = DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE())) and 
	invheader.customer = @customer

update customer_evaluation 
 set invoice_amt=@InvAmt, invoice_qty=@InvQty , invoice_cost = @ActualCost, 
   gross_margin =  case when @InvAmt>0 then (@InvAmt - @actualCost)/@InvAmt else 0 end 
where customer = @customer and [year]= DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE()))

select	@sample = sum(isnull(cbdetail.AMOUNT,0)) , 
		@samplebilled=sum(isnull(cbdetail.recovered_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year,  cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE())) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in (select code from code_cb where expense_code='SAMPLE' )

select @testing = sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year,  cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE())) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in (select code from code_cb where expense_code='TESTING' )

select @mailing =  sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year,  cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE())) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in  (select code from code_cb where expense_code='MAILING' )

select @FITTING = sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year,  cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE())) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in  (select code from code_cb where expense_code='FITTING' )

select @OTHER =  sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year,  cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE())) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code in  (select code from code_cb where expense_code='OTHER' )

/* 090106 dan - added */
select @ChargeBack  =  sum(isnull(cbdetail.approved_amt,0)) 
  from cbheader join cbdetail on cbheader.cbno=cbdetail.cbno
 where datename(year, cbdetail.transdate)=DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE())) and 
		cbheader.customer = @customer and 
		cbdetail.code  in  (select code from code_cb where 
				not (isnull(expense_code,'')='SAMPLE' or isnull(expense_code,'')='TESTING' or isnull(expense_code,'')='MAILING' or 
					isnull(expense_code,'')='FITTING' or isnull(expense_code,'')='OTHER' ) )

select @ReturnProfit = sum( - qty * ( isnull(actual_cost,0)- price ) )  from invdetail
	join invheader on invdetail.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno 
   where  invheader.customer = @customer and invheader.invoicetype='RET' and
				datename(year,  invheader.invoicedate ) = DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE()))
/* end - dan 090106 */

update customer_evaluation
 set sample_cost=@sample, sample_billed=@sampleBilled, testing_cost=@testing, mailing_cost=@mailing,
		fitting_cost = @fitting, misc_cost=@other , Return_Disc_allow=isnull(@ChargeBack,0) + isnull(@ReturnProfit,0) 
 where customer=@customer and  [year]=  DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE())) 

update customer_evaluation
 set net_margin=  case when isnull(invoice_amt,0) > 0 then (invoice_amt - isnull(invoice_cost,0) - isnull(sample_cost,0) + isnull(sample_billed,0) - 
			isnull(testing_cost,0)-isnull(mailing_cost,0)-isnull(fitting_cost,0)-isnull(Return_Disc_Allow,0)-
			isnull(misc_cost,0) ) / invoice_amt else 0 end 
 where customer=@customer and [year]= DATENAME(year, dateadd(yy, -1, GETDATE()))


-- end 







sp_delete_bartender 

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_delete_bartender] (@invoiceno int, @barno int, @invhead_box_id int, 

@packlist_id int, @pickno int)
as 
BEGIN
if @invoiceno > 0
BEGIN
delete bartender from bartender join bartender2 on bartender.bar_no = bartender2.bar_no and 
bartender2.invoiceno = @invoiceno
and bartender2.bar_no = @barno

delete bartender3
from bartender3 join bartender2 on bartender3.bar_no = bartender2.bar_no where bartender2.invoiceno = 
@invoiceno
and bartender2.bar_no = @barno

delete from bartender2 where invoiceno = @invoiceno and bar_no = @barno
/*uncomment only if they want to delete from packlist */
--delete from packlist where packlist_id = @packlist_id and invoiceno = @invoiceno
/*uncomment only if they want to delete from invhead_box */
--delete from invhead_box where invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id and invoiceno = @invoiceno
END

if @pickno > 0  
BEGIN
delete bartender from bartender join bartender2 on bartender.bar_no = bartender2.bar_no and 
bartender2.invoiceno = @invoiceno
and bartender2.bar_no = @barno

delete bartender3
from bartender3 join bartender2 on bartender3.bar_no = bartender2.bar_no where bartender2.pickno = 
@pickno
and bartender2.bar_no = @barno

delete from bartender2 where pickno = @pickno and bar_no = @barno
/*uncomment Only if they want to delete from packlist */
--delete from packlist where packlist_id = @packlist_id and pickno = @pickno
/*uncomment only if they want to delete from invhead_box */
--delete from invhead_box where invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id and pickno = @pickno and invoiceno = @invoiceno
END

END

sp_delete_cutdetail create procedure sp_delete_cutdetail (@cutno int)
as
delete from cutdetail where cutno=@cutno

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_discrep_onorder]
as
delete discrep_onorder
insert into discrep_onorder
select A.style,A.color,BO1=A.qty1,BO2=A.qty2,BO3=A.qty3,BO4=A.qty4,
BO5=A.qty5,BO6=A.qty6,BO7=A.qty7,BO8=A.qty8,BO9=A.qty9,BO10=A.qty10,
BO11=A.qty11,BO12=A.qty12,IO1=B.qty1,IO2=B.qty2,IO3=B.qty3,IO4=B.qty4,
IO5=B.qty5,IO6=B.qty6,IO7=B.qty7,IO8=B.qty8,IO9=B.qty9,IO10=B.qty10,
IO11=B.qty11,IO12=B.qty12
from v_discrep_backorder A, v_discrep_ivtfonorder B 
where A.style = B.code and A.color = B.color
and (A.qty1 <> B.qty1 or A.qty2 <> B.qty2 or A.qty3 <> B.qty3 or 
A.qty4 <> B.qty4 or A.qty5 <> B.qty5 or A.qty6 <> B.qty6 or 
A.qty7 <> B.qty7 or A.qty8 <> B.qty8 or A.qty9 <> B.qty9 or 
A.qty10 <> B.qty10 or A.qty11 <> B.qty11 or A.qty12 <> B.qty12)

sp_dropdiagram 
	CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_dropdiagram
	(
		@diagramname 	sysname,
		@owner_id	int	= null
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		set nocount on
		declare @theId 			int
		declare @IsDbo 			int
		
		declare @UIDFound 		int
		declare @DiagId			int
	
		if(@diagramname is null)
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Invalid value', 16, 1);
			return -1
		end
	
		EXECUTE AS CALLER;
		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();
		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner'); 
		if(@owner_id is null)
			select @owner_id = @theId;
		REVERT; 
		
		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname 
		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @UIDFound <> @theId))
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1)
			return -3
		end
	
		delete from dbo.sysdiagrams where diagram_id = @DiagId;
	
		return 0;
	END
	
sp_duedate 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_duedate    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_duedate    Script Date: 6/11/98 1:18:41 AM ******/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_duedate] as
begin

declare @invoiceno integer, @invoicedate datetime, @terms nchar(4), @canceldate datetime
declare @cutoffday integer, @days integer, @xcanceldate datetime, @monthadd integer
declare @mm nchar(2), @dd nchar(2), @yy nchar(4)

DECLARE c_dan CURSOR   FOR select invoiceno,invoicedate,terms,canceldate from invheader

open c_dan

fetch  next from c_dan into @invoiceno,@invoicedate,@terms,@canceldate

while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin 
 select @days=coalesce(days,0), @cutoffday=coalesce(cutoffday,0) from terms 
	where code=@terms
 

 if (@cutoffday=0 or @days=0 or @@rowcount = 0)
	select @xcanceldate = dateadd(dd, @days, @invoicedate)
 else
  begin
	if datepart(dd, @invoicedate) < @cutoffday
		select @monthadd=1
	else
		select @monthadd=2


	select @monthadd = @monthadd + convert(integer, @days / 30 )
	
	select @xcanceldate = dateadd(mm, @monthadd, @invoicedate)

	select @mm = convert( nchar(2), datepart(mm, @xcanceldate) )
	if @days%30 = 0 
		select @dd=' 1'
	else
		select @dd = convert( nchar(2), @days%30 )

	select @yy = convert( nchar(4), datepart(yy, @xcanceldate) )

	select @xcanceldate = convert(datetime, @mm +'/'+ @dd +'/'+ @yy ) 

print  @mm
print @dd
print @yy
print @terms
print 'test'

   end


 
 update invheader set canceldate = @xcanceldate where invoiceno=@invoiceno

 fetch  next from c_dan into @invoiceno,@invoicedate,@terms,@canceldate
end  /* @@fetch_status */

close c_dan
deallocate c_dan


end


/* end */

sp_email_2Excel CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_email_2Excel]  @id int , @format varchar(255) = NULL, @mailid INT=NULL OUTPUT
as 

declare @email_to nvarchar(255)
declare @email_cc nvarchar(255)
declare @email_bcc nvarchar(255)
declare @email_subject nvarchar(255)
declare @email_body nvarchar(max)
declare @cmdshell nvarchar(255)
declare @filename1 nvarchar(255)
declare @profilename varchar(255)
declare @filextension varchar(10)

select @email_to=email_to, @email_cc=email_cc, @email_bcc=email_bcc, @email_subject=email_subject, @email_body=email_body, @filename1=filename1 
, @filextension = Substring(filename1,CHARINDEX('.', filename1)+1,Len(filename1)) 
 from email_queue where email_queue_id=@id  

--set @cmdshell = 'bcp "select attachment1 from wf125sr..email_queue where email_queue_id='+convert(char(6), @id)+'" queryout "'+@filename1+'" -S .\SQL2014 -Usa -P15848 -T -N '
if LEFT(UPPER(isnull(@filextension,'')),4) <> 'XLS'
Begin
	set @cmdshell = 'bcp "select attachment1 from wf125sr..email_queue where email_queue_id='+convert(char(6), @id)+'" queryout "'+@filename1+'" -S NJDBSERVER16 -Uplugg -P15848@admi -T -N '
End
--Excel from 2Excel Needs the format being saved already
Else
Begin
	set @cmdshell = 'bcp "select attachment1 from wf125sr..email_queue where email_queue_id='+convert(char(6), @id)+'" queryout "'+@filename1+'" -S NJDBSERVER16 -Uplugg -P15848@admi -T -f '+@format
End

EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmdshell 
/*get the minimum profile name as the current profilename*/
SELECT @profilename = min(name) FROM msdb.dbo.sysmail_profile

EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail 
@recipients =  @email_to, 
@copy_recipients = @email_cc, 
@blind_copy_recipients = @email_bcc, 
--@profile_name = 'LT',
@profile_name = @profilename,
@subject = @email_subject, 
@body = @email_body,
@body_format = 'HTML',
@file_attachments = @filename1,
@mailitem_id = @mailid OUTPUT

--update email_queue set sent_date=getdate() where email_queue_id=@id 
Delete From email_queue WHERE email_queue_id = @id

sp_email_daily_status CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_email_daily_status] (@EMAIL char(40))
 AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @tableHTML  NVARCHAR(MAX) ;

	select  @tableHTML ='Orders: $'+ convert(varchar(20), isnull( convert(int,sum(total)),0)) + ' Qty:'+ convert(varchar(10), isnull(convert(int,sum(subtotal)),0)) 
		from soheader where convert(char(10),orderdate,102) = convert(char(10),getdate(),102)
	select  @tableHTML = @tableHTML + '  Invoiced: $'+ convert(varchar(20), isnull(convert(int,sum(invheader.total)),0)) +
		 ' Qty:'+ convert(varchar(10), isnull(convert(int, sum(invdetail.qty)),0)) 
		from invheader join invdetail on invheader.invoiceno=invdetail.invoiceno 
	 where convert(char(10),invheader.invoicedate,102) = convert(char(10),getdate(),102)

     EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail @recipients =  @EMAIL, 
     @subject = 'WF Daily Summary',
     @body = @tableHTML,
	-- @from_address='info',
	 @profile_name = 'WIN'
END

sp_email_daily_summary Create Procedure [dbo].[sp_email_daily_summary](@reportfor nvarchar(30),@datefrom date=null,@dateto date=null,@customerfrom nvarchar(50)=null,
											 @customerto nvarchar(50)=null,@salesrepfrom nvarchar(50)=null,@salesrepto nvarchar(50)=null)
as

begin


	if @reportfor='QUOTE'
		begin
		 exec sp_get_html_Quote @datefrom,@dateto,@customerfrom,@customerto,@salesrepfrom,@salesrepto
		end
	if @reportfor='SALESORDER' 
		begin
		exec [sp_get_html_soheader] @datefrom,@dateto,@customerfrom,@customerto,@salesrepfrom,@salesrepto
		end
	if @reportfor='INVOICE'
		begin
		exec [sp_get_html_invoice] @datefrom,@dateto,@customerfrom,@customerto,@salesrepfrom,@salesrepto
		end
	if @reportfor='CUTTICKET'
		begin
		exec [sp_get_html_cutheader] @datefrom,@dateto,@customerfrom,@customerto,@salesrepfrom,@salesrepto
		end
	if @reportfor='PO'
		begin
		exec [sp_get_html_poheader] @datefrom,@dateto,@customerfrom,@customerto
		end
end

sp_email_invoice_html_email_all /* 190520 Arun created */ 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_email_invoice_html_email_all] 
as 
DECLARE @invoiceno int , @customer nvarchar(10), @email nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cur_email_invoice CURSOR FOR
	SELECT invoiceno FROM temp_invoice_email 
	where isnull(sent_email ,'N') = 'N' 
	--AND isnull(shipvia_ref,'') <> ''
	 FOR READ ONLY

OPEN cur_email_invoice
FETCH cur_email_invoice INTO @invoiceno

-- loop until meet end of selected row
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT @customer = customer FROM invheader WHERE Invoiceno = @invoiceno 
		Exec usp_get_contact_email @code = @customer, @Module = 'web_ar', @contactemail = @email OUTPUT
		exec usp_send_invoice_html_email @invoiceno 
		waitfor delay '00:00:03'
		update temp_invoice_email SET sent_email = 'Y', email_to = @email WHERE invoiceno = @invoiceno;
		FETCH cur_email_invoice INTO @invoiceno 
	END
CLOSE cur_email_invoice
DEALLOCATE cur_email_invoice

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_email_notify_web_order](@orderno int)     
 AS    
declare @mybody nvarchar(max)    
declare @subject nvarchar(max)    
declare @email nchar(500)    
declare @total money    
declare @custpo varchar(20)    
declare @subtotal int     
declare @user5 varchar(20)    
declare @user4 nchar(1)

declare @customername nvarchar(50)    
declare @customer nvarchar(10)    
Select @total=Total,@custpo=custpo,@subtotal=subtotal,@user5=user5,@user4=user4,@customer=customer from soheader_hfc where orderno=@orderno;    
select @company=company from div where code=@user4    
select @customername=customer.name from customer where code=@customer    
    
SET @subject=isnull(rtrim(@company), '')+' WebOrder Confirmation# :'+convert(nvarchar(50),@orderno) +' for ' + rtrim(@customername) +' / '+'Amount : $'+Convert(nvarchar(50),@total)    
    
select @email=isnull(wf3_EmailNotifyWebOrders,'') from wfsystem3;    
SELECT @email = REPLACE(@email,',',';')    
IF @email=''    
return     
declare @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max);     
set @mybody =      
 N'<html><head><title></title></head>' + CHAR(10)     
 + N'<body style="font-family: Arial size:8pt"><style type="text/css">

}'+'

    text-align: left;        
 padding:3px;    
 font-size:12px;     
 padding:5px;    
 text-align:center;    
}'+'    
th {    
    border: 1px solid #000;     
    text-align: left;        
 padding:3px;    
 font-size:12px;     
 padding:5px;    
 text-align:center;    
}     
}    
</style>'        
 + N'<h2 style="padding:25px;color:#ff0000">New Order Placed</h2>'     
 + N'<table border="1" style="font-size:10pt">'     
 + N'<tr>'     
 + N'<th style="font-size: 10pt" face="sans-serif" bgcolor="#bdd6ee">WebOrder#</th>'     
 + N'<th style="font-size: 10pt" face="sans-serif" bgcolor="#bdd6ee" >Cust Code</th>'      
 + N'<th style="font-size: 10pt" face="sans-serif" bgcolor="#bdd6ee">Cust Name</th>'      
 + N'<th style="font-size: 10pt" face="sans-serif" bgcolor="#bdd6ee">CustPO</th>'     
 + N'<th style="font-size: 10pt" face="sans-serif" bgcolor="#bdd6ee" >User5</th>'       
 + N'<th style="font-size: 10pt" face="sans-serif" bgcolor="#bdd6ee">Ship Date </th>'     
 + N'<th style="font-size: 10pt" face="sans-serif" bgcolor="#bdd6ee">Cancel Date </th>'     
 + N'<th style="font-size: 10pt" face="sans-serif" bgcolor="#bdd6ee">OrderQty</th>'      
 + N'<th style="font-size: 10pt" face="sans-serif" bgcolor="#bdd6ee">Total $ </th>'    
       
 + N'</tr>' + CHAR(10);     
--PRINT @mybody    
SELECT @table =      
 CONVERT(nvarchar(max),     
  (select     
   td = isnull(orderno, '')    
  ,'' ,td = isnull(Customer, '')     
  ,'' ,td = isnull(Blname, '')     
  ,'' ,td = isnull(custpo,'')    
  ,'' ,td = isnull(user5, '')    
  ,'' ,td = isnull(convert(varchar(12),Shipdate), '')    
  ,'' ,td = isnull(convert(varchar(12),canceldate), '')    
  ,'' ,td = convert(int,(cast(isnull(subtotal, '') as money)))        
  ,'' ,td = CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2), ISNULL(total, ''))     
  from soheader_hfc    
  where 1=1 AND ORDERNO=@orderno    
  FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE));      
      
set @mybody = @mybody + @table + CHAR(10) + N'</table></body></html>';     
    
EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail     
 @recipients = @email,

 @subject = @subject,

 @body_format = 'HTML'

sp_email_queue 


CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_email_queue]  @id int  
as 

declare @email_to nvarchar(255)
declare @email_cc nvarchar(255)
declare @email_bcc nvarchar(255)
declare @email_subject nvarchar(255)
declare @email_body nvarchar(max)
declare @cmdshell nvarchar(255)
declare @filename1 nvarchar(255)
declare @profilename varchar(255)
declare @mailitem_id INT, @sysmail_mailitem_id INT
declare @sent_status tinyint, @sent_date datetime

select @email_to=email_to, @email_cc=email_cc, @email_bcc=email_bcc, @email_subject=email_subject, @email_body=email_body, @filename1=filename1, @sysmail_mailitem_id = isnull(sysmail_item_id,0)
from email_queue where email_queue_id=@id  

if @sysmail_mailitem_id > 0 
begin
	SELECT @sent_status = sent_status, @sent_date = sent_date FROM msdb.dbo.sysmail_mailitems WHERE mailitem_id = @sysmail_mailitem_id
	if @sent_status = 1
	begin
		update email_queue set sent_date=@sent_date where email_queue_id=@id AND sent_date is NULL
		return
	end
end

set @cmdshell = 'bcp "select attachment1 from ' + db_name() + '..email_queue where email_queue_id='+convert(char(6), @id)+'" queryout "'+@filename1+'" -S NJDBSERVER16 -Uplugg -P15848@admi -T -N '

EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmdshell 
/*get the minimum profile name as the current profilename*/
SELECT @profilename = min(name) FROM msdb.dbo.sysmail_profile

EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail 
@recipients =  @email_to, 
@copy_recipients = @email_cc, 
@blind_copy_recipients = @email_bcc, 
--@profile_name = 'LT',
@profile_name = @profilename,
@subject = @email_subject, 
@body = @email_body,
@body_format = 'HTML',
@file_attachments = @filename1,
@mailitem_id = @mailitem_id OUTPUT--, 
--@email_queue_id = @id

WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:3';
--update email_queue SET sysmail_item_id = @mailitem_id WHERE email_queue_id = @id
--PRINT 'mailitem_id ' + Cast(@mailitem_id as nvarchar(10))
SELECT @sent_status = sent_status FROM msdb.dbo.sysmail_mailitems WHERE mailitem_id = @mailitem_id

if @sent_status = 1 
begin
	update email_queue set sent_date=getdate() where email_queue_id=@id 
end

sp_email_queue_all /* 150424 dan - created */ 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_email_queue_all] 
as 
DECLARE @id int  

DECLARE cur_email_queue CURSOR FOR
	SELECT email_queue_id FROM email_queue where sent_date is null and attachment1 is not null
	 FOR READ ONLY

OPEN cur_email_queue
FETCH cur_email_queue INTO @id

-- loop until meet end of selected row
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN
		exec sp_email_queue @id 
		FETCH cur_email_queue INTO @id 
	END
CLOSE cur_email_queue
DEALLOCATE cur_email_queue

sp_fitcomment 
/* 150807 - Christhu added style to search on fit comment*/
/* 150810 - Christhu added vendor access*/
/* 160416 - Jaison changed the Fit_Comment.Comment to use the function [f_txt2rtf] */
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_fitcomment] (@flag char(1),@vendor nchar(20),@fromdate datetime,@todate datetime,@pageindex int,
 @pagesize int, @style varchar(20)=null,  @recordcount int output)
AS
BEGIN
if @flag = 'N' or @style<>''
Begin
SELECT   row_number()over(ORDER BY Fit_Comment.Fit_Comment_id desc) as RowNumber,Fit_Comment.upc,   
         Fit_Comment.RefNo,
         Fit_Comment.CommentBy,
		Approval=(case when Fit_Comment.ApprovalStatus = 'N' then 'Not Approved'     
		               when Fit_Comment.ApprovalStatus = 'C' then 'Approved with Corrections' 
		               when Fit_Comment.ApprovalStatus = 'Y' then 'Approved' End),
         CONVERT(varchar(10), Fit_Comment.CommentDate,   101) as CommentDate,
      --  dbo.fnRTFtoPlain(Fit_Comment.Comment) as Comment  ,
	  --Fit_Comment.Comment,
	  [dbo].[f_txt2rtf](Fit_Comment.Comment) as Comment,
  filename = '''',
  ivtf_sample.code  ,
  ivtf_sample.vendor,
  Fit_Comment.Fit_Comment_id  into  #result
    FROM Fit_Comment  join ivtf_sample on fit_comment.upc = ivtf_sample.upc
	where ivtf_sample.vendor = @vendor  or charindex(@vendor,webpdm_vendors)>0 and code like '%'+@style+'%'


	
select @recordcount = count(*) from #result

SELECT * FROM #Result
      WHERE RowNumber BETWEEN(@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1 AND(((@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1) + @PageSize) - 1
     
      DROP TABLE #Result
END  


if @flag = 'Y' and @style=''
Begin

SELECT   row_number()over(ORDER BY Fit_Comment.Fit_Comment_id desc) as RowNumber,Fit_Comment.upc,   
         Fit_Comment.RefNo,
         Fit_Comment.CommentBy,
		Approval=(case when Fit_Comment.ApprovalStatus = 'N' then 'Not Approved'     
					   when Fit_Comment.ApprovalStatus = 'C' then 'Approved with Corrections' 
		               when Fit_Comment.ApprovalStatus = 'Y' then 'Approved' End),
         CONVERT(varchar(10), Fit_Comment.CommentDate,   101) as CommentDate,
       -- dbo.fnRTFtoPlain(Fit_Comment.Comment) as Comment  ,
	   --Fit_Comment.Comment,
	   [dbo].[f_txt2rtf](Fit_Comment.Comment) as Comment,
  filename = '''',
  ivtf_sample.code  ,
  ivtf_sample.vendor,
  Fit_Comment.Fit_Comment_id  into  #result1
    FROM Fit_Comment  join ivtf_sample on fit_comment.upc = ivtf_sample.upc
	where ivtf_sample.vendor = @vendor or charindex(@vendor,webpdm_vendors)>0 and CommentDate between @fromdate and @todate


	
select @recordcount = count(*) from #result1

SELECT * FROM #result1
      WHERE RowNumber BETWEEN(@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1 AND(((@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1) + @PageSize) - 1
     
      DROP TABLE #Result1
END
END


sp_fix_exchangerate 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_fix_exchangerate] 

      AS

BEGIN

 

      UPDATE soheader SET exchange_rate='1.000000' WHERE ISNULL(exchange_rate,0)=0 

      UPDATE sodetail SET exchange_rate='1.000000' WHERE ISNULL(exchange_rate,0)=0

      UPDATE soheader SET currency = 'USD' WHERE ISNULL(currency,'')= ''

      UPDATE sodetail SET currency= 'USD' WHERE ISNULL(currency,'')=''

 

      UPDATE invheader SET exchange_rate='1.000000' WHERE ISNULL(exchange_rate,0)=0 

      UPDATE invdetail SET exchange_rate='1.000000' WHERE ISNULL(exchange_rate,0)=0

      UPDATE invheader SET currency = 'USD' WHERE ISNULL(currency,'')= ''

      UPDATE invdetail SET currency= 'USD' WHERE ISNULL(currency,'')=''

 

      UPDATE pickheader SET exchange_rate='1.000000' WHERE ISNULL(exchange_rate,0)=0 

      UPDATE pickdetail SET exchange_rate='1.000000' WHERE ISNULL(exchange_rate,0)=0

      UPDATE pickheader SET currency = 'USD' WHERE ISNULL(currency,'')= ''

      UPDATE pickdetail SET currency= 'USD' WHERE ISNULL(currency,'')=''

      

      UPDATE rmaheader SET exchange_rate='1.000000' WHERE ISNULL(exchange_rate,0)=0 

      UPDATE rmaheader SET currency = 'USD' WHERE ISNULL(currency,'')= ''

    

END

					WHERE userdate >= dateadd(day,datediff(day,1,GETDATE()),0) AND userdate < dateadd(day,datediff(day,0,GETDATE()),0)

sp_get_alloc_details 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_get_alloc_details](@get_WHERE nvarchar(255), @orderby nvarchar(255),  @pass_days nchar(50),@alloc_rule nchar(4))
AS
BEGIN 

EXEC ('INSERT INTO workTABLE
	  SELECT sodetail.sodetail_id ,sodetail.orderno,  soheader.shipdate,   soheader.canceldate,     soheader.customer,   
         	soheader.store,    soheader.salesrep1,    soheader.salesrep2,    soheader.shipvia,    soheader.user1,   
        	soheader.user2,   soheader.user3,    soheader.user4,     soheader.user5,    soheader.season,   
         	soheader.factored,     sodetail.style,    sodetail.color,   sodetail.line,  
	coalesce(sodetail.qty1,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty1,0) - coalesce(pick1,0) as qty1,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty2,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty2,0) - coalesce(pick2,0) as qty2,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty3,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty3,0) - coalesce(pick3,0) as qty3,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty4,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty4,0) - coalesce(pick4,0) as qty4,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty5,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty5,0) - coalesce(pick5,0) as qty5,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty6,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty6,0) - coalesce(pick6,0) as qty6,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty7,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty7,0) - coalesce(pick7,0) as qty7,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty8,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty8,0) - coalesce(pick8,0) as qty8,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty9,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty9,0) - coalesce(pick9,0) as qty9,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty10,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty10,0) - coalesce(pick10,0) as qty10,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty11,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty11,0) - coalesce(pick11,0) as qty11,
	coalesce(sodetail.qty12,0) - coalesce(shipped_qty12,0) - coalesce(pick12,0) as qty12,
       	  sodetail.price ,alloc_rule = "' +@alloc_rule+ '"'+
	' FROM sodetail join soheader on sodetail.orderno = soheader.orderno    
         	        left outer join v_pickdetail_open on  sodetail.sodetail_id = v_pickdetail_open.sodetail_id 
  	 WHERE  '
	+ @get_WHERE+ '   AND  soheader.shipdate < "'  + @pass_days +   '"  AND sodetail.closed = "N" ' +
	' AND sodetail.sodetail_id NOT IN (SELECT workTABLE.sodetail_id FROM workTABLE)  '  + @orderby)

	IF @@ERROR <>  0
		
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Insert into work TABLE Failed.', 16, 1)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		Return
	END
	
DELETE FROM WORKTABLE WHERE (STYLE NOT IN (SELECT CODE FROM IVTF_ALLOC) AND COLOR NOT IN (SELECT COLOR FROM IVTF_ALLOC))
END
/********************END SP_GET_ALLOC_DETAILS*******************************************/

sp_get_alloc_param 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_get_alloc_param]  AS
DECLARE @Alloc_days int,
	@SQL_pass nvarchar(255), 	/*Used to pass WHERE parameters to sp_get_alloc_details */
	@SQL_sort   nchar(255),               /*Used to pass Order By to sp_get_alloc_details */
	@alloc_date Datetime,  		/*Used to pass WHERE date parameter for how many days to allocate out*/
	@Date_string nchar(50), 		/* Changes @alloc_date to nchar for date evaulation in sp_get_alloc_detail*/
	@Alloc_rule   nchar(4)

	

	

DECLARE alloc_parm_CURSOR  CURSOR for 
SELECT sodetail_pass , sodetail_sort,days_alloc,alloc_rule  
FROM Allocation_rules WHERE Run_rule = 'Y'   order by alloc_rule
	
Open alloc_parm_CURSOR 


--perform the first fetch


FETCH NEXT FROM alloc_parm_CURSOR INTO @SQL_pass,@SQL_sort,@Alloc_days,@Alloc_rule
/* IF no rule defined abort the procedure */
IF  @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 
	begin
	CLOSE alloc_parm_cursor
	DEALLOCATE alloc_parm_cursor
		RAISERROR ('No rules defined for allocation.', 16, 1)
		Return
	End 
BEGIN TRANSACTION
Delete  workTABLE
Delete  ivtf_alloc
Update sodetail set alloc_qty1 = 0, 
		    alloc_qty2 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty3 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty4 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty5 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty6 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty7 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty8 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty9 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty10 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty11 = 0 ,
		    alloc_qty12 = 0 

IF @@ERROR  <> 0 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR ('Insert into work TABLE Failed.', 16, 1)
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	Return
END


     	INSERT INTO IVTF_Alloc
	  SELECT ivtf.code, ivtf.color,   
		coalesce( ivtf.qty1,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick1,0) as qty1,
		coalesce( ivtf.qty2,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick2,0) as qty2, 
		coalesce( ivtf.qty3,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick3,0) as qty3,
		coalesce( ivtf.qty4,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick4,0) as qty4,
		coalesce( ivtf.qty5,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick5,0) as qty5, 
		coalesce( ivtf.qty6,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick6,0) as qty6,
		coalesce( ivtf.qty7,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick7,0) as qty7,
		coalesce( ivtf.qty8,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick8,0) as qty8,
		coalesce( ivtf.qty9,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick9,0) as qty9, 
		coalesce( ivtf.qty10,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick10,0) as qty10,
		coalesce( ivtf.qty11,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick11,0) as qty11,
		coalesce( ivtf.qty12,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick12,0) as qty12 
	   FROM ivtf,v_pickdetail_open_style_color
	   WHERE 
		(ivtf.code *= v_pickdetail_open_style_color.style)and
		(ivtf.color *= v_pickdetail_open_style_color.color)and
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty1,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick1,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty2,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick2,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty3,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick3,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty4,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick4,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty5,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick5,0))+ 
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty6,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick6,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty7,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick7,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty8,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick8,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty9,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick9,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty10,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick10,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty11,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick11,0))+
		(coalesce( ivtf.qty12,0)-coalesce(v_pickdetail_open_style_color.pick12,0)) > 0
			 
	
	IF @@ERROR <>  0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Insert into Allocation Inventory TABLE Failed.', 16, 1)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		Return
	END
	IF (SELECT Count(*) FROM ivtf_alloc) = 0  
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('No inventory to allocate.', 16, 1)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		Return
	END

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	
	SELECT @alloc_date = dateadd(day, @alloc_days, getdate()),
-- @alloc_date = convert(datetime,convert(int,getdate()) + @Alloc_days ),
       	@Date_string = convert(nvarchar,@Alloc_date)
	exec sp_get_alloc_details @get_WHERE = @SQL_pass, 	
	                                          @orderby = @SQL_sort , 
         	                                  @pass_days = @date_string,
						  @alloc_rule = @Alloc_rule	
				

	FETCH NEXT FROM alloc_parm_CURSOR INTO @SQL_pass,@SQL_sort,@Alloc_days,@Alloc_rule
	
	
END 

CLOSE alloc_parm_CURSOR
DEALLOCATE alloc_parm_CURSOR
commit transaction

sp_getapprox_shipdate create Procedure [dbo].[sp_getapprox_shipdate] @style varchar(30)=null,@color varchar(30)=null
as
declare @checkstyle varchar(30)
declare @approx_shipdatefromdb varchar(50)
set @checkstyle = (select count(*) from ivtf where code=@style)
if @checkstyle >0
Begin
	if isnull(@color,'')=''
		begin
		set @approx_shipdatefromdb =(select  case when	sum(isnull(ivtf.qty,0))<=0 and 
							sum(isnull(ivtf.wip_qty1, 0) +isnull(ivtf.wip_qty2,0) +isnull(ivtf.wip_qty3,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty4,0)+
								isnull(ivtf.wip_qty5,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty6,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty7,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty8,0) +
								isnull(ivtf.wip_qty9,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty10,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty11,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty12,0)) > 0 
					 then   convert(varchar(40),dateadd(dd,3, max(completiondate)),101) 
	else convert(varchar(101),dateadd(dd,3,getdate()),101)
end as approx_shipdate 
		from cutheader join cutdetail on cutheader.cutno=cutdetail.cutno join ivtf on ivtf.code=cutdetail.style 
		join color on ivtf.color=  color.code where ivtf.code=@style and isnull(cutdetail.closed,'N')<>'Y')
		end
	else
		begin
			set @approx_shipdatefromdb =(select  case when	sum(isnull(ivtf.qty,0))<=0 and 
		sum(isnull(ivtf.wip_qty1, 0) +isnull(ivtf.wip_qty2,0) +isnull(ivtf.wip_qty3,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty4,0)+
		isnull(ivtf.wip_qty5,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty6,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty7,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty8,0) +
		isnull(ivtf.wip_qty9,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty10,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty11,0)+isnull(ivtf.wip_qty12,0)) > 0 
		then convert(varchar(40),dateadd(dd,3, max(completiondate)),101) 
		else convert(varchar(101),dateadd(dd,3,getdate()),101)
		end as approx_shipdate 
		from cutheader join cutdetail on cutheader.cutno=cutdetail.cutno join ivtf on ivtf.code=cutdetail.style 
		join color on ivtf.color=  color.code where ivtf.code=@style and ivtf.color=@color and isnull(cutdetail.closed,'N')<>'Y')
		end
end
else
	begin
		set @approx_shipdatefromdb =(select 'No Style Found!!!' as approx_shipdate)
	end
if @approx_shipdatefromdb<>'No Style Found!!!'
Begin

	select 
		convert(varchar(50),DATEADD(day,standard_days, @approx_shipdatefromdb),101) as standard_days,
		convert(varchar(50),DATEADD(day,rush_days,@approx_shipdatefromdb),101) as rush_days,
		convert(varchar(50),DATEADD(day,priority_days,@approx_shipdatefromdb),101) as priority_days,
		(select top 1 code from ivtf where code=@style) as descript ,
		(select top 1 descript from ivtf where code=@style) as code 
	from 
		webconfig
		
end
else
Begin
	select @approx_shipdatefromdb as approx_shipdate
	
end


sp_getbartender_upc_sample /* Added or charindex(@vendor,webpdm_vendors)>0 for vendor access */
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_getbartender_upc_sample]
( 
@pg int, 
@pgSize int ,
@vendor varchar(20)
) 
AS 
BEGIN 

 
Set NoCount OFF 
select row_number() over(order by user_date desc) as id, code,color,descript,upc,vendor,sample_desc,user_date INTO #temp from ivtf_sample  
where is_webpdm = 'Y' and vendor =@vendor  or charindex(@vendor,webpdm_vendors)>0
and ivtf_sample.user_date >=dateadd(mm, -1, getdate()) 
 
 
declare @from int 
declare @to int 
set @to=@pg * @pgSize 
Set @from= @pg * @pgSize-@pgsize 
 
Select * from #temp where id>@from and id<=@to 
Select count(*) from #temp
drop table #temp 
Set NoCount ON 
END
sp_GetCustomer CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetCustomer] @searchtext varchar(40) 
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
 AS
BEGIN
 SELECT customer.name, ltrim(rtrim(customer.code)) AS code, customer.addr1, customer.addr2, customer.zip,customer.email1,
 customer.phone1,customer.taxrate,customer.city,
 customer.state,customer.terms,customer.shipvia,customer.salesrep1,customer.pricelevel,s.customer,isnull(s.code,'') as storeCode,isnull(s.name,'') as shname,isnull(s.addr1,'') as shaddr1,isnull(s.addr2,'') as shaddr2,isnull(s.city,'') as shcity,isnull(s.[state],'') as shstate,isnull(s.zip,'') as shzip
FROM customer left outer join store s on customer.code=s.customer
where (( customer.code like '%'+ @searchtext + '%' ) OR
 ( customer.Website_company like '%'+ @searchtext + '%') OR
  ( customer.Name like '%'+ @searchtext + '%' ) OR
  ( customer.city like '%'+ @searchtext + '%' ) OR
   ( customer.contact1 like '%'+ @searchtext + '%' ) OR 
   ( customer.phone1 like '%'+ @searchtext + '%' ) OR 
   ( customer.email1 like '%'+ @searchtext + '%' ) OR
   ( customer.zip like '%'+ @searchtext + '%' ))

  --and s.code='00'
  and s.code=(select min(code) from store where store.customer=customer.code)
END
sp_GetDetails 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetDetails]
(@style char(13))
AS 
SELECT c.color_descript as color_descript ,rtrim(v.style) AS style,v.Thumbnail2,v.Thumbnail3,v.Thumbnail4,v.washing_instruction1, v.price  
AS price, rtrim(v.descript) descript,v.iosDataTS,v.media_url 
from ios_view_list AS v join  ios_view_list_coloronly AS c  on  v.color = c.color 
where v.style=@style

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetImagesPageWise]  
--[dbo].[GetImagesPageWise] 2, 10, null  
 @PageIndex INT   
   ,@PageSize INT  
 ,@grp nvarchar(20)  
 ,@category  nvarchar(20) =null  
  ,@season  nvarchar(20) =null 
  ,@customer nvarchar(40)  
  ,@filter char(1)  
   ,@PageCount INT OUTPUT  
AS  
BEGIN   
-- This is for to work with array  
--create type colortable as table

create table #Results  (Rownumber int,id int,code char(50),descript char(80),price2 decimal(10,2),webprice decimal(10,2),searchfrom char(500))  
  
Declare @var1 char(100)  
Declare @clgrp char(100)  
Declare @clctg char(100)  
Declare @frompriceclm nchar(1000)  
Declare @topriceclm nchar(1000)  
declare @sqll nvarchar(1000)  
Declare @cldetail char(100)  

 DECLARE @price nvarchar(10)  
 if (@customer <> 'N/A')  
 begin  
 select @price = (select case when customer.pricelevel='A' then 'price'  when customer.pricelevel='B' then 'priceb' when customer.pricelevel='C' then 'pricec' when customer.pricelevel='D' then 'priced' when customer.pricelevel='E' then 'pricee' when customer.pricelevel='F' then 'pricef' else 'price' end as price from customer where customer.code=@customer)  
 print @price  
 end  
 else  
 begin  
set @price = 'price'  
end  
  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
set @var1 = 'v_grid.'+ rtrim(@price)  
set @clgrp = 'v_grid.grp=''' + @grp   


--set @clctg = 'v_grid.category=''' + @category

set @cldetail=''
if(@season is not null AND @season <> '')  
begin  
set @cldetail = 'v_grid.season=''' + @season  
end  
else if (@category is not null AND @category <> '')  
begin  
set @cldetail = 'v_grid.category=''' + @category  
end  
else
begin
set @cldetail ='v_grid.category='''
end


  --Added by vinoothna Y for displying category,collections and seasons list with sorting.(180621)


if @filter = 'H'  
begin  

set @sqll = ' SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER   
            (  
                 order by ' +  rtrim(@var1) + ' desc  
            )AS RowNumber,' +   
      'v_grid.id,rtrim(v_grid.code) as code,v_grid.descript,convert(decimal(10,2),' + rtrim(@var1) + ')' + 'as price2,v_grid.webprice,'''' as ''searchfrom''' +  
     
    'from v_grid where 1=1  ' +case WHEN @grp <> '' THEN +' and '+ rtrim(@clgrp) + '''' else '' end +' and '+ rtrim(@cldetail)  +  ''' and '+'  color=( select min(color) from v_grid v2 where v2.style=v_grid.style)'+  
 ' group by v_grid.code,v_grid.id,v_grid.descript,' + rtrim(@var1) + ',webprice ' +  
 ' order by ' +  rtrim(@var1) + ' desc'  
 insert #Results  
 EXEC sp_executesql @sqll  

End  

ELSE
begin

set @sqll = ' SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER   
            (  
                 order by ' +  rtrim(@var1) + ' asc  
            )AS RowNumber,' +   
      'v_grid.id,rtrim(v_grid.code) as code,v_grid.descript,convert(decimal(10,2),' + rtrim(@var1) + ')' + 'as price2,v_grid.webprice,'''' as ''searchfrom''' +  
    'from v_grid where 1=1  ' +case WHEN @grp <> '' THEN +' and '+ rtrim(@clgrp) + '''' else '' end +' and '+ rtrim(@cldetail)  +  ''' and '+' color=( select min(color) from v_grid v2 where v2.style=v_grid.style)'+  
 ' group by v_grid.code,v_grid.id,v_grid.descript,' + rtrim(@var1) + ',webprice ' +  
 ' order by ' +  rtrim(@var1) + ' asc' 
 print @sqll 
 insert #Results  
 EXEC sp_executesql @sqll  

end

sp_GetInventoryDetails CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetInventoryDetails]
(@style char(13))
AS 
BEGIN
DECLARE @combinedString VARCHAR(MAX)
SELECT  @combinedString = COALESCE(@combinedString + ',', '') + rtrim(c.descript)
FROM 
color AS c,view_list AS v
where v.code=@style and v.color <> '.' and v.color=c.code
SELECT @combinedString as color ,rtrim(v.code) AS style,v.washing_instruction1,rtrim(v.descript) descript,color,color_descript,qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,wip_qty1,wip_qty2,wip_qty3,wip_qty4,wip_qty5,wip_qty6, wip_qty7,wip_qty8,wip_qty9,wip_qty10,wip_qty11,wip_qty12,   isnull(prepack_qty1,0) AS prepack_qty1,isnull(prepack_qty2,0) AS prepack_qty2,isnull(prepack_qty3,0) AS prepack_qty3,isnull(prepack_qty4,0) AS prepack_qty4,isnull(prepack_qty5,0) AS prepack_qty5,isnull(prepack_qty6,0) AS prepack_qty6,isnull (prepack_qty7,0) AS prepack_qty7,isnull(prepack_qty8,0) AS prepack_qty8,isnull(prepack_qty9,0) AS prepack_qty9,isnull(prepack_qty10,0) AS prepack_qty10,isnull(prepack_qty11,0) AS prepack_qty11,isnull(prepack_qty12,0) AS prepack_qty12,convert(char (10),eta_date,101) AS eta_date,location,price,isnull(washing_instruction1,'No HTML') AS washing_instruction,isnull(size1,'') AS size1,isnull(size2,'') AS size2,isnull(size3,'') AS size3,isnull(size4,'') AS size4,isnull(size5,'') AS size5,isnull(size6,'') AS size6,isnull(size7,'') AS size7,isnull(size8,'') AS size8,isnull(size9,'') AS size9,isnull(size10,'') AS size10,isnull(size11,'') AS size11,isnull(size12,'') AS size12,isnull(onorder_qty1,0) AS onorder_qty1,isnull(onorder_qty2,0) AS onorder_qty2,isnull(onorder_qty3,0) AS onorder_qty3,isnull(onorder_qty4,0) AS onorder_qty4,isnull(onorder_qty5,0) AS onorder_qty5,isnull(onorder_qty6,0) AS onorder_qty6,isnull (onorder_qty7,0) AS onorder_qty7,isnull(onorder_qty8,0) AS onorder_qty8,isnull(onorder_qty9,0) AS onorder_qty9,isnull(onorder_qty10,0) AS onorder_qty10,isnull(onorder_qty11,0) AS onorder_qty11,isnull(onorder_qty12,0) AS onorder_qty12 from v_ios_ivtf AS v,color AS c
where v.code=@style and v.color=c.code and v.color = '.'

END


sp_helpdiagramdefinition 
	CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_helpdiagramdefinition
	(
		@diagramname 	sysname,
		@owner_id	int	= null 		
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		set nocount on

		declare @theId 		int
		declare @IsDbo 		int
		declare @DiagId		int
		declare @UIDFound	int
	
		if(@diagramname is null)
		begin
			RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1);
			return -1
		end
	
		execute as caller;
		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();
		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner');
		if(@owner_id is null)
			select @owner_id = @theId;
		revert; 
	
		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname;
		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @UIDFound <> @theId ))
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1);
			return -3
		end

		select version, definition FROM dbo.sysdiagrams where diagram_id = @DiagId ; 
		return 0
	END
	
sp_helpdiagrams 
	CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_helpdiagrams
	(
		@diagramname sysname = NULL,
		@owner_id int = NULL
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @user sysname
		DECLARE @dboLogin bit
		EXECUTE AS CALLER;
			SET @user = USER_NAME();
			SET @dboLogin = CONVERT(bit,IS_MEMBER('db_owner'));
		REVERT;
		SELECT
			[Database] = DB_NAME(),
			[Name] = name,
			[ID] = diagram_id,
			[Owner] = USER_NAME(principal_id),
			[OwnerID] = principal_id
		FROM
			sysdiagrams
		WHERE
			(@dboLogin = 1 OR USER_NAME(principal_id) = @user) AND
			(@diagramname IS NULL OR name = @diagramname) AND
			(@owner_id IS NULL OR principal_id = @owner_id)
		ORDER BY
			4, 5, 1
	END
	
sp_html_update 

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_html_update] @code nchar(13)
As 
-- 150703 dan - add ATS if ATS>0 
--141229 Arun fixed the join (earlier was updating the first row as default to all the code

update ivtf set iosDataTS=getdate(), washing_instruction1=
'<body>
<ul style="list-style-type:square">   
<li style="color:yellow;"><span style="color:black;">Fabric:'+isnull(fab_name,'')+' </span></li>   
<li style="color:blue;"><span style="color:black;">Content:'+isnull(ivtf.fab_content,'')+'</span></li>       
<li style="color:red;"><span style="color:black;">Brand:'+isnull(ivtf.brand_name,'')+'</span></li>       
<li style="color:yellow;"><span style="color:black;">Category:'+isnull(category.descript,'Not Assigned')+' </span></li>   
<li style="color:blue;"><span style="color:black;">Label:'+isnull(grp.descript,'Not Assigned')+' </span></li>   
<li style="color:lightgreen;"><span style="color:black;">Available Sizes:'+ isnull(division.size1,'')+isnull(division.size2,'')+isnull(division.size3,'')+isnull(division.size4,'')+
isnull(division.size5,'')+isnull(division.size6,'')+isnull(division.size7,'')+isnull(division.size8,'')+
isnull(division.size9,'')+isnull(division.size10,'')+isnull(division.size11,'')+isnull(division.size12,'')+' </span></li>  
<li style="color:red;"><span style="color:black;">Ratios:'+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty1,0))+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty2,0))+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty3,0))+
 convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty4,0))+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty5,0))+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty6,0))+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty7,0))+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty8,0))+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty9,0))+
 convert(char(2), isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty10,0))+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty11,0))+ convert(char(2),isnull(ivtf.prepack_qty12,0)) +' </span></li>  

<li style="color:yellow;"><span style="color:black;">'+
(case when qty1-onorder_qty1+wip_qty1 + qty2-onorder_qty2+wip_qty2 + qty3-onorder_qty3+wip_qty3 > 0 then  
'ATS:'+ 
isnull(division.size1,'')+'='+convert(char(5),convert(int,qty1-onorder_qty1+wip_qty1))+'|'+
isnull(division.size2,'')+'='+convert(char(5),convert(int,qty2-onorder_qty2+wip_qty2))+'|'+
isnull(division.size3,'')+'='+convert(char(5),convert(int,qty3-onorder_qty3+wip_qty3))+'|'+
isnull(division.size4,'')+'='+convert(char(5),convert(int,qty4-onorder_qty4+wip_qty4))+'|'+
isnull(division.size5,'')+'='+convert(char(5),convert(int,qty5-onorder_qty5+wip_qty5))+'|'+
isnull(division.size6,'')+'='+convert(char(5),convert(int,qty6-onorder_qty6+wip_qty6))+'|'+
isnull(division.size7,'')+'='+convert(char(5),convert(int,qty7-onorder_qty7+wip_qty7))+'|'+
isnull(division.size8,'')+'='+convert(char(5),convert(int,qty8-onorder_qty8+wip_qty8))+'|'+
isnull(division.size9,'')+'='+convert(char(5),convert(int,qty9-onorder_qty9+wip_qty9)) else '' end) +' </span></li>
 </ul>    
</body>'
from category, grp, division where ivtf.category=category.code 
and ivtf.grp=grp.code 
and ivtf.division=division.code and ivtf.tradeshow='Y' and ivtf.code=@code 

sp_html_update_all 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_html_update_all]
As 

DECLARE  @code nchar(13)
DECLARE @cnt int
DECLARE code_cursor CURSOR  FOR 
SELECT code FROM ivtf 
OPEN code_cursor

FETCH code_cursor INTO @code

select @cnt = 0
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	exec sp_html_update @code 

fetch code_cursor into @code
End

CLOSE code_cursor
DEALLOCATE code_cursor

As

'<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN" "http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd">  
<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">    <head>  <meta content="en-us" http-equiv="Content-Language" />  
<meta content="text/html; charset=utf-8" http-equiv="Content-Type" />  <title>Product HTML</title>  </head>    
<body>
<ul>   
<li>Style#:'+@code+'</li>       
<li>Description:'+ivtf.descript+'</li>       
<li>Category:'+isnull(category.descript,'Not Assigned')+' </li>   
<li>Label:'+isnull(grp.descript,'Not Assigned')+' </li>   
<li>Available Sizes:'+ isnull(division.size1,'')+isnull(division.size2,'')+isnull(division.size3,'')+isnull(division.size4,'')+
isnull(division.size5,'')+isnull(division.size6,'')+isnull(division.size7,'')+isnull(division.size8,'')+
isnull(division.size9,'')+isnull(division.size10,'')+isnull(division.size11,'')+isnull(division.size12,'')+' </li>   

</ul>    
</body>      
</html>'
from ivtf JOIN category ON category.code = ivtf.category
JOIN  grp ON grp.code = ivtf.grp
JOIN division ON division.code = ivtf.division where ivtf.grp = @code

sp_insert_hfc 
/*1401 Madhan/Raja - To insert into Soheader_hfc table (Shopping Cart Check Out FROM Android Device) */
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_insert_hfc]
(@customer nchar(10),@code nchar(20),@orderno int,@email nvarchar(30),@style nchar(13),@color nchar(12),@total money,@index int,@qty1 int,@qty2 int,
@qty3 int,@qty4 int,@qty5 int,@qty6 int,@qty7 int,@qty8 int,@qty9 int,@qty10 int,@qty11 int,@qty12 int,@price money)

as 
begin

declare @name nchar(20),@addr1 nchar(30),@addr2 nchar(30),@city nchar(20),@state nchar(3),@zip nchar(10),@phone1 nchar(15),@country nchar(35),@store nchar(10) 

select @name=name,@addr1=addr1,@addr2 = addr2,@city=city,@state=state,@zip=zip,@phone1=phone1,@store=store_id,@country=country from store where code = @code and web_user = @email

declare @pricelevel char(1) = (select pricelevel from customer where code=@customer)

if(@index = 0)
BEGIN
	insert into soheader_hfc
	(orderno,orderdate,customer,blname,bladdr1,bladdr2,blcity,blstate,blzip,store,shname,shaddr1,shaddr2,shcity,shstate,shzip, phone,shcountry,pricelevel,total)
	values(@orderno,GETDATE(),@customer,@name,@addr1,@addr2,@city,@state,@zip,@store,@name,@addr1,@addr2,@city,@state,@zip,@phone1,@country,@pricelevel,@total)
END

insert into sodetail_hfc
(orderno,line,style,color,qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,price)
values(@orderno,@index+1,@style,@color,@qty1,@qty2,@qty3,@qty4,@qty5,@qty6,@qty7,@qty8,@qty9,@qty10,@qty11,@qty12,@price)

end

sp_insert_object_trigger_so 

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_insert_object_trigger_so] ( @sourcemodule nchar(25),@id bigint)
AS
Declare @Transactionno nchar(20)
Declare @code nchar(20)
Declare @doc_security_level nchar(1)
Declare @filetype nchar(20)
Declare @object  varbinary(max)
Declare @description nchar(50)
Declare @filesize nchar(10)
Declare @doctype nchar(10)
Declare @style nchar(20)
Declare @docdatetime datetime
Declare @username nchar(10)
Declare @thumbnail  varbinary(max)
Declare @icon  varbinary(max)
Declare @filelink  nchar(1000)

--

if @sourcemodule = 'SALESORDER' 
select @Transactionno=Orderno,@code =code,@filetype = filetype,@description = description,@filesize = filesize,
@style = style,@filelink =filelink,@doctype = doctype,@username = username, @docdatetime = docdatetime,
@doc_security_level = '',
@object = convert(varbinary(max),object),@thumbnail = convert(varbinary(max),thumbnail),@icon = convert(varbinary(max),icon)  
from soheader_docs where id =@id 

if @sourcemodule = 'CUT TICKET' 
select @Transactionno=cutno,@code =code,@filetype = filetype,@description = description,@filesize = filesize,
@style = style,@filelink =filelink,@doctype = doctype,@username = username, @docdatetime = docdatetime,
@doc_security_level = doc_security_level,
@object = convert(varbinary(max),object),@thumbnail = convert(varbinary(max),thumbnail),@icon = convert(varbinary(max),icon) 
from cutheader_docs where cutheader_docs_id =@id 

if @sourcemodule = 'PURCHASEORDER'
select @Transactionno=orderno,@code =code,@filetype = filetype,@description = description,@filesize = filesize,
@style = style,@filelink =filelink,@doctype = doctype,@username = username, @docdatetime = docdatetime,
@doc_security_level = doc_security_level,
@object = convert(varbinary(max),object),@thumbnail = convert(varbinary(max),thumbnail),@icon = convert(varbinary(max),icon)
from poheader_docs where poheader_docs_id =@id 

if @sourcemodule = 'CUSTOMER MASTER' 
select @Transactionno=customer,@code =code,@filetype = filetype,@description = description,@filesize = filesize,
@filelink =filelink,@doctype = doctype,@username = username, @docdatetime = docdatetime,
@doc_security_level = '',
@object = convert(varbinary(max),object),@thumbnail = convert(varbinary(max),thumbnail),@icon = convert(varbinary(max),icon)
from customer_docs where customer_docs_id =@id 

if @sourcemodule = 'SAMPLE MASTER' 
select @Transactionno=upc,@code =code,@filetype = filetype,@description = description,@filesize = filesize,
@style =style,  @filelink =filelink,@doctype = doctype,@username = username, @docdatetime = docdatetime,
@doc_security_level = doc_security_level,
@object = convert(varbinary(max),object),@thumbnail = convert(varbinary(max),thumbnail),@icon = convert(varbinary(max),icon) 
from ivtf_sample_docs where ivtf_docs_id =@id 

if @sourcemodule = 'STYLE MASTER' 
select @Transactionno=style,@code =code,@filetype = filetype,@description = description,@filesize = filesize,
@style =style,  @filelink =filelink,@doctype = doctype,@username = username, @docdatetime = docdatetime,
@doc_security_level = doc_security_level,
@object = convert(varbinary(max),object),@thumbnail = convert(varbinary(max),thumbnail),@icon = convert(varbinary(max),icon)
from ivtf_docs where ivtf_docs_id =@id 

if @sourcemodule = 'VENDOR MASTER' 
select @Transactionno=name,@code =code,@filetype = filetype,@description = description,@filesize = filesize,
 @filelink =filelink,@doctype = doctype,@username = username, @docdatetime = docdatetime,
 @doc_security_level = '',
@object = convert(varbinary(max),object),@thumbnail = convert(varbinary(max),thumbnail),@icon = convert(varbinary(max),icon)
from manufacturer_docs where manufacturer_docs_id =@id 

if @sourcemodule = 'IMPORT' 
select @Transactionno=fileno,@code =code,@filetype = filetype,@description = description,@filesize = filesize,
 @filelink ='',@doctype = doctype,@username = username, @docdatetime = docdatetime,
 @doc_security_level = '',
@object = convert(varbinary(max),object) from import_docs where import_docs_id =@id 

Update  consolidated_docs set consolidated_docs.Transactionno=@Transactionno, object=@object,thumbnail=@thumbnail,icon=@icon,
 code = @code,doc_security_level=@doc_security_level,filetype = @filetype,doctype = @doctype,
description = @description ,filesize = @filesize,style =@style,filelink =@filelink  
where sourceid = @id and sourcemodule= @sourcemodule 



sp_insert_spec 





CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_insert_spec] (@style nchar(25), @image_base64 varchar(MAX), @thumbnail_base64  varchar(MAX), @icon_base64  varchar(MAX), 
	@userid nchar(10), @newflag char(1)=NULL, 
	@imageLocation char(1) = NULL, @pageTitle nchar(30), @descript nvarchar(max)= NULL,  @imagesize char(1)=NULL, @textComment nvarchar(3000)=NULL ,
	@filetype varchar(10) = NULL)
as
/* 180929 dan - added '&. QC Module' */ 
/* 170228 dan - if style# starts with '.', add a new Sample Master */ 
/* 160601 Jothi / Mani G  - Added Consolidated Docs tabls - */
/* 160506 Mani.G-160506 - Added Control# for WFsearch*/
/* 160501 dan - added '^' to Import Module Docs */ 
/* 160422 dan - be able to upload directly to style master image 1-4 */ 
/* 160419 dan - $ to SalesOrder Docs */
/* 160326 dan - added '#' key for uploading image to SampleShipment */ 
/* 151225 dan - update the IVTF iosImageTS if uploading to '1' style master 1st image */ 
/* 150901 dan - added Customer Master Document */ 
/* 150728 dan - do the RTF formatting here using the [f_txt2rtf] */ 
/* 150727 DAN - '!Z. FitComment Additional Images' 5 images of fit_comment, find the next blank one and insert, ADD the text to existing text */ 
/* 150716 dan - fit_comment insert the LINE as max(line)+10 */ 
/* 150713 dan - buy sheet multiple pages option 'order#-page#' format */ 
/* 150711 dan - added '9. To BuySheet (enter Order# in Style# field)' */
/* 150701 dan - 8. Add to Doc Management */ 
/* 150627 dan - add IVTR if not exists */ 
/* 150620 dan - '6' QC Report to Cut Docs */ 
/* 150602 dan - send all FULL, THUMBNAIL & ICON on ONE call */ 
/* 150602 dan - add option '6. To Sample Master Docs'  */ 
/* 150531 dan - icon also */
/* 150526 dan - added 'Thumbnail/Fullsize' option */ 
/* 150324 dan - option to add to the style master's 4 images */ 
/* 141113 dan - made upc work for '49' series barcodes also */ /* 131205 dan - added the FitComment FULL text , also to iPDM v131 */ 
/* 131204 dan - added default doc_security_level to 1, image location 'Z' goes into table FIT_COMMENTS */
/*				also put right amount of @descript to each table columns, max for the Fit Comment  */ 
/* 131128 dan - if scanned, ignore the 'NEW' switch, cannot add new sample master if barcode (which exists) was scanned */ 
/* 130611 DAN - added @imageLocation parameter */ 
/* 130408 dan - fixed problem with inserting blank UPC when NEW */ 
/* 130301 dan - created for iPDM inserting into DOCS */ 
declare @nextUPC bigint
declare @defDiv char(1)
declare @lineno int 
declare @orderno int 
declare @fit_line int 
declare @fit_image_length int 
Declare @color nchar(25)
  --SET @style ='AG1001C+h66'

  if left(@style,1)='.' 
	BEGIN
		SET @newflag = 'Y' 
		SET @style = substring(@style, 2, 25)  
	END 

  if isnull(@filetype,'') = '' 
	SET @filetype = 'JPG'


  IF CHARINDEX('+',@style) > 0
	begin
		select @color=SUBSTRING ( @style , CHARINDEX('+',@style)+1 ,len(@style) )
		select @style=LEFT(@style, CHARINDEX('+',@style) - 1 )

	end 	
Else
	begin
	select @color='.'
	end 
				   

select @defDiv=isnull(max(code),'A') from div where default_div='Y'
if @defDiv is null
	set @defDiv='A' 

if (len(@style)=13 and left(@style,1)='0') or (len(@style)=12 and left(@style,1)='4') or (len(@style)=11 and left(@style,1)='4')
	/* is scanned, carcode passed  */
	begin
		/* 130330 dan - get the 11 digit UPC */ 
		if (len(@style)=13)  
			set @nextUPC=substring(@style,2,11)
		if (len(@style)=12)  
			set @nextUPC=substring(@style,1,11)
		if (len(@style)=11)  
			set @nextUPC=@style

		select @style=code ,@color=color from ivtf_sample where upc=@nextUPC
	end
else
	/* style entered in */ 
	begin
		if @newflag='Y' 
			/* 170228 dan - added COMMENT */ 
			/* 130408 dan - get the next upc# and assign to this NEW sample style */ 
			begin 
				select @nextUPC = convert(bigint, max(upc))+1 from ivtf_sample 
				/* 141114 dan - populate ACTIVE column */ 
				--insert into ivtf_sample (user4, active,customer, code, color, descript, long_desc, upc, created_user, created_date)
				--	values (@defDiv, 1, 'iPDM', @style, '.',  LEFT(@descript,50) , LEFT(@descript,100) , @nextUPC, @userid, getdate() ) 
				insert into ivtf_sample (user4, active,customer, code, color, descript, long_desc, upc, created_user, created_date, memo)
					values (@defDiv, 1, 'iPDM', @style, @color,  LEFT(@descript,50) , LEFT(@descript,100) , @nextUPC, @userid, getdate(), @textComment ) 

			end
		else
		-- if not adding new style, get the UPC# from first sample
		-- 141113 dan - check if user scanned UPC or entered style# 
		-- 141124 dan - get the MAX upc# from sample master for the style 
			select @nextUPC = max(UPC) from ivtf_sample where code=@style
	end 


/* 150111 dan - use the Min(color) if adding to Fabric */ 
/* 130406 dan - check if @nextUPC is still null, if so, get max next upc */
if (@nextUPC is null and @style is null) and NOT( RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation))='x' or (RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation))>='1' and RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation))<='4') ) 
	BEGIN 
		select 'Style does not exist!  Not posted' as SQLresult 
		return
	END 

/* below converts base64 to binary */ 
Declare @xml xml
Declare @bin varbinary(max)
Declare @binT varbinary(max)
Declare @binI varbinary(max)


declare @count int
declare @minColor nchar(13)

/* full size image */
SELECT @xml = CAST( '<row data="' + @image_base64 + '" />' as xml )
SELECT @bin = @xml.value('(/row/@data)[1]', 'varbinary(max)')

/* thumbnail image */ 
SELECT @xml = CAST( '<row data="' + @thumbnail_base64 + '" />' as xml )
SELECT @binT = @xml.value('(/row/@data)[1]', 'varbinary(max)')

/* icon image */ 
SELECT @xml = CAST( '<row data="' + @icon_base64 + '" />' as xml )
SELECT @binI = @xml.value('(/row/@data)[1]', 'varbinary(max)')

/* 150901 dan - Customer Master Docs */

/* 141205 dan - post to FABRIC Master feature added */
if RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation))='x' COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS
BEGIN
	Select @count = count(*), @minColor = min(color) from ivtr_image where code=@style  
	if @count = 0 
		begin
			Select @count=count(*) from ivtr where code=@style  
			/* 150627 dan - raw material doesn't exist, add */
			if @count = 0 
				insert into ivtr (type,code,color, descript, user4, location) values ('T',@style,'.',left(@descript,50), '*','HOUS' ) 
			select @minColor=min(color) from ivtr where code=@style 
			--insert into ivtr_image (code,color,type) values (@style,@minColor,'.jpg') 
			insert into ivtr_image (code,color,type) values (@style,@color,'.jpg') 
		end
	--update ivtr_image set ivtr_image = @bin, thumbnail = @binT,  icon = @binI where code=@style and color=@minColor   
	update ivtr_image set ivtr_image = @bin, thumbnail = @binT,  icon = @binI where code=@style and color=@color   
	select 'Fabric:'+@style+' data posted.' as SQLresult 
	return 
END

/* 150711 dan - added '9. To BuySheet (enter Order# in Style# field)' */
if RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation))='9'
BEGIN

	if charindex('-', @style) > 0 
	BEGIN 
		select @orderno = CONVERT(int, left(@style, charindex('-', @style) - 1 ) )
		select @lineno =  CONVERT(int, right(rtrim(@style), len(rtrim(@style)) - charindex('-', @style) )  ) 

		select @lineno = CONVERT(int, right(rtrim(@style),2) ) 
	END
	else 
	BEGIN
		select @orderno = CONVERT(int, @style) 
		select @lineno = 10
	END 
	update soheader_buysheet set sheet_image = @bin where orderno = @orderno and line = @lineno 
	select @style+'Added image to Buy Sheet#'+convert(char(10), @orderno) +' Line#'+ convert(char(10), @lineno) +' Data posted.' as SQLresult 
	return 
END

/* 150727 dan */ 
if RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation))='!'
BEGIN 
	select @fit_image_length=datalength(image2) from fit_comment where UPPER(Refno)=UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(@descript,10))) 
		and upc=@nextUPC 
	if isnull(@fit_image_length,0)=0 
		update Fit_comment set image2=@bin, thumbnail2=@binT where upc=@nextUPC and UPPER(Refno)=UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(@descript,10))) 
	else 
		BEGIN 
			select @fit_image_length=datalength(image3) from fit_comment where upc=@nextUPC and UPPER(Refno)=UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(@descript,10))) 
			if isnull(@fit_image_length,0)=0 
				update Fit_comment set image3=@bin, thumbnail3=@binT where upc=@nextUPC and UPPER(Refno)=UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(@descript,10))) 
			else 
				BEGIN 
					select @fit_image_length=datalength(image4) from fit_comment where upc=@nextUPC and UPPER(Refno)=UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(@descript,10))) 
					if isnull(@fit_image_length,0)=0 
						update Fit_comment set image4=@bin, thumbnail4=@binT where upc=@nextUPC and UPPER(Refno)=UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(@descript,10))) 
					else 
						update Fit_comment set image5=@bin, thumbnail5=@binT where upc=@nextUPC and UPPER(Refno)=UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(@descript,10))) 
				END 
		END 
END

	if UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation)))='P'
		update ivtf_sample set Spec17 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
	if UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation)))='Q'
		update ivtf_sample set Spec18 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
	if UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation)))='R'
		update ivtf_sample set Spec19 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
	if UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation)))='S'
		update ivtf_sample set Spec20 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
	if UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation)))='T'
		update ivtf_sample set Spec21 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
	if UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation)))='U'
		update ivtf_sample set Spec22 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
	if UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation)))='V'
		update ivtf_sample set Spec23 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
	if UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation)))='W'
		update ivtf_sample set Spec24 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
	if RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation))='X'  COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS 
		update ivtf_sample set Spec25 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
	if UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@imageLocation)))='Y'
		update ivtf_sample set Spec26 = @pageTitle where  upc=@nextUPC 
END 
select 'Style:'+@style+' data posted.' as SQLresult
