sp_ios_ivtf_upc 
Create procedure sp_ios_ivtf_upc @upc nchar(20)
As
	select code,v_ios_ivtf.color,descript,color_descript,qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,
		   wip_qty1,wip_qty2,wip_qty3,wip_qty4,wip_qty5,wip_qty6, wip_qty7,wip_qty8,wip_qty9,wip_qty10,wip_qty11,wip_qty12,   
		   isnull(prepack_qty1,0) AS prepack_qty1,isnull(prepack_qty2,0) AS prepack_qty2,isnull(prepack_qty3,0) AS prepack_qty3,
		   isnull(prepack_qty4,0) AS prepack_qty4,isnull(prepack_qty5,0) AS prepack_qty5,isnull(prepack_qty6,0) AS prepack_qty6,
		   isnull (prepack_qty7,0) AS prepack_qty7,isnull(prepack_qty8,0) AS prepack_qty8,isnull(prepack_qty9,0) AS prepack_qty9,
		   isnull(prepack_qty10,0) AS prepack_qty10,isnull(prepack_qty11,0) AS prepack_qty11,isnull(prepack_qty12,0) AS prepack_qty12,
		   convert(char (10),eta_date,101) AS eta_date,location,v_ios_ivtf.price,isnull(washing_instruction1,'No HTML') AS washing_instruction,
		   isnull(size1,'') AS size1,isnull(size2,'') AS size2,isnull(size3,'') AS size3,isnull(size4,'') AS size4,isnull(size5,'') AS size5,
		   isnull(size6,'') AS size6,isnull(size7,'') AS size7,isnull(size8,'') AS size8,isnull(size9,'') AS size9,isnull(size10,'') AS size10,
		   isnull(size11,'') AS size11,isnull(size12,'') AS size12,isnull(onorder_qty1,0) AS onorder_qty1,isnull(onorder_qty2,0) AS onorder_qty2,
		   isnull(onorder_qty3,0) AS onorder_qty3,isnull(onorder_qty4,0) AS onorder_qty4,isnull(onorder_qty5,0) AS onorder_qty5,
		   isnull(onorder_qty6,0) AS onorder_qty6,isnull (onorder_qty7,0) AS onorder_qty7,isnull(onorder_qty8,0) AS onorder_qty8,
		   isnull(onorder_qty9,0) AS onorder_qty9,isnull(onorder_qty10,0) AS onorder_qty10,isnull(onorder_qty11,0) AS onorder_qty11,
		   isnull(onorder_qty12,0) AS onorder_qty12, isnull(inventory_notes,'') as inventory_notes 
	from v_ios_ivtf Left Outer Join code_sku on v_ios_ivtf.code = code_sku.style and v_ios_ivtf.color = code_sku.color
	where code = @upc Or code_sku.sku = @upc


sp_ipayment 
Create Procedure sp_ipayment @orderno int, @paidamt money, @cc_name nchar(50), @cc_no int, @cc_expdate datetime, @cc_addr nchar(30), @cc_cvv char(5), @cc_zip nchar(10), @pmttype nchar(8), @refno nchar(20)
As
Begin
	Insert into arcash(orderno, paidamt, creditcard_name, creditcardno, creditcard_expdate, creditcard_cvv, creditcard_addr, creditcard_zip, pmt_code, refno) 
	values (@orderno, @paidamt, @cc_name, @cc_no, @cc_expdate, @cc_cvv, @cc_addr, @cc_zip, @pmttype, @refno)
End

sp_ivtf_analytics /*customer info as per Dan Email */ 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_ivtf_analytics] @style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @log char(20), @lat char(20), @module nchar(10), @refno char(20)= NULL, @customer nchar(10) =NULL 
As 
	Insert into ivtf_analytics(style, color, modulename, GPSlon, GPSlat, ClickDatetime, refno, customer) Values (@style, @color, @module, @log, @lat, GetDate(), @refno, @customer)

sp_ivtf_CURSOR 
CREATE PROC [dbo].[sp_ivtf_CURSOR] ( @w_sodetailid		int,
	@w_style 		nchar(13),@w_color 		nchar(12),@w_royaltor nchar(10),
	@w_qty1 		int,@w_qty2 		int,
	@w_qty3 		int,@w_qty4 		int,
	@w_qty5 		int,@w_qty6 		int,
	@w_qty7 		int,@w_qty8 		int,
	@w_qty9 		int,
	@w_qty10 		int,@w_qty11 		int,
	@w_qty12 		int) as
DECLARE @i_style 		nchar(13),@i_color 		nchar(12),@i_royaltor nchar(10),
	@i_qty1 		int,@i_qty2 		int,
	@i_qty3 		int,@i_qty4 		int,
	@i_qty5 		int,@i_qty6 		int,
	@i_qty7 		int,@i_qty8 		int,
	@i_qty9 		int,
	@i_qty10 		int,@i_qty11 		int,
	@i_qty12 		int,@temp 		int
	
 SELECT @i_qty1 =  coalesce(ivtf_alloc.qty1,0) , @i_qty2 = coalesce(ivtf_alloc.qty2,0), @i_qty3 =  coalesce(ivtf_alloc.qty3,0),
	@i_qty4 =coalesce(ivtf_alloc.qty4,0),@i_qty5 =coalesce( ivtf_alloc.qty5,0), @i_qty6 =coalesce( ivtf_alloc.qty6,0),  
        @i_qty7 =coalesce( ivtf_alloc.qty7,0), @i_qty8=  coalesce(ivtf_alloc.qty8,0), @i_qty9  = coalesce( ivtf_alloc.qty9,0),
        @i_qty10 =coalesce( ivtf_alloc.qty10,0), @i_qty11=  coalesce(ivtf_alloc.qty11,0), @i_qty12  = coalesce( ivtf_alloc.qty12,0)
	
    FROM ivtf_alloc  
   WHERE ( ivtf_alloc.code =@w_style  ) AND  
         ( ivtf_alloc.color = @w_color ) AND  
         ( isnull(ivtf_alloc.royaltor,'') = @w_royaltor )     

/* condition 1 : Avail to Allocate qty ( oredered - pick - ship) <= stock qty  */


IF  @w_qty1  <=  @i_qty1 AND @w_qty1 >  0 
	Begin 
	 UPDATE sodetail       SET alloc_qty1 = @w_qty1 
   	WHERE sodetail.sodetail_id =@w_sodetailid	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Sodetail Update Failed.', 16, 1)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		Return
	END

	 UPDATE ivtf_alloc      SET qty1 = qty1 - @w_qty1
  	   WHERE ( ivtf_alloc.code =@w_style  ) AND  
        	 ( ivtf_alloc.color = @w_color )  AND  
         ( isnull(ivtf_alloc.royaltor,'') = @w_royaltor )   

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Ivtf Allocl Update Failed.', 16, 1)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		Return	
	END
	end 
/* condition 1 : Avail to Allocate qty ( oredered - pick - ship) >  stock qty  */
IF  @w_qty1  >  @i_qty1 AND  @i_qty1 > 0
	begin
	 UPDATE sodetail       SET alloc_qty1 = @i_qty1 
   	WHERE sodetail.sodetail_id =@w_sodetailid	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Sodetail Update Failed.', 16, 1)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		Return
	END

	UPDATE ivtf_alloc   SET qty1 = 0
     	WHERE ( ivtf_alloc.code =@w_style  ) AND  
         	( ivtf_alloc.color = @w_color )  AND  
         ( isnull(ivtf_alloc.royaltor,'') = @w_royaltor )   

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Ivtf Alloc Failed.', 16, 1)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		Return
	END
	end
/*****************************************************qty2***********************************************************/
IF  @w_qty2  <=  @i_qty2  AND @w_qty2 > 0 
	begin

	 UPDATE sodetail       SET alloc_qty2 = @w_qty2 
   	WHERE sodetail.sodetail_id =@w_sodetailid

		RAISERROR ('Sodetail Update Failed.', 16, 1)

		Return

	 UPDATE ivtf_alloc      SET qty2 = qty2 -  @w_qty2 
  	   WHERE ( ivtf_alloc.code =@w_style  ) AND

				 [page26_ts]=ivtf_image.[page26_ts]
				FROM [IMAC21A_WIN8_1\SQL2014].[wf125sR].[dbo].[ivtf_image] iv JOIN ivtf_image ON 
				iv.style= ivtf_image.style AND iv.color = ivtf_image.color and isnull(iv.royaltor, '') = isnull(ivtf_image.royaltor, '') 
				WHERE iv.ivtf_image_id = @ivtf_image_id
		END

	END

sp_ivtr_onhand 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_ivtr_onhand    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_ivtr_onhand    Script Date: 6/11/98 1:18:41 AM ******/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_ivtr_onhand] (
@type nchar(1),
@code nchar(10),
@color nchar(10),
@location nchar(10),
@lot nchar(30) )
as
update ivtr set onhand=(select sum(qty) from logr 
	where type=@type and code=@code and color=@color and
	location=@location and lot=@lot)
where type=@type and code=@code and color=@color and
	location=@location and lot=@lot

sp_ivtr_required_UPDATE 



/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_ivtr_required_UPDATE    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
create procedure sp_ivtr_required_UPDATE AS

UPDATE	ivtr
SET	required = 0

UPDATE	ivtr
SET	required = vivt.required * -1
FROM	v_ivtr_required_sum vivt
WHERE	ivtr.code = vivt.raw_code
AND	ivtr.color = vivt.raw_color
AND	ivtr.location = "HOUS"
AND	ivtr.lot = ""
AND	vivt.required < 0






sp_manual_wh_transfer CREATE PROCEDURE sp_manual_wh_transfer ( @transfer_id int)
AS
BEGIN
Declare @style nvarchar(13)
Declare @color nvarchar(12)
Declare @royaltor nvarchar(10)
Declare @transfer_dt datetime
Declare @TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL INT
Declare @transfer_status nchar(1)
Declare @from_warehouse nchar(2)
Declare @to_warehouse nchar(2) 
 
SELECT @transfer_status = transfer_status, @from_warehouse = from_wh, @to_warehouse = to_wh FROM transfer_header WHERE transfer_id = @transfer_id

Declare cur_transfer cursor 
FOR SELECT TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL, transfer_dt FROM transfer_header join transfer_detail ON transfer_detail.transfer_id = transfer_header.transfer_id 
WHERE transfer_header.transfer_id = @transfer_id
OPEN cur_transfer 
FETCH NEXT FROM cur_transfer INTO @TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL, @transfer_dt
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	insert into logfdetail(transferno,logno, refno, line,logdate, style, color,royaltor, qty1, qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,cost, location, cutno, warehouse) 
	(select @transfer_id,0,'TRF'+convert(varchar(10),@transfer_id),transfer_detail_id,@transfer_dt,style,color, royaltor, (-1)*qty1,(-1)*qty2,(-1)*qty3,(-1)*qty4,(-1)*qty5,(-1)*qty6,(-1)*qty7,
	(-1)*qty8,(-1)*qty9,(-1)*qty10,(-1)*qty11,(-1)*qty12,
	isnull(cost,0), 'HOUS', 0, @from_warehouse FROM transfer_detail WHERE TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL = @TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL) 

insert into logfdetail(transferno,logno, refno, line,logdate, style, color,royaltor, qty1, qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,cost, location, cutno, warehouse) 
	(select @transfer_id,0,'TRF'+convert(varchar(10),@transfer_id),transfer_detail_id,@transfer_dt,style,color, royaltor, qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,isnull(cost,0),
	'HOUS',0, 'IT' FROM transfer_detail WHERE TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL = @TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL) 

if @transfer_status = 'T' 
	BEGIN
		insert into logfdetail(transferno,logno, refno, line,logdate, style, color,royaltor, qty1, qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,cost, location, cutno, warehouse) 
		(select @transfer_id,0,'TRF'+convert(varchar(10),@transfer_id),transfer_detail_id,@transfer_dt,style,color, royaltor,(-1)*qty1,(-1)*qty2,(-1)*qty3,(-1)*qty4,(-1)*qty5,(-1)*qty6,(-1)*qty7,(-1)*qty8,
		(-1)*qty9,(-1)*qty10,(-1)*qty11,(-1)*qty12,
		isnull(cost,0), 'HOUS',0, 'IT' FROM transfer_detail WHERE TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL = @TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL)

		insert into logfdetail(transferno,logno, refno, line,logdate, style, color,royaltor, qty1, qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,cost, location, cutno, warehouse) 
		(select @transfer_id,0,'TRF'+convert(varchar(10),@transfer_id),transfer_detail_id,@transfer_dt,style,color, royaltor, qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,isnull(cost,0),
		'HOUS', 0, @to_warehouse FROM transfer_detail WHERE TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL = @TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL) 
	END 
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_transfer INTO @TRANSFER_ID_DETAIL, @transfer_dt
END
	CLOSE cur_transfer
    DEALLOCATE cur_transfer
END

As
Begin

SELECT @media_url = isnull(media_url,'') FROM webconfig WHERE wfsystem = 1;
/*Since Winserver2 has wf125sB database and port 85 has been forwarded to it. */
	--Update ivtf 
	--Set media_url = 'http://chennai.winfashion.net:85/Wf/view/CommitGoods2.aspx?code=' + rtrim(@code)
	--Where code = @code 
	/*170322 Arun - to use media_url from Webconfig table*/
	update ivtf 
	set media_url = @media_url + '?code=' + rtrim(@code) WHERE code = @code 

End


sp_milestone_add 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_milestone_add](@cutno int,@type as nchar(1)) as
Declare	@cutdate datetime,
	@date1 datetime,
	@date2 datetime,
	@date3 datetime,
	@date4 datetime,
	@date5 datetime,
	@date6 datetime,
	@date7 datetime,
	@date8 datetime,
	@days1 int,
	@days2 int,
	@days3 int,
	@days4 int,
	@days5 int,
	@days6 int,
	@days7 int,
	@days8 int

select @cutdate = cutheader.issuedate from cutheader where cutno = @cutno
if isdate(@cutdate) = 0 
 RAISERROR ('No Issue Date set for cut ticket ',18,16,1) 
else
Begin
select @days1 = code_milestone.days1, 
        @days2 = code_milestone.days2, 
        @days3 = code_milestone.days3,
        @days4 = code_milestone.days4,
        @days5 = code_milestone.days5,
        @days6 = code_milestone.days6,
        @days7 = code_milestone.days7,
        @days8 = code_milestone.days8
from code_milestone where ms_type = @type and isnull(code_milestone.code1,'') <>''
if @@rowcount = 0 
   RAISERROR ('No Milestones Codes where setup for type ',18,16,1) 
ELSE 
   BEGIN
    select @date1 = dateadd(dd,@days1,@cutdate)
    select @date2 = dateadd(dd,@days2,@cutdate)
    select @date3 = dateadd(dd,@days3,@cutdate)
    select @date4 = dateadd(dd,@days4,@cutdate)
    select @date5 = dateadd(dd,@days5,@cutdate)
    select @date6 = dateadd(dd,@days6,@cutdate)
    select @date7 = dateadd(dd,@days7,@cutdate)
    select @date8 = dateadd(dd,@days8,@cutdate)

    insert into cut_milestone (ms_type, cutno, mduedate1,mduedate2,mduedate3,mduedate4,mduedate5,mduedate6, mduedate7,mduedate8 ) 
		values(@type, @cutno,@date1,@date2,@date3,@date4,@date5,@date6,@date7,@date8)

   END
end

sp_milestone_recalc 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_milestone_recalc](@cutno int,@type as nchar(1)) as
Declare	@cutdate datetime,
	@date1 datetime,
	@date2 datetime,
	@date3 datetime,
	@date4 datetime,
	@date5 datetime,
	@date6 datetime,
	@date7 datetime,
	@date8 datetime,
	@days1 int,
	@days2 int,
	@days3 int,
	@days4 int,
	@days5 int,
	@days6 int,
	@days7 int,
	@days8 int
select @cutdate = cutheader.issuedate from cutheader where cutno = @cutno
if isdate(@cutdate) = 0 
 RAISERROR ('No Issue Date set for cut ticket ',18,16,1) 
else
Begin
select @days1 = code_milestone.days1, 
        @days2 = code_milestone.days2, 
        @days3 = code_milestone.days3,
        @days4 = code_milestone.days4,
        @days5 = code_milestone.days5,
        @days6 = code_milestone.days6,
        @days7 = code_milestone.days7,
        @days8 = code_milestone.days8
from code_milestone where ms_type = @type and isnull(code_milestone.code1,'') <>''
if @@rowcount = 0 
   RAISERROR ('No Milestones Codes where setup for type ',18,16,1) 
ELSE 
   BEGIN
    select @date1 = dateadd(dd,@days1,@cutdate)
    select @date2 = dateadd(dd,@days2,@cutdate)
    select @date3 = dateadd(dd,@days3,@cutdate)
    select @date4 = dateadd(dd,@days4,@cutdate)
    select @date5 = dateadd(dd,@days5,@cutdate)
    select @date6 = dateadd(dd,@days6,@cutdate)
    select @date7 = dateadd(dd,@days7,@cutdate)
    select @date8 = dateadd(dd,@days8,@cutdate)

    update cut_milestone set ms_type=@type, cutno=@cutno, mduedate1=@date1,mduedate2=@date2,mduedate3=@date3,
			     mduedate4=@date4,mduedate5=@date5,mduedate6=@date6, mduedate7=@date7,mduedate8=@date8  
    where cutno = @cutno

   END
end

sp_MScolumn_properties 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_MScolumn_properties    Script Date: 1/29/00 12:58:38 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_MScolumn_properties    Script Date: 1/10/98 7:04:11 AM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_MScolumn_properties    Script Date: 4/16/96 9:12:39 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_MScolumn_properties    Script Date: 4/4/96 4:11:20 PM ******/
/* Microsoft SQL Server - Scripting			*/
/* Server: SH_NT			*/
/* Database: WinFashion			*/
/* Creation Date 3/5/96 1:10:22 PM 			*/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_MScolumn_properties    Script Date: 3/5/96 1:10:41 PM ******/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_MScolumn_properties] @object_name nvarchar(92) as
create table #sphelptab	( 		col_name        nchar (30),      col_id   tinyint,	col_type        nchar (30),       		col_len         tinyint,        col_status      tinyint,	col_def         nchar (30)  null, 		col_dom         nchar (30)  null,      usr_type    smallint,      var_len     bit,       def_own     nchar (30) null,      dom_own     nchar (30) null	) 	
insert into #sphelptab	
select c.name, c.colid, t.name, c.length, c.status,	object_name(c.cdefault),object_name(c.domain),	   t.usertype, 0, user_name(def.uid), user_name(dom.uid) 	
	from syscolumns c left outer join systypes t on c.usertype = t.usertype 
                      left outer join sysobjects def on def.id = c.cdefault 
                      left  outer join sysobjects dom on dom.id = c.domain
	where 
c.id = object_id(@object_name)		 	
update #sphelptab	set col_type = 'money'	where col_type = 'moneyn' 	
update #sphelptab	set col_type = 'float'	where col_type = 'floatn' 	
update #sphelptab	set col_type = 'int'	where col_type = 'intn' 
update #sphelptab	set col_type = 'datetime'	where col_type = 'datetimn'  
update #sphelptab      set var_len = 1      where usr_type in (1,2,3,4,18) 	
select t.col_name, t.col_type, t.col_len, Nulls = convert(bit, (t.col_status & 8)),       t.col_def, t.col_dom, t.var_len, t.def_own, t.dom_own, UDTOwner = user_name(n.uid)   
 from #sphelptab t left outer join  systypes n on  t.col_type = n.name      
where  n.usertype > 99   order by t.col_id

sp_npclean_col CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_npclean_col]
 @DatabaseName varchar(75) = null,
 @SchemaName varchar(75) = null,
 @TableName varchar(75),
 @ColumnName varchar(75)
as
begin
 Declare @FullTableName varchar(100)
 declare @UpdateSQL nvarchar(1000)
 if @DatabaseName is null begin
  set @DatabaseName = db_name()
 end
 if @SchemaName is null begin
  set @SchemaName = schema_name()
 end
 set @FullTableName = '[' + @DatabaseName + '].[' + @SchemaName + '].[' + @TableName + ']'
 set @UpdateSQL = 'update ' + @FullTableName + ' set [' + @ColumnName + '] = dbo.fn_npclean_string([' + @ColumnName + ']) where [' + @ColumnName + '] like ''%[^ -~0-9A-Z]%'''
 exec sp_ExecuteSQL @UpdateSQL
end

SP_OrderStatus 




-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_OrderStatus]
as

SET NOCOUNT ON;

--Create a temporary table
CREATE TABLE #T1([customer] varchar(50)
      ,[shipdate] datetime
      ,[canceldate] datetime
      ,[orderno] int
      ,[custpo] varchar(20)
      ,[socount] int
      ,[ordered] int
      ,[shipped] int
      ,[balance] int
      ,[div] varchar(20)                    
	  ,[warehouse] nchar(2)
	  ,[closed] nchar(1)       )

DECLARE @canceldate datetime, @customer nvarchar(50), @balance int, @shipped int, @custpo varchar(20),
    @message varchar(80),@div varchar(20), @shipdate datetime, @socount int, @ordered int; 


DECLARE order_cursor CURSOR FOR 
SELECT customer,custpo, shipdate, canceldate,  count(*)as SOcount,SUM(subtotal) as Ordered, SUM(COALESCE(shipped,0)) as Shipped ,SUM(subtotal)-SUM(COALESCE(shipped,0)) as Balance, user4 as div
FROM soheader 
WHERE     (COALESCE(shipped,0) < subtotal) AND (((shipdate > { fn NOW() } - 14) AND (shipdate < { fn NOW() } + 14) )or ( (canceldate > { fn NOW() } - 14) AND (canceldate < { fn NOW() } + 14))) AND (COALESCE (bulk_order, 'N') = 'N') AND (closed = 'N') 
group by shipdate,customer, custpo,canceldate,user4
ORDER BY shipdate, customer, custpo,canceldate,user4

OPEN order_cursor

FETCH NEXT FROM order_cursor 
INTO @customer,@custpo, @shipdate, @canceldate, @socount, @ordered, @shipped,@balance,@div

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
   

    -- Declare an inner cursor based   
    -- on vendor_id from the outer cursor.

    insert into #t1
    SELECT top 1 @customer as customer, LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shipdate, 120), 10) as shipdate,LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR, @canceldate, 120), 10) as canceldate,orderno, custpo, @socount as SalesOrderCount, @ordered as Ordered, @shipped as Shipped, @balance as Balance,@div as div, warehouse, closed
    FROM soheader
    WHERE customer = @customer and custpo = @custpo and shipdate = @shipdate and canceldate = @canceldate and closed = 'N' 



    
        -- Get the next order.
    FETCH NEXT FROM order_cursor 
    INTO @customer,@custpo, @shipdate, @canceldate, @socount, @ordered, @shipped,@balance,@div

END 
CLOSE order_cursor;
DEALLOCATE order_cursor;

select * from #T1
drop table #T1

FROM soheader 
WHERE     (COALESCE(shipped,0) < subtotal) AND (((shipdate > { fn NOW() } - 14) AND (shipdate < { fn NOW() } + 14) )or ( (canceldate > { fn NOW() } - 14) AND (canceldate < { fn NOW() } + 14))) AND (COALESCE (bulk_order, 'N') = 'N') AND (closed = 'N') and user4 in ('D', '9','R')

SP_PalletSlips 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_PalletSlips] 
    @Parameter1 INT = 720,
    @Parameter2 VARCHAR (100) = 'Telmo'
as

SET NOCOUNT ON;

drop table T3

--Create a temporary table
CREATE TABLE #T1([customer] varchar(50)
      ,[invcdate] datetime
      ,[pallet_num] int
      ,[custpo] varchar(20)
      ,[invccount] int
      ,[print_boxes] int
             )



DECLARE  @customer nvarchar(50),@wfuser nvarchar(50), @tot_boxes int, @custpo varchar(20),
      @invccount int,  @total_qty int,@palletsize int, @pallets int, @pallet_bal int;

 SET @palletsize  = @Parameter1 
 set @wfuser = @Parameter2
 SELECT distinct [po] into #T2 FROM [dbo].[v_bartender] WHERE [bar_user] = @wfuser group by po

DECLARE po_cursor CURSOR FOR 
select i.customer, i.custpo, count(*) as invccount, @palletsize as palletsize, sum(totqty) as total_qty, sum (i.boxes) as tot_boxes , sum (totqty)/@palletsize as pallets,sum (totqty)%@palletsize as pallet_bal from invheader i inner join #t2 t on  i.custpo = t.po 
group by customer,custpo
ORDER BY  customer, custpo



--SELECT [qty1], [to_name], [po], [sku_upc1], [to_address1], [to_city_zip], [to_address], [f_name], [f_address], [f_city_zip], [f_phone], [ship_ref] into #T2 FROM [dbo].[v_bartender] WHERE [bar_user] = @wfuser 
--select * from v_bartender WHERE [bar_user] = @wfuser 
--SELECT distinct [po],    [to_address1], [to_city_zip], [to_address], [f_name], [f_address], [f_city_zip], [f_phone], [ship_ref] into #T2 FROM [dbo].[v_bartender] WHERE [bar_user] = @wfuser group by po,  [to_address1], [to_city_zip], [to_address], [f_name], [f_address], [f_city_zip], [f_phone], [ship_ref] 


OPEN po_cursor

FETCH NEXT FROM po_cursor 
  INTO @customer,@custpo,@invccount,@palletsize,@total_qty, @tot_boxes, @pallets,@pallet_bal

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
   

    ---Declare an inner cursor based   
    --on vendor_id from the outer cursor.

 DECLARE @PrintMessage NVARCHAR(100),
  @Counter INT ,@Max_count INT ;
    SET @Counter=1  
 set @Max_count = @pallets

    SET @PrintMessage = N'Total Pallet Count is '

    + N'.';  

 WHILE ( @Counter <= @Max_count)
    BEGIN

    SET @Counter  = @Counter  + 1

 
   -- PRINT @PrintMessage;

  select @customer as customer, ''  as invoicedate, @counter as pallet_num, @custpo as custpo, @invccount as invcount, @palletsize as print_boxes
  -- SELECT top 1 @customer as customer, LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR, @invcdate, 120), 10) as invoicedate,invoiceno, custpo, @invccount as InvoiceCount, @boxes as boxes
  --FROM invheader
  --WHERE customer = @customer and custpo = @custpo --and invoicedate = @invcdate 

    END
 if @pallet_bal > 0
 BEGIN
    insert into #t1
    select @customer as customer, ''  as invoicedate, 1 as pallet_num, @custpo as custpo, @invccount as invcount, @pallet_bal as print_boxes
 END
    
        -- Get the next po.
    FETCH NEXT FROM po_cursor 
    INTO @customer,@custpo,@invccount,@palletsize,@total_qty, @tot_boxes, @pallets,@pallet_bal
END 
CLOSE po_cursor;
DEALLOCATE po_cursor;

--select * from #T1 order by custpo
--select * from #T2

      ,[invcdate] datetime
      ,[pallet_num] int
      ,[custpo] varchar(20)
	  ,[distri] varchar(20)
      ,[invccount] int
      ,[print_boxes] int
             )

 set @wfuser = @Parameter2

select i.customer, i.custpo, i.distri,count(*) as invccount, @palletsize as palletsize, sum(totqty) as total_qty, sum (i.boxes) as tot_boxes , sum (totqty)/@palletsize as pallets,sum (totqty)%@palletsize as pallet_bal from invheader i inner join #t2 t on  i.custpo = t.po

/*
**  1 - PB stored procedure that retrieves column info
**     from the catalog
*/
create proc sp_pbcolumn @id int as
select colid, status, type, length, name, usertype
from dbo.syscolumns  where id = @id
 




sp_pbfktable 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbfktable    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbfktable    Script Date: 4/16/96 9:12:39 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbfktable    Script Date: 4/4/96 4:11:21 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbfktable    Script Date: 3/5/96 1:10:42 PM ******/
/*
**  10 - PB stored procedure that retrieves table info
**       from foreign keys referencing the current table
*/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_pbfktable]
@tblname nvarchar(60) = NULL as
declare @objid int
if @tblname = null
return
else
begin
select @objid = object_id(@tblname)
select name, id, type, uid, user_name(uid) from sysobjects
where id in (select k.id from syskeys k where k.depid =
@objid) 
end
return

sp_pbforeignkey 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbforeignkey    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbforeignkey    Script Date: 4/16/96 9:12:40 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbforeignkey    Script Date: 4/4/96 4:11:21 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbforeignkey    Script Date: 3/5/96 1:10:42 PM ******/
/*
** 9 - PB stored procedure that retrieves foreign key info
**     from the catalog
*/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_pbforeignkey]
@tabname nvarchar(92)                    /* the table to check for indexes */
as
declare @tabid int                      /* the object id of the table */
/*
**  Check to see the the table exists and initialize @objid.
*/
select @tabid = object_id(@tabname)
/*
**  Table doesn't exist so return.
*/
if @tabid is NULL
begin
return
end
else
/*
**  See if the object has any foreign keys
*/
begin
select k.keycnt, OBJECT_NAME(k.depid), 
(select USER_NAME(o.uid) from dbo.sysobjects o 
where o.id = @tabid),
objectkey1 = col_name(k.id, key1),
objectkey2 = col_name(k.id, key2),
objectkey3 = col_name(k.id, key3),
objectkey4 = col_name(k.id, key4),
objectkey5 = col_name(k.id, key5),
objectkey6 = col_name(k.id, key6),
objectkey7 = col_name(k.id, key7),
objectkey8 = col_name(k.id, key8)
from syskeys k, master.dbo.spt_values v
where  k.type = v.number and v.type =  'K'
and k.type = 2 and k.id = @tabid
return
end

sp_pbindex 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbindex    Script Date: 1/29/00 12:58:38 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbindex    Script Date: 1/10/98 7:04:12 AM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbindex    Script Date: 4/16/96 9:12:41 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbindex    Script Date: 4/4/96 4:11:22 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbindex    Script Date: 3/5/96 1:10:43 PM ******/
/*
**  3 - PB stored procedure that retrieves index info
**     from the catalog
*/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_pbindex]
@objname nvarchar(92)                    /* the table to check for indexes */
as
declare @objid int                      /* the object id of the table */
declare @indid int                      /* the index id of an index */
declare @key1 nvarchar(30)               /* first key  */
declare @key2 nvarchar(30)               /* second key  */
declare @key3 nvarchar(30)               /* third key  */
declare @key4 nvarchar(30)               /* fourth key  */
declare @key5 nvarchar(30)               /* ...  */
declare @key6 nvarchar(30)
declare @key7 nvarchar(30)
declare @key8 nvarchar(30)
declare @key9 nvarchar(30)               /* ...  */
declare @key10 nvarchar(30)
declare @key11 nvarchar(30)
declare @key12 nvarchar(30)
declare @key13 nvarchar(30)               /* ...  */
declare @key14 nvarchar(30)
declare @key15 nvarchar(30)
declare @key16 nvarchar(30)
declare @unique smallint                /* index is unique */
declare @clustered  smallint            /* index is clustered */
/*
**  Check to see the the table exists and initialize @objid.
*/
select @objid = object_id(@objname)
/*
**  Table doesn't exist so return.
*/
if @objid is NULL
begin
return
end
/*
**  See if the object has any indexes.
**  Since there may be more than one entry in sysindexes for the object,
**  this select will set @indid to the index id of the first index.
*/
select @indid = min(indid)
from sysindexes
where id = @objid
and indid > 0
and indid < 255
/*
**  If no indexes, return.
*/
if @indid is NULL
begin
return
end
/*
**  Now check out each index, figure out it's type and keys and
**  save the info in a temporary table that we'll print out at the end.
*/
create table sp_indtab
(
index_name      nvarchar(30),
index_num       int,
index_key1      nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key2      nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key3      nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key4      nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key5      nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key6      nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key7      nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key8      nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key9      nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key10     nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key11     nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key12     nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key13     nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key14     nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key15     nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_key16     nvarchar(30) NULL,
index_unique    smallint,
index_clustered smallint
)
while @indid != NULL
begin
/*
**  First we'll figure out what the keys are.
*/
declare @i int
declare @thiskey nvarchar(30)
declare @lastindid int
select @i = 1
set nocount on
while @i <= 16
begin
select @thiskey = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
if @thiskey = NULL
begin
goto keysdone
end
if @i = 1
begin
select @key1 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 2
begin
select @key2 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 3
begin
select @key3 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 4
begin
select @key4 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 5
begin
select @key5 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 6
begin
select @key6 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 7
begin
select @key7 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 8
begin
select @key8 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 9
begin
select @key9 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 10
begin
select @key10 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 11
begin
select @key11 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 12
begin
select @key12 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 13
begin
select @key13 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 14
begin
select @key14 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 15
begin
select @key15 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
else
if @i = 16
begin
select @key16 = index_col(@objname, @indid, @i)
end
/*
**  Increment @i so it will check for the next key.
*/
select @i = @i + 1
end
/*
**  When we get here we now have all the keys.
*/
keysdone:
set nocount off
/*
**  Figure out if it's a  clustered or nonclustered index.
*/
if @indid = 1
select @clustered = 1
if @indid > 1
select @clustered = 0
/*
**  Now we'll check out the status bits for this index
*/
/*
**  See if the index is unique (0x02).
*/
if exists (select *
from master.dbo.spt_values v, sysindexes i
where i.status & v.number = v.number
and v.type = "I"
and v.number = 2
and i.id = @objid
and i.indid = @indid)
select @unique = 1
else
select @unique = 0
/*
**  Now we have all the needed info for the index so we'll add
**  the goods to the temporary table.
*/
insert into sp_indtab
select name, @i - 1, @key1, @key2, @key3, @key4,
@key5, @key6, @key7, @key8, @key9,
@key10, @key11, @key12, @key13, @key14,
@key15, @key16, @unique, @clustered
from sysindexes
where id = @objid
and indid = @indid
/*
**  Now move @indid to the next index.
*/
select @lastindid = @indid
select @indid = NULL
select @indid = min(indid)
from sysindexes
where id = @objid
and indid > @lastindid
and indid < 255
end
/*
**  Now print out the contents of the temporary index table.
*/
select index_name, index_num, index_key1, index_key2,
index_key3, index_key4, index_key5, index_key6,
index_key7, index_key8, index_key9, index_key10,
index_key11, index_key12, index_key13, index_key14,
index_key15, index_key16, index_unique, index_clustered
from sp_indtab
drop table sp_indtab

sp_pbprimarykey 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbprimarykey    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbprimarykey    Script Date: 4/16/96 9:12:41 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbprimarykey    Script Date: 4/4/96 4:11:22 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbprimarykey    Script Date: 3/5/96 1:10:44 PM ******/
/*
** 8 - PB stored procedure that retrieves primary key info
**     from the catalog
*/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_pbprimarykey]
@tabname nvarchar(92)                    /* the table to check for indexes */
as
declare @tabid int                      /* the object id of the table */
/*
**  Check to see the the table exists and initialize @objid.
*/
select @tabid = object_id(@tabname)
/*
**  Table doesn't exist so return.
*/
if @tabid is NULL
begin
return
end
else
/*
**  See if the object has a primary key
*/
begin
select k.keycnt,
objectkey1 = col_name(k.id, key1),
objectkey2 = col_name(k.id, key2),
objectkey3 = col_name(k.id, key3),
objectkey4 = col_name(k.id, key4),
objectkey5 = col_name(k.id, key5),
objectkey6 = col_name(k.id, key6),
objectkey7 = col_name(k.id, key7),
objectkey8 = col_name(k.id, key8)
from syskeys k, master.dbo.spt_values v
where  k.type = v.number and v.type =  'K'
and k.type = 1 and k.id = @tabid
return
end

sp_pbproc 


/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbproc    Script Date: 5/18/99 3:28:01 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbproc    Script Date: 4/16/96 9:12:41 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbproc    Script Date: 4/4/96 4:11:22 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbproc    Script Date: 3/5/96 1:10:44 PM ******/
/*
**  4 - PB stored procedure that retrieves proc info
**     from the catalog
*/
create proc sp_pbproc
@procid int = NULL ,
@procnumber smallint = NULL  as
if @procid = null
begin
select o.id, o.name, o.uid, user_name(o.uid),
p.number from dbo.sysobjects o, dbo.sysprocedures p
where o.type = 'P' and p.sequence = 0 and o.id = p.id
end
else
begin
select name, type, length, colid from dbo.syscolumns
where (id = @procid and number = @procnumber)
end
return




sp_pbtable 
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbtable    Script Date: 1/29/00 12:58:38 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbtable    Script Date: 1/10/98 7:04:12 AM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbtable    Script Date: 4/16/96 9:12:42 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbtable    Script Date: 4/4/96 4:11:23 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_pbtable    Script Date: 3/5/96 1:10:44 PM ******/
/*
**  6 - PB stored procedure that retrieves table info
**     from the catalog
*/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_pbtable]
@tblname nvarchar(60) = NULL as
declare @objid int
if @tblname = null
select name, id, type, uid, user_name(uid) from sysobjects where
(type = 'S' or type = 'U' or type = 'V')
else
begin
select @objid = object_id(@tblname)
select name, id, type, uid, user_name(uid) from sysobjects
where id = @objid
end
return

/*
**  7 - PB stored procedure that retrieves comments info
**     from the catalog
*/
create procedure sp_pbtext
@objid  int ,
@number smallint = NULL
as
if (@number = NULL)
select text  from dbo.syscomments where id = @objid
else
select text  from dbo.syscomments where
(id = @objid and number = @number)
return

sp_pickdetail_crosstab 	CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_pickdetail_crosstab] ( @sqlquery nvarchar(max)OUTPUT)
AS  
declare
    @cols nvarchar(max),
    @stmt nvarchar(max)

select @cols = isnull(@cols + ', ', '') + '"' + t.style + '"' from (select distinct (rtrim(style)+rtrim(color)) as style from pickdetail) as T
PRINT @cols

SET @stmt = 
    'select style, pickno, store
    from (select CONVERT(varchar(20), rtrim(style)) +CONVERT(varchar(20),rtrim(color)) as style, pickdetail.pickno, pickheader.store
	,pickdetail.qty FROM pickdetail
	JOIN pickheader ON pickdetail.pickno = pickheader.pickno )as T
        pivot 
        (
            sum(qty)
            for T.style in (' + @cols + ')
        ) as P'
SELECT @sqlquery = @stmt

sp_pos_arcashPoint create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_pos_arcashPoint] (@invoiceno int, @customer char(10), @paidamt money, @refno char(20), 
@pmtcode char(4), @cctroutd char(15), @authno char(15), @memo varchar(200),
@cardno char(20), @member char(40), @expdate char(10), @cardtype char(10), @XMLresponse varchar(4000), @orderno int, 
@signatureBase64 text, @terminal char(10), @cardpresent char(1), @ccTraceCode char(30), @ccResultRef char(16), @ccClientTroutd char(10) )
AS
	INSERT INTO ArCash (invoiceno, customer, paiddate, create_date, paidamt, refno, pmt_code, ccTroutD, ccAuthNo, memo, bankno, current_exchange_rate, 
		batchno, acct_exported, checkid, currency, exchange_rate, cc_cardno, cc_member, cc_expdate, cc_CardType, ccXMLresponse,
		orderno, cc_signatureBase64, POS_TerminalCode , card_present,  ccTraceCode, ccResultRef, ccClientTroutd  ) 
	VALUES (isnull(@invoiceno,0), @customer, getdate(), getdate(), @paidamt , @refno, @pmtcode, @cctroutd, @authno, @memo, '', 
		1.0, '', 'N', '', 'USD', 1.0 , left(@cardno,4)+'********'+right(rtrim(@cardno),4), @member, @expdate, @cardtype, @XMLresponse,
		 isnull(@orderno,0), @signatureBase64, @terminal, isnull(@cardpresent,'Y'),  @ccTraceCode, @ccResultRef, @ccClientTroutd ) 


sp_prepack_physinvt create procedure sp_prepack_physinvt (@invoiceno int)
as
declare @isPosted char(1)
select @isPosted=isnull(prepack_physinvt_posted,'Y') from invheader where invoiceno=@invoiceno;

if @isPosted='N' 
begin
	/* procedure to reduce inventory from PACKLIST, and put back INVDETAIL */
	insert into logfdetail (style, color, royaltor, warehouse, prepack, logno, refno, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6,
   				qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12, location, logdate, line )
	select packlist.style, packlist.color, packlist.royaltor, invheader.warehouse, isnull(packlist.prepack_code,''), 0, 
		'inv#'+convert(char(6), invheader.invoiceno), -packlist.qty1*invhead_box.boxes, -packlist.qty2*invhead_box.boxes,
		 -packlist.qty3*invhead_box.boxes, -packlist.qty4*invhead_box.boxes,
			-packlist.qty5*invhead_box.boxes, -packlist.qty6*invhead_box.boxes, -packlist.qty7*invhead_box.boxes, 
			-packlist.qty8*invhead_box.boxes, -packlist.qty9*invhead_box.boxes, -packlist.qty10*invhead_box.boxes,
			 -packlist.qty11*invhead_box.boxes,	-packlist.qty12*invhead_box.boxes, 'HOUS', getdate(), 1  
	 from packlist join invheader on packlist.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno  
				join invhead_box on packlist.invoiceno=invhead_box.invoiceno and packlist.boxno=invhead_box.boxno 
	 where packlist.invoiceno=@invoiceno 

	/* now put back what is in INVDETAIL */
	insert into logfdetail (style, color, royaltor, warehouse, prepack, logno, refno, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6,
   				qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12, location, logdate, line )
	select invdetail.style, invdetail.color, invdetail.royaltor, invheader.warehouse, isnull(invdetail.prepack_code,''),0, 
		'inv#'+convert(char(6), invheader.invoiceno), invdetail.qty1, invdetail.qty2, invdetail.qty3,invdetail.qty4,
			invdetail.qty5, invdetail.qty6, invdetail.qty7, invdetail.qty8, invdetail.qty9, invdetail.qty10, invdetail.qty11,
			invdetail.qty12, 'HOUS', getdate() , invdetail.line 
	 from invdetail join invheader on invdetail.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno  
	 where invdetail.invoiceno=@invoiceno 
	
	update invheader set prepack_physinvt_posted='Y' where invoiceno=@invoiceno 
end


sp_qc_factory_score create procedure sp_qc_factory_score (@vendor nchar(10), @begdate datetime, @endDate datetime) 
as
begin 

declare @total int
declare @pass int
declare @hold int
declare @fail int
declare @fail2 int
declare @fail3orMore int 
declare @withLG int 
declare @cancelled int 

select @total = count(myCount) from ( 
	select  myCount=count(*)  from qc where factory=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 

select @pass = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*)  from qc where qcresult='PASS' and factory=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 

select @hold = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*)  from qc where qcresult='HOLD' and factory=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x  
select @fail = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*) from qc where qcresult='FAIL' and factory=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 
select @fail2 = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*) from qc where qcresult='FAIL 2' and factory=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 
select @fail3orMore = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*) from qc where  left(qcresult,4)='FAIL' and qcresult>'FAIL 2'
	 and factory=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 
select @withLG = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*) from qc where qcresult='SHIP WITH LG' and factory=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by  REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 
select @cancelled = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*) from qc where qcresult='CANCEL' and factory=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by  REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 


declare @t table(descript varchar(30), total int, qc_percent decimal(5,2) )
insert @t values('Number of Inspections', isnull(@total,0),0)
insert @t values('Pass', isnull(@pass,0), case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@pass,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end )
insert @t values('Hold', isnull(@hold,0),case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@hold,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Fail', isnull(@fail,0),case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@fail,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Fail 1 time', isnull(@fail,0) - isnull(@fail2,0) - isnull(@fail3orMore,0) ,case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then (isnull(@fail,0) - isnull(@fail2,0) - isnull(@fail3orMore,0))*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Fail 2 times', isnull(@fail2,0) - isnull(@fail3orMore,0),case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then (isnull(@fail2,0) - isnull(@fail3orMore,0))*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Fail 3 or more', isnull(@fail3orMore,0) ,case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then (isnull(@fail3orMore,0))*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Accepted with LG', isnull(@withLG,0),case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@withLG,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Penalty/Cancellation', isnull(@cancelled,0), case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@cancelled,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end) 

select * from @t
end

sp_qc_score create procedure sp_qc_score (@qcno integer)  
as
begin 
	declare @pono nchar(30)
	declare @qcresult nchar(20)
	declare @poqty nchar(30)
	declare @qc_score_multiplier decimal(5,2) 
	declare @qc_qty1 int 
	declare @qc_qty2 int 
	declare @qc_qty3 int 
	declare @qc_qty4 int 
	declare @qc_qty5 int 
	declare @QC_Qty1_Multiplier decimal(5,2)
	declare @QC_Qty2_Multiplier decimal(5,2)
	declare @QC_Qty3_Multiplier decimal(5,2)
	declare @QC_Qty4_Multiplier decimal(5,2)
	declare @QC_Qty5_Multiplier decimal(5,2)
	declare @qc_multiplier decimal(5,2) 
	declare @fail_count int 

	select 
		@qc_qty1 = QC_Qty1, 
		@QC_Qty1_Multiplier=QC_Qty1_Multiplier,
		@qc_qty2 = QC_Qty2, 
		@QC_Qty2_Multiplier=QC_Qty2_Multiplier,
		@qc_qty3 = QC_Qty3, 
		@QC_Qty3_Multiplier=QC_Qty3_Multiplier,
		@qc_qty4 = QC_Qty4, 
		@QC_Qty4_Multiplier=QC_Qty4_Multiplier,
		@qc_qty5 = QC_Qty5, 
		@QC_Qty5_Multiplier=QC_Qty5_Multiplier from wfsystem3 where wfsystem=1  


	select @pono = pono, @qcresult=qcresult, @poqty=convert(int, poqty)  from qc where qcno=@qcno 
	if @qcresult='PASS' or @qcresult='SHIP WITH LG' 
	begin
		SELECT 
		   @qc_multiplier = CASE WHEN @poqty < @qc_qty1 THEN @QC_Qty1_Multiplier
				WHEN @poqty < @qc_qty2 THEN @QC_Qty2_Multiplier
				WHEN @poqty < @qc_qty3 THEN @QC_Qty3_Multiplier
				WHEN @poqty < @qc_qty4 THEN @QC_Qty4_Multiplier
				ELSE @QC_Qty5_Multiplier
			END  
		update qc set qc_score_multiplier=@qc_multiplier where qcno=@qcno 
	end 


	if @qcresult='PASS' 
	begin
		update qc set qc_score=5 where qcno=@qcno 
		select @fail_count = count(*) from qc where pono=@pono 
		if @fail_count=2 
			update qc set qc_score = 2 where  qcno=@qcno
		if @fail_count=3 
			update qc set qc_score = 1 where  qcno=@qcno
		if @fail_count>3 
			update qc set qc_score = 0 where  qcno=@qcno
	end 


	if @qcresult='SHIP WITH LG' 
	begin
		update qc set qc_score = 3 where  qcno=@qcno 	
	end 

end 

sp_qc_vendor_score create procedure sp_qc_vendor_score (@vendor nchar(10), @begdate datetime, @endDate datetime) 
as
begin 

declare @total int
declare @pass int
declare @hold int
declare @fail int
declare @fail2 int
declare @fail3orMore int 
declare @withLG int 
declare @cancelled int 

select @total = count(myCount) from ( 
	select  myCount=count(*)  from qc where vendor=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 

select @pass = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*)  from qc where qcresult='PASS' and vendor=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 

select @hold = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*)  from qc where qcresult='HOLD' and vendor=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x  
select @fail = count(myCount) from (

	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 
select @fail2 = count(myCount) from (

	group by REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x

select @cancelled = count(myCount) from ( 
	select myCount=count(*) from qc where qcresult='CANCEL' and vendor=@vendor and qcdate between @begdate and @enddate 
	group by  REPLACE(PONO,' ','') ) x 


declare @t table(descript varchar(30), total int, qc_percent decimal(5,2) )
insert @t values('Number of Inspections', isnull(@total,0),0)
insert @t values('Pass', isnull(@pass,0), case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@pass,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end )
insert @t values('Hold', isnull(@hold,0),case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@hold,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Fail', isnull(@fail,0),case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@fail,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Fail 1 time', isnull(@fail,0) - isnull(@fail2,0) - isnull(@fail3orMore,0) ,case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then (isnull(@fail,0) - isnull(@fail2,0) - isnull(@fail3orMore,0))*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Fail 2 times', isnull(@fail2,0) - isnull(@fail3orMore,0),case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then (isnull(@fail2,0) - isnull(@fail3orMore,0))*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Fail 3 or more', isnull(@fail3orMore,0) ,case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then (isnull(@fail3orMore,0))*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Accepted with LG', isnull(@withLG,0),case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@withLG,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end)
insert @t values('Penalty/Cancellation', isnull(@cancelled,0), case when isnull(@total,0)<>0 then isnull(@cancelled,0)*100.00/@total else 0 end) 

select * from @t
end

sp_recalc_invoice_duedate 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_recalc_invoice_duedate] as
/* take care of the simple net days */

update invheader set canceldate= dateadd(dd, isnull(terms.days,0), invoicedate)

 from terms where invheader.terms = terms.code and isnull(terms.cutoffday,0)=0

 

update invheader set canceldate= CONVERT(datetime, 

  convert(nchar(2), 

            case when datepart(day, invoicedate) <= isnull(terms.cutoffday,0) then 

                        case when datepart(month, invoicedate) = 12 then

                                    '01'

                        else

                                    datepart(month, invoicedate)+1

                        end 

            else

                        case when datepart(month, invoicedate)=12 then

                                    '02'

                        else

                                    case when datepart(month,invoicedate)=11 then

                                                '01'

                                    else

                                                datepart(month,invoicedate)+2

                                    end

                        end

            end )

+'/10/'+

   convert(nchar(4),

            case when datepart(month, invoicedate)=12 then

                        datepart(year , invoicedate) + 1 

            else

                        datepart(year, invoicedate)

            end ) 

)

from  terms

 where invheader.terms=terms.code and isnull(terms.cutoffday,0)>0

 

update invheader set canceldate = 

case when (terms.days - 10)%30 = 0 then

            convert(datetime, convert(nchar(2), datepart(month, dateadd(dd, terms.days-10, canceldate) ) ) +'/10/'+

            convert(nchar(4), datepart(year, dateadd(dd, terms.days-10, canceldate) ) ) )

     else 

            dateadd(dd, terms.days - 10, canceldate)

     end  

 from terms 

where invheader.terms=terms.code and isnull(terms.cutoffday,0)>0

sp_renamediagram 
	CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_renamediagram
	(
		@diagramname 		sysname,
		@owner_id		int	= null,
		@new_diagramname	sysname
	
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		set nocount on
		declare @theId 			int
		declare @IsDbo 			int
		
		declare @UIDFound 		int
		declare @DiagId			int
		declare @DiagIdTarg		int
		declare @u_name			sysname
		if((@diagramname is null) or (@new_diagramname is null))
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Invalid value', 16, 1);
			return -1
		end
	
		EXECUTE AS CALLER;
		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();
		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner'); 
		if(@owner_id is null)
			select @owner_id = @theId;
		REVERT;
	
		select @u_name = USER_NAME(@owner_id)
	
		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname 
		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @UIDFound <> @theId))
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1)
			return -3
		end
	
		-- if((@u_name is not null) and (@new_diagramname = @diagramname))	-- nothing will change
		--	return 0;
	
		if(@u_name is null)
			select @DiagIdTarg = diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @theId and name = @new_diagramname
		else
			select @DiagIdTarg = diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @new_diagramname
	
		if((@DiagIdTarg is not null) and  @DiagId <> @DiagIdTarg)
		begin
			RAISERROR ('The name is already used.', 16, 1);
			return -2
		end		
	
		if(@u_name is null)
			update dbo.sysdiagrams set [name] = @new_diagramname, principal_id = @theId where diagram_id = @DiagId
		else
			update dbo.sysdiagrams set [name] = @new_diagramname where diagram_id = @DiagId
		return 0
	END

SP_Report_Receiving 

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Report_Receiving] 
    @Parameter1 varchar(100) = '20220701',
    @Parameter2 VARCHAR (100) = '20020731'
as

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE  @edate nvarchar(50),  @sdate varchar(50)
     

 SET @sdate  = @Parameter1 
 set @edate = @Parameter2

SELECT  [fileno]
      ,[cartons]
      ,[totalqty]
      ,[closed]
      ,[div]
      ,[warehouse]
      ,[Importnum_id]
      ,[rec_date]
      ,[recv_qty]
      ,[import_id]
  FROM [import] where rec_date >= @sdate and rec_date <= @edate
  order by rec_date,div
 

SP_Report_Shipping 

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Report_Shipping] 
    @Parameter1 varchar(100) = '20220701',
    @Parameter2 VARCHAR (100) = '20020731'
as

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE  @edate nvarchar(50),  @sdate varchar(50)
     

 SET @sdate  = @Parameter1 
 set @edate = @Parameter2

select  d.style,d.color,d.warehouse,sum(d.qty1 + d.qty2 + d.qty3 + d.qty4 + d.qty5 + d.qty6 + d.qty7 + d.qty8 + d.qty9 + d.qty10 + d.qty11 + d.qty12)as qtyshipped from invheader h right join invdetail d  on h.invoiceno = d.invoiceno
where h.invoicedate >= @sdate and h.invoicedate <= @edate and h.user4 <> 'A' --and d.style like 'd%'
group by d.style, d.color,d.warehouse

sp_return_ip_hostname CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_return_ip_hostname] ( @ip_address nvarchar(100) output, @hostname nchar(100) output)
AS
BEGIN

SELECT  @ip_address = c.client_net_address, @hostname = s.host_name
FROM sys.dm_exec_connections AS c
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions AS s
    ON c.session_id = s.session_id
	WHERE c.session_id = @@SPID
--SELECT @ip_address output, @hostname output;

END

sp_sample_docs_image 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_sample_docs_image] (@code nchar(10), @style nchar(13),@pageindex int,@pagesize int,@recordcount int output)
   
AS
BEGIN
set nocount on;
SELECT row_number() over (order by docdatetime desc) as rownumber,rtrim(ivtf_sample_docs.style) as style,rtrim(ivtf_sample_docs.code) as code, ivtf_sample_docs.ivtf_docs_id,
filetype = (case  WHEN  filetype='JPG' and ivtf_sample_docs.Thumbnail is not null then rtrim(ivtf_sample_docs.code) + rtrim(style) + '.jpeg'  
				  WHEN filetype = 'PDF' then 'pdf.jpg' 
				  WHEN filetype = 'Excel' then 'excel.jpg' 
				  WHEN filetype = 'svg' then 'svg.jpg'
				  else 'noimage.jpg' End),
ivtf_sample_docs.Thumbnail,ivtf_sample_docs.description,ivtf_sample_docs.filesize,ivtf_sample_docs.doctype,code_doctype.security_level,
ivtf_sample_docs.docdatetime,ivtf_sample_docs.username into #results FROM ivtf_sample_docs,code_doctype WHERE(ivtf_sample_docs.doctype = code_doctype.code)
and style = @style and code_doctype.security_level <=(select docs_security_level from manufacturer WHERE code = @code)
--ORDER BY ivtf_sample_docs.docdatetime desc

select @recordcount = count(*) from #results

SELECT * FROM #Results
      WHERE RowNumber BETWEEN(@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1 AND(((@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1) + @PageSize) - 1
     
      DROP TABLE #Results
END
sp_smartsearch CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_smartsearch] @searchtext nchar(200), @pageindex int=NULL,@pagesize int=NULL,@pagecount int=NULL output
as
begin
declare @col1 nchar(1000) 
declare @col2 nchar(1000) 
declare @item int

/* 140702 dan - added for backward compatibility */ 
if @pageindex is null
	begin
		set @pageindex = 1 
		set @pagesize = 1000000
	end 

select 'Style name'+v.code as searchfrom, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by v.code desc ) AS RowNumber, 
max(v.id) as id, v.code, max(v.descript) as descript, convert(decimal(10,2), max(v.price) ) as price2 , convert(decimal(10,2), max(v.web_price) ) as webprice ,
 max(division.descript) as divisionss, max(grp.descript) as groups, max(category.descript) as category
 into #temptbl
FROM ivtf v  
	left outer JOIN  division on v.division=division.code   
	left outer join grp on v.grp=grp.code
	left outer join category on v.category=category.code
	left outer join color on v.color=color.code 	
	left outer join ivtf_image on ivtf_image.style = v.code and ivtf_image.color = v.color
WHERE  (v.active = 1 AND (category.is_web = 'Y') AND (grp.is_web = 'Y') AND (v.web_show = 'Y') AND (DATALENGTH (ivtf_image.Thumbnail1) >0)  ) and 
(v.code like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
v.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
color.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
division.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
category.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
grp.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' ) 
group by v.code 


DECLARE @RecordCount INT
    SELECT @RecordCount = COUNT(*) FROM #temptbl 
	print @RecordCount
	SET @PageCount = CEILING(CAST(@RecordCount AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) / CAST(@PageSize AS DECIMAL(10, 2)))
    PRINT    @PageCount
           
    SELECT searchfrom,RowNumber,id, code, descript,price2,webprice FROM #temptbl 
    WHERE  RowNumber BETWEEN(@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1 AND(((@PageIndex -1) * @PageSize + 1) + @PageSize) - 1
     
  DROP TABLE #temptbl
end

sp_smartsearchNew 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_smartsearchNew] @searchtext nchar(200),@priceflag nvarchar(200), @pageindex int=NULL,@pagesize int=NULL,@pagecount int=NULL output
as
begin
declare @col1 nchar(1000) 
declare @col2 nchar(1000) 
declare @item int



/* 140702 dan - added for backward compatibility */ 
if @pageindex is null
	begin
		set @pageindex = 1 
		set @pagesize = 1000000
	end 

select 'Style name'+v.code as searchfrom, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by v.code desc ) AS RowNumber, max(v.short_descript) as shortdesc,
max(v.id) as id, v.code, max(v.descript) as descript,

 
price2=case 
 when @priceflag='Wholesale' then 
 convert(decimal(10,2), max(v.price) ) 
 when @priceflag='Bothprice' then 
 convert(decimal(10,2), max(v.price) )
 else NULL end,
 --case  else NULL end,
 price3=case
 when @priceflag ='Retail' then
 convert(decimal(10,2),max(v.price2)) 
 when @priceflag ='Bothprice' then
 convert(decimal(10,2),max(v.price2)) 
 else NULL end,


 max(division.descript) as divisionss, max(grp.descript) as groups, max(category.descript) as category
FROM ivtf v  
	left outer JOIN  division on v.division=division.code   
	left outer join grp on v.grp=grp.code
	left outer join category on v.category=category.code
	left outer join color on v.color=color.code 	
	left outer join ivtf_image on ivtf_image.style = v.code and ivtf_image.color = v.color
WHERE  (v.active = 1 AND (category.is_web = 'Y') AND (grp.is_web = 'Y') AND (v.web_show = 'Y') ) and 
(v.code like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
v.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
color.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
division.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
category.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
grp.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' ) 
group by v.code 


end

sp_smartsearchW2 CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_smartsearchW2] @searchtext nchar(200),@priceflag nvarchar(200), @pageindex int=NULL,@pagesize int=NULL,@pagecount int=NULL output
as
begin
declare @col1 nchar(1000) 
declare @col2 nchar(1000) 
declare @item int



/* 140702 dan - added for backward compatibility */ 
if @pageindex is null
	begin
		set @pageindex = 1 
		set @pagesize = 1000000
	end 

select 'Style name'+v.code as searchfrom, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by v.code desc ) AS RowNumber, max(v.short_descript) as shortdesc,
max(v.id) as id, v.code, max(v.descript) as descript,

 
price2=case 
 when @priceflag='Wholesale' then 
 convert(decimal(10,2), max(v.price) ) 
 when @priceflag='Bothprice' then 
 convert(decimal(10,2), max(v.price) )
 else NULL end,
 --case  else NULL end,
 price3=case
 when @priceflag ='Retail' then
 convert(decimal(10,2),max(v.price2)) 
 when @priceflag ='Bothprice' then
 convert(decimal(10,2),max(v.price2)) 
 else NULL end,


 max(division.descript) as divisionss, max(grp.descript) as groups, max(category.descript) as category
FROM ivtf v  
	left outer JOIN  division on v.division=division.code   
	left outer join grp on v.grp=grp.code
	left outer join category on v.category=category.code
	left outer join color on v.color=color.code 	
	left outer join ivtf_image on ivtf_image.style = v.code and ivtf_image.color = v.color
WHERE  (v.active = 1 AND (category.is_web = 'Y') AND (grp.is_web = 'Y') AND (v.web_show = 'Y') ) and 
(v.code like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
v.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
color.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
division.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
category.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
grp.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' ) 
group by v.code 


end

sp_sodetail_picked_ZERO CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_sodetail_picked_ZERO] (@orderno int)
/***to UPDATE PICKED QUANTITY AS ZERO AFTER THE PICK IS DELETED BUT SODETAIL STILL HAS THE PICKED QUANTITIES **/
as BEGIN
DECLARE @style nchar(13)
DECLARE @color nchar(12)
DECLARE @royaltor nchar(13)

DECLARE @mycursor CURSOR
SET @MyCursor = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD
FOR
SELECT style,color,isnull(royaltor,'') FROM sodetail where orderno = @orderno
OPEN @MyCursor
FETCH NEXT FROM @MyCursor
INTO @style, @color, @royaltor
while (@@fetch_status=0)
begin
UPDATE SODETAIL SET pick_qty1 = 0, pick_qty2 = 0,pick_qty3 = 0, pick_qty4 = 0,pick_qty5 = 0, pick_qty6 = 0,
pick_qty7 = 0, pick_qty8 = 0,pick_qty9 = 0, pick_qty10 = 0,pick_qty11 = 0, pick_qty12 = 0
WHERE orderno = @orderno and style =@style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
UPDATE soheader SET picked = 0 WHERE orderno = @orderno
FETCH NEXT FROM @MyCursor
INTO @style, @color, @royaltor
END
CLOSE @MyCursor
DEALLOCATE @MyCursor

END

sp_specLog2SpecSheet CREATE PROCEDURE sp_specLog2SpecSheet (@upc nvarchar(20), @Trigger_Status nvarchar (25)) 
AS 
BEGIN
DECLARE @specsheet_id INT
DECLARE @count INT
SET IDENTITY_INSERT spec_sheet ON
if UPPER(@Trigger_Status) = 'DELETE'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE cur_specsheet_id CURSOR FOR
		SELECT spec_sheet_id FROM spec_sheet_log WHERE upc = @upc AND UPPER(Trigger_status) = 'DELETE' ORDER BY spec_sheet_id DESC
		OPEN cur_specsheet_id
		FETCH cur_specsheet_id INTO @specsheet_id
		While @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @count = count(*) FROM spec_sheet WHERE spec_sheet_id = @specsheet_id
			if @count = 0 
			BEGIN
			
				INSERT INTO spec_sheet([style],[code],[s1],[s2],[s3],[s4],[s5],[s6],[s7],[s8],[s9],[unit],[line],[delta],[tolerance],[s10],
			  [s11],[s12],[size1],[size2],[size3],[size4],[size5],[size6],[size7],[size8],[size9],[size10],[size11],[size12],[descript],
			  [descript2],[delta_size],[tolerance_size],[royaltor],[upc],[deltaMinus],[delta_sizeMinus],[spec_key],
			  [graded_s1],[graded_s2],[graded_s3],[graded_s4],[graded_s5],[graded_s6],[graded_s7],[graded_s8],[graded_s9],[graded_s10],
			  [graded_s11],[graded_s12],[delta1],[delta2],[delta3],[delta4],[delta5],[delta6],[delta7],[delta8],[delta9],[delta10],
			  [delta11],spec_sheet_id)
			  (SELECT [style],[code],[s1],[s2],[s3],[s4],[s5],[s6],[s7],[s8],[s9],[unit],[line],[delta],[tolerance],[s10],
			  [s11],[s12],[size1],[size2],[size3],[size4],[size5],[size6],[size7],[size8],[size9],[size10],[size11],[size12],[descript],
			  [descript2],[delta_size],[tolerance_size],[royaltor],[upc],[deltaMinus],[delta_sizeMinus],[spec_key],
			  [graded_s1],[graded_s2],[graded_s3],[graded_s4],[graded_s5],[graded_s6],[graded_s7],[graded_s8],[graded_s9],[graded_s10],
			  [graded_s11],[graded_s12],[delta1],[delta2],[delta3],[delta4],[delta5],[delta6],[delta7],[delta8],[delta9],[delta10],
			  [delta11],spec_sheet_id FROM spec_sheet_log WHERE spec_sheet_id = @specsheet_id and UPC = @upc AND UPPER(Trigger_status) = 'DELETE')
			END
			FETCH NEXT FROM cur_specsheet_id INTO @specsheet_id 
		END

	END

CLOSE cur_specsheet_id 
DEALLOCATE cur_specsheet_id
SET IDENTITY_INSERT spec_sheet OFF
END

sp_store_info /* HAVE FEW ARGUMENTS AS OPTIONAL AS USER MIGHT NOT WANT TO INSERT ALL DETAILS */
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_store_info] @customer nchar(10), @name nchar(30), @email1 nchar(50), @web_pwd nchar(30), @addr1 nchar(30), @addr2 nchar(30) = NULL, @city nchar(20), @state nchar(3), @zip nchar(10), @contact1 nchar(30) = NULL, @country nchar(35) = NULL
As 
BEGIN
declare @code nchar(10)
declare @count int

SELECT @count = count(*) FROM store WHERE customer = @customer and web_user = @email1
/* IF COUNTRY IS NULL USE DEFAULT AS USA */
If isnull(@country, '') = ''
BEGIN
	SET @country = 'USA'
END
IF @count = 0 
BEGIN
/* WHEN NO ROWS MAX WOULD RETURN NULL HENCE CONVERT TO ZERO AND ADD 1 */
SELECT @code = '0' + CONVERT(varchar(10), isnull(max(code), 0) + 1) FROM store WHERE customer = @customer and web_user = @email1
END
ELSE
/*WHEN ROWS ARE THERE CONVERT TO INTEGER AND INCREMENT BY 1*/
/*Repeats 9 over and over */
--SELECT CASE WHEN max(a.code) < 9 THEN @code = CONVERT(varchar(10), max(a.code))
--ELSE @code = CONVERT(varchar(10), max(a.code) + 1)  END FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(CODE) = 1 THEN CONVERT(varchar(10), max(code) + 1) 
--ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), RTRIM(isnull('0000', 0) + 1 )) END as code 
--FROM store where customer = @customer and web_user=@email1 
--GROUP BY code) a 
BEGIN
/* does not repeat 9 */
SET @CODE = (SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(A.CODE) < 9 THEN '0' +CONVERT(varchar(10), max(CAST(a.code as INT) + 1))
ELSE  CONVERT(varchar(10), max(CAST(a.code as INT) + 1)) END as code FROM
(SELECT CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(CODE) = 1 THEN CONVERT(varchar(10), max(code)) END as code
 FROM store WHERE customer = @customer and web_user = @email1 GROUP BY code) a)

END 

Insert into store(customer, code, name, web_user, web_password, addr1, addr2, city, state, zip, contact1, country) Values (@customer, @code, @name, @email1, @web_pwd, @addr1, @addr2, @city, @state, @zip, @contact1, @country) 
END


sp_store_shipdays 
CREATE procedure [sp_store_shipdays]  @styleno char(40)  
AS
select invheader.shname, invheader.shaddr1, invheader.shaddr2, invheader.shcity, invheader.shstate, invheader.shzip, invheader.shcountry, phone1,isnull(monday_From,'-') AS monday_From,isnull(monday_To,'-') AS monday_To,
isnull(sunday_From,'-') AS sunday_From,isnull(sunday_To,'-') AS sunday_To,isnull(tuesday_from,'-') AS tuesday_from,isnull(tuesday_to,'-') AS tuesday_to,
isnull(wednesday_from,'-') AS wednesday_from,isnull(wednesday_to,'-') AS wednesday_to,isnull(thursday_from,'-') AS thursday_from,isnull(thursday_to,'-') AS thursday_to,
isnull(friday_from,'-') AS friday_from,isnull(friday_to,'-') AS friday_to,isnull(saturday_from,'-') AS saturday_from,isnull(saturday_to,'-') AS saturday_to
 from invheader join v_store_hours on invheader.store = v_store_hours.code and invheader.customer = v_store_hours.customer
 where invoiceno in (select invoiceno from invdetail where style = @styleno)
  and datediff(dd, getdate(), invoicedate) < (select store_shipdays from iosConfig)

 @code nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10)
as

select @upc,@code, @color, descript,category, season, year, body,       division, weight,
 cost,price,price2,price3,price4,user1,user2,user3, memo,

royaltor,   brand_name , orderqtymul ,  isdocsexist, created_date,created_user, UPDATED_USER, UPDATED_DATE,

  gauge_yarn, shipnote, fab_code , groupname, refstyle, refMasterStyle 
 from ivtf where code = @code AND color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(@royaltor, '')

  AND rtrim(isnull(ivtf_image.royaltor,'')) = rtrim(isnull(@royaltor,'')))

		 from ivtf join ivtf_image i2 on i2.style = ivtf.code AND i2.color = ivtf.color 
		 AND isnull(i2.royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')
	 where rtrim(ivtf.code)=rtrim(@code)  AND rtrim(ivtf.color) =rtrim(@color)
	  AND rtrim(isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')) = rtrim(isnull(@royaltor,''))
	End
/* 160111 dan - also copy the Vendor costing if it exists */
if exists (select code from ivtf_vendor_cost where code = @code AND color = @color  )
	BEGIN 
		select @customer_style=customer_style, @customer_color=customer_color from ivtf_sample where upc=@upc 

		insert into ivtf_sample_vendor_cost (sample_upc,
		code ,color,
		vend1,price1,priceTerms1,date1,note1,selected1,
		vend2 ,price2 ,priceTerms2 ,date2,note2,selected2,
		vend3,price3,priceTerms3,date3,note3,selected3,
		vend4 ,price4 ,priceTerms4 ,date4 ,note4 ,selected4 ,
		vend5 ,price5 ,priceTerms5 ,date5 ,note5 ,selected5 ,

		vend8,price8 ,priceTerms8 ,date8,note8 ,selected8 ,
		vend9 ,price9 ,priceTerms9 ,date9 ,note9 ,selected9 ,
		memo )
		
		select @upc, code, color, 
		vend1,price1,priceTerms1,date1,note1,selected1,
		vend2 ,price2 ,priceTerms2 ,date2,note2,selected2,
		vend3,price3,priceTerms3,date3,note3,selected3,
		vend4 ,price4 ,priceTerms4 ,date4 ,note4 ,selected4 ,
		vend5 ,price5 ,priceTerms5 ,date5 ,note5 ,selected5 ,

sp_StyleToSample_Cutno 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_StyleToSample_Cutno]
 @code nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10), @cutno INT
as
/* 160504 dan - fixed @color=@color to 'color=@color' */ 
/*160426 Arun added */

declare @customer_style nchar(13)
declare @upc nchar(20)
declare @customer_color nchar(12)
/*Get the last max UPC + 1 to assign to ivtf_sample */

SELECT @upc = convert(char(20), CONVERT(DECIMAL, ISNULL(MAX(upc), 0 )) + 1) FROM ivtf_sample
/*insert same code, color as ivtf_sample.code, ivtf_sample.color */ 

insert into ivtf_sample (upc, code, color,descript,category, season, year, body,       division_graded, weight,
 cost,price,price2,price3,price4,user1,user2,user3, memo, 
location, avgcost, stdcost, lstcost,  commpcnt1,  commpcnt2 ,active, priceb,
pricec,priced,pricee,pricef, sku ,   user4, carelabel , label1,label2,label3,userid,user_date,  
grp,vendor,vend_style,vend_color,vend_fob, vend_price, vend_currency, landed_cost, other_cost,
short_descript, importcat, body2 ,  long_desc, est_cost,country_origin,
fab_name,fab_content,fab_store,fab_label,fab_thread,cutting_info,width,length,design,
pattern,sew,sew_instruction1,sew_instruction2,sew_instruction3, sew_instruction4, sew_instruction5,
sew_instruction6, sew_instruction7, sew_instruction8, sew_instruction9, sew_instruction10, 
washing_instruction1, washing_instruction2, salesrep, create_date,  sample_approval_date,
production_date, sample_size,  sample_desc, pattern_date, stylecard, p_req_date, p_done_date,
volume, lead_time,   lead_m,     clength,     cwidth,      cheight,     vlength,     vwidth,      vheight,
royaltor,   brand_name ,          orderqtymul ,  isdocsexist, created_date,created_user, UPDATED_USER, UPDATED_DATE,
isbomexist, weight_hanging,actual_date,subcategory,  dye_house,  knit_cost,
mach_type, greige_yld,greige_wdt,inch_revo, cutline, fin_color,  gum_trim,   fin_yield,
fin_width,shrink,torque,dye_loss,knit_loss, yarn_size,  descript_style,       percentage,
fin_colorno, comments,yarn_size1, yarn_size2, yarn_size3, yarn_size4, descript_style1,      descript_style2,      descript_style3,
descript_style4,percentage1,percentage2,percentage3,percentage4,knit_house, 
customer,   customer_style, customer_color, marketer,merchandiser,coordinator,comminv_descript,
stitch_hor,stitch_ver,HarmonizeCode,QuotaCategory, YarnWeight, YarnCost, pricex,
  gauge_yarn, shipnote,fab_code, groupname , refstyle, refMasterStyle, cutno, division )
(
select @upc,@code, @color, descript,category, season, year, body,       division, weight,
 cost,price,price2,price3,price4,user1,user2,user3, memo, 
location, avgcost, stdcost, lstcost,  commpcnt1,  commpcnt2 ,active, priceb,
pricec,priced,pricee,pricef, sku ,   user4, carelabel , label1,label2,label3,userid,user_date,  
grp,vendor,vend_style,vend_color,vend_fob, vend_price, vend_currency, landed_cost, other_cost,
short_descript, importcat, body2 , long_desc, est_cost,country_origin,
fab_name,fab_content,fab_store,fab_label,fab_thread,cutting_info,width,length,design,
pattern,sew,sew_instruction1,sew_instruction2,sew_instruction3, sew_instruction4, sew_instruction5,
sew_instruction6, sew_instruction7, sew_instruction8, sew_instruction9, sew_instruction10, 
washing_instruction1, washing_instruction2, salesrep, create_date,  sample_approval_date,
production_date, sample_size,  sample_desc, pattern_date, stylecard, p_req_date, p_done_date,
volume, lead_time,   lead_m,     clength,     cwidth,      cheight,     vlength,     vwidth,      vheight,
royaltor,   brand_name , orderqtymul ,  isdocsexist, created_date,created_user, UPDATED_USER, UPDATED_DATE,
isbomexist, weight_hanging,actual_date,subcategory,   dye_house,  knit_cost,
mach_type, greige_yld,greige_wdt,inch_revo, cutline, fin_color,  gum_trim,   fin_yield,
fin_width,shrink,torque,dye_loss,knit_loss, yarn_size,  descript_style,       percentage,
fin_colorno, comments,yarn_size1, yarn_size2, yarn_size3, yarn_size4, descript_style1,      descript_style2,      descript_style3,
descript_style4,percentage1,percentage2,percentage3,percentage4,knit_house, 
customer,   customer_style, customer_color, marketer,merchandiser,coordinator,comminv_descript,
stitch_hor,stitch_ver,HarmonizeCode,QuotaCategory, YarnWeight, YarnCost, pricex,
  gauge_yarn, shipnote, fab_code , groupname, refstyle, refMasterStyle , @cutno, 'SAMP'
 from ivtf where code = @code AND color = @color and isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(@royaltor, '') )

/* also copy image, 150709 dan - add image3 and image4 & thumbnails and icons */
/*170415 Arun - check if the image exists in the ivtf_image first*/
/*if primary key is set as style+color+royaltor*/
/*
if  exists(select ivtf_image.style FROM ivtf_image WHERE rtrim(ivtf_image.style)=rtrim(@code)  AND rtrim(ivtf_image.color) =rtrim(@color)
  AND rtrim(isnull(ivtf_image.royaltor,'')) = rtrim(isnull(@royaltor,'')))
  begin
	insert into ivtf_image (sample_upc, style, color, style_image1,style_image2, style_image3, style_image4, 
		thumbnail1, thumbnail2, thumbnail3, thumbnail4, icon1, icon2, icon3, icon4, id1, id2, id3, id4)
	  select @upc, ivtf.code, ivtf.color, i2.style_image1, i2.style_image2, 
		i2.style_image3, i2.style_image4, 
		i2.thumbnail1, i2.thumbnail2, i2.thumbnail3, i2.thumbnail4, i2.icon1, i2.icon2, i2.icon3, i2.icon4, 
		i2.id1, i2.id2, i2.id3, i2.id4 
		 from ivtf join ivtf_image i2 on i2.style = ivtf.code AND i2.color = ivtf.color 
		 AND isnull(i2.royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')
	 where rtrim(ivtf.code)=rtrim(@code)  AND rtrim(ivtf.color) =rtrim(@color)
	  AND rtrim(isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'')) = rtrim(isnull(@royaltor,''))
	End
*/
/* 160111 dan - also copy the Vendor costing if it exists */
if exists (select code from ivtf_vendor_cost where code = @code AND color = @color  )
	BEGIN 
		select @customer_style=customer_style, @customer_color=customer_color from ivtf_sample where upc=@upc 

		insert into ivtf_sample_vendor_cost (sample_upc,
		code ,color,
		vend1,price1,priceTerms1,date1,note1,selected1,
		vend2 ,price2 ,priceTerms2 ,date2,note2,selected2,
		vend3,price3,priceTerms3,date3,note3,selected3,
		vend4 ,price4 ,priceTerms4 ,date4 ,note4 ,selected4 ,
		vend5 ,price5 ,priceTerms5 ,date5 ,note5 ,selected5 ,
		vend6 ,price6 ,priceTerms6 ,date6 ,note6 ,selected6 ,
		vend7 ,price7 ,priceTerms7 ,date7 ,note7 ,selected7,
		vend8,price8 ,priceTerms8 ,date8,note8 ,selected8 ,
		vend9 ,price9 ,priceTerms9 ,date9 ,note9 ,selected9 ,
		memo )
		
		select @upc, code, color, 
		vend1,price1,priceTerms1,date1,note1,selected1,
		vend2 ,price2 ,priceTerms2 ,date2,note2,selected2,
		vend3,price3,priceTerms3,date3,note3,selected3,
		vend4 ,price4 ,priceTerms4 ,date4 ,note4 ,selected4 ,
		vend5 ,price5 ,priceTerms5 ,date5 ,note5 ,selected5 ,
		vend6 ,price6 ,priceTerms6 ,date6 ,note6 ,selected6 ,
		vend7 ,price7 ,priceTerms7 ,date7 ,note7 ,selected7,
		vend8,price8 ,priceTerms8 ,date8,note8 ,selected8 ,
		vend9 ,price9 ,priceTerms9 ,date9 ,note9 ,selected9 ,
		memo from ivtf_vendor_cost where code = @code AND color = @color 

	END 
/*171011 Arun - insert into code_sku table also as per david*/ 

if NOT exists(Select top 1 sku FROM code_sku WHERE code_sku.sku = @upc) 
	begin
		INSERT INTO code_sku(custid, sku, upc_check_digit, style, color, royaltor) 
		VALUES('INTERNAL', @upc, dbo.fn_check_digit9(@upc), @code, @color, @royaltor)
	end

sp_system_date 



create procedure sp_system_date 
as 
begin 
declare @err int, 
@rcount int 
select getdate()       
return 
end 
;

sp_upd_pickd_packlist CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_upd_pickd_packlist] 
(@pickno INT) 
AS 
DECLARE @style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10)
DECLARE @pack1 INT, @pack2 INT, @pack3 INT, @pack4 INT, @pack5 INT,
@pack6 INT,@pack7 INT, @pack8 INT, @pack9 INT, @pack10 INT,
@pack11 INT, @pack12 INT
BEGIN
DECLARE cur_pack CURSOR FOR
	SELECT style, color, royaltor,
	sum(isnull(p.qty1,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )) ,
	sum(isnull(p.qty2,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )) ,
	sum(isnull(p.qty3,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )),
	sum(isnull(p.qty4,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )),
	sum(isnull(p.qty5,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )),
	sum(isnull(p.qty6,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )) ,
	sum(isnull(p.qty7,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )),
	sum(isnull(p.qty8,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )) ,
	sum(isnull(p.qty9,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )),
	sum(isnull(p.qty10,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )),
	sum(isnull(p.qty11,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 )) ,
	sum(isnull(p.qty12,0) * (endbox - begbox +1 ))
	FROM packlist p
	JOIN invhead_box ON p.pickno = invhead_box.pickno and p.boxno = invhead_box.boxno
	WHERE p.pickno = @pickno
	GROUP BY p.pickno, style, color, royaltor
OPEN cur_pack 
FETCH cur_pack INTO @style, @color, @royaltor ,@pack1, @pack2,@pack3,@pack4,@pack5,@pack6,
@pack7,@pack8,@pack9,@pack10,@pack11,@pack12
While (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
	BEGIN
		UPDATE pickdetail SET qty1 = @pack1,qty2 = @pack2, 	qty3 = @pack3, qty4 = @pack4,
		qty5 = @pack5, qty6 = @pack6, qty7 = @pack7, qty8 = @pack8, qty9 = @pack9,
		qty10 = @pack10, qty11 = @pack11, qty12 = @pack12 WHERE pickno =@pickno AND style =@style AND color =@color 
		AND royaltor = @royaltor
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur_pack  INTO @style, @color, @royaltor,@pack1, @pack2,@pack3,@pack4,@pack5,@pack6,
@pack7,@pack8,@pack9,@pack10,@pack11,@pack12
	END
	CLose cur_pack 
	Deallocate cur_pack
END

sp_update_cutdetail_line_new CREATE procedure sp_update_cutdetail_line_new (@cutno int) AS
DECLARE @lineno int
DECLARE @cutdetail_id int
DECLARE @line_increment int
DECLARE @row_num int
declare code_cutdetail_line cursor for
SELECT row_number() Over(ORDER By cutdetail_id, line  ) ,isnull(line,0), cutdetail_id FROM cutdetail WHERE cutno = @cutno
OPEN code_cutdetail_line
FETCH code_cutdetail_line INTO @row_num, @lineno, @cutdetail_id
While (@@fetch_status = 0)
BEGIN
       SET @line_increment = @lineno + 1
       
       UPDATE cutdetail SET line = @row_num WHERE cutno = @cutno AND cutdetail_id = @cutdetail_id

       FETCH code_cutdetail_line INTO @row_num,@lineno, @cutdetail_id
END
CLOSE code_cutdetail_line
DEALLOCATE code_cutdetail_line
