CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_update_cutpdm_date] (@fromcut int, @tocut int) as

Declare @fromcutno int
Declare @tocutno int

Begin
Select @fromcutno = @fromcut
select @tocutno = @tocut

update webcutheaderpdm set date1=dateadd(day,PdmHDay1,cutheader.issuedate),date2=dateadd(day,PdmHDay2,cutheader.issuedate),
date3=dateadd(day,PdmHDay4,cutheader.issuedate),date5=dateadd(day,PdmHDay5,cutheader.issuedate),
date6=dateadd(day,PdmHDay6,cutheader.issuedate),date7=dateadd(day,PdmHDay7,cutheader.issuedate),
date8=dateadd(day,PdmHDay8,cutheader.issuedate),date9=dateadd(day,PdmHDay9,cutheader.issuedate),
date10=dateadd(day,PdmHDay10,cutheader.issuedate),date11=dateadd(day,PdmHDay11,cutheader.issuedate),
date12=dateadd(day,PdmHDay12,cutheader.issuedate),date13=dateadd(day,PdmHDay13,cutheader.issuedate),
date14=dateadd(day,PdmHDay14,cutheader.issuedate),date15=dateadd(day,PdmHDay15,cutheader.issuedate),
date16=dateadd(day,PdmHDay16,cutheader.issuedate),date17=dateadd(day,PdmHDay17,cutheader.issuedate),
date18=dateadd(day,PdmHDay18,cutheader.issuedate),date19=dateadd(day,PdmHDay19,cutheader.issuedate),
date20=dateadd(day,PdmHDay20,cutheader.issuedate),date21=dateadd(day,PdmHDay21,cutheader.issuedate),
date22=dateadd(day,PdmHDay22,cutheader.issuedate),date23=dateadd(day,PdmHDay23,cutheader.issuedate),
date24=dateadd(day,PdmHDay24,cutheader.issuedate),date25=dateadd(day,PdmHDay25,cutheader.issuedate)
from webcutheaderpdm join cutheader on webcutheaderpdm.cutno = cutheader.cutno  
                     left outer join webpdmheads on cutheader.ms_type = webpdmheads.code  
 WHERE 
         ( ( cutheader.cutno between @fromcutno and @tocutno ) ) 

end

CREATE PROC sp_UPDATE_FILENO AS

DECLARE LOGFDETAIL_Cursor CURSOR FOR
SELECT LOGFDETAIL_ID, LOGNO FROM LOGFDETAIL WHERE CUTNO > 0 

DECLARE @LOGID int,
	@LOGNO int

OPEN LOGFDETAIL_Cursor

FETCH NEXT FROM LOGFDETAIL_Cursor INTO @LOGID,
				       @LOGNO

BEGIN

UPDATE LOGFDETAIL SET LOGFDETAIL.FILENO = (SELECT REFNO FROM LOGFHEADER WHERE LOGNO = @LOGNO)
WHERE LOGFDETAIL.LOGFDETAIL_ID = @LOGID



FETCH NEXT FROM LOGFDETAIL_Cursor INTO @LOGID,
				       @LOGNO

END
CLOSE LOGFDETAIL_Cursor
DEALLOCATE LOGFDETAIL_Cursor







sp_update_fileno_qty 


--drop proc sp_update_fileno_qty
CREATE PROC sp_update_fileno_qty AS

DECLARE fileno_Cursor CURSOR FOR

SELECT fileno from import

DECLARE @import int,
	@TOTAL INT

OPEN fileno_Cursor

FETCH NEXT FROM fileno_Cursor INTO @import
			

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

BEGIN
SELECT @TOTAL = SUM(coalesce(qty1,0)+coalesce(qty2,0)+coalesce(qty3,0)+
		     coalesce(qty4,0)+coalesce(qty5,0)+coalesce(qty6,0)+
		     coalesce(qty7,0)+coalesce(qty8,0)+coalesce(qty9,0)+
		     coalesce(qty10,0)+coalesce(qty11,0)+coalesce(qty12,0))
		from logfdetail where location <> 'CUT' AND FILENO = @IMPORT

update import set totalqty = @TOTAL WHERE FILENO = @IMPORT

SELECT @TOTAL = SUM(coalesce(qty1,0)+coalesce(qty2,0)+coalesce(qty3,0)+
		     coalesce(qty4,0)+coalesce(qty5,0)+coalesce(qty6,0)+
		     coalesce(qty7,0)+coalesce(qty8,0)+coalesce(qty9,0)+
		     coalesce(qty10,0)+coalesce(qty11,0)+coalesce(qty12,0))
		from logfdetail where location = 'HOUS' AND FILENO = @IMPORT

update import set recv_qty = @TOTAL WHERE FILENO = @IMPORT

FETCH NEXT FROM fileno_Cursor INTO @import

END
CLOSE fileno_Cursor
DEALLOCATE fileno_Cursor




SP_UPDATE_IMPORT_QTY 
CREATE PROC [dbo].[SP_UPDATE_IMPORT_QTY](@LIMPORT INT,@LID nchar(1), @LOCATION nchar(4)) AS

DECLARE @IMPORT INT,
	@ID nchar(1),
	@TOTAL INT


BEGIN

SELECT @IMPORT = @LIMPORT
SELECT @ID = @LID

SELECT @TOTAL = SUM(COALESCE(QTY1,0)+COALESCE(QTY2,0)+COALESCE(QTY3,0)+
		     COALESCE(QTY4,0)+COALESCE(QTY5,0)+COALESCE(QTY6,0)+
		     COALESCE(QTY7,0)+COALESCE(QTY8,0)+COALESCE(QTY9,0)+
		     COALESCE(QTY10,0)+COALESCE(QTY11,0)+COALESCE(QTY12,0))
		FROM LOGFDETAIL 
	WHERE LOCATION = @LOCATION  AND 
		COALESCE(QTY1,0)+COALESCE(QTY2,0)+ COALESCE(QTY3,0) +
		COALESCE(QTY4,0)+COALESCE(QTY5,0)+ COALESCE(QTY6,0) +
		COALESCE(QTY7,0)+COALESCE(QTY8,0)+ COALESCE(QTY9,0) +
		COALESCE(QTY10,0)+COALESCE(QTY11,0)+ COALESCE(QTY12,0) > 0 
		AND FILENO = @IMPORT AND IMPORTNUM_ID = @ID
UPDATE IMPORT SET TOTALQTY = @TOTAL WHERE FILENO = @IMPORT AND IMPORTNUM_ID = @ID

SELECT @TOTAL = SUM(COALESCE(QTY1,0)+COALESCE(QTY2,0)+COALESCE(QTY3,0)+
		     COALESCE(QTY4,0)+COALESCE(QTY5,0)+COALESCE(QTY6,0)+
		     COALESCE(QTY7,0)+COALESCE(QTY8,0)+COALESCE(QTY9,0)+
		     COALESCE(QTY10,0)+COALESCE(QTY11,0)+COALESCE(QTY12,0))
		FROM LOGFDETAIL WHERE LOCATION = 'HOUS' AND FILENO = @IMPORT AND IMPORTNUM_ID = @ID

UPDATE IMPORT SET RECV_QTY = @TOTAL WHERE FILENO = @IMPORT AND IMPORTNUM_ID = @ID

END 

/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/


SET ANSI_NULLS ON

sp_update_invdetail_line 
create PROC [dbo].[sp_update_invdetail_line] (@invoiceno INT)
AS
DECLARE @invdetail_id INT
DECLARE @line int
DECLARE @line2 int
 set @line2=1
DECLARE con_curs CURSOR FOR
	SELECT invdetail_id 
	FROM invdetail WHERE invoiceno = @invoiceno
	FOR READ ONLY

OPEN con_curs
FETCH con_curs INTO @invdetail_id

-- loop until meet end of selected row
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN

		UPDATE invdetail SET line2 = @line2
		WHERE invdetail_id = @invdetail_id	

		FETCH con_curs INTO @invdetail_id
  set @line2=@line2+1
	END
update invdetail set line=line2 where invoiceno=@invoiceno
CLOSE con_curs
DEALLOCATE con_curs

sp_update_invheader_invdetail_total Create Procedure sp_update_invheader_invdetail_total 
AS 
BEGIN
DECLARE @invoiceno int
DECLARE cur_invoice CURSOR  FOR 
SELECT invheader.invoiceno
FROM invheader JOIN invdetail ON invdetail.invoiceno = invheader.invoiceno 
WHERE isnull(invheader.Closed, 'N') = 'N'  
GROUP BY invheader.invoiceno , invheader.subtotal
HAVING SUM(invdetail.qty*isnull(invdetail.price,0)) <> invheader.subtotal
OPEN cur_invoice 
FETCH NEXT FROM cur_invoice INTO @invoiceno
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
BEGIN
	UPDATE invheader SET subtotal = det_total 
	FROM invheader JOIN (SELECT invoiceno as invno, sum(invdetail.qty*isnull(price,0)) as det_total
	FROM invdetail GROUP BY invoiceno ) a ON a.invno = invheader.invoiceno
	WHERE invheader.invoiceno = @invoiceno 
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_invoice INTO @invoiceno
END

CLOSE cur_invoice
DEALLOCATE cur_invoice

END

sp_update_ivtf_upc 
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_update_ivtf_upc]
as
declare @style nchar(13)
declare @color nchar(12)
declare @royaltor nchar(10)
declare @upc nchar(20)
declare @chk nchar(1)
declare @pack int

declare cursor_upc cursor for 

	select style, color, sku, upc_check_digit, pack = 
      	CASE ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack1,0))))+ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack2,0))))+ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack3,0))))+
	ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack4,0))))+ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack5,0))))+ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack6,0))))+
	ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack7,0))))+ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack8,0))))+ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack9,0))))+
	ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack10,0))))+ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack11,0))))+ltrim(rtrim(str(isnull(pack12,0))))
        WHEN '100000000000' THEN 1 WHEN '010000000000' THEN 2 WHEN '001000000000' THEN 3 WHEN '000100000000' THEN 4
        WHEN '000010000000' THEN 5 WHEN '000001000000' THEN 6 WHEN '000000100000' THEN 7 WHEN '000000010000' THEN 8
        WHEN '000000001000' THEN 9 WHEN '000000000100' THEN 10 WHEN '000000000010' THEN 11 WHEN '000000000001' THEN 12
        ELSE 13 END,isnull(royaltor,'')
	from code_sku where custid = 'UPC'

open cursor_upc
fetch cursor_upc into @style,@color,@upc,@chk,@pack,@royaltor
/* Cursor for sodetail(host) - End */
	while (@@fetch_status=0)
		begin
			if @pack = 1 
			update ivtf set upc=@upc, upc_chk=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 2 
			update ivtf set upc2=@upc, upc_chk2=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 3 
			update ivtf set upc3=@upc, upc_chk3=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 4 
			update ivtf set upc4=@upc, upc_chk4=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 5 
			update ivtf set upc5=@upc, upc_chk5=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 6 
			update ivtf set upc6=@upc, upc_chk6=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 7 
			update ivtf set upc7=@upc, upc_chk7=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 8 
			update ivtf set upc8=@upc, upc_chk8=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 9 
			update ivtf set upc9=@upc, upc_chk9=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 10 
			update ivtf set upc10=@upc, upc_chk10=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 11 
			update ivtf set upc11=@upc, upc_chk11=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor
			if @pack = 12 
			update ivtf set upc12=@upc, upc_chk12=@chk where code = @style and color = @color and royaltor = @royaltor

			fetch cursor_upc into @style,@color,@upc,@chk,@pack,@royaltor
		end
close cursor_upc
deallocate cursor_upc

sp_update_ivtf_user1_eta 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_update_ivtf_user1_eta] as

sp_update_multi_colors CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_update_multi_colors]

		SELECT 'No Images uploaded for style ' + @style

sp_update_nrf_code 
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_update_nrf_code (@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12))
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @customer_color nchar(10)

SELECT @customer_color = isnull(nrf_code, '') FROM color WHERE code = @color

UPDATE ivtf SET customer_color = @customer_color WHERE code = @style and color = @color

END 


sp_update_nrf_code_all 
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_update_nrf_code_all 
 AS
DECLARE nrf_style_color CURSOR FOR
SELECT code , color FROM IVTF

declare @code  nchar(13),
		@color nchar(12),
		@cnt int

open nrf_style_color 
Fetch nrf_style_color into @code, @color

select @cnt = 0
while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin

/* Execute the main store procedure with parm*/
exec sp_update_nrf_code @code, @color

select @cnt = @cnt + 1

	/* fetch next row */
fetch nrf_style_color into @code, @color
END
/*Close and Deallocate */
/* clean up */
close nrf_style_color

select @cnt
deallocate nrf_style_color

sp_update_pickdetail_line 

CREATE procedure sp_update_pickdetail_line (@pickno int) AS
DECLARE @lineno int
DECLARE @pickdetail_id int
DECLARE @line_increment int
DECLARE @row_num int
declare code_pickdetail_line cursor for
SELECT row_number() Over(ORDER By pickdetail_id, line  ) ,isnull(line,0), pickdetail_id FROM pickdetail WHERE pickno = @pickno
OPEN code_pickdetail_line
FETCH code_pickdetail_line INTO @row_num, @lineno, @pickdetail_id
While (@@fetch_status = 0)
BEGIN
       SET @line_increment = @lineno + 1
       
       UPDATE pickdetail SET line = @row_num WHERE pickno = @pickno AND pickdetail_id = @pickdetail_id

       FETCH code_pickdetail_line INTO @row_num,@lineno, @pickdetail_id
END
CLOSE code_pickdetail_line
DEALLOCATE code_pickdetail_line

sp_update_pickdetail_line_all CREATE procedure sp_update_pickdetail_line_all
AS
declare @pickno INT
declare code_pickno cursor for
SELECT pickno FROM pickdetail
OPEN code_pickno
FETCH code_pickno INTO @pickno
While (@@fetch_status = 0)
BEGIN
   execute sp_update_pickdetail_line @pickno
   FETCH code_pickno INTO @pickno
END
CLOSE code_pickno
DEALLOCATE code_pickno

sp_update_pickdetail_wh create procedure sp_update_pickdetail_wh(@pickno INT, @warehouse nchar(2))
AS 
BEGIN
Update pickdetail SET warehouse = @warehouse WHERE pickno = @pickno 
END

sp_update_sodetail_line 
CREATE procedure sp_update_sodetail_line (@orderno int) AS
DECLARE @lineno int
DECLARE @sodetail_id int
DECLARE @line_increment int
DECLARE @row_num int
declare code_sodetail_line cursor for
SELECT row_number() Over(ORDER By sodetail_id, line  ) ,isnull(line,0), sodetail_id FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @orderno
OPEN code_sodetail_line
FETCH code_sodetail_line INTO @row_num, @lineno, @sodetail_id
While (@@fetch_status = 0)
BEGIN
	SET @line_increment = @lineno + 1
	
	UPDATE sodetail SET line = @row_num WHERE orderno = @orderno AND sodetail_id = @sodetail_id

	FETCH code_sodetail_line INTO @row_num,@lineno, @sodetail_id
END
CLOSE code_sodetail_line
DEALLOCATE code_sodetail_line

sp_update_sodetail_line_all 
Create Procedure sp_update_sodetail_line_all 
AS 
Declare @orderno INT
DECLARE code_orderno cursor FOR 
SELECT orderno FROM sodetail 
OPEN code_orderno 
FETCH code_orderno INTO @orderno
While(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
Begin
	Execute sp_update_sodetail_line @orderno
	FETCH code_orderno INTO @orderno
END
CLOSE code_orderno
DEALLOCATE code_orderno

sp_update_sodetail_line_duplicate_orderonly 
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_update_sodetail_line_duplicate_orderonly
AS
DECLARE @orderno int
DECLARE cur_duplicate CURSOR FOR  
SELECT orderno FROM sodetail GROUP BY orderno, line having count(line) > 1 ORDER BY orderno, line 
OPEN cur_duplicate 
FETCH cur_duplicate INTO @orderno
WHILE(@@fetch_status = 0)
BEGIN
	EXEC sp_update_sodetail_line @orderno
	FETCH cur_duplicate INTO @orderno
END 
CLOSE cur_duplicate
DEALLOCATE cur_duplicate

sp_update_soheader CREATE  Procedure [dbo].[sp_update_soheader] (@orderno int) 
as
Begin
Declare @qty int
Declare @price money
select @price=sum(qty*price), @qty=sum(qty) from sodetail where orderno=@orderno; 
Update soheader SET subtotal=@qty,total=@price where orderno=@orderno;  
end 


sp_update_soheader_total CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_update_soheader_total] (@orderno int, @toorderno int = NULL)
AS 
BEGIN

if isnull(@toorderno,0) = 0 
	SET @toorderno = @orderno
update soheader set total = a.sum_total FROM 
soheader JOIN
(select orderno, sum_total = sum((coalesce(qty1,0)+coalesce(qty2,0)+coalesce(qty3,0)+
coalesce(qty4,0) + coalesce(qty5,0) + coalesce(qty6,0)+coalesce(qty7,0)+coalesce(qty8,0)+coalesce(qty9,0)
+coalesce(qty10,0) + coalesce(qty11,0) +coalesce(qty12,0)) * isnull(price,0)) FROM sodetail 
GROUP BY orderno ) a 
ON a.orderno = soheader.orderno 
WHERE soheader.orderno between @orderno AND @toorderno

END 


sp_update_wh_batch CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_update_wh_batch] as

update wh_batch set customer = (select max(customer) from pickheader where wh_batch=wh_batch.wh_batch_id) 
 where isnull(customer,'')=''

update wh_batch set custpo = (select max(custpo) from pickheader where wh_batch=wh_batch.wh_batch_id) 
 where isnull(custpo,'')=''

update wh_batch set distri = (select max(distri) from pickheader where wh_batch=wh_batch.wh_batch_id)
 where isnull(distri,'')=''

update wh_batch set shipvia = (select max(shipvia) from pickheader where wh_batch=wh_batch.wh_batch_id)
 where isnull(shipvia,'')=''

update wh_batch set FACTORED = (select max(factored) from pickheader where wh_batch=wh_batch.wh_batch_id)
 where isnull(factored,'')=''


sp_upgraddiagrams 
	CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams
	AS
	BEGIN
		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagrams') IS NOT NULL
			return 0;
	
		CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagrams
		(
			name sysname NOT NULL,
			principal_id int NOT NULL,	-- we may change it to varbinary(85)
			diagram_id int PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY,
			version int,
	
			definition varbinary(max)
			CONSTRAINT UK_principal_name UNIQUE
			(
				principal_id,
				name
			)
		);


		/* Add this if we need to have some form of extended properties for diagrams */
		/*
		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagram_properties') IS NULL
		BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagram_properties
			(
				diagram_id int,
				name sysname,
				value varbinary(max) NOT NULL
			)
		END
		*/

		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.dtproperties') IS NOT NULL
		begin
			insert into dbo.sysdiagrams
			(
				[name],
				[principal_id],
				[version],
				[definition]
			)
			select	 
				convert(sysname, dgnm.[uvalue]),
				DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(N'dbo'),			-- will change to the sid of sa
				0,							-- zero for old format, dgdef.[version],
				dgdef.[lvalue]
			from dbo.[dtproperties] dgnm
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dggd on dggd.[property] = 'DtgSchemaGUID' and dggd.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]	
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dgdef on dgdef.[property] = 'DtgSchemaDATA' and dgdef.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]
				
			where dgnm.[property] = 'DtgSchemaNAME' and dggd.[uvalue] like N'_EA3E6268-D998-11CE-9454-00AA00A3F36E_' 
			return 2;
		end
		return 1;
	END
	
sp_web_styleLog CREATE procedure sp_web_styleLog (
@style nvarchar(13),
@publicip varchar(255),
@hostname nvarchar(200),
@browser nvarchar(100),
 @TimeStamp datetime,
-- @clicks int,
 @customer nchar(15)
)
as
begin

declare @numstyles int

select @numstyles = isnull(sum(clicks),0) from web_styleLog  where style = @style and customer = @customer

if @numstyles = 0
begin

insert into web_styleLog(style,publicip,hostname,browser,TimeStamp,clicks,customer) values(@style,@publicip,@hostname,@browser,@TimeStamp,@numstyles + 1,@customer)

end

else
begin


update web_styleLog set clicks = @numstyles + 1 where style = @style and customer = @customer

end

end


select   isnull(sum(clicks),0) from web_styleLog
sp_wf_update_ivtf CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_wf_update_ivtf] as
UPDATE IVTF SET ivtf.QTY1=isnull(vlog.qty1,0)-isnull(vinv.qty1,0),
	ivtf.QTY2=isnull(vlog.qty2,0)-isnull(vinv.qty2,0),
	ivtf.QTY3=isnull(vlog.qty3,0)-isnull(vinv.qty3,0),
	ivtf.QTY4=isnull(vlog.qty4,0)-isnull(vinv.qty4,0),
	ivtf.QTY5=isnull(vlog.qty5,0)-isnull(vinv.qty5,0),
	ivtf.QTY6=isnull(vlog.qty6,0)-isnull(vinv.qty6,0),
	ivtf.QTY7=isnull(vlog.qty7,0)-isnull(vinv.qty7,0),
	ivtf.QTY8=isnull(vlog.qty8,0)-isnull(vinv.qty8,0),
	ivtf.QTY9=isnull(vlog.qty9,0)-isnull(vinv.qty9,0),
	ivtf.QTY10=isnull(vlog.qty10,0)-isnull(vinv.qty10,0),
	ivtf.QTY11=isnull(vlog.qty11,0)-isnull(vinv.qty11,0),
	ivtf.QTY12=isnull(vlog.qty12,0)-isnull(vinv.qty12,0)
	from ivtf left outer join v_ivtf_saleout vinv on ivtf.CODE=vinv.style and isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') = isnull(vinv.royaltor,'') and ivtf.COLOR=vinv.color    
              left outer join v_style_log_hous_sum vlog on ivtf.code=vlog.style and ivtf.COLOR=vlog.color and isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') = isnull(vlog.royaltor,'')

sp_WFSearch CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_WFSearch]  @userid nchar(10), @searchText nvarchar(100)  
AS
delete from WFSearch where userid=@userid 
/*Mani.G- 160426 - added -No need to insert IF @searchText is empty, */
IF @searchText='' 
begin 
Return
end 
/* search past search history selection: past 6 months  */
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
		select @userid, 'Hist on '+ convert(char(12), max(searchDate), 101)+' '+convert(char(3), count(*))+' time'+
				(case when count(*)>1 then 's' else '' end)+' ('+left(max(resultText),150) , resultModule, resultKeyValue, 100 - count(*)     
		 from WFSearch_history where userid=@userid and searchText=@searchText and DATEDIFF(mm,  searchDate, getdate() ) < 7  
		 group by userid, searchText, resultModule, resultKeyValue 

/* 160326 dan - check for if user scanned Barcode: will give SQL INT overflow error: max is 2147483647 */ 
/* if number is searched, go through the SO/INV/CUT/PO/RMA */ 
/*Added -Cutticktet - SO#+Customter+Custpo# -160329*/
if ISNUMERIC(@searchText)=1 and len(@searchText)<11 
BEGIN
	insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
		select @userid, 'Order#:'+ convert(char(10),orderno)+' '+isnull(blname,'') , 'SALESORDER', orderno, 200  
			from soheader where orderno = @searchText 
	insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
		select @userid, 'Invoice#:'+ convert(char(10),invoiceno) + ' '+isnull(blname,'') , 'INVOICE', invoiceno, 210  
			from invheader where invoiceno = @searchText 
	insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
		select @userid, 'CUT#:'+ convert(char(10),Orderno)+'Customer:'+isnull(customer,'')+' '+'CustPO#:'+isnull(Custpo,'')+''+contractor+''+
		isnull(style_header,'') ,'CUTTICKET', cutno, 220  from cutheader where cutno = @searchText 
	insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
		select @userid, 'PO#:'+ convert(char(10),orderno)+' '+isnull(blname,'') , 'PO', orderno, 230  
		from poheader where orderno = @searchText 
	insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
		select @userid, 'PICK#:'+ convert(char(10),pickno)+' '+isnull(blname,'') , 'PICKTICKET', pickno, 240  
		from pickheader where pickno = @searchText 
	insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
		select @userid, 'RMA#:'+ convert(char(10),invoiceno)+' '+isnull(blname,'') , 'RMA', invoiceno, 250  
		from rmaheader where invoiceno = @searchText 
END 


/* custPO */ 
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'CustPO#:'+ custpo+' Cust:'+customer , 'SALESORDER', orderno, 310  from soheader where custpo like '%'+@searchText+'%'  
  
   

insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'CustPO#:'+ custpo+' Cust:'+customer , 'INVOICE', invoiceno, 320  from invheader where custpo like '%'+@searchText+'%'  

 
/* style master */
/*170331 Arun added refStyle , refMasterStyle as per Dan Email*/
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Style#'+ code +' Season:'+max(isnull(season,'')) + ' Desc:'+max(isnull(descript,'')), 'STYLEMASTER', code, 330    
	from ivtf where code like '%'+@searchText+'%' or refStyle like '%'+@searchText+'%' or refMasterStyle like '%'+@searchText+'%' group by code 
	

insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Descript:'+ descript, 'STYLEMASTER', code, 340  from ivtf where descript like '%'+@searchText+'%' 
		group by code, descript   

/* customer master */ 
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Code#:'+ code, 'CUSTOMER', code, 350  from customer where code like '%'+@searchText+'%'  
  
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'CompanyName:'+ name , 'CUSTOMER', code, 360   from customer where name like '%'+@searchText+'%'  


/* vendor master */ 
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Code#:'+ code, 'VENDOR', code, 370  from manufacturer where code like '%'+@searchText+'%'  

insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'VendorName:'+ name , 'VENDOR', code, 380  from manufacturer where name like '%'+@searchText+'%'  

/* raw material */
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Code#:'+ code + ' Desc:'+max(isnull(descript,'')), 'FABRIC/TRIM', code, 390  from IVTR where code like '%'+@searchText+'%'
		group by code 

insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Descript:'+ descript , 'FABRIC/TRIM', code, 400  from IVTR where descript like '%'+@searchText+'%'  
  
  /*Mani.G -160425 - Search the style for all modules */ 
/* open orders with style - SO */
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Open Orders with style:'+ style +' Cust:'+(select isnull(max(blname),'') from soheader where orderno=sodetail.orderno), 
	'SALESORDER', orderno, 500  
	from sodetail where style like '%'+@searchText+'%' 
	group by style, orderno 	
	
	/* open orders with style - CUT */
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Open Orders with style:'+ style +' Cust:'+(select isnull(max(customer),'') from cutheader where cutdetail.cutno=cutheader.cutno), 
	'CUTTICKET', cutno, 501 
	from cutdetail where style like '%'+@searchText+'%' 
	group by style, cutno 
	      
	/* open orders with style - PO */
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Open Orders with style:'+ style +' Cust:'+(select isnull(max(blname),'') from poheader where podetail.orderno=poheader.orderno), 
	'PO', podetail.orderno, 502
	from podetail where style like '%'+@searchText+'%'  
	group by style, orderno       

	/* open orders with style - RMA */
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Open Orders with style:'+ style +' Cust:'+(select isnull(max(blname),'') from rmaheader where rmadetail.invoiceno=rmaheader.invoiceno), 
	'RMA', rmadetail.invoiceno, 503 
	from rmadetail where style like '%'+@searchText+'%' 
	group by style, invoiceno 
	
	/* open orders with style - INVOICE */
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Open Orders with style:'+ style +' Cust:'+(select isnull(max(blname),'') from invheader where invdetail.invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno), 
	'INVOICE', invdetail.invoiceno, 504
	from invdetail where style like '%'+@searchText+'%'
	group by style, invoiceno 
		
	/* open orders with style - PICK */
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Open Orders with style:'+ style +' Cust:'+(select isnull(max(blname),'') from pickheader where pickdetail.pickno=pickheader.pickno), 
	'PICK', pickdetail.pickno, 505
	from pickdetail where style like '%'+@searchText+'%'  
	group by style, pickno 

		/* open orders with style - IMPORT */
insert into WFSearch (userid, resultText, resultModule, resultKeyValue, ranking) 
  select top 50 @userid, 'Open Orders with style:'+ style +' Cust:'+(select isnull(max(contractor),'') from logfheader where logfdetail.logno=logfheader.logno), 
	'IMPORT', logfdetail.logno, 506
	from logfdetail where style like '%'+@searchText+'%' and logno=0 and refno='Import' 
	group by style, logno

sp_work_CURSOR 
/* PROCEDURE SCROLLS THROUGH ALL ROWS IN WORKTABLE AND BEGINS ALLOCATION PROCESS*/
CREATE PROC [dbo].[sp_work_CURSOR] AS
DECLARE work_CURSOR CURSOR FOR SELECT sodetail_id,style,color,qty1,qty2,
					qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12
				 FROM workTABLE


DECLARE @w_sodetailid		int,
	@w_style 		nchar(13),
	@w_color 		nchar(12),
	@w_qty1 		int,
	@w_qty2 		int,
	@w_qty3 		int,
	@w_qty4 		int,
	@w_qty5 		int,
	@w_qty6 		int,
	@w_qty7 		int,
	@w_qty8 		int,
	@w_qty9 		int,
	@w_qty10 		int,
	@w_qty11 		int,
	@w_qty12 		int

OPEN work_CURSOR

FETCH NEXT FROM work_CURSOR INTO 
	@w_sodetailid, @w_style, @w_color,@w_qty1 ,		
	@w_qty2 ,@w_qty3 ,@w_qty4 ,@w_qty5 ,@w_qty6 ,		
	@w_qty7 ,@w_qty8 ,@w_qty9 ,@w_qty10 ,@w_qty11 ,@w_qty12 		
			

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

BEGIN

exec 	  sp_ivtf_CURSOR   @w_sodetailid	=  @w_sodetailid	,
	@w_style =@w_style 		,@w_color 	= @w_color 	,
	@w_qty1 = @w_qty1		,@w_qty2 	= @w_qty2	,
	@w_qty3 = @w_qty3		,@w_qty4 	= @w_qty4	,
	@w_qty5 = @w_qty5 		,@w_qty6 	=@w_qty6	,
	@w_qty7 = @w_qty7		,@w_qty8 	=@w_qty8 	,
	@w_qty9 = @w_qty9 		,@w_qty10 	= @w_qty10	,
	@w_qty11 = @w_qty11 		,@w_qty12 	= @w_qty12 		

FETCH NEXT FROM work_CURSOR INTO 
	@w_sodetailid, @w_style, @w_color,@w_qty1 ,		
	@w_qty2 ,@w_qty3 ,@w_qty4 ,@w_qty5 ,@w_qty6 ,		
	@w_qty7 ,@w_qty8 ,@w_qty9 ,
	@w_qty10 ,@w_qty11 ,@w_qty12 		
	

END
CLOSE work_CURSOR
DEALLOCATE work_CURSOR

spex_memo_transfer 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[spex_memo_transfer]
as
declare code_curs cursor for
	select seq_order_no, remark , print_on_invoice 
	from spexoracle..order_remark 
	for read only


/* local variable to hold columns returned from cursor */
declare @orderno int, @remark nchar(60), @print nchar(1)


/* open the cursor and loop it!! */
open code_curs
fetch code_curs into @orderno, @remark, @print

while(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin
	if @print='Y' 
		update soheader set memo=rtrim(convert(nchar(500),memo) ) + ':'+ @remark	
		 where orderno=@orderno
	else
		update soheader set inhouse_memo=rtrim(convert(nchar(500), inhouse_memo) ) + ':'+ @remark	
		 where orderno=@orderno

	/* fetch next row */
	fetch code_curs into @orderno, @remark, @print
	
end

/* clean up */
close code_curs

deallocate code_curs

spExportData_n create proc spExportData_n 
as 

declare @sql varchar(8000)
declare @dbname varchar(100)
declare @fullfilename varchar(100)= 'C:\temp\text.xls'
declare @processeddate nvarchar(25)
set @processeddate = format(getdate(), 'yyyyMMdd')
SET @sql = 'select * from shopify_webhook_process_job where format(processed_date, ''yyyyMMdd'')=' + @processeddate

SET @dbname = DB_NAME()


if @sql = '' or @fullFileName = '' 
begin 
select 0 as ReturnValue -- failure 
return 
end 
-- if DB isn't passed in set it to master 
select @dbName = 'use ' + @dbName + ';' 
if object_id('##TempExportData') is not null 
drop table ##TempExportData 
if object_id('##TempExportData2') is not null 
drop table ##TempExportData2 
-- insert data into a global temp table 
declare @columnNames varchar(8000), @columnConvert varchar(8000), @tempSQL varchar(8000) 

select @tempSQL = left(@sql, charindex('from', @sql)-1) + ' into ##TempExportData ' + 
substring(@sql, charindex('from', @sql)-1, len(@sql)) 

exec(@dbName + @tempSQL) 
if @@error > 0 
begin 
select 0 as ReturnValue -- failure 
return 
end 
-- build 2 lists 
-- 1. column names 
-- 2. columns converted to nvarchar 
SELECT @columnNames = COALESCE( @columnNames + ',', '') + column_name, 
@columnConvert = COALESCE( @columnConvert + ',', '') + 'convert(nvarchar(4000),' 
+ column_name + case when data_type in ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') then ',121' 
when data_type in ('numeric', 'decimal') then ',128' 
when data_type in ('float', 'real', 'money', 'smallmoney') then ',2' 
when data_type in ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') then ',120' 
else '' 
end + ') as ' + column_name 
FROM tempdb.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Columns 
WHERE table_name = '##TempExportData' 

-- execute select query to insert data and column names into new temp table 
SELECT @sql = 'select ' + @columnNames + ', temp##SortID into ##TempExportData2 from (select ' + @columnConvert + ', ''2'' as [temp##SortID] from ##TempExportData union all select ''' + replace(@columnNames, ',', ''', ''') + ''', ''1'') t order by [temp##SortID]' 
print @sql
exec (@sql) 

-- build full BCP query 
DECLARE @bcpCommand VARCHAR(8000) 
SET @bcpCommand = 'bcp " SELECT * from ##TempExportData2 order by temp##SortID " queryout' 
SET @bcpCommand = @bcpCommand + ' C:\Temp\test1.xls -S ' + @@SERVERNAME + ' -c -w -T -U sa -P 15848",-CRAW'
print @bcpCommand 
EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @bcpCommand 
if @@error > 0 
begin 
select 0 as ReturnValue -- failure 
return 
end 
drop table ##TempExportData 
drop table ##TempExportData2 
set @columnNames =' ' 
set @columnConvert =' ' 
set @tempSQL =' ' 
select 1 as ReturnValue



store_insert create procedure [dbo].[store_insert](@customer nvarchar(60),@name varchar(60),@addr1 nvarchar(60),@addr2 nvarchar(60),@city nvarchar(30),@state nvarchar(10),@zip nvarchar(10),@billaddr1 nvarchar(60),@billaddr2 nvarchar(60),@billcity nvarchar(30),@billstate nvarchar(10),@billzip nvarchar(10))
as
declare @count int 
begin
 set @count = (select isnull(max(CONVERT(int,code)),00) from store where customer = @customer) + 1

 insert into store(name,customer,code,addr1,addr2,city,state,zip,billaddr1,billaddr2,billcity,billstate,billzip) values(@name,@customer,@count,@addr1,@addr2,@city,@state,@zip,@billaddr1,@billaddr2,@billcity,@billstate,@billzip)

 print @count
 end

CREATE PROCEDURE [Stores]  AS select Zip, Name, Addr1, City, State, '('+left(Phone1,3)+')'+substring(phone1,4,3)+'-'+substring(phone1,7,20) Phone from 
store order by zip,name

test CREATE procedure test @basedata varchar(max)
as
begin
--set @basedata=''
Declare @index integer
Declare @cnt integer
Declare @incre integer
Declare @thumb varchar(max)
Declare @based varchar(max)
Declare @data varchar(max)

Set @index = 1 
Set @cnt=1
Set @thumb=''
Set @based=convert(varchar(max),@basedata)
Set @data=convert(varchar(max),@basedata)
Set @incre = 4

while @index < len(@based)
 begin
	if @cnt=4
 	begin
 	--print @based
	--print @data
	--print @index
		set @cnt=1
		set @thumb=@thumb + substring(@data,4,1)
		set @data=right(@data,len(@data)-@incre)
	end
		else
	begin
		set @cnt=@cnt+1
	end
	set @index=@index+1
end
print @thumb
end
TestCharindex CREATE procedure TestCharindex
@name nvarchar(max),
@search nvarchar(10)
as begin 

--set @name ='ali reza dar yek shabe barani ba yek  dokhtare khoshkel be disco raft va ali baraye 1 saat anja bud va sepas... ali...'

Declare @a table (pos int)
Declare @pos int
Declare @oldpos int
Select @oldpos=0
select @pos=patindex('%'+ @search +'%',@name) 
while @pos > 0 and @oldpos<>@pos
 begin
   insert into @a Values (@pos)
   Select @oldpos=@pos
   select @pos=patindex('%'+ @search +'%',Substring(@name,@pos + 1,len(@name))) + @pos
end

Select * from @a
end
update_cartitems 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[update_cartitems]
(

  @email1 nvarchar(50),
  @style nvarchar(20),
  @color nvarchar(20),
  @color_code nvarchar(20),
  @UPrice decimal(18,2),
  @size1 nvarchar(10),
  @size2 nvarchar(10),
  @size3 nvarchar(10),
  @size4 nvarchar(10),
  @size5 nvarchar(10),
  @size6 nvarchar(10),
  @size7 nvarchar(10),
  @size8 nvarchar(10),
  @size9 nvarchar(10),
  @size10 nvarchar(10),
  @size11 nvarchar(10),
  @size12 nvarchar(10),
  @quantity1 int,
  @quantity2 int,
  @quantity3 int,
  @quantity4 int,
  @quantity5 int,
  @quantity6 int,
  @quantity7 int,
  @quantity8 int,
  @quantity9 int,
  @quantity10 int,
  @quantity11 int,
  @quantity12 int,
  @totalqty int,
  @totalprice decimal(18,2),
  @rowid int,
  @custcode nvarchar(10),
  @storecode nvarchar(10)  
)
as 
Begin

declare @count int
declare @overallqty int
declare @overallamt decimal(18,2)
select @count = COALESCE(count(*),0) from cart  where email1 = @email1 and style = @style
if (@count > 0)
Begin 
update cart set color = @color,color_code=@color_code, UPrice = @UPrice  ,
quantity1 = @quantity1 ,quantity2 = @quantity2 ,quantity3 =  @quantity3 ,quantity4  = @quantity4,quantity5 =  @quantity5 ,quantity6 =  @quantity6 ,
quantity7  = @quantity7,quantity8 =  @quantity8,quantity9  = @quantity9,quantity10 =  @quantity10,quantity11 = @quantity11 ,quantity12 =  @quantity12,
totalqty = @totalqty ,totalprice = @totalprice from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode and style = @style and rowid =@rowid and color_code = @color_code

select @overallqty = COALESCE(sum(totalqty),0),@overallamt = COALESCE(sum(totalprice),0) from cart where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode

update cart set overallqty = @overallqty, overallamt = @overallamt where customer = @custcode and  store=@storecode

End

End

update_cutdetail_actual_cost 

/*170713 Arun commented as per Dan Email as some cuts are FOB and will not BOM */
/* 081116 dan - added table IVTF_LOT, performance tuned */
CREATE  procedure [dbo].[update_cutdetail_actual_cost] (@cutno integer )
as
/*170713 Arun commented as per Dan Email as some cuts are FOB and will not BOM */
/*180118 Arun added condition whether to update actual_cost based on Import/Materials Required*/
--if (select use_costsheet from wfsystem3 WHERE wfsystem =1 ) = 'Y'
--begin
	update cutdetail set actual_cost= 
	 ( select sum( - qty * cost ) from logr where cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id ) / qty 
	 where cutno=@cutno 
--end
update sodetail set actual_cost=cutdetail.actual_cost 
from cutdetail where sodetail.cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and cutdetail.cutno=@cutno


update pickdetail set actual_cost=cutdetail.actual_cost 
from cutdetail where pickdetail.cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and cutdetail.cutno=@cutno

update invdetail set actual_cost=cutdetail.actual_cost 
from cutdetail where invdetail.cutdetail_id=cutdetail.cutdetail_id and cutdetail.cutno=@cutno

update ivtf set cost= isnull(cutdetail.actual_cost,0) 
  from cutdetail where cutdetail.cutno=@cutno and 
	ivtf.code=cutdetail.style and ivtf.color=cutdetail.color and 
	isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') = isnull(cutdetail.royaltor,'') 

update ivtf_lot set cost= isnull(cutdetail.actual_cost,0) 
  from cutdetail where ivtf_lot.cutdetail_id = cutdetail.cutdetail_id and cutdetail.cutno=@cutno 

update logfdetail set cost_other = isnull(cutdetail.actual_cost,0) - isnull(cost_freight,0) - isnull(cost,0)  
  from cutdetail where logfdetail.cutdetail_id = cutdetail.cutdetail_id and 
			logfdetail.location='HOUS' and cutdetail.cutno=@cutno

/* 090122 Added by Anand To update fob_price from material used*/
update cutdetail set fob_price = logr.cost 
	from logr where cutdetail.cutdetail_id = logr.cutdetail_id and logr.type = 'C' and 
				logr.code = 'CMT+QUOTA' and logr.cutno =@cutno

Update_DeviceToken CREATE procedure Update_DeviceToken
 (@SourceFrom nvarchar(10), @LoginID nvarchar(100), @iOS_android_DeviceToken nvarchar(255)= null)
 as
 begin
 if(@SourceFrom = 'iOS')
 Begin 
 update company_directory set ios_Device_TokenID = @iOS_android_DeviceToken where login_id = @LoginID
End
if(@SourceFrom = 'android')
 Begin 
 update company_directory set android_Device_TokenID = @iOS_android_DeviceToken where login_id = @LoginID
End


end






update_exchange_rate 


CREATE procedure [dbo].[update_exchange_rate] as
update soheader set currency='USD' where currency is null or currency=''
update soheader set exchange_rate=1.0 where currency='USD' 
update sodetail set currency='USD' where currency is null or currency=''
update sodetail set exchange_rate=1.0 where currency='USD' 
update soheader set exchange_rate = (select conversion from code_currency where code=soheader.currency) where exchange_rate is null

update invheader set currency='USD' where currency is null or currency=''
update invheader set exchange_rate=1.0 where currency='USD' 
update invdetail set currency='USD' where currency is null or currency=''
update invdetail set exchange_rate=1.0 where currency='USD' 
update invheader set exchange_rate = (select conversion from code_currency where code=invheader.currency) where exchange_rate is null

update arcash set currency='USD' where currency is null or currency=''
update arcash set exchange_rate=1.0 where currency='USD' 
update arcash set exchange_rate = (select conversion from code_currency where code=arcash.currency) where exchange_rate is null

update_ivtf_weighted_avg_cost CREATE procedure [dbo].[update_ivtf_weighted_avg_cost] 
as
update ivtf set avgcost = (select sum(qty * (cost_freight+cost_other+cost) ) / sum(qty) 
from logfdetail where qty>0 and location='HOUS' and style=ivtf.code and color=ivtf.color 
group by style, color ) 

UPDATE_IVTR_ONHAND 

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[UPDATE_IVTR_ONHAND] AS
UPDATE IVTR_LOT SET ONHAND=0

UPDATE IVTR_LOT SET ONHAND=(SELECT SUM(ISNULL(QTY,0)) FROM LOGR WHERE 
  IVTR_LOT.TYPE=LOGR.TYPE AND IVTR_LOT.CODE=LOGR.CODE AND IVTR_LOT.COLOR=LOGR.COLOR 
   AND IVTR_LOT.LOT=LOGR.LOT and ivtr_lot.location=logr.location)

UPDATE IVTR SET ONHAND=(SELECT SUM(ISNULL(ONHAND,0)) FROM IVTR_LOT WHERE 
  IVTR_LOT.TYPE=IVTR.TYPE AND IVTR_LOT.CODE=IVTR.CODE AND IVTR_LOT.COLOR=IVTR.COLOR )

/* 070409 dan - also fix the received_qty of podetail */
update podetail set qty2=(select sum(qty) from logr where orderno=podetail.orderno
		and podetail.type=logr.type and podetail.style=logr.code and podetail.color=logr.color and
		location='HOUS' and qty>0 )


update_poheader_AP 
create procedure update_poheader_AP as
update poheader set apbatch = 
(select BatNbr from solomon..apdoc where PONbr = poheader.orderno and PONbr in (select convert(char(10),orderno) from poheader))
update poheader set apamount = 
(select CuryOrigDocAmt from solomon..apdoc where PONbr = poheader.orderno and PONbr in (select convert(char(10),orderno) from poheader))
update poheader set apbalance = 
(select CuryDocBal from solomon..apdoc where PONbr = poheader.orderno and PONbr in (select convert(char(10),orderno) from poheader))

update_sodetail_pick 

create procedure update_sodetail_pick as
update sodetail set pick_qty1=0,pick_qty2=0,pick_qty3=0,pick_qty4=0,pick_qty5=0,
pick_qty6=0,pick_qty7=0,pick_qty8=0,pick_qty9=0,pick_qty10=0,pick_qty11=0,pick_qty12=0 where closed='N'

update sodetail set 
pick_qty1=(select sum(isnull(qty1,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty2=(select sum(isnull(qty2,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty3=(select sum(isnull(qty3,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty4=(select sum(isnull(qty4,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty5=(select sum(isnull(qty5,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty6=(select sum(isnull(qty6,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty7=(select sum(isnull(qty7,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty8=(select sum(isnull(qty8,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty9=(select sum(isnull(qty9,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty10=(select sum(isnull(qty10,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),
pick_qty11=(select sum(isnull(qty11,0)) from pickdetail where closed='N' and sodetail_id=sodetail.sodetail_id),

 where closed='N'

isnull(alloc_qty4,0)+isnull(alloc_qty5,0)+isnull(alloc_qty6,0)+
isnull(alloc_qty7,0)+isnull(alloc_qty8,0)+isnull(alloc_qty9,0)+
isnull(alloc_qty10,0)+isnull(alloc_qty11,0)+isnull(alloc_qty12,0)  ) 
from sodetail where sodetail.orderno=soheader.orderno group by sodetail.orderno )




UPDATE_SOHEADER_HOLD_PASTDUE_CUSTOMERS 
CREATE PROCEDURE UPDATE_SOHEADER_HOLD_PASTDUE_CUSTOMERS 
AS
UPDATE SOHEADER SET CLOSED='H' 
 WHERE CLOSED='N' 
 AND CUSTOMER IN 
(SELECT CUSTOMER FROM INVHEADER
 WHERE CANCELDATE < GETDATE()- 45
 AND CLOSED<>'Y' AND TOTAL-PAYMENT>10)


UPDATE SODETAIL SET CLOSED='H' WHERE CLOSED='N' AND 
 ORDERNO IN (SELECT ORDERNO FROM SOHEADER WHERE CLOSED='H')

WHILE @icount <=@max_count

		WITH(line_id nvarchar(50) '$.id', product_id nvarchar(50) '$.product_id', variant_id nvarchar(50) '$.variant_id',
		quantity decimal(16,3) '$.quantity',
		price decimal(16,3) '$.price',

		end
	end

	@retailerPrice = JSON_VALUE(@jsonValue, '$.price'), @line_status = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.status'),
	@line_no = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.id'),

		SET @size = right(@sku, CHARINDEX('_', reverse(@sku)) -1)

--SELECT @total_wt = ceiling(sum(isnull(Nullif(isnull(ivtf.weight,0),0),1))) FROM pickdetail 
--JOIN ivtf ON pickdetail.style = ivtf.code AND pickdetail.color = ivtf.color 
--AND isnull(pickdetail.royaltor, '') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor, '') and pickdetail.pickno = @pickno
SELECT @total_wt = SUM(ceiling(CASE WHEN isnull(ivtf.weight, 0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE ivtf.weight END))
FROM pickdetail JOIN ivtf ON pickdetail.style = ivtf.code AND pickdetail.color = ivtf.color 
AND isnull(pickdetail.royaltor, '') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor, '') and pickdetail.pickno = @pickno
if isnull(@total_wt,0) = 0
begin
SET @total_wt = 1
end
SET  @volume= Round(@length * @width * @height / 1728,2)
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[invhead_box]([invoiceno],[boxno],[weight],[store], [length],[width],[height],[begbox],[endbox]
           ,[pickno],[boxes],[volume],[code_box],[prepack_bk],[ucc128_no])
	VALUES(0, 1, @total_wt, @storecode, @length, @width, @height, 1, 1,
			@pickno, 1, @volume, @code_box, 'N', '')
	end
	SELECT @invhead_box_id = isnull(max(invhead_box_id),0) FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno
	UPDATE packlist SET invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id WHERE pickno = @pickno
	SELECT @boxqty = totalqty FROM uv_total_box_qty WHERE pickno = @pickno 
	UPDATE pickheader SET boxqty = @boxqty , weight = @total_wt, boxes = 1, volume = @volume, totqty = @boxqty WHERE pickno = @pickno
end

END


usp_acenda_variant_insert /*20210203 Arun - this will update ecomm_ivtf_attrib which will then be used for inventory update*/
Create Procedure usp_acenda_variant_insert(@ijson nvarchar(max))
AS
declare @jsontable Json_parseTable
declare @min_id int, @max_id int , @iCnt int = 0
declare @imageid1 nvarchar(100),@imageid2 nvarchar(100), @imageid3 nvarchar(100), @imageid4 nvarchar(100),
@image_url1 nvarchar(255), @image_url2 nvarchar(255), @image_url3 nvarchar(255), @image_url4 nvarchar(255), 
@variant_id nvarchar(100), @productid nvarchar(100), @ecomm_var_id int, @wf_ivtf_code nvarchar(100), @wf_ivtf_color nvarchar(20)
declare @json nvarchar(max) 

BEGIN

insert into @jsontable(jsonkey, jsonvalue)
select [key], value from openJSON(@ijson, '$.result')

select @min_id = min(table_id), @max_id = max(table_id) FROm @jsontable

SET @iCnt = @Min_id 
while @iCnt <= @max_id
begin /*begin of loop*/
	SELECT @json = jsonvalue FROM @jsontable WHERE table_id = @iCnt
	SELECT @variant_id = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.id'), @productid = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.product_id'), 
	@imageid1 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.images[0].id'), @imageid2 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.images[1].id'),
	@imageid3 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.images[2].id'), @imageid4 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.images[3].id'), 
	@image_url1 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.images[0].original'), @image_url2 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.images[1].original'),
	@image_url3 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.images[2].original'), @image_url4 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.images[3].original'), 
	@wf_ivtf_code = JSON_VALUE(@Json, '$.sku'), @wf_ivtf_color = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.color')
	
	SET @wf_ivtf_code = substring(@wf_ivtf_code, 1, charindex('_', @wf_ivtf_code)-1)

	if Not Exists (select * from ecomm_ivtf_attrib WHERE ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND Ecomm_product_variant_id = @variant_id)
	begin
		insert into Ecomm_ivtf_attrib( Ecomm_platform,wf_ivtf_code, Ecomm_product_id, Ecomm_product_variant_id, 
		ecomm_sku, ecomm_barcode, wf_product_variant, wf_product_barcode, color, size, ecomm_product_variant_title,
		created_date, ecomm_product_image_id1, ecomm_product_image_id2, ecomm_product_image_id3, ecomm_product_image_id4, 
		division)
		select 'ACENDA', substring(sku, 1, charindex('_', sku)-1), product_id, id, sku, upc, color + '^' + size, upc,
		color, size, variant_title,created_date, imageid1, imageid2, imageid3, imageid4,
		'A'from openJson(@json)
		WITH (id nvarchar(100) '$.id', product_id nvarchar(100) '$.product_id', sku nvarchar(50) '$.sku', upc nvarchar(50) '$.barcode', color nvarchar(50) '$.color', size nvarchar(10) '$.size',
			imageid1 nvarchar(100) '$.images[0].id', imageid2 nvarchar(100) '$.images[1].id', imageid3 nvarchar(100) '$.images[2].id', imageid4 nvarchar(100) '$.images[3].id',
			image_url1 nvarchar(255) '$.images[0].original', image_url2 nvarchar(255) '$.images[1].original', image_url3 nvarchar(255) '$.images[2].original', 
			image_url4 nvarchar(255) '$.images[3].original', variant_title nvarchar(110) '$.name', created_date datetime '$.date_created')
	End
	If Not Exists(select wf_ivtf_code FROM ecomm_ivtf_image WHERE ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid)
	begin
		if isnull(@imageid1,'') <> '' 
		begin
			INSERT INTO ecomm_ivtf_image(ecomm_platform, Ecomm_product_id, wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color, ecomm_image_position, ecomm_image_id, create_date, image_src, division)
			VALUES('ACENDA', @productid, @wf_ivtf_code, @wf_ivtf_color, 1, @imageid1, getdate(), @image_url1, 'A')
		end
		if isnull(@imageid2,'') <> '' 
		begin
			INSERT INTO ecomm_ivtf_image(ecomm_platform, Ecomm_product_id, wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color, ecomm_image_position, ecomm_image_id, create_date, image_src, division)
			VALUES('ACENDA', @productid, @wf_ivtf_code, @wf_ivtf_color, 2, @imageid2, getdate(), @image_url2, 'A')
		end
		if isnull(@imageid3,'') <> '' 
		begin
			INSERT INTO ecomm_ivtf_image(ecomm_platform, Ecomm_product_id, wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color, ecomm_image_position, ecomm_image_id, create_date, image_src, division)
			VALUES('ACENDA', @productid, @wf_ivtf_code, @wf_ivtf_color, 3, @imageid3, getdate(), @image_url3, 'A')
		end
		if isnull(@imageid4,'') <> '' 
		begin
			INSERT INTO ecomm_ivtf_image(ecomm_platform, Ecomm_product_id, wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color, ecomm_image_position, ecomm_image_id, create_date, image_src, division)
			VALUES('ACENDA', @productid, @wf_ivtf_code, @wf_ivtf_color, 4, @imageid4, getdate(), @image_url4, 'A')
		end
	end
	else
	begin
		if isnull(@imageid1,'') <> '' 
		begin
			UPDATE ecomm_ivtf_image SET ecomm_image_id = @imageid1,  wf_ivtf_code = @wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color = @wf_ivtf_color, image_src = @image_url1
			WHERE ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND ecomm_image_position = 1
			
		end
		if isnull(@imageid2,'') <> '' 
		begin
			UPDATE ecomm_ivtf_image SET ecomm_image_id = @imageid2,  wf_ivtf_code = @wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color = @wf_ivtf_color, image_src = @image_url2
			WHERE ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND ecomm_image_position = 2
		end
		if isnull(@imageid3,'') <> '' 
		begin
			UPDATE ecomm_ivtf_image SET ecomm_image_id = @imageid3,  wf_ivtf_code = @wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color = @wf_ivtf_color, image_src = @image_url3
			WHERE ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND ecomm_image_position = 3
		end
		if isnull(@imageid4,'') <> '' 
		begin
			UPDATE ecomm_ivtf_image SET ecomm_image_id = @imageid4,  wf_ivtf_code = @wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color = @wf_ivtf_color, image_src = @image_url4
			WHERE ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND ecomm_image_position = 4
		end
	end

	SET @iCnt = @iCnt + 1
end /*end of loop*/
END

usp_acenda_variant_insert_all 
CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_acenda_variant_insert_all]
AS
/*whatever has been downloaded to ecomm_product_Download use that to update in ecomm_ivtf_attrib it's needed for inventory updates*/
declare @json nvarchar(max), @_id int 
begin
DECLARE cur_ecomm_product_id CURSOR FOR SELECT _id FROM ecomm_product_download WHERE isnull(processed, 'N') = 'N' AND ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA'
OPEN cur_ecomm_product_id 
FETCH cur_ecomm_product_id INTO @_id
WHILE(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin	
	SELECT @Json = [response_data] FROM ecomm_product_download WHERE _id = @_id
	exec [usp_acenda_variant_insert] @json
	update ecomm_product_download SET processed = 'Y' where _id= @_id
	fetch next FROM cur_ecomm_product_id INTO @_id
END
Close cur_ecomm_product_id
Deallocate cur_ecomm_product_id
End

usp_auto_picktoinvoice_dsco_all 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_auto_picktoinvoice_dsco_all] 
AS 
declare @pickno INT, @inv_generated char (1), @invoiceno int, @html nvarchar(max)
DECLARE cur_pick CURSOR FOR 
SELECT pickno, inv_generated FROM dsco_auto_pick WHERE isnull(inv_generated, 'N') <> 'Y'
OPEN cur_pick 
FETCH cur_pick INTO @pickno, @inv_generated
WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
begin
exec create_invoice_from_pickticket @pickno
SELECT @invoiceno = max(invoiceno) from invheader WHERE pickno = @pickno
if @invoiceno> 0 
begin
	UPDATE dsco_auto_pick SET inv_generated = 'Y', invoiceno = @invoiceno WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(invoiceno,0) = 0
	SELECT @html = dbo.[f_return_order_invoice](@invoiceno)
	exec msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail @profile_name = 'WinFashion', @recipients = 'test@winfashion.com;mohan@winfashion.com;
	gaja@winfashion.com;dhanraj@winfashion.com;krishna@winfashion.com;arun@winfashion.com;sivakumar@winfashion.com;markesh@winfashion.com',
	@subject = 'Alexia Admor - DSCO SALES ORDER / INVOICE COMPARISON', 
	@body = @html, 
	@body_format = 'html'
end
FETCH NEXT FROM cur_pick INTO @pickno, @inv_generated
end
CLOSE cur_pick
DEALLOCATE cur_pick


usp_check_packlist_pick Create PROCEDURE usp_check_packlist_pick (@pickno INT)
AS
Declare @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(10), @prepack_code nvarchar(13),
@qty1 int, @qty2 int, @qty3 int, @qty4 int, @qty5 int, @qty6 int, @qty7 int, @qty8 int, @qty9 int, @qty10 int, @qty11 int, @qty12 INT
Declare @pqty1 int, @pqty2 int, @pqty3 int, @pqty4 int, @pqty5 int, @pqty6 int, @pqty7 int, @pqty8 int, @pqty9 int, @pqty10 int, @pqty11 int, @pqty12 INT
DECLARE @error_count INT = 0
BEGIN

if Not Exists(Select boxno FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno )
Begin
	SELECT 'No Boxing Done.'
End

DECLARE cur_pick CURSOR FOR 
SELECT style, color, royaltor, isnull(prepack_code,''), isnull(qty1,0), isnull(qty2,0), isnull(qty3, 0), isnull(qty4,0), isnull(qty5,0), isnull(qty6,0), isnull(qty7,0), 
		isnull(qty8, 0), isnull(qty9,0), isnull(qty10,0), isnull(qty11,0), isnull(qty12,0)
FROM pickdetail WHERE pickno = @pickno ORDER BY pickdetail_id 
OPEN cur_pick 
FETCH cur_pick INTO @style, @color, @royaltor, @prepack_code, @qty1, @qty2, @qty3, @qty4, @qty5, @qty6, @qty7, @qty8, @qty9, @qty10, @qty11, @qty12
while(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
begin

SELECT  @pqty1 = SUM(isnull(qty1,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)), @pqty2 = SUM(isnull(qty2,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)), @pqty3 = SUM(isnull(qty3,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)),
		@pqty4 = SUM(isnull(qty4,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)), @pqty5 = SUM(isnull(qty5,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)), @pqty6 = SUM(isnull(qty6,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)),
		@pqty7 = SUM(isnull(qty7,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)), @pqty8 = SUM(isnull(qty8,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)), @pqty9 = SUM(isnull(qty9,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)),
		@pqty10 = SUM(isnull(qty10,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)), @pqty11 = SUM(isnull(qty11,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1)), @pqty12 = SUM(isnull(qty12,0) * (endbox - begbox + 1))
FROM packlist p, invhead_box b
WHERE isnull(p.pickno,0) = isnull(b.pickno,0) AND p.boxno = b.boxno AND p.pickno = @pickno AND style = @style AND color = @color AND isnull(royaltor, '') = @royaltor AND isnull(prepack_code, '') = @prepack_code

	if @qty1 <> @pqty1
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty1 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty2 <> @pqty2
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty2 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty3 <> @pqty3
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty3 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty4 <> @pqty4
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty4 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty5 <> @pqty5
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty5 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty6 <> @pqty6
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty6 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty7 <> @pqty7
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + 'qty7 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty8 <> @pqty8
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty8 Mismatched.'  + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty9 <> @pqty9
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty9 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty10 <> @pqty10
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty10 Mismatched.'  + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty11 <> @pqty11
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty11 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		SET @error_count = @error_count + 1
		GOTO label_exit;
	end
	if @qty12 <> @pqty12
	begin
		SELECT @style + '-' + @color + ' qty12 Mismatched.' + ' PT# ' + CAST(@pickno as nvarchar(10))
		GOTO label_exit;
	end

FETCH NEXT FROM cur_pick INTO @style, @color, @royaltor, @prepack_code, @qty1, @qty2, @qty3, @qty4, @qty5, @qty6, @qty7, @qty8, @qty9, @qty10, @qty11, @qty12
end
label_exit:
CLOSE cur_pick
DEALLOCATE cur_pick
if @error_count = 0
--PRINT 'No Mismatch found.'
begin
SELECT 'OK.'
end
END

usp_copy_boxing_pickToInv CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_copy_boxing_pickToInv] 
	(@fromInvPickNo int, @toInvNo int)
as 
Declare @ll_count INT, @begbox INT, @endbox INT

SELECT @ll_count = max(boxno), @begbox = max(begbox), @endbox = max(endbox) FROM invhead_box WHERE Invoiceno = @toInvNo

update packlist SET boxno = boxno + @ll_count, invoiceno = @toInvNo WHERE pickno = @fromInvPickNo;
UPDATE INVHEAD_BOX set invoiceno = @toInvNo, boxno = boxno + @ll_count,
begbox=begbox + @begbox, endbox = endbox + @endbox
WHERE pickno = @fromInvPickNo

usp_copy_cc_info_so_inv CREATE PROCEDURE usp_copy_cc_info_so_inv 
(@orderno INT,@invoiceno INT ) 
AS 
DECLARE @cc_authamount money
DECLARE @auth_customer_profile_id nvarchar(50),
@auth_customer_payment_profile_id nvarchar(50),
@auth_shipment_profileID  nvarchar(50),
@cc_troutD char(15),
@cc_auth char(15)
BEGIN 
SELECT @cc_authamount = cc_authamount, @cc_auth=cc_auth,@cc_troutD=cc_troutD,
@auth_customer_profile_id = auth_customer_profile_id, @auth_customer_payment_profile_id=auth_customer_payment_profile_id,
@auth_shipment_profileID = auth_shipment_profileID from soheader WHERE orderno = @orderno

if @@ROWCOUNT>0

	UPDATE invheader set cc_authamount = @cc_authamount, cc_troutD=@cc_troutD,cc_auth=@cc_auth, 
	auth_customer_payment_profile_id = @auth_customer_payment_profile_id,
	auth_customer_profile_id=@auth_customer_profile_id,
	auth_shipment_profileID= @auth_shipment_profileID
	FROM invheader 
	WHERE invheader.invoiceno = @invoiceno
END 

usp_copy_packlist 
/*190828 Arun - copy to Packlist Stored Procedure will be called when DSCO manual Order Import */
create procedure [dbo].[usp_copy_packlist] (@pickno INT)
AS
declare @length decimal (9,3), @width decimal (9,3) , @height decimal(9,3), @volume decimal (9,3), @weight decimal (9,3), @num_of_box int
declare @code_box nvarchar(10), @invhead_box_id INT, @boxqty INT, @storecode nvarchar(20), @customer_code nvarchar(10)
begin
DELETE FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(invoiceno,0) = 0
DELETE FROM packlist WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(invoiceno,0) = 0
SELECT @storecode = isnull(store,'00'), @customer_code = customer FROM pickheader WHERE pickno = @pickno
insert into packlist([line],[invoiceno],[store],[style],[color],[qty1],[qty2],[qty3],[qty4],[qty5]
        ,[qty6],[qty7],[qty8],[qty9],[boxno],[invhead_box_id],[pickno],[ordered_style],[ordered_color]
        ,[qty10],[qty11],[qty12],[royaltor],[PO1_IN],[multipick],[sodetail_id],[sku_cb],[prepack_code]
        ,[sku_in],[line_mode],[msn_no],[prepack_qty],[packaging_type],[packaging_code],[packaging_descript])
(SELECT line, 0, @storecode, style, color, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, 1, 0, @pickno, 
	ordered_style, ordered_color, qty10, qty11, qty12, royaltor, po1_in, '', sodetail_id, sku_cb, 
	prepack_code, sku_in, line_mode, msn_no, prepack_qty, packaging_type,packaging_code,packaging_descript
	FROM pickdetail WHERE pickno = @pickno)
SELECT @code_box = isnull(box_code,'') FROM customer WHERE code = LEFT(@customer_code,10)
SELECT @length = length, @width = width , @height = height  FROM code_box WHERE code = @code_box
SET  @volume= Round(@length * @width * @height / 1728,2)
INSERT INTO [dbo].[invhead_box]([invoiceno],[boxno],[weight],[store], [length],[width],[height],[begbox],[endbox]
        ,[pickno],[boxes],[volume],[code_box],[prepack_bk],[ucc128_no])
VALUES(0, 1, 1, @storecode, @length, @width, @height, 1, 1,
		@pickno, 1, @volume, @code_box, 'N', '')
	
SELECT @invhead_box_id = isnull(max(invhead_box_id),0) FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno
UPDATE packlist SET invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id WHERE pickno = @pickno
SELECT @boxqty = totalqty FROM uv_total_box_qty WHERE pickno = @pickno 
UPDATE pickheader SET boxqty = @boxqty , weight = 1, boxes = 1, volume = @volume, totqty = @boxqty WHERE pickno = @pickno
END
