		spec_page10,Spec_page10_Thumbnail,spec_page11,Spec_page11_Thumbnail,spec_page12,Spec_page12_Thumbnail,Spec_page13,Spec_page13_Thumbnail,
		Spec_page14,Spec_page14_Thumbnail, spec_page15, Spec_page15_Thumbnail,Spec_page16, Spec_page16_Thumbnail, spec_page17,Spec_page17_Thumbnail,
		spec_page18,Spec_page18_Thumbnail,spec_page19, Spec_page19_Thumbnail,spec_page20,Spec_page20_Thumbnail,spec_page21,Spec_page21_Thumbnail,
		Spec_page22,Spec_page22_Thumbnail,spec_page23, Spec_page23_Thumbnail,spec_page24,Spec_page24_Thumbnail, spec_page25, spec_page25_thumbnail,
		Spec_page26,Spec_page26_Thumbnail FROM ivtf_image WHERE ivtf_image_id = @image_id)
	end
	else
	begin
		UPDATE ivtf_image SET sample_upc= @sample_upc, Spec_page0= v2.spec_page0, spec_page1 = v2.spec_page1, spec_page2 = v2.spec_page2, 
		spec_page3 = v2.spec_page3, spec_page4 =v2.spec_page4, spec_page5=v2.spec_page5, spec_page6 = v2.spec_page6 , spec_page7=v2.spec_page7,
		spec_page8 = v2.spec_page8, spec_page9 = v2.spec_page9, spec_page10=v2.spec_page10, spec_page11 = v2.spec_page11, spec_page12 = v2.spec_page12, 
		spec_page13 = v2.spec_page13, spec_page14 = v2.spec_page14, spec_page15 = v2.spec_page15 , Spec_page16 = v2.spec_page16 , spec_page17 = v2.spec_page17 ,
		spec_page18 = v2.spec_page18, spec_page19 = v2.spec_page19, spec_page20 = v2.spec_page20, spec_page21 = v2.spec_page21, spec_page22 = v2.spec_page22, 
		spec_page23 = v2.spec_page23, spec_page24 = v2.spec_page24, spec_page25 = v2.spec_page25, spec_page26 = v2.spec_page26, Spec_page0_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page0_Thumbnail,
		Spec_page1_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page1_Thumbnail, Spec_page2_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page2_Thumbnail, Spec_page3_Thumbnail= v2.Spec_page3_Thumbnail,
		Spec_page4_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page4_Thumbnail, Spec_page5_Thumbnail= v2.Spec_page5_Thumbnail, Spec_page6_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page6_Thumbnail,
		Spec_page7_Thumbnail= v2.Spec_page7_Thumbnail, Spec_page8_Thumbnail=v2.Spec_page8_Thumbnail, Spec_page9_Thumbnail= v2.Spec_page9_Thumbnail, 
		Spec_page10_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page10_Thumbnail, Spec_page11_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page11_Thumbnail,Spec_page12_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page12_Thumbnail, 
		Spec_page13_Thumbnail=v2.Spec_page13_Thumbnail, Spec_page14_Thumbnail=v2.Spec_page14_Thumbnail, Spec_page15_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page15_Thumbnail, 
		Spec_page16_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page16_Thumbnail, Spec_page17_Thumbnail =v2.Spec_page17_Thumbnail, Spec_page18_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page18_Thumbnail, 
		Spec_page19_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page19_Thumbnail, Spec_page20_Thumbnail=v2.Spec_page20_Thumbnail, Spec_page21_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page21_Thumbnail, 
		Spec_page22_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page22_Thumbnail, Spec_page23_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page23_Thumbnail, Spec_page24_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page24_Thumbnail, 
		Spec_page25_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page25_Thumbnail, Spec_page26_Thumbnail = v2.Spec_page26_Thumbnail
		FROM ivtf_image , ivtf_image v2 
		WHERE v2.ivtf_image_id = @ivtf_image_id
		AND ivtf_image.style = @style AND ivtf_image.color = @color AND isnull(ivtf_image.sample_upc,'') = isnull(@sample_upc,'')
	end

	PRINT @sample_upc + @style +@color

FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_sample INTO @sample_upc, @style, @color 
END
CLOSE cur_ivtf_sample
DEALLOCATE cur_ivtf_sample

usp_create_boxing 
/*create boxing based on pickno, boxno, upc */
CREATE   Procedure [dbo].[usp_create_boxing] (@pickno int, @boxno int, @upc nvarchar(20),@qty int,@deviceNo nvarchar(20), @invoiceno int= null,
@generate_label int = NULL)
As 
declare @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(11), @pack1 int,@pack2 int, @pack3 int, @pack4 int, 
@pack5 int, @pack6 int, @pack7 int, @pack8 int, @pack9 int, @pack10 int, @pack11 int, @pack12 int
declare @sku nvarchar(20), @store nvarchar(10), @customer nvarchar(10), @code_box nvarchar(20), @weight decimal(16,3), 
@begbox int, @endbox int, @length int, @width int, @height int, @volume decimal(8,4), @invhead_box_id INT, @prepack_code nvarchar(20), 
@isPrepack char(1), @sodetail_id int, @sku_in nvarchar(30), @po1_in nvarchar(40), @packaging_type nvarchar(100), 
@packaging_code nvarchar(100), @packaging_descript nvarchar(100), @packlist_id INT, @sku_cb nvarchar(30),@total_wt int = 0, 
@line int, @total_volume decimal (8,4)

BEGIN
If Not Exists( SELECT pickno FROM pickheader WHERE pickno = @pickno) 
begin
return
end
SEt @sku = LEFT(@upc, 11)
SELECT @style = style, @color = color, @royaltor = isnull(royaltor, '') , @pack1 = isnull(pack1, 0), @pack2 = isnull(pack2, 0), @pack3 = isnull(pack3, 0), 
@pack4 = isnull(pack4,0), @pack5 = isnull(pack5,0), @pack6 = isnull(pack6,0), @pack7 = isnull(pack7, 0), @pack8 = isnull(pack8, 0), @Pack9 = isnull(pack9, 0), 
@pack10 = isnull(pack10, 0), @pack11 = isnull(pack11,0), @pack12 =isnull(pack12,0) , @isPrepack = isnull(prepack, 'N'), @prepack_code = isnull(prepack_code_sku,'')
FROM code_sku WHERE sku =@sku 
if @style = '' 
begin
return
end

if Not Exists(select style FROM pickdetail WHERE pickno = @pickno AND style = @style AND color = @color AND isnull(royaltor, '') = @royaltor)
begin
SELECT 'Item missing from Pick#'+cast(@pickno as varchar(10))  as 'SQLResult'
return
end

SELECT @customer = customer , @store = store FROM pickheader WHERE pickno = @pickno

SELECT @code_box = isnull(box_code, '') FROM customer WHERE code = @customer
if @code_box = '' 
begin
SELECT @code_box = isnull(code,'') FROM code_box WHERE isnull(default_box, 'N') = 'Y'
end
SELECT @length = isnull(length, 0), @width = isnull(width, 0), @height = isnull(height,0), @volume = isnull(volume, 0.00) FROM code_box WHERE code = @code_box

SELECT @begbox = isnull(max(endbox), 0)+ 1 FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(invoiceno,0) = isnull(@invoiceno,0)
SET @endbox = @begbox 

SELECT @sodetail_id = isnull(max(sodetail_id),0), @po1_in = isnull(max(Po1_in), ''), @sku_in = isnull(max(sku_in),''), @packaging_code= isnull(max(packaging_code),''), 
@packaging_descript = isnull(max(packaging_descript),''), @packaging_type = isnull(max(packaging_type),''), @sku_cb = isnull(max(sku_cb), '')
FROM pickdetail WHERE pickno = @pickno AND style = @style AND color = @color AND isnull(royaltor, '') = @royaltor AND isnull(prepack_code,'') = @prepack_code

If Not Exists( SELECT pickno FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(invoiceno,0) = isnull(@invoiceno,0) and boxno = @boxno) 
begin
INSERT INTO  invhead_box (pickno, boxno, invoiceno, store, weight, boxes, begbox, endbox, length, width, height, volume, other_information)
Values(@Pickno, @boxno, isnull(@invoiceno,0), @store, @weight, 1, @begbox, @endbox, @length, @width , @height, @volume, @deviceNo)
end
SELECT @invhead_box_id = invhead_box_id FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno AND boxno = @boxno
if Not Exists(SELECT packlist_id FROM packlist WHERE pickno = @Pickno AND boxno = @boxno AND isnull(invoiceno,0) = isnull(@invoiceno,0) AND isnull(prepack_code,'') = @prepack_code)
begin
SElECT @line = isnull(max(line),0) + 1 FROM packlist WHERE pickno = @Pickno AND boxno = @boxno AND isnull(invoiceno,0) = isnull(@invoiceno,0) AND isnull(prepack_code,'') = @prepack_code
INSERT INTO packlist (pickno,store, boxno,line, invoiceno, invhead_box_id, style, color, royaltor, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12, prepack_code,
		PO1_IN, sku_in, sku_cb, packaging_code, packaging_type, packaging_descript, sodetail_id)
VALUES(@pickno,@store, @boxno, @line, isnull(@invoiceno, 0), @invhead_box_id, @style, @color, @royaltor, @pack1*@qty, @pack2 *@qty, @pack3*@qty, @pack4*@qty, @pack5*@qty,
@pack6*@qty, @pack7*@qty, @pack8*@qty, @pack9*@qty, @pack10*@qty, @pack11*@qty, @pack12*@qty, @prepack_code, @po1_in, @sku_in, @sku_cb, @packaging_code, @packaging_type, 
@packaging_descript, @sodetail_id)
End
ELSE
begin
SELECT @packlist_id = packlist_id FROM packlist WHERE pickno = @Pickno AND boxno = @boxno AND isnull(@invoiceno,0) = @invoiceno AND isnull(prepack_code,'') = @prepack_code
update packlist set qty1 = qty1 + @pack1 *@qty, qty2 = qty2 + @pack2 *@qty,qty3 = qty3 + @pack3 *@qty,qty4 = qty4 + @pack1 *@qty,qty5 = qty5 + @pack5 *@qty,qty6 = qty6 + @pack6 *@qty,
	qty7 = qty7 + @pack7 *@qty,qty8 = qty8 + @pack8 *@qty,qty9 = qty9 + @pack9 *@qty,qty10 = qty10 + @pack10 *@qty,qty11 = qty11 + @pack11 *@qty,qty12 = qty12 + @pack12 *@qty
WHERE packlist_id = @packlist_id
END
END

/*weight should be wt * qty */
SELECT @total_wt  = CEILING(isnull(sum(isnull(CASE WHEN isnull(ivtf.weight,0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ivtf.weight END,1) * 
isnull(packlist.qty1,0) + isnull(packlist.qty2,0) + isnull(packlist.qty3,0) + isnull(packlist.qty4,0) + isnull(packlist.qty5,0) + isnull(packlist.qty6,0) 
+ isnull(packlist.qty7,0) + isnull(packlist.qty8,0) + isnull(packlist.qty9,0) + isnull(packlist.qty10,0) + isnull(packlist.qty11,0) + isnull(packlist.qty12,0)),1)) FROM packlist JOIN ivtf ON 
ivtf.code  = packlist.style AND ivtf.color = packlist.color AND ivtf.royaltor = isnull(packlist.royaltor, '')
WHERE packlist.pickno = @pickno AND isnull(packlist.invoiceno, 0) = isnull(@invoiceno,0) AND packlist.boxno = @boxno

SELECT @total_volume = sum(volume) FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(invoiceno,0) = isnull(@invoiceno,0) 

UPDATE invhead_box SET weight = @total_wt WHERE pickno = @pickno AND isnull(invoiceno,0) = isnull(@invoiceno,0) AND boxno = @boxno
UPDATE pickheader SET boxes = (select sum(boxes) FROM invhead_box WHERE invhead_box.pickno = pickheader.pickno), weight = @total_wt, volume = @total_volume WHERE pickno = @pickno 
UPDATE pickheader SET boxqty = (select sum(isnull(uv_total_box_qty.totalqty,0)) FROM uv_total_box_qty WHERE uv_total_box_qty.pickno = pickheader.pickno) WHERE pickno = @pickno 

SELECT @total_wt  = CEILING(isnull(sum(isnull(CASE WHEN isnull(ivtf.weight,0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ivtf.weight END,1) * 
isnull(packlist.qty1,0) + isnull(packlist.qty2,0) + isnull(packlist.qty3,0) + isnull(packlist.qty4,0) + isnull(packlist.qty5,0) + isnull(packlist.qty6,0) 
+ isnull(packlist.qty7,0) + isnull(packlist.qty8,0) + isnull(packlist.qty9,0) + isnull(packlist.qty10,0) + isnull(packlist.qty11,0) + isnull(packlist.qty12,0)),1)) FROM packlist JOIN ivtf ON 
ivtf.code  = packlist.style AND ivtf.color = packlist.color AND ivtf.royaltor = isnull(packlist.royaltor, '')
WHERE packlist.pickno = @pickno AND isnull(packlist.invoiceno, 0) = isnull(@invoiceno,0)


UPDATE pickheader SET weight = @total_wt, volume = @total_volume WHERE pickno = @pickno 

If Exists(select packlist.boxno FROM invhead_box JOIN packlist ON invhead_box.pickno = packlist.pickno AND isnull(invhead_box.invoiceno,0) = isnull(packlist.invoiceno,0)
AND invhead_box.boxno = packlist.boxno WHERE invhead_box.pickno = @pickno AND invhead_box.boxno = @boxno) 
begin
if @generate_label = 1
begin
/*Generate label */
	exec usp_create_ucc128_label @pickno, @boxno, 'Q', @invoiceno
end
SELECT 'Boxing Done Successfully.' as 'SQLResult'
end
else 
begin
SELECT 'Boxing Failed.' as 'SQLResult'
end


usp_create_ucc128_label /*200316 Arun added invoicenum as optional*/
/*insert into bartender, bartender2, bartender3 based on pickno, boxno*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_create_ucc128_label](@pickno INT, @boxno INT, @bar_user nvarchar(10) = NULL, @invoicenum int = null)
AS 
declare @barno int, @packlist_id int, @edi_Store nvarchar(20), @invoiceno int, @blname nvarchar(50),
@s_bar nvarchar(20), @div char(1), @upc_segment nvarchar(10), @is_nine nvarchar(9), @g_nine nvarchar(9),
@billoflading nvarchar(30),@shipvia_descript nvarchar(50),@shipvia nvarchar(20), @scac nvarchar(10),
@releaseno nvarchar(30),@po_id nvarchar(30), @mat_storage_loc nvarchar(100), @store_markfor nvarchar(10),
@familyob nvarchar(100), @style_gap nvarchar(30), @size_gap nvarchar(10) , @qty int, @product_group1 nvarchar(100),
@sku_cb nvarchar(30), @custpo nvarchar(20), @customer nvarchar(10), @hanging_shipment int, @store nvarchar(10), 
@fob nvarchar(20), @shname nvarchar(40), @shaddr1 nvarchar(40), @shaddr2 nvarchar(40), @shcity nvarchar(40),
@shstate nvarchar(10), @shzip nvarchar(10), @shdept nvarchar(10), @dept_Descript nvarchar(40),@storename nvarchar(40), 
@ucc128_location nvarchar(50), @store_addr1 nvarchar(40), @store_addr2 nvarchar(40), @store_city nvarchar(40), 
@store_state nvarchar(10), @store_zip nvarchar(10), @customer_id nvarchar(10), @st_store nvarchar(1), @st_store_st nvarchar(1),
@dc nvarchar(10), @dc_code nvarchar(10), @ll_beg_box_ctr int, @pro_no nvarchar(30), @ls_state nvarchar(10), @ref_phc nvarchar(50), 
@facility_id nvarchar(50), @g_upc varchar(10), @s_bycityzip nvarchar(200), @begbox int, @endbox int,@invhead_box_id INT, @max_endbox int,
@prepack_bk nvarchar(10), @weight int, @trackno nvarchar(30), @mdse_type nvarchar(50), @store_n1st nvarchar(10),
@box_ctr int, @cust_div nvarchar(10), @lbl_dest nvarchar(20), @sku_color_bo1 nvarchar(50),@packaging_type nvarchar(50), @packaging_code nvarchar(50), @packaging_descript nvarchar(200),
@sku_it nvarchar(30),@sku_iz nvarchar(30), @sku_up nvarchar(20), @sku_sk nvarchar(30), @line_mode nvarchar(30), @msn_no nvarchar(30),@warehouse nvarchar(2)
declare @s_from1 nvarchar(50), @s_from2 nvarchar(50), @s_from3 nvarchar(100), @s_from4 nvarchar(20),@s_zip nvarchar(5), @carton nvarchar(50),@style_descript nvarchar(50),
@iCnt int = 0, @invhead_box_seq_id int, @ls_dressbarn char(1) = 'N', @edi_vendorid nvarchar(20), @s_128string nvarchar(50), @s_128check nvarchar(2)
declare @i int = 0, @max_temp_id INT = 0, @min_temp_id INT = 0, @max_edi_id INT = 0, @min_edi_id INT = 0
declare @j int = 0, @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(13), @size nvarchar(10)
declare @qty1 int, @qty2 int, @qty3 int, @qty4 int, @qty5 int, @qty6 int, @qty7 int, @qty8 int, @qty9 int, @qty10 int, @qty11 int, @qty12 int, 
@size1 nvarchar(10), @size2 nvarchar(10), @size3 nvarchar(10), @size4 nvarchar(10), @size5 nvarchar(10), @size6 nvarchar(10), @size7 nvarchar(10), 
@size8 nvarchar(10), @size9 nvarchar(10), @size10 nvarchar(10), @size11 nvarchar(10), @size12 nvarchar(10), @sql nvarchar(4000), @str_s nvarchar(10),
@size_str nvarchar(10), @k int = 0, @sku_in nvarchar(50), @sku nvarchar(50),@sku2 nvarchar(20), @sku3 nvarchar(20), @sku4 nvarchar(20), @sku5 nvarchar(20), 
@sku6 nvarchar(20), @sku7 nvarchar(20), @sku8 nvarchar(20), @sku9 nvarchar(20), @sku10 nvarchar(20), @sku11 nvarchar(20), @sku12 nvarchar(20)


if isnull(@invoicenum,0) >0
begin
if Not Exists(select invoiceno FROM invheader WHERE invoiceno = @invoicenum)
return
end
else
begin
if Not Exists(select pickno FROM pickheader WHERE pickno = @pickno)
return
end


if isnull(@invoicenum,0) >0
begin
if Not exists(select boxno FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno AND boxno = @boxno)
return
end
else 
begin
if Not exists(select boxno FROM invhead_box WHERE invoiceno = @invoicenum AND boxno = @boxno)
return
end
/*delete the existing record based on the Bar_user */
DELETE FROM bartender WHERE bar_user = @bar_user
DELETE FROM bartender2 WHERE bar_user = @bar_user
DELETE FROM bartender3 WHERE bar_user = @bar_user

DELETE FROM v_packlist_sum_by_style
DELETE FROM v_bartender_edi_sku


if isnull(@invoicenum,0) > 0 
begin
SELECT @begbox = begbox, @endbox = endbox,@invhead_box_id = invhead_box_id,@prepack_bk = prepack_bk, @weight = weight,@trackno = trackno
FROM invhead_box WHERE invoiceno = @invoicenum AND boxno = @boxno
SELECT @max_endbox = max(endbox) FROM invhead_box WHERE invoiceno = @invoicenum  /*250424 Arun - to update the correct carton - 28641 */
end
else
begin
SELECT @begbox = begbox, @endbox = endbox,@invhead_box_id = invhead_box_id,@prepack_bk = prepack_bk, @weight = weight,@trackno = trackno
FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno AND boxno = @boxno
SELECT @max_endbox = max(endbox) FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno /*250424 Arun - to update the correct carton- 28641 */
end

SET @bar_user = isnull(@bar_user, 'Q'); SET @g_nine = REPLICATE('0',9)
BEGIN

if isnull(@pickno,0) >0
begin
SELECT @custpo = rtrim(p.custpo), @releaseno = ISNULL(rtrim(p.releaseno),''), @shipvia = rtrim(p.shipvia), @customer = rtrim(p.customer), @billoflading = rtrim(billoflading) , 
	   @hanging_shipment = ISNULL(p.hanging_shipment, 0), @store = rtrim(p.store), @fob = rtrim(fob), @shname= rtrim(shname), @shaddr1= rtrim(shaddr1), @shaddr2 = rtrim(shaddr2), 
	   @shcity = ISNULL(rtrim(shcity), ''), @shstate = ISNULL(rtrim(shstate), ''), @shzip = ISNULL(rtrim(shzip), ''),@shdept = rtrim(shdept), @dept_descript = rtrim(d.descript), 
	   @edi_store = CASE WHEN st.edi_store <> '' THEN rtrim(st.edi_store) ELSE rtrim(p.store) END,@familyob = rtrim(familyob), @storename = rtrim(st.name), @ucc128_location = rtrim(ucc128_location), 
	   @store_addr1 = rtrim(st.addr1), @store_addr2 = rtrim(st.addr2), @store_city = ISNULL(rtrim(st.city), ''),@store_state = ISNULL(rtrim(st.state), ''), @store_zip = ISNULL(rtrim(st.zip), ''), 
	   @shipvia_descript = rtrim(s.descript), @scac = rtrim(scac_code), @customer_id = rtrim(p.customer), @st_store = rtrim(p.shipto_store), @st_store_st = rtrim(st.shipto_store), 
	   @dc = CASE WHEN edi_dc <> '' THEN rtrim(edi_dc) ELSE rtrim(di.code) END, @dc_code = rtrim(st.distribution_center), @ll_beg_box_ctr = c.box_ctr, @pro_no = rtrim(pro_no),
	   @ls_state = rtrim(p.blstate), @ref_phc = rtrim(ref_phc),@facility_id = rtrim(facility_id), @div = isnull(p.user4,''), @invoiceno = isnull(p.invoiceno,0), @warehouse = isnull(nullif(p.warehouse,''), '00'),
	   @blname = isnull(blname, '')
FROM pickheader p left outer join dept d on p.customer = d.customer AND p.shdept = d.code  
				  left outer join distri di on p.customer = di.customer AND p.distri = di.code 	  
				  join store st on  p.customer = st.customer AND p.store = st.code  
				  left outer join shipvia s on p.shipvia = s.code
	              left outer join customer c on  p.customer = c.code
	              left outer join  bol b on  p.bolno = b.bolno
	 WHERE p.pickno = @pickno
END
Else
begin
SELECT @custpo = rtrim(p.custpo), @releaseno = ISNULL(rtrim(p.releaseno),''), @shipvia = rtrim(p.shipvia), @customer = rtrim(p.customer), @billoflading = rtrim(billoflading) , 
	   @hanging_shipment = ISNULL(p.hanging_shipment, 0), @store = rtrim(p.store), @fob = rtrim(fob), @shname= rtrim(shname), @shaddr1= rtrim(shaddr1), @shaddr2 = rtrim(shaddr2), 
	   @shcity = ISNULL(rtrim(shcity), ''), @shstate = ISNULL(rtrim(shstate), ''), @shzip = ISNULL(rtrim(shzip), ''),@shdept = rtrim(shdept), @dept_descript = rtrim(d.descript), 
	   @edi_store = CASE WHEN st.edi_store <> '' THEN rtrim(st.edi_store) ELSE rtrim(p.store) END,@familyob = rtrim(familyob), @storename = rtrim(st.name), @ucc128_location = rtrim(ucc128_location), 
	   @store_addr1 = rtrim(st.addr1), @store_addr2 = rtrim(st.addr2), @store_city = ISNULL(rtrim(st.city), ''),@store_state = ISNULL(rtrim(st.state), ''), @store_zip = ISNULL(rtrim(st.zip), ''), 
	   @shipvia_descript = rtrim(s.descript), @scac = rtrim(scac_code), @customer_id = rtrim(p.customer), @st_store = rtrim(p.shipto_store), @st_store_st = rtrim(st.shipto_store), 
	   @dc = CASE WHEN edi_dc <> '' THEN rtrim(edi_dc) ELSE rtrim(di.code) END, @dc_code = rtrim(st.distribution_center), @ll_beg_box_ctr = c.box_ctr, @pro_no = rtrim(pro_no),
	   @ls_state = rtrim(p.blstate), @ref_phc = rtrim(ref_phc),@facility_id = rtrim(facility_id), @div = isnull(p.user4,''), @invoiceno = isnull(p.invoiceno,0), @warehouse = isnull(nullif(p.warehouse,''), '00'),
	   @blname = isnull(blname, ''),@pickno = isnull(p.pickno,0)
FROM invheader p left outer join dept d on p.customer = d.customer AND p.shdept = d.code  
				  left outer join distri di on p.customer = di.customer AND p.distri = di.code 	  
				  join store st on  p.customer = st.customer AND p.store = st.code  
				  left outer join shipvia s on p.shipvia = s.code
	              left outer join customer c on  p.customer = c.code
	              left outer join  bol b on  p.bolno = b.bolno
	 WHERE p.invoiceno = @invoicenum
--END
end

usp_crosstab_customerpo_status Create Procedure usp_crosstab_customerpo_status 
(  @fromcustomer nvarchar(10), @toCustomer nvarchar(10), @fromcustpo nvarchar(30),@endCustpo nvarchar(30))
AS
DECLARE @cols AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
 declare   @query  AS NVARCHAR(MAX)

select @cols = STUFF((SELECT ',' + QUOTENAME(soheader.store) 
                  FROM sodetail sod JOIN soheader ON sod.orderno = soheader.orderno
			 WHERE ( ( soheader.custpo between @fromcustpo and @endCustpo ) AND  
			( soheader.customer between @fromcustomer and @toCustomer ) )
                    group by soheader.store
                    order by soheader.store
            FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
            ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') 
        ,1,1,'')

print @cols
set @query = N'SELECT *  from 
             (
              SELECT soheader.customer, sodetail.style as style, sodetail.color as color, soheader.canceldate as canceldate, soheader.custpo,
soheader.store as store, sum(sodetail.qty) as qty
FROM sodetail JOIN soheader ON sodetail.orderno = soheader.orderno 
 WHERE ( ( soheader.custpo between '''+@fromcustpo +''' and '''+@endCustpo +''' ) AND  
( soheader.customer between '''+@fromcustomer+''' and ''' +@toCustomer +''' ) )
GROUP BY sodetail.style, sodetail.color, soheader.customer,soheader.store, soheader.custpo,soheader.canceldate
) x
 pivot 
 (
 MAX(qty)
 for store in (' + @cols + N')
 ) p '
print @query
exec sp_executesql @query

usp_dsco_inventory_upload 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_dsco_inventory_upload] 
AS 
BEGIN 
declare @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(11), @user4 nvarchar(1), @_id BIGINT,
@mincount int, @maxcount int, @iCount int
Create table #temp_ivtf_ecomm
(style nvarchar(13), color nvarchar(12), royaltor nvarchar(11), user4 nvarchar(1), _id BIGINT , rowno int, temp_id INT IDENTITY(1,1))

INSERT INTO #temp_ivtf_ecomm(style, color, royaltor, user4, _id, rowno)
(SELECT e.style, e.color, e.royaltor, i.user4, cast(e.ivtf_ecomm_edi_id AS BIGINT), row_number() OVER(ORDER BY e.ivtf_ecomm_edi_id asc)  
FROM ivtf_ecomm_edi e JOIN ivtf i ON e.style = i.code AND e.color = i.color AND isnull(e.Royaltor,'') = isnull(i.royaltor,'') 
GROUP BY e.style, e.color, e.royaltor, i.user4, e.ivtf_ecomm_edi_id)

SELECT @mincount = min(rowno), @maxcount = max(rowno) FROM #temp_ivtf_ecomm 
SEt @iCount = @MinCount
WHILE @iCount <= @maxcount 
begin
	SELECT @style = style, @color = color, @royaltor = isnull(royaltor,''), @user4 = user4, @_id = _id FROM #temp_ivtf_ecomm WHERE rowno = @iCount
	exec usp_DSCO_Inventory_Sync @style, @color, @royaltor, @user4 , @_id
	SET @iCount = @iCount + 1
end

DROP TABLE #temp_ivtf_ecomm
END

usp_dsco_inventory_upload_bystyle /*201110 Arun added to do inventory sync by style */
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_dsco_inventory_upload_bystyle] (@style nvarchar(20), @color nvarchar(20), @royaltor nvarchar(20), @user4 char(1), @ecomm_invt_id int)
AS 
declare @ls_style nvarchar(20), @ls_color nvarchar(20), @ls_royaltor nvarchar(20), @customer nvarchar(20), @_id INT
BEGIN
declare cur_ecomm_edi CURSOR FOR SELECT rtrim(style), rtrim(color),i.royaltor, rtrim(customer), ivtf_ecomm_edi_id FROM ivtf_ecomm_edi i 
	JOIN customer c ON c.code = i.customer WHERE isnull(c.dsco_api_token, '') <> '' AND style = @style AND color = @color AND i.royaltor = @royaltor 
	OPEN cur_ecomm_edi 
	FETCH cur_ecomm_edi INTO @ls_style, @ls_color, @ls_royaltor, @customer, @_id
	WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
	begin
		if Exists(SELECT style FROM ivtf_ecomm_edi i JOIN customer c ON c.code = i.customer WHERE isnull(c.dsco_api_token,'') <> '' AND style = @style AND color = @color)
		begin
			exec usp_DSCO_Inventory_Sync_customer @style = @ls_style , @color = @ls_color, @royaltor = @ls_royaltor , @user4 = @user4 , @_id = @_id, @customer= @customer
			UPDATE ecomm_inventory_update_temp SET is_update = 'Y' WHERE ecomm_inventory_update_temp_id = @ecomm_invt_id 
			print @ls_style + '_' + @ls_color + '_' + @customer
			insert into dsco_inventory_temp(style, color, royaltor, customer, ecomm_id, update_date)
			VALUES(@ls_style, @ls_color, @ls_royaltor, @customer, @_id, getdate())
		end
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ecomm_edi INTO @ls_style, @ls_color, @ls_royaltor, @customer, @_id
	end
	CLOSE cur_ecomm_edi
	DEALLOCATE cur_ecomm_edi
END

usp_dsco_inventory_upload_bystyle_all /*201110 Arun added to do inventory sync by style - This can be used for INVENTORY JOB.*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_dsco_inventory_upload_bystyle_all]
AS 
BEGIN 
declare @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(11), @user4 nvarchar(1), @_id int,
@mincount int, @maxcount int, @iCount int, @customer nvarchar(20),
@ls_style nvarchar(20), @ls_color nvarchar(20), @ls_royaltor nvarchar(20), @temp_id int


Create table #temp_ivtf_ecomm
(style nvarchar(13), color nvarchar(12), royaltor nvarchar(11), user4 nvarchar(1), temp_id INT , rowno int, _id INT IDENTITY(1,1))

insert into #temp_ivtf_ecomm (style, color, royaltor, user4, temp_id, rowno)
(SELECT style, color, '', user4, ecomm_inventory_update_temp_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ecomm_inventory_update_temp_id ASC)
FROM ecomm_inventory_update_temp WHERE isnull(ecomm_platform, '') = 'DSCO' and isnull(is_update, 'N') = 'N')

SELECT @mincount = min(rowno), @maxCount = max(rowno) FROM #temp_ivtf_ecomm
SET @iCount = @mincount
WHILE @iCount <= @maxcount
begin
	SELECT @ls_style = style, @ls_color = color, @ls_royaltor = royaltor, @user4 = user4 , @temp_id = temp_id FROM #temp_ivtf_ecomm WHERE rowno = @iCount
	exec usp_dsco_inventory_upload_bystyle @style= @ls_style , @color = @ls_color, @royaltor = @ls_royaltor, @user4 =@user4, @ecomm_invt_id = @temp_id  
	SET @iCount = @iCount + 1
end

DROP TABLE #temp_ivtf_ecomm

END

declare @json_parsetable dbo.json_parsetable, @min_count int, @max_count int, @icount int, @jsonvalue nvarchar(max),@order_id nvarchar(50),

set @icount = @min_count
WHILE @icount <=@max_count
begin
	SET @sku = ''; SET @color_descript = ''; SET @color_code = ''; SET @style_code= '';SEt @size= ''
	SELECT @jsonvalue = jsonvalue FROM @json_parsetable WHERE table_id = @icount
	if Isnull(@jsonvalue, '')  <> ''
	begin
		if isjson(@jsonvalue) >0 
		begin
		insert into ##line_items (order_id, line_no, customer, custpo, testflag, created_date,edi_store,shipdate,canceldate,  dsco_item_id, quantity, price, sku, ean, upc, partnerSKU,expectedCost, dsco_wh_id, line_status, message_text, packingInstructions, shipInstructions,retailerPrice, size, departmentId, tradingpartnerID )
		(select @dsco_order_id,@iCount, @customer, @poNumber, @testFlag, @created_date, @edi_store, @shipdate, @canceldate, *  from openJson(@jsonvalue)
		WITH(dsco_item_id nvarchar(50) '$.dscoItemId',
		quantity decimal(16,3) '$.quantity',
		price decimal(16,3) '$.expectedCost',
		sku nvarchar(50) '$.sku',
		ean nvarchar(50) '$.ean',
		upc nvarchar(50) '$.upc',
		partnerSku nvarchar(50) '$.partnerSku',
		expectedCost decimal(16,3) '$.expectedCost',
		dsco_wh_id nvarchar(50) '$.warehouseDscoId',
		line_status nvarchar(50) '$.status',
		message_text nvarchar(max) '$.message',
		packingInstructions nvarchar(max) '$.packingInstructions',
		shipInstrunctions nvarchar(max) '$.shipInstructions',
		retailerPrice decimal(16,3) '$.retailPrice',
		size nvarchar(10) '$.size',
		departmentId nvarchar(20) '$.departmentId',
		tradingpartnerID nvarchar(50) '$.dscoTradingPartnerId')) 
		
		end
	end

	SELECT @dsco_item_id = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.dscoItemId'),@sku = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.sku'), @dsco_item_id = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.dscoItemId'), @deptID = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.departmentId'),
	@deptName = JSON_VALUE(@jsonValue, '$.departmentName'), @retailerPrice = JSON_VALUE(@jsonValue, '$.retailPrice'), @line_status = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.status'), @expectedCost = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.expectedCost'), 
	@consumerPrice = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.consumerPrice'), @line_no = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.lineNumber'),@line_message = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.message'),
	@upc = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.upc')

	DELETE FROM dsco_order_ids WHERE order_id = @order_id AND dsco_item_id = @dsco_item_id

		SET @upc = @sku
	end

	SET @upc = LEFT(@sku,11)
	SELECT @style = max(style), @color = max(color) , @size = max(size_desc) FROM code_SKU WHERE sku = @upc AND custid = 'UPC'

	SET @line_memo = 'SKU:'+ rtrim(@sku) + ',UPC:' + rtrim(@upc) + ',style:' + rtrim(@style) + ',color:' + rtrim(@color) + ',size:' + rtrim(@size)
	if @iCount = 1 
	begin
		SET @ord_Json = @json
	end

	INSERT INTO dsco_order_ids(order_id, line_no, dsco_item_id, sku, upc, ean, partnerSKU, expectedCost, ConsumerPrice, WHcode, RetailerWHCode, dsco_WHID, 
	line_status, message_text, packingInstructions, shipInstructions, style, color, size, retailerPrice, deptID, customer, tradingPartnerID, deptName, 
	created_date,custpo, testflag, ShipCarrier, ShipMethod, ShippingServiceLevelCode, dscoCarrier, dscoShipMethod, dscoShippingServiceLevelCode, 
	retailerShipMethod, retailerShippingServiceLevelCode, retailerShipCarrier, acknowledged_sent) 
	VALUES(@dsco_order_id, isnull(@line_no, @iCount), @dsco_item_id, isnull(@sku,''), isnull(@upc,''), @ean, @partnerSKU, @expectedCost, @consumerPrice, @dsco_whcode, @RetailerWHCode, @dscowhId,
	@line_status, @message, @packingInstructions, @shipInstructions, @style, @color, @size, @retailerPrice, @deptID, @customer, @tradingPartnerID, @deptName, 
	@created_date, @poNumber, @testFlag, @shipCarrier, @shipMethod, @shippingServiceLevelCode, @dscoShipCarrier, @dscoShipMethod, @dscoshippingServiceLevelCode,
	@retailerShipMethod, @retailerShippingServiceLevelCode, @retailerShipCarrier, 'N')
	
	UPDATE ##line_items SET style = @style, color = @color, size = @size, line_memo = @line_memo WHERE line_no = @iCount

SET @iCount = @iCount + 1

END

	end
	else

	qty5 = qty5 + @pack5 * @item_qty, qty6 = qty6 + @pack6 * @item_qty, qty7 = qty7 + @pack7 * @item_qty,qty8 = qty8 + @pack8 * @item_qty, qty9 = qty9 + @pack9 * @item_qty,

create table ##temp_sodetail (sodetail_id int, rowno int, orderno int)

(SELECT sodetail_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sodetail_id), @newOrderno FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno)
(SELECT @rownumber_detail = isnull(max(rowno), 0) FROM ##temp_sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno)

update sodetail set line = @line_number WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id and orderno = @newOrderno
if @line_number = 1 
begin
SELECT @ls_style = style , @ls_color = color from sodetail WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id 
SELECT @ls_season = isnull(season,'') FROM ivtf WHERE isnull(code, '') = @ls_style AND isnull(Color, '') = @ls_color
end
end
SEt @line_number = @line_number + 1
end

           ,[qty10],[qty11],[qty12],[royaltor],[PO1_IN],[multipick],[sodetail_id],[sku_cb],[prepack_code]
           ,[sku_in],[line_mode],[msn_no],[prepack_qty],[packaging_type],[packaging_code],[packaging_descript])
	(SELECT line, 0, @storecode, style, color, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, 1, 0, @pickno, 
		ordered_style, ordered_color, qty10, qty11, qty12, royaltor, po1_in, '', sodetail_id, sku_cb, 
		prepack_code, sku_in, line_mode, msn_no, prepack_qty, packaging_type,packaging_code,packaging_descript
		FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno)
--SET @code_box = 'D1' 
SELECT @code_box = isnull(box_code,'') FROM customer WHERE code = LEFT(@customer_code,10)
if @code_box = '' 
begin
	SELECT @code_box = code FROM code_box WHERE isnull(default_box, 'N') = 'Y'
end
SELECT @length = length, @width = width , @height = height  FROM code_box WHERE code = @code_box
SET  @volume= Round(@length * @width * @height / 1728,2)
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[invhead_box]([invoiceno],[boxno],[weight],[store], [length],[width],[height],[begbox],[endbox]
           ,[pickno],[boxes],[volume],[code_box],[prepack_bk],[ucc128_no])
	VALUES(0, 1, 1, @storecode, @length, @width, @height, 1, 1,
			@pickno, 1, @volume, @code_box, 'N', '')
	end
	SELECT @invhead_box_id = isnull(max(invhead_box_id),0) FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno
	UPDATE packlist SET invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id WHERE pickno = @pickno
	SELECT @boxqty = totalqty FROM uv_total_box_qty WHERE pickno = @pickno 
	UPDATE pickheader SET boxqty = @boxqty , weight = 1, boxes = 1, volume = @volume, totqty = @boxqty WHERE pickno = @pickno
end
insert into [dsco_webhook_process_job] (orderid, ordernumber, import_order_number, memo, processed_date, processed, customer, 
	trading_partner_id, custpo )
VALUES(@dsco_order_id, @consumerOrderNumber, @newOrderno, 'DSCO Customer PO: '+@poNumber + 'imported. WF order# ' +
	 cast(@newOrderno as nvarchar(20)) + '. DSCO Order Download ID: ' + cast(@dsco_webhook_id as nvarchar(20)), getdate(), 'N' , 
	@customer, @tradingPartnerID, @poNumber)

END

declare @json_parsetable dbo.json_parsetable, @min_count int, @max_count int, @icount int, @jsonvalue nvarchar(max),

create table ##line_items (order_id nvarchar(50), line_no int, dsco_item_id nvarchar(50), quantity decimal(16,3),

 style nvarchar(50), color nvarchar(100),tradingpartnerID nvarchar(50), departmentId nvarchar(20) ,

gift_message nvarchar(500), packingslipmessage nvarchar(4000), consumerPrice decimal (16,3) )

insert into @json_parsetable
select 'lineItems', [key], [Value] from OPENJSON(@lineitemsJson) 

/*only for debugging purpose*/
--select 'line_items', [key], [Value] from OPENJSON(@json) 

--select * from @json_parsetable

begin
DELETE FROM dsco_order_ids WHERE order_id = @order_id 
end


select @min_count = min(table_id), @max_count = max(table_id) from @json_parsetable WHERE parent_jsonkey = 'lineItems' 
set @icount = @min_count
WHILE @icount <=@max_count
begin
	SET @sku = ''; SET @color_descript = ''; SET @color_code = ''; SET @style_code= '';SEt @size= ''
	SELECT @jsonvalue = jsonvalue FROM @json_parsetable WHERE table_id = @icount
	if Isnull(@jsonvalue, '')  <> ''
	begin
		if isjson(@jsonvalue) >0 
		begin
		insert into ##line_items (order_id, line_no, customer, custpo, testflag, created_date,edi_store,shipdate,canceldate, 
		dsco_item_id, quantity, price, sku, ean, upc, partnerSKU,expectedCost, dsco_wh_id, line_status, message_text, 
		packingInstructions, shipInstructions,retailerPrice, size, departmentId, tradingpartnerID ,gift_message,packingslipmessage,
		consumerPrice
		)
		(select @dsco_order_id,@iCount, @customer, @poNumber, @testFlag, @created_date, @edi_store, @shipdate, @canceldate,*  from openJson(@jsonvalue)
		WITH(dsco_item_id nvarchar(50) '$.dscoItemId',
		quantity decimal(16,3) '$.quantity',
		price decimal(16,3) '$.expectedCost',
		sku nvarchar(50) '$.sku',
		ean nvarchar(50) '$.ean',
		upc nvarchar(50) '$.upc',
		partnerSku nvarchar(50) '$.partnerSku',
		expectedCost decimal(16,3) '$.expectedCost',
		dsco_wh_id nvarchar(50) '$.warehouseDscoId',
		line_status nvarchar(50) '$.status',
		message_text nvarchar(max) '$.message',
		packingInstructions nvarchar(max) '$.packingInstructions',
		shipInstrunctions nvarchar(max) '$.shipInstructions',
		retailerPrice decimal(16,3) '$.retailPrice',
		size nvarchar(10) '$.size',
		departmentId nvarchar(20) '$.departmentId',
		tradingpartnerID nvarchar(50) '$.dscoTradingPartnerId',
		gift_message nvarchar(400) '$.giftMessage',
		packingslipmessage nvarchar(4000) '$.packingSlipMessage',
		consumerPrice decimal(16, 3) '$.consumerPrice') )
		
		end
	end

	SELECT @code_box = code FROM code_box WHERE isnull(default_box, 'N') = 'Y'

SELECT @length = length, @width = width , @height = height  FROM code_box WHERE code = @code_box
--SELECT @total_wt = ceiling(sum(isnull(Nullif(isnull(ivtf.weight,0),0),1))) FROM pickdetail 
--JOIN ivtf ON pickdetail.style = ivtf.code AND pickdetail.color = ivtf.color 
--AND isnull(pickdetail.royaltor, '') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor, '') and pickdetail.pickno = @pickno
SELECT @total_wt = SUM(ceiling(CASE WHEN isnull(ivtf.weight, 0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE ivtf.weight END))
FROM pickdetail JOIN ivtf ON pickdetail.style = ivtf.code AND pickdetail.color = ivtf.color 
AND isnull(pickdetail.royaltor, '') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor, '') and pickdetail.pickno = @pickno
if isnull(@total_wt,0) = 0
begin
SET @total_wt = 1
end
SET  @volume= Round(@length * @width * @height / 1728,2)
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[invhead_box]([invoiceno],[boxno],[weight],[store], [length],[width],[height],[begbox],[endbox]
           ,[pickno],[boxes],[volume],[code_box],[prepack_bk],[ucc128_no])
	VALUES(0, 1, @total_wt, @storecode, @length, @width, @height, 1, 1,
			@pickno, 1, @volume, @code_box, 'N', '')
	end
	SELECT @invhead_box_id = isnull(max(invhead_box_id),0) FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno
	UPDATE packlist SET invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id WHERE pickno = @pickno
	SELECT @boxqty = totalqty FROM uv_total_box_qty WHERE pickno = @pickno 
	UPDATE pickheader SET boxqty = @boxqty , weight = @total_wt, boxes = 1, volume = @volume, totqty = @boxqty WHERE pickno = @pickno
end

	 cast(@newOrderno as nvarchar(20)) + '. DSCO Order Download ID: ' + cast(@dsco_webhook_id as nvarchar(20)), getdate(), 'N' , 
	@customer, @tradingPartnerID, @poNumber)

END

SELECT @length = length, @width = width , @height = height  FROM code_box WHERE code = @code_box
--SELECT @total_wt = ceiling(sum(isnull(Nullif(isnull(ivtf.weight,0),0),1))) FROM pickdetail 
--JOIN ivtf ON pickdetail.style = ivtf.code AND pickdetail.color = ivtf.color 
--AND isnull(pickdetail.royaltor, '') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor, '') and pickdetail.pickno = @pickno
SELECT @total_wt = SUM(ceiling(CASE WHEN isnull(ivtf.weight, 0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE ivtf.weight END))
FROM pickdetail JOIN ivtf ON pickdetail.style = ivtf.code AND pickdetail.color = ivtf.color 
AND isnull(pickdetail.royaltor, '') = isnull(ivtf.royaltor, '') and pickdetail.pickno = @pickno
if isnull(@total_wt,0) = 0
begin
SET @total_wt = 1
end
SET  @volume= Round(@length * @width * @height / 1728,2)
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[invhead_box]([invoiceno],[boxno],[weight],[store], [length],[width],[height],[begbox],[endbox]
           ,[pickno],[boxes],[volume],[code_box],[prepack_bk],[ucc128_no])
	VALUES(0, 1, @total_wt, @storecode, @length, @width, @height, 1, 1,
			@pickno, 1, @volume, @code_box, 'N', '')
	end
	SELECT @invhead_box_id = isnull(max(invhead_box_id),0) FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno
	UPDATE packlist SET invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id WHERE pickno = @pickno
	SELECT @boxqty = totalqty FROM uv_total_box_qty WHERE pickno = @pickno 
	UPDATE pickheader SET boxqty = @boxqty , weight = @total_wt, boxes = 1, volume = @volume, totqty = @boxqty WHERE pickno = @pickno
end
insert into [dsco_webhook_process_job] (orderid, ordernumber, import_order_number, memo, processed_date, processed, customer, 
	trading_partner_id, custpo )
VALUES(@dsco_order_id, @consumerOrderNumber, @newOrderno, 'DSCO Customer PO: '+@poNumber + 'imported. WF order# ' +
	 cast(@newOrderno as nvarchar(20)) + '. DSCO Order Download ID: ' + cast(@dsco_webhook_id as nvarchar(20)), getdate(), 'N' , 
	@customer, @tradingPartnerID, @poNumber)

--221003 Arun added to update ecomm_temp_order
 if isnull(@temp_id,'') <> '' 
 begin
	UPDATE ecomm_temp_order SET processed = 'Y', processed_date = Getdate(), wf_orderno = @newOrderno WHERE _id = @temp_id
 end
END

BEGIN

@discount = isnull(discount, 0.00), @discpercent = isnull(discpercent, 0.00), @dscowhId = isnull(dsco_wh_id,''), @dsco_whcode = isnull(dsco_whcode,''),@tradingPartnerID = isnull(tradingPartnerID, ''), @retailerShipMethod = retailerShipMethod, @retailerShippingServiceLevelCode = retailerShippingServiceLevelCode,

poNumber nvarchar(30) '$.poNumber',retailerCreateDate nvarchar(30) '$.retailerCreateDate',channel nvarchar(30) '$.channel',lineItems nvarchar(max) '$.payload.lineItems',
signatureRequiredFlag nvarchar(30) '$.signatureRequiredFlag',shipInstructions nvarchar(max) '$.shipInstructions', giftWrapFlag nvarchar(max) '$.giftWrapFlag',
giftWrapMessage nvarchar(max) '$.giftWrapMessage', testflag nvarchar(20) '$.testFlag', currencyCode nvarchar(10) '$.currencyCode', cancelAfterDate nvarchar(30) '$.cancelAfterDate',
consumerOrderNumber nvarchar(50) '$.consumerOrderNumber',dscoOrderId nvarchar(50) '$.dscoOrderId',dscoRetailerId nvarchar(50) '$.dscoRetailerId',dscoSupplierId nvarchar(50) '$.dscoSupplierId',

retailerShipCarrier nvarchar(50) '$.retailerShipCarrier', retailerShipMethod nvarchar(50) '$.retailerShipMethod', retailerShippingServiceLevelCode nvarchar(50) '$.retailerShippingServiceLevelCode', 
retailerWHCode varchar(20) '$.dscoWarehouseRetailerCode',dscoShipCarrier nvarchar(30) '$.dscoShipCarrier', dscoShipMethod nvarchar(50) '$.dscoShipMethod', dscoshippingServiceLevelCode nvarchar(50) '$.dscoShippingServiceLevelCode' )

SELECT @customer = code FROM customer WHERE isnull(dsco_id,'') = @dscoRetailerId

SELECT @dsco_url = rtrim(dsco_api_url) from wfsystem3 WHERE wfsystem = 1
if right(@dsco_url,1) <> '/'
begin
set @dsco_url = @dsco_url + '/'
end
/*190716 Arun - if not acknowledged , need to acknowledge order */
SELECT @lCount = count(*) FROM dsco_order_ids WHERE order_id = @dsco_order_id AND isnull(acknowledged_sent, 'N') = 'Y'
/*just double check , since the row could have been deleted from dsdco_order_ids table. This is for avoiding duplicate Acknowledgement Sending*/
if @lCount = 0 
begin
SELECT @lCount = Count(*) FROM ecomm_response WHERE ecomm_platform = 'DSCO' and Module = 'ORDER ACK' AND method = 'POST' and url = @dsco_url + 'order/'+@dsco_order_id + '/acknowledge' AND response_code IN('200', '201')
end

SELECT @orderno = isnull(orderno,0) FROM soheader WHERE custpo = LEFT(@poNumber,20) AND customer = @customer AND orderid = @dsco_order_id
if isnull(@orderno,0) > 0
begin
	UPDATE dsco_webhook SET processed = 'Y', orderno = @orderno WHERE dsco_webhook_id = @dsco_webhook_id
	if @lCount = 0
	begin
		exec usp_DSCO_Order_Aknowledgement @dsco_order_id, 'A'
	end
	return
end


declare @json_parsetable dbo.json_parsetable, @min_count int, @max_count int, @icount int, @jsonvalue nvarchar(max),@order_id nvarchar(50),
@dsco_item_id nvarchar(50), @quantity decimal, 
@price decimal (10,3), @sku nvarchar(50), @variant_title nvarchar(255) , @size nvarchar(50),@color_descript nvarchar(200), @color_code nvarchar(13),
@style_code nvarchar(20), @division nvarchar(5), @line_memo nvarchar(max),@colcount int , @ll_stCount int, @underscoreOccurence int, @Rcount int,
@upc nvarchar(20), @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @ord_json nvarchar(max)

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##line_items') IS NOT NULL
begin
DROP TABLE ##line_items
END
create table ##line_items (order_id nvarchar(50), line_no int, dsco_item_id nvarchar(50), quantity decimal, 
price decimal(10,3), sku nvarchar(50), ean nvarchar(50), upc nvarchar(50), partnerSKU nvarchar(50), expectedCost decimal, 
dsco_wh_id nvarchar(50), line_status nvarchar(100), message_text nvarchar(4000), packingInstructions nvarchar(max), shipinstructions nvarchar(max), 
retailerPrice decimal, size nvarchar(10), customer nvarchar(20), custpo nvarchar(50), testflag nvarchar(20),
 style nvarchar(50), color nvarchar(100),tradingpartnerID nvarchar(50), departmentId nvarchar(20) ,
line_memo nvarchar(max), created_date datetime, edi_store nvarchar(10), shipdate datetime , canceldate datetime)

insert into @json_parsetable
select 'lineItems', [key], [Value] from OPENJSON(@lineitemsJson) 

/*only for debugging purpose*/
--select 'line_items', [key], [Value] from OPENJSON(@json) 

--select * from @json_parsetable

select @min_count = min(table_id), @max_count = max(table_id) from @json_parsetable WHERE parent_jsonkey = 'lineItems' 
set @icount = @min_count
WHILE @icount <=@max_count
begin
	SET @sku = ''; SET @color_descript = ''; SET @color_code = ''; SET @style_code= '';SEt @size= ''
	SELECT @jsonvalue = jsonvalue FROM @json_parsetable WHERE table_id = @icount
	if Isnull(@jsonvalue, '')  <> ''
	begin
		if isjson(@jsonvalue) >0 
		begin
		insert into ##line_items (order_id, line_no, customer, custpo, testflag, created_date,edi_store,shipdate,canceldate,  dsco_item_id, quantity, price, sku, ean, upc, partnerSKU,expectedCost, dsco_wh_id, line_status, message_text, packingInstructions, shipInstructions,retailerPrice, size, departmentId, tradingpartnerID )
		(select @dsco_order_id,@iCount, @customer, @poNumber, @testFlag, @created_date, @edi_store, @shipdate, @canceldate, *  from openJson(@jsonvalue)
		WITH(dsco_item_id nvarchar(50) '$.dscoItemId',
		quantity decimal '$.quantity',
		price decimal '$.expectedCost',
		sku nvarchar(50) '$.sku',
		ean nvarchar(50) '$.ean',
		upc nvarchar(50) '$.upc',
		partnerSku nvarchar(50) '$.partnerSku',
		expectedCost decimal '$.expectedCost',
		dsco_wh_id nvarchar(50) '$.warehouseDscoId',
		line_status nvarchar(50) '$.status',
		message_text nvarchar(max) '$.message',
		packingInstructions nvarchar(max) '$.packingInstructions',
		shipInstrunctions nvarchar(max) '$.shipInstructions',
		retailerPrice decimal '$.retailPrice',
		size nvarchar(10) '$.size',
		departmentId nvarchar(20) '$.departmentId',
		tradingpartnerID nvarchar(50) '$.dscoTradingPartnerId')) 
		
		end
	end

	SELECT @dsco_item_id = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.dscoItemId'),@sku = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.sku'), @dsco_item_id = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.dscoItemId'), @deptID = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.departmentId'),
	@deptName = JSON_VALUE(@jsonValue, '$.departmentName'), @retailerPrice = JSON_VALUE(@jsonValue, '$.retailPrice'), @line_status = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.status'), @expectedCost = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.expectedCost'), 
	@consumerPrice = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.consumerPrice'), @line_no = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.lineNumber'),@line_message = JSON_VALUE(@jsonvalue, '$.message')

	DELETE FROM dsco_order_ids WHERE order_id = @order_id AND dsco_item_id = @dsco_item_id

	
	if len(@sku) > 11 
	 SET @upc = LEFT(@sku,11)
	SELECT @style = max(style), @color = max(color) , @size = max(size_desc) FROM code_SKU WHERE sku = @upc AND custid = 'UPC'

	SET @line_memo = 'SKU:'+ rtrim(@sku) + ',UPC:' + rtrim(@upc) + ',style:' + rtrim(@style) + ',color:' + rtrim(@color) + ',size:' + rtrim(@size)
	if @iCount = 1 
	begin
		SET @ord_Json = @json
	end

	INSERT INTO dsco_order_ids(order_id, line_no, dsco_item_id, sku, upc, ean, partnerSKU, expectedCost, ConsumerPrice, WHcode, RetailerWHCode, dsco_WHID, 
	line_status, message_text, packingInstructions, shipInstructions, style, color, size, retailerPrice, deptID, customer, tradingPartnerID, deptName, 
	created_date,custpo, testflag, ShipCarrier, ShipMethod, ShippingServiceLevelCode, dscoCarrier, dscoShipMethod, dscoShippingServiceLevelCode, 
	retailerShipMethod, retailerShippingServiceLevelCode, retailerShipCarrier, acknowledged_sent) 
	VALUES(@dsco_order_id, isnull(@line_no, @iCount), @dsco_item_id, @sku, @upc, @ean, @partnerSKU, @expectedCost, @consumerPrice, @dsco_whcode, @RetailerWHCode, @dscowhId,
	@line_status, @message, @packingInstructions, @shipInstructions, @style, @color, @size, @retailerPrice, @deptID, @customer, @tradingPartnerID, @deptName, 
	@created_date, @poNumber, @testFlag, @shipCarrier, @shipMethod, @shippingServiceLevelCode, @dscoShipCarrier, @dscoShipMethod, @dscoshippingServiceLevelCode,
	@retailerShipMethod, @retailerShippingServiceLevelCode, @retailerShipCarrier, 'N')
	
	UPDATE ##line_items SET style = @style, color = @color, size = @size, line_memo = @line_memo WHERE line_no = @iCount

SET @iCount = @iCount + 1

END

if @lCount = 0 
begin
	exec usp_DSCO_Order_Aknowledgement @dsco_order_id, 'A'
end

delete from Ecommerce_Orders where order_id = @dsco_order_id AND Ecomm_Platform = 'DSCO'
insert into Ecommerce_Orders(Ecomm_Platform,order_id, product_id, sku, item_price, item_qty, size_desc, line_memo, style, color, testflag , upc, shipdate, canceldate,retail_price, edi_store) 
(select 'DSCO', @dsco_order_id, dsco_item_id, sku, price, quantity, size, line_memo, style, color, testflag , upc, shipdate, canceldate, retailerPrice, isnull(edi_store,'00') FROM ##line_items)

SET @total_discounts = @discount 
if @total_discounts > 0 
begin
	SET @discount_code = 'Discount ' + @discpercent + '%'
end

SELECT @min_order_id = min(ecommerce_orders_id), @max_order_id = max(ecommerce_orders_id) FROM Ecommerce_Orders WHERE order_id = @dsco_order_id 
AND Ecomm_Platform = 'DSCO'

SELECT @newOrderno = isnull(max(orderno),0) + 1 FROM soheader
INSERT INTO soheader (orderno, orderid, custpo, cust_orderno) Values(@newOrderno, @dsco_order_id, LEFT(@poNumber,20), @consumerOrderNumber)
SET @iCounter = @min_order_id
While @iCounter <= @max_order_id
begin
SET @retail_price = 0.00
SELECT @upc = isnull(upc,''), @sku = isnull(sku,'') , @product_id  = isnull(product_id,''), @style = isnull(style,''), @color_descript = isnull(color,''), 
@size_desc = isnull(size_desc,''), @item_price = isnull(item_price,0.00), @item_qty = isnull(item_qty,0) , @color = isnull(color,''),
@line_memo = isnull(cast(line_memo as nvarchar(max)), ''), @retail_price = isnull(retail_price,0.00)
FROM ecommerce_orders WHERE Ecommerce_Orders_id = @iCounter
if len(@upc) >11 
begin
SET @upc = LEFT(@upc,11)
end
SELECT @style = style,@color_code = color,@royaltor = royaltor, @pack1 = isnull(pack1,0), @pack2 = isnull(pack2,0), @pack3 = isnull(pack3,0), 
		@pack4 = isnull(pack4,0), @pack5 = isnull(pack5,0), @pack6 = isnull(pack6,0), @pack7 = isnull(pack7,0), @pack8 = isnull(pack8,0), 
		@pack9 = isnull(pack9,0), @pack10 = isnull(pack10,0), @pack11 = isnull(pack11,0), @pack12 = isnull(pack12,0) 
FROM code_SKU where sku = @upc AND custid = 'UPC'

print 'if isnull(@upc,"")' + '@color_code :' + @color_code
if isnull(@style,'') = '' and @@ROWCOUNT= 0
begin
	SET @upcnotFound = 1
	SET @iCounter = @iCounter + 1
	insert into [dsco_webhook_process_job] (orderid, ordernumber, import_order_number, memo, processed_date, processed, customer, 
	trading_partner_id, custpo )
	VALUES(@dsco_order_id, @consumerOrderNumber, 0, 'SKU:' + @upc + ' not found in Code SKU table.DSCO Customer PO: ' +
		@poNumber + ' soheader order# ' + cast(@newOrderno as nvarchar(20)) + '. Webhook_id: ' + cast(@dsco_webhook_id as nvarchar(20)), getdate(), 'N' , 
		@customer, @tradingPartnerID, @poNumber)
	GOTO NOORDER
	BREAK;
end
else
begin
	SET @upcnotFound = 0
	SET @linecount = isnull(@linecount,0) + 1
	SELECT @sodetail_id = isnull(min(sodetail_id),0) FROM sodetail WHERE orderno =@newOrderno AND style = @style AND color = @color_code AND price = @item_price AND isnull(po1_up,'') = @sku
	
	if @sodetail_id = 0 
	begin
		insert into sodetail (orderno, line, style, color, royaltor, qty1, qty2,qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11,qty12,price, actual_price,
		currency, exchange_rate, warehouse, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, memo, closed,po1_up, ticket_price)
		Values(@newOrderno, @linecount, @style, @color_code, @royaltor, @pack1 * @item_qty, @pack2 * @item_qty, @pack3 * @item_qty, @pack4 * @item_qty, @pack5 * @item_qty,
		@pack6 * @item_qty, @pack7 * @item_qty, @pack8 * @item_qty, @pack9 * @item_qty, @pack10 * @item_qty, @pack11 * @item_qty, @pack12 * @item_qty, @item_price, @item_price,
		isnull(@currencyCode, 'USD'), 1.00, '00', 0.00,0.00, @line_memo, 'N', @sku, isnull(@retail_price, 0.00))
	end
	else
	begin
	update sodetail set qty1 = qty1 + @pack1 * @item_qty, qty2 = qty2 + @pack2 * @item_qty,qty3 = qty3 + @pack3 * @item_qty,qty4 = qty4 + @pack4 * @item_qty,
	qty5 = qty5 + @pack5 * @item_qty, qty6 = qty6 + @pack6 * @item_qty, qty7 = qty7 + @pack7 * @item_qty,qty8 = qty8 + @pack8 * @item_qty, qty9 = qty9 + @pack9 * @item_qty,
	 qty10 = qty10 + @pack10 * @item_qty, qty11 = qty11 + @pack11 * @item_qty, qty12 = qty12 + @pack12 * @item_qty,memo = isnull(cast(memo as nvarchar(max)),'') + @line_memo,
	 closed = 'N', po1_up = @sku
	 WHERE sodetail_id = @sodetail_id
	end
	
end

SET @iCounter = @iCounter + 1
end


NOORDER:
SELECT @detail_count = count(*) FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno
if @detail_count = 0 
begin
delete from soheader WHERE orderno = @newOrderno
return
end

SELECT @storecode = isnull(code, '00') FROM store WHERE customer = @customer AND (code = @edi_store or edi_store = @edi_store) 

if @storecode is NULL
begin
	SET @storecode = '00'

FROM customer WHERE code = @customer

if isnull(@Currencycode, '') <> '' 
begin
SET @currency = @currencyCode

SELECT @ls_shipvia = min(code) FROM shipvia WHERE scac_code = @shippingServiceLevelCode AND Charindex(@shipCarrier, code) > 0
if @ls_shipvia <> '' 
begin
SET @shipvia = @ls_shipvia

SET @memo = ' order_id: ' + @dsco_order_id + 'PONumber:' + @poNumber+' , order_number: ' + @consumerOrderNumber+ ' , created_at: ' + convert(varchar(10),@created_date ,101) +
',ShipMethod:' + @shipMethod +',shippingServiceLevelCode:' + @shippingServiceLevelCode+',consumerOrderNumber:' + @consumerOrderNumber +',shipCarrier:' +@shipCarrier+
',shipInstructions:' + isnull(@shipInstructions,'') + ',testFlag:' + @testFlag+',message:' + isnull(@message,'')+',DSCOWHID:'+@dscowhId + ',DSCOWHCode:'+@dsco_whcode+
',marketingMessage:' + isnull(@marketingMessage,'') + ',packingInstructions:' + isnull(@packingInstructions,'') + ',packingSlipMessage:' + isnull(@packingSlipMessage,'') + 
',returnsMessage:' + isnull(@returnsMessage,'')
--+' , freight: ' +cast(isnull(@shipping_price,'') as varchar(10))+ ' , fulfillment_status: ' + @financial_status+ ' , Token: '+@token+
--' , source_name: ' + @source_name

SET @shname = rtrim(@shFirstName) +space(1) + rtrim(@shLastName)

update soheader set closed = 'N',ordertype = 'E', orderdate = @created_date, shipdate = @created_date, canceldate = @created_date,
buyer = left(@buyer,30), refno = cast(left(@consumerOrderNumber,15) as nvarchar(15)), total = isnull(@total_price,0), 
custpo = cast(left(@poNumber,20) as nvarchar(20)),
contact_email =left(@contact_email,255), customer = left(@customer_code,10), 
blname = left(@blname,30), bladdr1 = left(@bladdress1,30), bladdr2 = left(@bladdress2,30), blcity = left(@blcity,20), blstate = left(@blstate,3), blzip = left(@blzip,10),

country = left(@blcountry,35), currency = left(@currency,4), exchange_rate = 1.00, user1 = left(@user1,10), user2 = left(@user2,15), user3 = left(@user3,15),
user4 = isnull(left(@user4,1),'A'), user5 = left(@user5,20), salesrep1 =@salesrep1, salesrep2 = @salesrep2, commpcnt1 = @comm_rate1, 
commpcnt2 = @comm_rate2, shipvia = @shipvia, terms = left(@terms,4), pricelevel = isnull(left(@pricelevel,1), 'A'), warehouse = '00', 
taxrate = @taxrate, memo_code = left(@memo_code,10), box_mode = 1, inhouse_memo = @invoice_memo, ups_shipper = left(@ups_shipper,10),
store = @storecode, shname = left(@shname,30), shaddr1 = left(@shAddr1,30), 
shaddr2 = left(@shAddr2,30), shcity = left(@shcity,20), shstate = left(@shstate,3), shzip = left(@shzip,10), shcountry = left(@shcountry,35), --tax = @total_tax,
misc = -1 * @total_discounts , miscdesc = left(@discount_code,25), freight = @shippingSurcharge, created_user = isnull(left(@wfuser,10), 'SQL'),
td5_12 = @shippingServiceLevelCode, dropship = 'Y'
WHERE orderno = @newOrderno


if @memo_opt = 'I' 
begin
update soheader set inhouse_memo = isnull(cast(inhouse_memo as nvarchar(max)),'') + @memo where orderno = @newOrderno
end
else
begin
update soheader set memo = isnull(cast(memo as nvarchar(max)),'') + @memo where orderno = @newOrderno
end

update Ecommerce_Orders set processed = 'Y' where order_id = @order_id
update dsco_webhook SET processed = 'Y', orderno = @newOrderno WHERE dsco_webhook_id = @dsco_webhook_id
--update the line correctly 
SET @line_number = 1 

create table ##temp_sodetail (sodetail_id int, rowno int, orderno int)
insert into ##temp_sodetail (sodetail_id, rowno, orderno)
(SELECT sodetail_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sodetail_id), @newOrderno FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno)
(SELECT @rownumber_detail = isnull(max(rowno), 0) FROM ##temp_sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno) 
WHILE @line_number <=@rownumber_detail
begin
SELECT @tempsodetail_id = sodetail_id FROM ##temp_sodetail WHERE rowno = @line_number
SELECT @soline = line FROM sodetail where sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id
if @line_number<> @soline 
begin
update sodetail set line = @line_number WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id and orderno = @newOrderno
if @line_number = 1 
begin
SELECT @ls_style = style , @ls_color = color from sodetail WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id 
SELECT @ls_season = isnull(season,'') FROM ivtf WHERE isnull(code, '') = @ls_style AND isnull(Color, '') = @ls_color
end
end
SEt @line_number = @line_number + 1
end
drop table ##temp_sodetail 

if @create_store = 1 
begin
 INSERT INTO store(customer, name, code, addr1, addr2, city, state, zip, country, warehouse)
 Values(@customer_code,@shname, @storeCode, @shaddr1, @shaddr2, @shcity, @shstate, @shzip, @shcountry,'00')
end
--END

select @totalqty = sum(qty), @total_price = sum(isnull(qty,0) * isnull(price,0)) from sodetail where orderno = @neworderno

update soheader set season = @ls_season, subtotal = @totalqty, total = @total_price + ISNULL(misc,0) + isnull(freight,0) WHERE orderno = @newOrderno

if isnull(@autopick, 'N') = 'Y' 
begin
	Execute create_pick_from_salesorder @neworderno
	waitfor delay '00:00:03'
	SELECT @pickno = isnull(max(pickno),0) FROM pickheader WHERE orderno = @newOrderno
	if @pickno > 0 
	DELETE FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno AND invoiceno = 0 
	DELETE FROM packlist WHERE pickno = @pickno AND invoiceno = 0
	begin
	insert into packlist([line],[invoiceno],[store],[style],[color],[qty1],[qty2],[qty3],[qty4],[qty5]
           ,[qty6],[qty7],[qty8],[qty9],[boxno],[invhead_box_id],[pickno],[ordered_style],[ordered_color]
           ,[qty10],[qty11],[qty12],[royaltor],[PO1_IN],[multipick],[sodetail_id],[sku_cb],[prepack_code]
           ,[sku_in],[line_mode],[msn_no],[prepack_qty],[packaging_type],[packaging_code],[packaging_descript])
	(SELECT line, 0, @storecode, style, color, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, 1, 0, @pickno, 
		ordered_style, ordered_color, qty10, qty11, qty12, royaltor, po1_in, '', sodetail_id, sku_cb, 
		prepack_code, sku_in, line_mode, msn_no, prepack_qty, packaging_type,packaging_code,packaging_descript
		FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno)
--SET @code_box = 'D1' 
SELECT @code_box = isnull(box_code,'') FROM customer WHERE code = LEFT(@customer_code,10)
if @code_box = '' 
begin
	SELECT @code_box = code FROM code_box WHERE isnull(default_box, 'N') = 'Y'
end
SELECT @length = length, @width = width , @height = height  FROM code_box WHERE code = @code_box
SET  @volume= Round(@length * @width * @height / 1728,2)
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[invhead_box]([invoiceno],[boxno],[weight],[store], [length],[width],[height],[begbox],[endbox]
           ,[pickno],[boxes],[volume],[code_box],[prepack_bk],[ucc128_no])
	VALUES(0, 1, 1, @storecode, @length, @width, @height, 1, 1,
			@pickno, 1, @volume, @code_box, 'N', '')
	end
	SELECT @invhead_box_id = isnull(max(invhead_box_id),0) FROM invhead_box WHERE pickno = @pickno
	UPDATE packlist SET invhead_box_id = @invhead_box_id WHERE pickno = @pickno
	SELECT @boxqty = totalqty FROM uv_total_box_qty WHERE pickno = @pickno 
	UPDATE pickheader SET boxqty = @boxqty , weight = 1, boxes = 1, volume = @volume, totqty = @boxqty WHERE pickno = @pickno
end
insert into [dsco_webhook_process_job] (orderid, ordernumber, import_order_number, memo, processed_date, processed, customer, 
	trading_partner_id, custpo )
VALUES(@dsco_order_id, @consumerOrderNumber, @newOrderno, 'DSCO Customer PO: '+@poNumber + 'imported. WF order# ' +
	 cast(@newOrderno as nvarchar(20)) + '. Webhook_id: ' + cast(@dsco_webhook_id as nvarchar(20)), getdate(), 'N' , 
	@customer, @tradingPartnerID, @poNumber)

END

usp_ecomm_inventory_byWH /*This stored Procedure is used for the inventory Quantity syncing to the Shopify */
create Procedure [dbo].[usp_ecomm_inventory_byWH] (@style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @warehouse nvarchar(4))
AS 
begin
SELECT ivtf.code, ivtf.color, ivtf_wh.style , ivtf_wh.color as whColor, ivtf_wh.warehouse as whWarehouse, 
ivtf_wh.qty1 as WHOH1, ivtf_wh.qty2 as WHOH2, ivtf_wh.qty3 as WHOH3, ivtf_wh.qty4 as WHOH4, ivtf_wh.qty5 as WHOH5,
ivtf_wh.qty6 as WHOH6, ivtf_wh.qty7 as WHOH7, ivtf_wh.qty8 as WHOH8, ivtf_wh.qty9 as WHOH9, ivtf_wh.qty10 as WHOH10,
ivtf_wh.qty11 as WHOH11, ivtf_wh.qty12 as WHOH12, ivtf.qty1 as OH1, ivtf.qty2 as OH2, ivtf.qty3 as OH3, ivtf.qty4 as OH4,
ivtf.qty5 as OH5, ivtf.qty6 as OH6, ivtf.qty7 as OH7, ivtf.qty8 as OH8, ivtf.qty9 as OH9, ivtf.qty10 as OH10, ivtf.qty11 as OH11, 
ivtf.qty12 as OH12, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty1,0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty1,0) as RTS1, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty2,0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty2, 0) as RTS2, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty3, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty3, 0) as RTS3, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty4, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty4, 0) as RTS4, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty5, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty5, 0) as RTS5, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty6, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty6, 0) as RTS6, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty7, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty7, 0) as RTS7, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty8, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty8, 0) as RTS8, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty9, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty9, 0) as RTS9, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty10, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty10, 0) as RTS10, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty11, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty11, 0) as RTS11, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty12, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty12, 0) as RTS12, 
isnull(ivtf.qty1, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty1, 0) as stOH1, isnull(ivtf.qty2, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty2, 0) as stOH2, 
isnull(ivtf.qty3, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty3, 0) as stOH3, isnull(ivtf.qty4, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty4,0) as stOH4, 
isnull(ivtf.qty5, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty5, 0) as stOH5, isnull(ivtf.qty6, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty6, 0) as stOH6, 
isnull(ivtf.qty7, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty7, 0) as stOH7, isnull(ivtf.qty8, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty8, 0) as stOH8, 
isnull(ivtf.qty9, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty9, 0) as stOH9, isnull(ivtf.qty10, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty10, 0) as stOH10, 
isnull(ivtf.qty11, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty11, 0) as stOH11, isnull(ivtf.qty12, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty12, 0) as stOH12

FROM ivtf JOIN ivtf_wh ON ivtf.code = ivtf_wh.style AND ivtf.color = ivtf_wh.color AND isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf_wh.royaltor, '')
	LEFT OUTER JOIN v_wh_onorder ON ivtf_wh.style = v_wh_onorder.style AND ivtf_wh.color = v_wh_onorder.color AND isnull(ivtf_wh.royaltor, '') = isnull(v_wh_onorder.royaltor,'')
	AND isnull(ivtf_wh.warehouse, '00') = isnull(v_wh_onorder.warehouse, '00')
WHERE ivtf_wh.style = @style AND ivtf_wh.color = @color AND ivtf_wh.warehouse = @warehouse
end

usp_ecomm_inventory_byWH_DSCO 
/*This stored Procedure is used for the inventory Quantity syncing to the DSCO as per David for Multi Warehouse */
create Procedure [dbo].[usp_ecomm_inventory_byWH_DSCO] (@style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @warehouse nvarchar(4))
AS 
begin
SELECT ivtf.code, ivtf.color, ivtf_wh.style , ivtf_wh.color as whColor, ivtf_wh.warehouse as whWarehouse, 
ivtf_wh.qty1 as WHOH1, ivtf_wh.qty2 as WHOH2, ivtf_wh.qty3 as WHOH3, ivtf_wh.qty4 as WHOH4, ivtf_wh.qty5 as WHOH5,
ivtf_wh.qty6 as WHOH6, ivtf_wh.qty7 as WHOH7, ivtf_wh.qty8 as WHOH8, ivtf_wh.qty9 as WHOH9, ivtf_wh.qty10 as WHOH10,
ivtf_wh.qty11 as WHOH11, ivtf_wh.qty12 as WHOH12, ivtf.qty1 as OH1, ivtf.qty2 as OH2, ivtf.qty3 as OH3, ivtf.qty4 as OH4,
ivtf.qty5 as OH5, ivtf.qty6 as OH6, ivtf.qty7 as OH7, ivtf.qty8 as OH8, ivtf.qty9 as OH9, ivtf.qty10 as OH10, ivtf.qty11 as OH11, 
ivtf.qty12 as OH12, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty1,0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty1,0) as RTS1, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty2,0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty2, 0) as RTS2, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty3, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty3, 0) as RTS3, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty4, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty4, 0) as RTS4, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty5, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty5, 0) as RTS5, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty6, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty6, 0) as RTS6, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty7, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty7, 0) as RTS7, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty8, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty8, 0) as RTS8, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty9, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty9, 0) as RTS9, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty10, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty10, 0) as RTS10, 
isnull(ivtf_wh.qty11, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty11, 0) as RTS11, isnull(ivtf_wh.qty12, 0) - isnull(v_wh_onorder.qty12, 0) as RTS12, 
isnull(ivtf.qty1, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty1, 0) as stOH1, isnull(ivtf.qty2, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty2, 0) as stOH2, 
isnull(ivtf.qty3, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty3, 0) as stOH3, isnull(ivtf.qty4, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty4,0) as stOH4, 
isnull(ivtf.qty5, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty5, 0) as stOH5, isnull(ivtf.qty6, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty6, 0) as stOH6, 
isnull(ivtf.qty7, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty7, 0) as stOH7, isnull(ivtf.qty8, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty8, 0) as stOH8, 
isnull(ivtf.qty9, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty9, 0) as stOH9, isnull(ivtf.qty10, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty10, 0) as stOH10, 
isnull(ivtf.qty11, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty11, 0) as stOH11, isnull(ivtf.qty12, 0) - isnull(ivtf.onorder_qty12, 0) as stOH12,
--below was added looking at uv_ecommerce_style_shopify.
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty1,0) - isnull(onorder_qty1,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty1 ,0) - isnull(onorder_qty1,0) as INT) ELSE 
 0 END as qty1,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty2,0) - isnull(onorder_qty2,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty2,0) - isnull(onorder_qty2,0)  as INT) ELSE 
0 END as qty2,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty3,0) - isnull(onorder_qty3,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty3,0) - isnull(onorder_qty3,0) as INT) ELSE 
0 END as qty3,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty4,0) - isnull(onorder_qty4,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty4,0) - isnull(onorder_qty4,0) as int) ELSE 
0 END as qty4,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty5,0) - isnull(onorder_qty5,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty5,0) - isnull(onorder_qty5,0) as INT) ELSE 
0 END as qty5,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty6,0) - isnull(onorder_qty6,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty6,0) - isnull(onorder_qty6,0) as INT) ELSE 
0 END as qty6,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty7,0) - isnull(onorder_qty7,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty7,0) - isnull(onorder_qty7,0) as INT) ELSE 
0 END as qty7,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty8,0) - isnull(onorder_qty8,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty8,0) - isnull(onorder_qty8,0) as INT) ELSE 
0 END as qty8,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty9,0) - isnull(onorder_qty9,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty9,0) - isnull(onorder_qty9,0) as INT) ELSE 
0 END as qty9,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty10,0) - isnull(onorder_qty10,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty10,0) - isnull(onorder_qty10,0) as INT) ELSE 
0 END as qty10,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty11,0) - isnull(onorder_qty11,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(isnull(ivtf.qty11,0) - isnull(onorder_qty11,0) as INT) ELSE
0 END as qty11,
Case WHEN (isnull(ivtf.qty12,0) - isnull(onorder_qty12,0))  > 1 THEN 
Cast(ivtf.qty12 - onorder_qty12 as INT) ELSE 
0 END as qty12

FROM ivtf JOIN ivtf_wh ON ivtf.code = ivtf_wh.style AND ivtf.color = ivtf_wh.color AND isnull(ivtf.royaltor,'') = isnull(ivtf_wh.royaltor, '')
	LEFT OUTER JOIN v_wh_onorder ON ivtf_wh.style = v_wh_onorder.style AND ivtf_wh.color = v_wh_onorder.color AND isnull(ivtf_wh.royaltor, '') = isnull(v_wh_onorder.royaltor,'')
	AND isnull(ivtf_wh.warehouse, '00') = isnull(v_wh_onorder.warehouse, '00')
WHERE ivtf_wh.style = @style AND ivtf_wh.color = @color AND ivtf_wh.warehouse = @warehouse
end

usp_ecomm_order_download_all CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_ecomm_order_download_all]
AS
declare @ecomm_platform nvarchar(20), @wf_customer nvarchar(20)
begin
declare cur_ecomm CURSOR FOR SELECT distinct platform_name, isnull(wf_customer,'') FROM ecomm_platform WHERE platform_name <> 'DSCO' and isnull(api_token,'') <> ''
AND isnull(api_url,'') <> ''
OPEN cur_ecomm
FETCH cur_ecomm INTO @ecomm_platform, @wf_customer 
WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
begin
/*210415 Arun - sometimes due to other ACENDA and REVCASCADE jobs ecomm_order_download table updates with wrong ecomm_platform and causes issue with importing*/
/*better use the procedure with specific stored procedures*/
	if @ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA' 
	begin
	--exec dbo.usp_ecomm_order_download @ecomm_platform, @wf_customer 
		exec [usp_ecommerce_acenda_order_download]
	end
	if @ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' 
	begin
		exec [usp_ecommerce_revcascade_order_download]
	end
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ecomm INTO @ecomm_platform, @wf_customer
end
CLOSE Cur_ecomm
DEALLOCATE cur_ecomm

end

usp_ecomm_order_import_all 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_ecomm_order_import_all]
AS
declare @ecomm_platform nvarchar(20), @wf_customer nvarchar(20)
declare @json nvarchar(max), @ecomm_order_id int, @icnt int = 0, @_id int,
@min_id int, @max_id int
begin

--select top 1 @json = order_json_XML, @ecomm_order_id = _id, @ecomm_platform = ecomm_order_download.ecomm_platform from ecomm_order_download 
--JOIN ecomm_platform 
--ON ecomm_order_download.ecomm_platform = ecomm_platform.platform_name
--WHERE ecomm_platform.platform_name <> 'DSCO' and isnull(api_token,'') <> ''
--AND isnull(api_url,'') <> ''
--AND isnull(ecomm_order_download.processed, 'N') <> 'Y' 
--ORDER BY _id ASC

DECLARE cur_ecomm_platform CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT platform_name FROM ecomm_platform WHERE ecomm_platform.platform_name <> 'DSCO' and isnull(api_token,'') <> '' AND isnull(api_url,'') <> ''
OPEN cur_ecomm_platform 
FETCH cur_ecomm_platform INTO @ecomm_platform
WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
begin

if @ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA'
begin
	exec usp_acenda_order_import_JSON_customer @json, @ecomm_order_id, 'SQL', 'Y', ''
	waitfor delay '00:00:05'
	Create table #temp_acenda_ord_download(downloadid int, _id INT IDENTITY(1,1))
	
	insert into #temp_acenda_ord_download(downloadid)
	(SELECT _id FROM ecomm_order_download WHERE ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA' and isnull(processed, 'N') <> 'Y' 
	and (JSON_VALUE(order_JSON_XML, '$.count') >0 or JSON_VALUE(order_JSON_XML, '$.num_total') >0 ))
	SELECT @min_id = min(_id), @max_id = max(_id) FROM #temp_acenda_ord_download
	SET @iCnt = @min_id
	if @iCnt > 0 
	begin
		WHILE @icnt <=@max_id
		begin
		SELECT @_id = downloadid FROM #temp_acenda_ord_download WHERE _id = @icnt

		SELECT @json = order_json_XML FROM ecomm_order_download WHERE _id = @_id
		exec usp_acenda_order_import_JSON_customer @json, @_id, 'SQL', 'Y', ''

		waitfor delay '00:00:05'
		SET @icnt = @iCnt + 1
		end
	end
	DROP table #temp_acenda_ord_download
	UPDATE ecomm_order_download SET processed = 'Y' where ecomm_platform = 'ACENDA' and 
	(JSON_VALUE(order_JSON_XML, '$.count') =0 or JSON_VALUE(order_JSON_XML, '$.num_total') =0 )
end
if @ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' 
begin
	exec usp_revcascade_manual_ord_process @ecomm_order_id
	waitfor delay '00:00:05'
	Create table #temp_revcascade_ord_download(downloadid int, _id INT IDENTITY(1,1))
	
	insert into #temp_revcascade_ord_download(downloadid)
	(SELECT _id FROM ecomm_order_download WHERE ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' and isnull(processed, 'N') <> 'Y' 
	and (JSON_VALUE(order_JSON_XML, '$.count') >0 or JSON_VALUE(order_JSON_XML, '$.num_total') >0 ))
	SELECT @min_id = min(_id), @max_id = max(_id) FROM #temp_revcascade_ord_download
	SET @iCnt = @min_id
	if @iCnt > 0 
	begin
		WHILE @icnt <=@max_id
		begin
		SELECT @_id = downloadid FROM #temp_revcascade_ord_download WHERE _id = @icnt

		--SELECT @json = order_json_XML FROM ecomm_order_download WHERE _id = @_id
		exec usp_revcascade_manual_ord_process @_id

		waitfor delay '00:00:05'
		SET @icnt = @iCnt + 1
		end
	end
	DROP table #temp_revcascade_ord_download
	UPDATE ecomm_order_download SET processed = 'Y' where ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' and 
	(JSON_VALUE(order_JSON_XML, '$.count') =0 or JSON_VALUE(order_JSON_XML, '$.num_total') =0 )
end

FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ecomm_platform INTO @ecomm_platform
End
end

(@ecomm_platform nvarchar(20))
AS 
/*170727 Arun added to send email about the status of the inventory sync*/
 DECLARE @Style NVARCHAR(MAX)= '', 
 @ls_subject nvarchar(50);
 SET @ls_subject = @ecomm_platform +' Inventory Sync Log'
 /*
Define CSS for html to use
*/
SET @Style += +N'<style type="text/css">' + N'.tg  {border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;border-color:#aaa;}'
    + N'.tg td{font-family:Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;padding:10px 5px;border-style:solid;border-width:1px;overflow:hidden;word-break:normal;border-color:#aaa;color:#333;background-color:#fff;}'
    + N'.tg th{font-family:Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:normal;padding:10px 5px;border-style:solid;border-width:1px;overflow:hidden;word-break:normal;border-color:#aaa;color:#fff;background-color:#C3A0FA;}'
    + N'.tg .tg-9ajh{font-weight:bold;background-color:#BBF7FB}' + N'.tg .tg-hgcj{font-weight:bold;text-align:center}'
    + N'</style>';
DECLARE @tableHTML NVARCHAR(MAX)= '';
SET @tableHTML += @Style + @tableHTML + N'<H2>' + @ecomm_platform + ' Inventory Sync Log' + '</H2>' 
	+ N'<table class="tg">' --DEFINE TABLE
/*
Define Column Headers and Column Span for each Header Column
*/
	+ N'<tr>' 
    + N'<th class="tg-hgcj" colspan="7">' + @ecomm_platform +' Inventory Sync Log For Date ' + convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) +'</th>' 
	+ N'</tr>' 
/*
Define Column Sub-Headers
*/	+ N'<tr>'
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Style#</td>'
    + N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Color#</td>' 
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Sync Date</td>'
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Response_code</td>'
    + N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Comment</td>'
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Memo</td></tr>'
/*
Define data for table and cast to xml
*/
      + CAST(( SELECT td = style ,
					'',
                    td = color ,
					'',
                    td = format(updated_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:MM:ss'),
					'',
                    td = response_code ,
					'',
					td = memo ,
					'',
					td = comment ,
					''
				
             FROM   Ecommerce_inventory_sync
			
             ORDER BY 1 ,
                    2
           FOR
             XML PATH('tr') ,
                 TYPE
           ) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'</table>';
		   
--PRINT @tableHTML
EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail
@profile_name = 'WIN', 
@recipients = 'timmy@winfashion.com',
@body = @tableHTML,
@body_format = 'HTML' , 
@subject = @ls_subject


usp_ftp_ltc_download /*for downloading files from FTP using WINSCP*/
create procedure usp_ftp_ltc_download (@ftp_profile nvarchar(20))
As 
declare @hostname nvarchar(250), @ftp_username nvarchar(20), @ftp_password nvarchar(50)
declare @ls_str nvarchar(4000), @local_in_dir nvarchar(255)
BEGIN
if isnull(@ftp_profile,'') = '' 
begin
	return 
end
SELECT @hostname = isnull(ftp_url,'') , @ftp_username = isnull(ftp_username,''), @ftp_password = isnull(ftp_password,'') FROM ftp_profile WHERE isnull(profile_name,'') = @ftp_profile
SELECT @local_in_dir = isnull(ltc_in_dir, 'C:\LTC\IN') FROM wfsystem3 


if isnull(@hostname,'') = '' 
begin 
return
End 

SET @ls_str = 'C:\PROGRA~2\WinSCP\WinSCP.com /ini=nul /command "open ftp://' +@ftp_username+':'+@ftp_password + '@' + @hostname+ '/"""   "get OUT/*.CSV '+ @local_in_dir + '\"    "exit" '
exec xp_cmdshell @ls_str
END

usp_get_contact_email 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_get_contact_email] (@code nvarchar(10), 
@module nvarchar(10), @contactemail nvarchar(max) OUTPUT)
AS 
DECLARE @email nvarchar(max)
if @module = 'web_orders'
begin
	SET @email =  (SELECT STUFF(
		( SELECT ';' + rtrim(isnull(contacts.email,''))
		   FROM contacts JOIN customer ON contacts.code = customer.code 
		   WHERE customer.code = @code and 
		   (isnull(contacts.email,'') <> '' and isnull(web_orders,'N') = 'Y')
	FOR XML PATH(''),type).value('.','nvarchar(max)'),1,1,''))
end 
if @module = 'web_ar' 
begin
	SET @email = (SELECT STUFF(
		( SELECT ';' + rtrim(isnull(contacts.email,''))
		   FROM contacts JOIN customer ON contacts.code = customer.code 
		   WHERE customer.code = @code and 
		   (isnull(contacts.email,'') <> '' and isnull(web_ar,'N') = 'Y')
	FOR XML PATH(''),type).value('.','nvarchar(max)'),1,1,''))
end
if @module= 'web_ship' 
begin
	SET @email = (SELECT STUFF(
		( SELECT ';' + rtrim(isnull(contacts.email,''))
		   FROM contacts JOIN customer ON contacts.code = customer.code 
		   WHERE customer.code = @code and 
		   (isnull(contacts.email,'') <> '' and isnull(web_ship,'N') = 'Y')
	FOR XML PATH(''),type).value('.','nvarchar(max)'),1,1,''))
end
SELECT @email
SET @contactemail = @email
