usp_get_edi_line CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_get_edi_line](@edisegment nvarchar(5), @customer nvarchar(10), 
		@fromedidate nvarchar(10), @toedidate nvarchar(10), @edidoc nvarchar(5))
AS 
--DECLARE @terminator nvarchar(1)
--DECLARE @separator nvarchar(1)
DECLARE @fromdate datetime, @todate datetime
DECLARE @ll_pos INT 
DECLARE @edifile nvarchar(max)
DECLARE @edi_id INT
SET @ll_pos = 1 
SET @fromdate = CONVERT(datetime, @fromedidate)
SET @todate = CONVERT(datetime, @toedidate)

BEGIN 
--SELECT @terminator = max( right(convert(nvarchar(max),CONVERT(nvarchar(max),edi_doc)),1))
--,@separator = max(substring(CONVERT(nvarchar(max),edi_doc),4,1)) FROM edilog WHERE custid = @customer AND edi_type = @edidoc

DECLARE cur_edi_doc CURSOR FOR 
--SELECT edi_id, CONVERT(nvarchar(max), edi_doc) FROM edilog WHERE custid = @customer AND edi_type = @edidoc AND datediff(dd, @edi_processed, edi_processed) = 0
--SELECT edi_id FROM edilog WHERE custid = @customer AND edi_type = @edidoc AND datediff(dd, @edi_processed, edi_processed) = 0
--SELECT edi_id FROM edilog WHERE custid = @customer AND edi_type = @edidoc AND edi_processed >= @fromedidate and edi_processed <= @todate
SELECT edi_id FROM edilog WHERE custid = @customer AND edi_type = @edidoc AND 
  edi_processed >= @fromedidate and edi_processed < dateadd(dd, 1,@todate)   
OPEN cur_edi_doc 
FETCH FROM cur_edi_doc INTO @edi_id--, @edifile
While @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

Execute usp_get_edi_line_id @edi_id, @edisegment
--SELECT substring(CONVERT(nvarchar(max),edi_doc), charindex(@edisegment+@separator, CONVERT(nvarchar(max),edi_doc)), 
--charindex(@terminator,CONVERT(nvarchar(max),edi_doc),charindex(@edisegment+@separator, CONVERT(nvarchar(max),edi_doc)) + 1) - charindex(@edisegment+@separator, CONVERT(nvarchar(max),edi_doc)))
--FROM edilog WHERE custid = @customer AND edi_type = @edidoc AND datediff(dd, @edi_processed, edi_processed) = 0 
 
 --WHILE @ll_pos > 0 
 --BEGIN
	--SELECT 'EDI ID:' + CAST(@edi_id as VARCHAR(MAX)), substring(@edifile, charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile, @ll_pos),
	--charindex(@terminator,@edifile,charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile) + 1) - charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile))
	--SET @ll_pos = Charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile, @ll_pos + 1)
 --END
 FETCH NEXT FROM cur_edi_doc INTO @edi_id
END
CLOSE cur_edi_doc
DEALLOCATE cur_edi_doc
END


usp_get_edi_line_id CREATE procedure usp_get_edi_line_id(@edi_id INT, @edisegment nvarchar(5)) 
AS 
DECLARE @edifile nvarchar(max)
DECLARE @ll_pos INT,@iCount INT
DECLARE @terminator nvarchar(3),@separator nvarchar(3)
BEGIN 
SELECT @edifile = edi_doc FROM edilog WHERE edi_id =@edi_id
SET @iCount = 0
SET @terminator =  right(convert(nvarchar(max),CONVERT(nvarchar(max),@edifile)),1)
SET @separator = substring(CONVERT(nvarchar(max),@edifile),4,1)

SET @ll_pos = Charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile, 1)
WHILE @ll_pos > 0 
BEGIN
	SET @iCount = @iCount + 1
	SELECT 'EDI ID:' + CAST(@edi_id as VARCHAR(MAX)),@icount as 'Number',  substring(@edifile, charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile, @ll_pos),
	charindex(@terminator,@edifile,charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile) + 1) - charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile))
	SET @ll_pos = Charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile, @ll_pos + 1)
END

END

usp_get_edi_line_id_grid 

CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_get_edi_line_id_grid](@edi_id INT, @edisegment nvarchar(20)) 
AS 
DECLARE @edifile nvarchar(max)
DECLARE @ll_pos INT,@iCount INT
DECLARE @terminator nvarchar(3),@separator nvarchar(3), @beg_line nvarchar(500), @ll_beg_pos INT
BEGIN 
Create table ##edi_temp
(descript nvarchar(200), number int, edi_line nvarchar(500), beg_line nvarchar(500))
SELECT @edifile = edi_doc FROM edilog WHERE edi_id =@edi_id
SET @iCount = 0
SET @terminator =  right(convert(nvarchar(max),CONVERT(nvarchar(max),@edifile)),1)
SET @separator = substring(CONVERT(nvarchar(max),@edifile),4,1)

SET @ll_beg_pos = Charindex('BEG' + @separator, @edifile, 1)
SET @ll_pos = Charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile, 1)
WHILE @ll_pos > 0 
BEGIN
	SET @iCount = @iCount + 1
	--SELECT 'EDI ID:' + CAST(@edi_id as VARCHAR(MAX)),@icount as 'Number',  substring(@edifile, charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile, @ll_pos),
	--charindex(@terminator,@edifile,charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile) + 1) - charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile))
	insert into ##edi_temp (descript, number, edi_line, beg_line)
	(SELECT 'EDI ID:' + CAST(@edi_id as VARCHAR(MAX)),@icount as 'Number',  substring(@edifile, charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile, @ll_pos),
	charindex(@terminator,@edifile,charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile) + 1) - charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile))
	, substring(@edifile, charindex('BEG'+@separator, @edifile, @ll_beg_pos),
	charindex(@terminator,@edifile,charindex('BEG'+@separator, @edifile) + 1) - charindex('BEG'+@separator, @edifile)))
	SET @ll_pos = Charindex(@edisegment+@separator, @edifile, @ll_pos + 1)
	SET @ll_beg_pos = Charindex('BEG' + @separator, @edifile, @ll_beg_pos + 1)
END
SELECT * from ##edi_temp 
drop table ##edi_temp
END

usp_get_email 
CREATE PROCEDURE usp_get_email (@code nvarchar(10), @module nvarchar(10))
AS 
DECLARE @email nvarchar(max)
if @module = 'web_orders'
begin
	SET @email =  (SELECT STUFF(
		( SELECT ';' + rtrim(isnull(contacts.email,''))
		   FROM contacts JOIN customer ON contacts.code = customer.code 
		   WHERE customer.code = @code and 
		   (isnull(contacts.email,'') <> '' and isnull(web_orders,'N') = 'Y')
	FOR XML PATH(''),type).value('.','nvarchar(max)'),1,1,''))
end 
if @module = 'web_ar' 
begin
	SET @email = (SELECT STUFF(
		( SELECT ';' + rtrim(isnull(contacts.email,''))
		   FROM contacts JOIN customer ON contacts.code = customer.code 
		   WHERE customer.code = @code and 
		   (isnull(contacts.email,'') <> '' and isnull(web_ar,'N') = 'Y')
	FOR XML PATH(''),type).value('.','nvarchar(max)'),1,1,''))
end
if @module= 'web_ship' 
begin
	SET @email = (SELECT STUFF(
		( SELECT ';' + rtrim(isnull(contacts.email,''))
		   FROM contacts JOIN customer ON contacts.code = customer.code 
		   WHERE customer.code = @code and 
		   (isnull(contacts.email,'') <> '' and isnull(web_ship,'N') = 'Y')
	FOR XML PATH(''),type).value('.','nvarchar(max)'),1,1,''))
end
SELECT @email

usp_insert_dsco_webhook /*190823 Arun - to ensure any single quotes value will also be inserted, making string and doing insert was failing*/
create PROCEDURE usp_insert_dsco_webhook
(@ecomm_name nvarchar(10), @ecomm_url nvarchar(255), @response_data nvarchar(max), @method_name nvarchar(100))
AS 
declare @now datetime , @processed char(1) = 'N'
BEGIN
SET @now = getdate()
INSERT INTO dsco_webhook (ecomm_name, ecomm_url, response_data, response_date, method_name, processed)
Values(@ecomm_name, @ecomm_url, @response_data, @now, @method_name, @processed)
END

@response_code nvarchar(10),

@url      nvarchar(100),

@color      nvarchar(12),

AS

                         values (@response_code,@Module,@Method,@url,@style,@color,@request,@response,@request_date, @ecomm_platform, isnull(@customer, ''))  
  
end

usp_ios_sku 
create procedure usp_ios_sku(@sku nvarchar(20), @pricelevel char(1) = NULL)
as
begin
select v_ios_ivtf.color, code,descript,color_descript,qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,wip_qty1,wip_qty2,wip_qty3,wip_qty4,wip_qty5,wip_qty6, wip_qty7,wip_qty8,wip_qty9,
wip_qty10,wip_qty11,wip_qty12,Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack1 Else isnull(prepack_qty1,0) END AS prepack_qty1,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack2 Else isnull(prepack_qty2,0) END AS prepack_qty2,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack3 Else isnull(prepack_qty3,0) END AS prepack_qty3,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack4 Else  isnull(prepack_qty4,0) END AS prepack_qty4,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack5 Else  isnull(prepack_qty5,0) END AS prepack_qty5,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack6 Else isnull(prepack_qty6,0) END AS prepack_qty6,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack7 Else isnull (prepack_qty7,0) END AS prepack_qty7,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack8 Else isnull(prepack_qty8,0) END AS prepack_qty8,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack9 Else  isnull(prepack_qty9,0)  END AS prepack_qty9,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack10 Else isnull(prepack_qty10,0) END AS prepack_qty10, 
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack11 Else  isnull(prepack_qty11,0)  END AS prepack_qty11,
Case when v_iTradeshow_Barcode.isPrepack = 'Y' Then v_iTradeShow_Barcode.pack12 Else isnull(prepack_qty12,0) END AS prepack_qty12,
 convert(char (10),eta_date,101) AS eta_date,location,isnull(washing_instruction1,'No HTML') AS washing_instruction,isnull(size1,'') AS size1,
isnull(size2,'') AS size2,isnull(size3,'') AS size3,isnull(size4,'') AS size4,isnull(size5,'') AS size5,isnull(size6,'') AS size6,
isnull(size7,'') AS size7,isnull(size8,'') AS size8,isnull(size9,'') AS size9,isnull(size10,'') AS size10,isnull(size11,'') AS size11,
isnull(size12,'') AS size12,isnull(onorder_qty1,0) AS onorder_qty1,isnull(onorder_qty2,0) AS onorder_qty2,isnull(onorder_qty3,0) AS onorder_qty3,
isnull(onorder_qty4,0) AS onorder_qty4,isnull(onorder_qty5,0) AS onorder_qty5,isnull(onorder_qty6,0) AS onorder_qty6,isnull (onorder_qty7,0) AS onorder_qty7,
isnull(onorder_qty8,0) AS onorder_qty8,isnull(onorder_qty9,0) AS onorder_qty9,isnull(onorder_qty10,0) AS onorder_qty10,isnull(onorder_qty11,0) AS onorder_qty11,
isnull(onorder_qty12,0) AS onorder_qty12, isnull(inventory_notes,'') as inventory_notes,user1, 
CASE @pricelevel WHEN 'B' THEN v_ios_ivtf.priceb
				 WHEN 'C' THEN v_ios_ivtf.pricec
				 WHEN 'D' THEN v_ios_ivtf.priced
				 WHEN 'E' THEN v_ios_ivtf.pricee
				 WHEN 'F' THEN v_ios_ivtf.pricef
				 Else v_ios_ivtf.pricec END as price


																												
from v_ios_ivtf Left Outer Join v_iTradeShow_Barcode on v_ios_ivtf.code = v_iTradeShow_Barcode.style and v_ios_ivtf.color=v_iTradeShow_Barcode.color where v_iTradeShow_Barcode.sku=@sku
End
usp_ipdm_user_tasks_email_excel 
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_ipdm_user_tasks_email_excel] (@begdate date , @enddate date, @email nvarchar(255), @status varchar(2))
AS
declare @sbegdate varchar(20), @senddate varchar(20), @filename nvarchar(255) 

set @begdate = '2014/01/01'
set @enddate = getdate()
set @sbegdate = format(@begdate, 'yyyy/MM/dd')
set @senddate = format(@enddate, 'yyyy/MM/dd')
set @filename = 'C:\temp\' + format(getdate(),'yyyyMMddhhmmss')+ '.xls'

usp_ivtf_ecomm_edi_image CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_ivtf_ecomm_edi_image](@format nvarchar(50)) 
as 
DECLARE @ivtf_image_id INT
DECLARE @filelocation varchar(255)
DECLARE @icount int , @rcount int
DECLARE @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12)
DECLARE @filename nvarchar(255) 
DECLARE @filename2 nvarchar(255) 
DECLARE @filename3 nvarchar(255) 
DECLARE @filename4 nvarchar(255) 

Create table ##imageTemp (ivtf_image_id INT, web_prod_image_url nvarchar(255), 
style_image1 image, style_image2 image, style_image3 image, style_image4 image,
style nvarchar(13), color nvarchar(12), rowno INT)

set @icount = 0
SELECT @filelocation = isnull(web_prod_image_url ,'') FROM div WHERE code = 'A'
--DECLARE cur_copy_image_file CURSOR FOR
INSERT INTO ##imageTemp(ivtf_image_id, web_prod_image_url, style_image1, style_image2, style_image3, style_image4, rowno, style, color)
(SELECT ivtf_image_id ,@filelocation, ivtf_image.style_image1, ivtf_image.style_image2, ivtf_image.style_image3, ivtf_image.style_image4,
	Row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ivtf_image_id DESC), ivtf_image.style , ivtf_image.color FROM ivtf_image 
	JOIN ivtf_ecomm_edi ON ivtf_image.style = ivtf_ecomm_edi.style 
	 )

SELECT @rcount = count(*) FROM ##imageTemp	
	 --FOR READ ONLY
--OPEN cur_copy_image_file
--FETCH cur_copy_image_file INTO @ivtf_image_id, @filelocation
--WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
WHILE @icount <= @rcount
	BEGIN
		--exec sp_copy_image_file @ivtf_image_id , @filelocation, @format

		

		SELECT @style = style, @color = color, @ivtf_image_id = ivtf_image_id FROM ##imageTemp WHERE rowno = @icount 

		if Right(rtrim(@filelocation),1) <>'\' 
		begin
			SET @filelocation = @filelocation+'\'
		End

		/*161108 Arun - if '.' color then style.jpg */
		SET @filename = @filelocation + 'Style1\' + Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(@style),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_')+
						Case WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE '_' END +
						Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(CASE WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE @color END),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_') +'.jpg'
		SET @filename2 = @filelocation + 'Style2\' + Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(@style),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_')+
						Case WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE '_' END +
						Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(CASE WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE @color END),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_') +'.jpg'

		SET @filename3 = @filelocation + 'Style3\' + Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(@style),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_')+
						Case WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE '_' END +
						Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(CASE WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE @color END),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_') +'.jpg'

		SET @filename4 = @filelocation + 'Style4\' + Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(@style),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_')+
						Case WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE '_' END +
						Replace(Replace(Replace(rtrim(CASE WHEN @color = '.' THEN '' ELSE @color END),'\','_'),'/','_'),'&','_') +'.jpg'

		declare @cmdshell nvarchar(255)
		declare @cmdshell2 nvarchar(255)
		declare @cmdshell3 nvarchar(255)
		declare @cmdshell4 nvarchar(255)
		declare @datal1 INT, @datal2 INT, @datal3 INT,@datal4 INT

		SELECT @datal1=isnull(datalength(style_image1),0),@datal2=isnull(datalength(style_image2),0),@datal3=isnull(datalength(style_image3),0),@datal4=isnull(datalength(style_image4),0) FROM ##imageTemp WHERE ivtf_image_id = @ivtf_image_id

		set @cmdshell = 'bcp "select style_image1 from ##imageTemp where ivtf_image_id='+convert(varchar(20), @ivtf_image_id)+' " queryout "'+@filename+'" -S WFSERVER\SQL2017 -Usa -P15848@admi -T -f ' +@format
		set @cmdshell2 = 'bcp "select style_image2 from ##imageTemp where ivtf_image_id='+convert(varchar(20), @ivtf_image_id)+' " queryout "'+@filename2+'" -S WFSERVER\SQL2017 -Usa -P15848@admi -T -f '+@format
		set @cmdshell3 = 'bcp "select style_image3 from ##imageTemp where ivtf_image_id='+convert(varchar(20), @ivtf_image_id)+' " queryout "'+@filename3+'" -S WFSERVER\SQL2017 -Usa -P15848@admi -T -f '+@format
		set @cmdshell4 = 'bcp "select style_image4 from ##imageTemp where ivtf_image_id='+convert(varchar(20), @ivtf_image_id)+' " queryout "'+@filename4+'" -S WFSERVER\SQL2017 -Usa -P15848@admi -T -f '+@format

		if @datal1 > 0 
		EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmdshell 
		if @datal2 > 0
		EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmdshell2
		if @datal3 > 0
		EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmdshell3 
		if @datal4 > 0 
		EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmdshell4
		
		set @icount = @icount + 1
		
	END
	
	DROP table ##imageTemp

usp_joor_inventory_sync_Email 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_joor_inventory_sync_Email] 
AS 
/*170727 Arun added to send email about the status of the inventory sync*/
 DECLARE @Style NVARCHAR(MAX)= '';
 /*
Define CSS for html to use
*/
SET @Style += +N'<style type="text/css">' + N'.tg  {border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;border-color:#aaa;}'
    + N'.tg td{font-family:Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;padding:10px 5px;border-style:solid;border-width:1px;overflow:hidden;word-break:normal;border-color:#aaa;color:#333;background-color:#fff;}'
    + N'.tg th{font-family:Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:normal;padding:10px 5px;border-style:solid;border-width:1px;overflow:hidden;word-break:normal;border-color:#aaa;color:#fff;background-color:#C3A0FA;}'
    + N'.tg .tg-9ajh{font-weight:bold;background-color:#BBF7FB}' + N'.tg .tg-hgcj{font-weight:bold;text-align:center}'
    + N'</style>';
DECLARE @tableHTML NVARCHAR(MAX)= '';
SET @tableHTML += @Style + @tableHTML + N'<H2>Joor Inventory Sync Log' + '</H2>' 
	+ N'<table class="tg">' --DEFINE TABLE
/*
Define Column Headers and Column Span for each Header Column
*/
	+ N'<tr>' 
    + N'<th class="tg-hgcj" colspan="7">Joor Inventory Sync Log For Date ' + convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) +'</th>' 
	+ N'</tr>' 
/*
Define Column Sub-Headers
*/	+ N'<tr>'
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Style#</td>'
    + N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Color#</td>' 
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Sync Date</td>'
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Response_code</td>'
    + N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Comment</td>'
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Memo</td></tr>'
/*
Define data for table and cast to xml
*/
      + CAST(( SELECT td = style ,
					'',
                    td = color ,
					'',
                    td = format(updated_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:MM:ss'),
					'',
                    td = response_code ,
					'',
					td = memo ,
					'',
					td = comment ,
					''
				
             FROM   joor_sync
			
             ORDER BY 1 ,
                    2
           FOR
             XML PATH('tr') ,
                 TYPE
           ) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'</table>';
		   
--PRINT @tableHTML
EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail
@profile_name = 'WinFashion', 
@recipients = 'arun@winfashion.com',
@body = @tableHTML,
@body_format = 'HTML' , 
@subject = 'Joor Inventory Sync Log'


usp_Joor_INVT_Sync NULL
usp_joor_process_temp_order /*201110 Arun added refno and orderid also to check, multiple orders can have same custpo*/
/*201020 Arun - made changes on the Price logic as per Timmy Phone call

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_joor_process_temp_order] (@order_id nvarchar(20), @order_xml nvarchar(max), @id INT, @wfuserid nvarchar(10) = NULL) 
AS 
DECLARE @xmlstr XML, @hfcno int, @order_total decimal(16,3), @order_currency nvarchar(10), @customer_code nvarchar(20), 
@customer_name nvarchar(100), @date_created_str nvarchar(25), @date_created datetime, @date_ship_start_str nvarchar(25), 
@date_ship_start datetime, @date_ship_end_str nvarchar(25), @date_ship_end datetime, @order_season_code nvarchar(25), 
@order_type nvarchar(10), @idoc int , @line_itemsXml XML, @order_comments nvarchar(max), @order_discount decimal(16,3),
@salesrepname nvarchar(100), @salesrepcode nvarchar(20), @customerpo nvarchar(100), @shipping_code nvarchar(10), 
@shipping_name nvarchar(100), @shipping_phone nvarchar(20), @shipaddr1 nvarchar(100), @shipaddr2 nvarchar(100), 
@shipcity nvarchar(100), @shipstate nvarchar(100), @shipZip nvarchar(20), @shippingCountry nvarchar(100), 
@shippingMethodName nvarchar(100), @shippingMethodCode nvarchar(50), @shippingEmail nvarchar(255), 
@payment_Method_name nvarchar(100), @payment_method_code nvarchar(50), @created_by_username nvarchar(100), 
@created_by_email nvarchar(255),@billing_code nvarchar(10), @billing_name nvarchar(100), @billing_addr1 nvarchar(100), 
@billing_addr2 nvarchar(100), @billing_city nvarchar(100), @billing_state nvarchar(10), @billing_zip nvarchar(20), 
@billing_country nvarchar(100), @order_discount_percent decimal (16,3), @order_source nvarchar(50), @order_shipping_total decimal(16,3), 
@date_modified datetime, @date_modified_str nvarchar(25),@billing_phone nvarchar(20), @buyer nvarchar(30), @invoice_memo nvarchar(max), 
@ups_shipper nvarchar(10), @orderno INT, @buyername nvarchar(50), @LnDiscPercent decimal (16,3), @totalprice decimal (16, 3),
@orig_price decimal(16,3)

BEGIN
	If Exists(SELECT order_id FROM joor_orders WHERE order_id = @order_id )--AND isnull(process, '') <> 'N')
	begin
		SELECT @hfcno = isnull(max(hfcno),0) FROM joor_orders WHERE order_id = @order_id
		UPDATE joor_temp_order SET processed = 'Y', processed_date= getdate(), wf_orderno = @hfcno WHERE _id = @id 
	return
	end
 BEGIN TRY 
	SET @xmlstr = CAST(@order_xml AS XML)
	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @idoc OUTPUT, @xmlstr
	SELECT @order_total = CONVERT(decimal(16,3), order_total), @order_currency = order_currency, @customer_code = customer_code,
	@customer_name = customer_name, @date_created_str = date_created_str, @date_ship_start_str = date_ship_start_str, @date_ship_end_str = date_ship_end_str, 
	@order_season_code = order_season_code, @order_type = order_type, @line_itemsXml = lineItemsXML, @order_comments = isnull(order_comments, ''), 
	@order_discount = CONVERT(decimal(16,3) , order_discount), @order_discount_percent = CONVERT(Decimal(16,3), order_discount_percent), 
	@salesrepname = salesrepName, @salesrepcode = salesrepCode, @customerpo = isnull(customerpo, ''),@shipping_code = isnull(shipping_code, '00'), 
	@shipping_name = isnull(shipping_name, ''), @shipaddr1 = isnull(shipping_address_1, ''), @shipaddr2 =isnull(shipping_address_2,''), 
	@shipcity = shipping_city, @shipping_phone = shipping_phone, @shipstate =shipping_region, @shipZip = shipping_postal_code, 
	@shippingCountry = shipping_country, @shippingMethodName = shipping_method_name, @shippingMethodCode = shipping_method_code,
	@shippingEmail = shipping_email, @billing_code = isnull(billing_code, '00'), @billing_name = billing_name, @billing_addr1 = billing_address_1, 
	@billing_addr2 = billing_address_2, @billing_city = billing_city, @billing_state = billing_region, @billing_zip = billing_postal_code, @billing_country = billing_country, 
	@payment_method_code = payment_method_code, @payment_Method_name = payment_method_name, @created_by_username = created_by_username, 
	@created_by_email = created_by_email, @order_source = LEFT(order_source,20), @order_shipping_total = CONVERT(decimal(16,3),order_shipping_total) , 
	@date_modified_str = date_modified, @billing_phone = billing_phone, @buyername = buyer_name
	FROM OPENXML(@idoc, 'order',0) 
	WITH(order_total nvarchar(25) 'order_total',order_currency nvarchar(10) 'order_currency',customer_code nvarchar(20) 'customer_code' ,
	customer_name nvarchar(100) 'customer_name', date_created_str nvarchar(25) 'date_created', date_ship_start_str nvarchar(25) 'date_ship_start',
	date_ship_end_str nvarchar(25) 'date_ship_end', order_season_code nvarchar(25) 'order_season_code',order_type nvarchar(10) 'order_type',
	lineItemsXML XML 'line_items', order_comments nvarchar(max) 'order_comments', order_discount nvarchar(10) 'order_discount', 
	order_discount_percent nvarchar(10) 'order_discount_percent', salesrepName nvarchar(100) 'sales_representative', 
	salesrepCode nvarchar(20) 'sales_representative_code', customerpo nvarchar(100) 'customer_purchase_order', shipping_code nvarchar(10) 'shipping_code', 
	shipping_name nvarchar(100) 'shipping_name',shipping_phone nvarchar(20) 'shipping_phone', shipping_address_1 nvarchar(100) 'shipping_address_1',
	shipping_address_2 nvarchar(100) 'shipping_address_2', shipping_city nvarchar(100) 'shipping_city', shipping_region nvarchar(20) 'shipping_region',
	shipping_postal_code nvarchar(20) 'shipping_postal_code', 
	shipping_country nvarchar(100) 'shipping_country', shipping_method_name nvarchar(100) 'shipping_method_name', shipping_method_code nvarchar(20) 'shipping_method_code', 
	shipping_email nvarchar(255) 'shipping_email', billing_code nvarchar(10) 'billing_code',billing_name nvarchar(100) 'billing_name',
	billing_address_1 nvarchar(100) 'billing_address_1', billing_address_2 nvarchar(100) 'billing_address_2', billing_city nvarchar(100) 'billing_city', 
	billing_postal_code nvarchar(20) 'billing_postal_code', billing_country nvarchar(100) 'billing_country', payment_method_name nvarchar(100) 'payment_method_name', 
	payment_method_code nvarchar(20) 'payment_method_code',created_by_username nvarchar(100) 'created_by_username', created_by_email nvarchar(255) 'created_by_email', 
	order_source nvarchar(50) 'order_source', order_shipping_total nvarchar(20) 'order_shipping_total', date_modified nvarchar(25) 'date_modified', 
	billing_phone nvarchar(20) 'billing_phone', billing_region nvarchar(20) 'billing_region', buyer_name nvarchar(50) 'customer_buyer_name') 

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @idoc

	declare @llCustCount int
	SELECT @customer_code = dbo.MixedURLDecode(@customer_code)
	SELECT @llCustCount = count(*) FROM customer WHERE code = @customer_code
	if @llCustCount = 0 
	begin
		return --do not process if customer has not been created in WF as per David call.
	end
	/*Check also if the orders already there*/
	/*201110 Arun added refno and orderid also to check, multiple orders can have same custpo*/
	SELECT @orderno = isnull(max(orderno),0) FROM soheader 
	WHERE customer = @customer_code AND custpo = LEFT(@customerpo, 20) AND refno = cast(left(@order_id,15) as nvarchar(15)) and orderid = @order_id
	if @orderno >0 
	begin
		UPDATE joor_temp_order SET processed = 'Y', processed_date= getdate(), wf_orderno = @orderno WHERE _id = @id 
		UPDATE joor_orders SET process = 'Y' , hfcno = @orderno WHERE order_id = cast(@order_id as varchar(10))
		return
	end

	declare @user1 nvarchar(20), @user2 nvarchar(20), @user3 nvarchar(20), @user4 char(2), @user5 nvarchar(20), @salesrep1 nvarchar(20), @salesrep2 nvarchar(20), 
	@commrate1 decimal(16, 3), @commrate2 decimal(16,3), @pricelevel char(1), @taxrate decimal(16,3), @factored char(1), @po_required varchar(10), @duplicate_po varchar(10), 
	@memo_code nvarchar(20), @box_mode int, @custname nvarchar(30), @shipvia nvarchar(20), @terms nvarchar(20), @status nvarchar(10), @hold nvarchar(10), 
	@shipvia_code nvarchar(10), @terms_code nvarchar(10)

	SELECT @custName = name, @salesrep1 = salesrep1 , @salesrep2 = salesrep2, @shipvia = shipvia, @terms = terms, @user1 = user1, @user2 = user2, @user3 = user3, @user4 = user4,
	@user5 = user5, @pricelevel = pricelevel, @status = status, @factored = factored, @hold = hold, @po_required = po_required, @duplicate_po = duplicate_po, @memo_code = memo_code, 
	@commrate1 = comm_rate1, @commrate2 = comm_rate2, @taxrate = taxrate, @box_mode = box_mode,@invoice_memo = invoice_memo, @ups_shipper = ups_shipper, 
	@LnDiscPercent = isnull(LnDiscPercent, 0.00)
	FROM customer WHERE code = @customer_code

	SET @date_created =  CONVERT(date, LEFT(@date_created_str,10)); SET @date_modified = CONVERT(date, LEFT(@date_modified_str,10))
	SET @date_ship_start = CONVERT(date, LEFT(@date_ship_start_str,10)); SET @date_ship_end = CONVERT(date, LEFT(@date_ship_end_str,10))

	insert into joor_orders(order_id, order_total, order_currency, customer_code, customer_name, date_created, date_ship_start, date_ship_end, order_season_code, order_type, 
	xml, process, importeddate, b2b_platform)
	VALUES( cast(@order_id as varchar(10)), @order_total, isnull(@order_currency, 'USD'), @customer_code, @customer_name, CONVERT(date, LEFT(@date_created_str,10)), CONVERT(date, LEFT(@date_ship_start_str,10)),
	CONVERT(date, LEFT(@date_ship_end_str,10)), @order_season_code, @order_type, 
	@order_xml, '', getdate(), 'JOOR')

	CREATE table #line_items(ecomm_platform nvarchar(20), order_id nvarchar(50), created_date datetime, updated_date datetime, wfuserid nvarchar(10), total_price decimal(16,3),
	currency nvarchar(10), customer nvarchar(20),blname nvarchar(100), shname nvarchar(100), bladdress1 nvarchar(100), bladdress2 nvarchar(100), blcity nvarchar(100), 
	blstate nvarchar(20), blzip nvarchar(20), blcountry nvarchar(100), shaddress1 nvarchar(100), shaddress2 nvarchar(100), shcity nvarchar(100), shstate nvarchar(100), 
	shcountry nvarchar(100), order_number nvarchar(50), product_id nvarchar(50),style varchar(50), color nvarchar(50), sku nvarchar(50), item_price decimal(16,3), item_qty int, 
	note nvarchar(4000), blphone nvarchar(100), shphone nvarchar(100), shfax nvarchar(100), subtotal_price decimal(16,3), total_weight decimal(16,3), total_tax decimal(16,3),
	total_discount decimal(16,3), custpo nvarchar(50), customer_id nvarchar(50), importeddate datetime, raw_data nvarchar(max), buyer_name nvarchar(50), shzip nvarchar(50), 
	size_desc nvarchar(10), order_fulfillment_status nvarchar(10), source_name nvarchar(50), line_memo nvarchar(4000),upc nvarchar(50),shipping_title nvarchar(100),
	contact_email nvarchar(255), customer_email nvarchar(255), _id INT IDENTITY(1,1), item_unit_price decimal(16,3), colordescript nvarchar(100), 
	retail_price nvarchar(10))

	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @idoc OUTPUT, @line_itemsXml

	INSERT INTO #line_items(ecomm_platform, order_id, created_date, updated_date, wfuserid, total_price, currency, customer, blname, shname, bladdress1, bladdress2, blcity, 
	blstate, blzip, blcountry, shaddress1,shaddress2, shcity, shstate, shcountry, order_number, product_id, style, color, sku, item_price, item_qty, note, blphone, shphone, 
	shfax, subtotal_price, total_weight, total_tax, total_discount, custpo, customer_id, importeddate, raw_data, buyer_name, shzip, size_desc, order_fulfillment_status, source_name, 
	line_memo, upc, shipping_title, contact_email, customer_email, item_unit_price, colordescript, retail_price)
	select 'JOOR', @order_id, @date_created, @date_modified, @wfuserId, @order_total, isnull(@order_currency, 'USD'), @customer_code, @billing_name, @shipping_name, @billing_addr1, 
	@billing_addr2, @billing_city, @billing_state, @billing_zip, @billing_country, @shipaddr1, @shipaddr2, @shipcity, @shipstate, @shippingCountry, @order_id,item_style_id,
	item_number,item_color_code, item_upc,CONVERT(decimal(16,3), item_price),item_quantity, @order_comments, @billing_phone , @shipping_phone, '', @order_total,0.00, 0.00, @order_discount,
	@customerpo, @customer_code, getdate(), CAST(@line_itemsXml as nvarchar(max)), @billing_name, @shipZip, item_size, '', @order_source,item_comment, item_upc, 
	@shipping_name, @shippingEmail, @shippingEmail, 
	item_unit_price, item_color, item_retail_price
	FROM OPENXML(@idoc, 'line_items/item')
		WITH 
		(
		item_style_id nvarchar(50) 'item_style_id',
		item_name [nvarchar](50) 'item_name',
		item_number [nvarchar](100) 'item_number',
		item_color [nvarchar](100) 'item_color',
		--line_items xml 'line_items',
		item_color_code nvarchar(50) 'item_color_code',
		item_price nvarchar(10) 'item_price',
		item_unit_price nvarchar(10) 'item_unit_price',
		item_quantity nvarchar(10) 'item_quantity',
		item_size nvarchar(10) 'item_size', 
		item_upc nvarchar(50) 'item_upc',
		item_retail_price nvarchar(10) 'item_retail_price',
		item_size_code nvarchar(10) 'item_size_code', 
		item_comment nvarchar(4000) 'item_comment'
		)
	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @idoc	

	--SELECT * from #line_items

	declare @min_row int, @max_row int , @iCount int = 0, @newOrderno INT
	declare @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @colordescript nvarchar(50), @price decimal(16, 3), 
	@unit_price decimal(16, 3), @size nvarchar(10), @quantity int, @upc nvarchar(20), @retail_price decimal(16,3), 
	@line_memo nvarchar(4000), @upcnotFound int = 0,@pack1 int, @pack2 int, @pack3 int, @pack4 int, @pack5 int, 
	@pack6 int, @pack7 int, @pack8 int, @pack9 int, @pack10 int, @pack11 int, @pack12 int, @royaltor nvarchar(13),
	@color_code nvarchar(12), @division nvarchar(10), @packet nvarchar(20), @spack nvarchar(10), @sodetail_id int, 
	@sqlstatement nvarchar(max), @linecount int, @closed_wfsytem3_opt varchar(2) = 'N', @detail_count INT, 
	@ll_count int
	/*200926 Arun - if dateshipstart >=30 then 'HOLD' otherwise 'Open' as per Timmy call */
	/*200930 Arun - commented as per Timmy Phone conversation */
	--SELECT @closed_wfsytem3_opt  = CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(dd, getdate(), @date_ship_start) >= 30 THEN 'H' Else 'N' END

	SELECT @newOrderno = isnull(max(orderno),0) + 1 FROM soheader
	INSERT INTO soheader (orderno, orderid, custpo) Values(@newOrderno, @order_id, LEFT(@customerpo, 20))
	SELECT @min_row = min(_id), @max_row = max(_id) FROM #line_items
	SET @iCount = @min_row
	WHILE @iCount <= @max_row 
	BEGIN
	-- While @iCount <=@max_row
	SET @upcnotFound = 1
	SELECT @style = LEFT(style, 13), @color = LEFT(color, 12),@colordescript = colordescript,@size = size_desc, @quantity = item_qty, 
	@price = item_price,@retail_price = CONVERT(decimal(16,3), (case when isnull(retail_price, '')='' THEN '0.0' ELSE retail_price END)),
	@line_memo = isnull(line_memo, ''), @upc = isnull(upc, '')  FROM #line_items WHERE _id = @iCount
	SET @orig_price = @price
	-- 201020 Arun added for Customer's based LineDiscpercent as per Timmy Phone conversation.
	if @LnDiscPercent > 0.00 
	begin
		SET @price = @price - Round(@price * @LnDiscPercent/100, 2)
	end
	if @upc <> '' 
	--if @upc
	begin
		SELECT @style = style, @color = color, @royaltor = royaltor, @pack1 = isnull(pack1,0), @pack2 = isnull(pack2,0), @pack3 = isnull(pack3,0), 
			@pack4 = isnull(pack4,0), @pack5 = isnull(pack5,0), @pack6 = isnull(pack6,0), @pack7 = isnull(pack7,0), @pack8 = isnull(pack8,0), 
			@pack9 = isnull(pack9,0), @pack10 = isnull(pack10,0), @pack11 = isnull(pack11,0), @pack12 = isnull(pack12,0) 
		FROM code_SKU where sku = @upc AND custid = 'UPC'
		if isnull(@style,'') = '' and @@ROWCOUNT= 0
		begin
			SET @upcnotFound = 1
		end
		else
		begin
		SET @color_code = @color
		SET @upcnotFound = 0
		end
	-- if @upc
	end
	else
	begin
		if isnull(@style,'') = '' 
		begin
			delete from soheader Where orderno = @neworderno
			GOTO ExitSp;
		end
		SET @royaltor = ''
		SELECT @ll_count = count(*) FROM color WHERE code= @color
		PRINT '@ll_count ' + cast(@ll_count as nvarchar(10))
		if @ll_count = 0 
		begin
		SELECT @color_code = ivtf.color FROM ivtf JOIN color 
		ON ivtf.color = color.code 
		WHERE ivtf.code = rtrim(@Style) and  (UPPER(color.code) = UPPER(rtrim(@colordescript)) or UPPER(color.descript) = UPPER(rtrim(@colordescript)))
		PRINT 'COLOR CODE' + isnull(@color_code, '@color_code  is NULL')
		PRINT 'Color Descript' + isnull(@colordescript, '@color_descript IS NULL')
		if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
		set @color_code = LEFT(UPPER(rtrim(@colordescript)), 12)
		end
		else
		begin
			SET @color_code = @color
		end
	end
	Set @linecount = isnull(@linecount,0) + 1

	if @upcnotFound = 1 
	--if @upcnotFound = 1 
	begin
		If not exists(select code FROM ivtf WHERE code = @style)
		/*200909 Arun assuming item_number is coming in as code_color after joor_style_sync_option is set to by Color*/
		begin
			SET @style= SUBSTRING(@style, 1, charindex('_', @style,1) -1)
		end
		SELECT @division = division FROM ivtf WHERE code = @style AND color = @color_code

		SELECT @packet = pack FROM uv_dematrix_division WHERE code = @division AND size = @size

		SET @spack = 'qty' + cast(@packet as varchar(5))
		print 'spack' + isnull(@spack, 'spack is NULL')
		SELECT @sodetail_id = isnull(min(sodetail_id),0) FROM sodetail WHERE orderno =@newOrderno AND style = @style AND color = @color_code AND price = @price

	if @sodetail_id = 0 
	begin
	SET @sqlstatement = N'insert into sodetail(orderno,line, style, color, royaltor, ' + @spack + ', price, actual_price, currency, exchange_rate, warehouse, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, memo, closed, ticket_price, discpercent, orig_price)
	values(' ++cast(@neworderno as varchar(10))+',' +cast(@linecount as varchar(10)) +',''' + @style +''','''+ @color_code+''',''' + isnull(@royaltor, '') +''','+cast(@quantity as varchar(10))+',' 
	+cast(@price as varchar(10))+',' +cast(@price as varchar(10))+','''+@order_currency+''',1.00,''00'',0.00,0.00, '''+@line_memo +''','''+@closed_wfsytem3_opt+''',' + Cast(@retail_price as varchar(10)) + ',' + Cast(@LnDiscPercent as varchar(10)) +  ',' + Cast(@orig_price as varchar(10)) + ')'
	--if @upcnotFound = 1 
	end

	else
	--else 
	begin
	SET @sqlstatement = N' update sodetail SET ' +@spack +'='+@spack+' + '+cast(@quantity as varchar(10)) +', memo = isnull(cast(memo as nvarchar(max)), '''') + '',''''' +@line_memo + ''' WHERE sodetail_id = '+ cast(@sodetail_id as nvarchar(max))
	end
	/*only for debugging purpose*/
	PRINT @sqlstatement
	execute sp_executesql @sqlstatement
	end

	else
	begin
	SELECT @sodetail_id = isnull(min(sodetail_id),0) FROM sodetail WHERE orderno =@newOrderno AND style = @style AND color = @color_code AND price = @price
	if @sodetail_id = 0
	begin
	print 'insert into sodetail (orderno, line, style, color, royaltor, qty1, qty2,qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11,qty12,price, actual_price,
		currency, exchange_rate, warehouse, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, memo)
		Values(@newOrderno, @linecount, @style, @color_code, @royaltor, @pack1 * @quantity, @pack2 * @quantity, @pack3 * @quantity, @pack4 * @quantity, @pack5 * @quantity,
		@pack6 * @quantity, @pack7 * @quantity, @pack8 * @quantity, @pack9 * @quantity, @pack10 * @quantity, @pack11 * @quantity, @pack12 * @quantity, @item_price, @item_price,
		@currency, 1.00, ''00'', 0.00,0.00, @line_memo)'
		insert into sodetail (orderno, line, style, color, royaltor, qty1, qty2,qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11,qty12,price, actual_price,
		currency, exchange_rate, warehouse, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, memo, closed, ticket_price, discpercent, orig_price)
		Values(@newOrderno, @linecount, @style, @color_code, @royaltor, @pack1 * @quantity, @pack2 * @quantity, @pack3 * @quantity, @pack4 * @quantity, @pack5 * @quantity,
		@pack6 * @quantity, @pack7 * @quantity, @pack8 * @quantity, @pack9 * @quantity, @pack10 * @quantity, @pack11 * @quantity, @pack12 * @quantity, @price, @price,
		@order_currency, 1.00, '00', 0.00,0.00, @line_memo, @closed_wfsytem3_opt, @retail_price, @LnDiscPercent, @orig_price)
	end
	else 
	begin
	print '
		update sodetail set qty1 = qty1 + @pack1 * @quantity, qty2 = qty2 + @pack2 * @quantity,qty3 = qty3 + @pack3 * @quantity,qty4 = qty4 + @pack4 * @quantity,
		qty5 = qty5 + @pack5 * @quantity, qty6 = qty6 + @pack6 * @quantity, qty7 = qty7 + @pack7 * @quantity,qty8 = qty8 + @pack8 * @quantity, qty9 = qty9 + @pack9 * @quantity,
		 qty10 = qty10 + @pack10 * @quantity, qty11 = qty11 + @pack11 * @quantity, qty12 = qty12 + @pack12 * @quantity,memo = isnull(cast(memo as nvarchar(max)),'') + @line_memo
		 WHERE sodetail_id = @sodetail_id'
		 update sodetail set qty1 = qty1 + @pack1 * @quantity, qty2 = qty2 + @pack2 * @quantity,qty3 = qty3 + @pack3 * @quantity,qty4 = qty4 + @pack4 * @quantity,
		qty5 = qty5 + @pack5 * @quantity, qty6 = qty6 + @pack6 * @quantity, qty7 = qty7 + @pack7 * @quantity,qty8 = qty8 + @pack8 * @quantity, qty9 = qty9 + @pack9 * @quantity,
		 qty10 = qty10 + @pack10 * @quantity, qty11 = qty11 + @pack11 * @quantity, qty12 = qty12 + @pack12 * @quantity,memo = isnull(cast(memo as nvarchar(max)),'') + @line_memo,
		 closed = @closed_wfsytem3_opt
		 WHERE sodetail_id = @sodetail_id
	end
	--else
	end

	SET @iCount = @iCount + 1
	-- While @iCount <=@max_row
	END
	
		/*if nothing has been inserted to detail, delete the order */
	SELECT @detail_count = count(*) FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno
	if @detail_count = 0 
	begin
	delete from soheader WHERE orderno = @newOrderno
	return
	end

	if isnull(@shippingMethodCode, '') = '' 
	begin
		SElECT @shippingMethodCode = isnull(code,'') FROM shipvia WHERE UPPER(rtrim(descript)) = UPPER(rtrim(@shippingMethodName))
	end
	if isnull(@shippingMethodCode, '') <> '' 
	begin
		if len(@shippingMethodCode) <=4
		begin
		SET @shipvia_code = @shippingMethodCode
		end
		else
		begin
			SElECT @shipvia_code = isnull(code,'') FROM shipvia WHERE UPPER(rtrim(descript)) = UPPER(rtrim(@shippingMethodName))
		end
	end
	else
	begin
		SET @shipvia_code = @shipvia
	end
	if isnull(@payment_method_code,'') = '' 
	begin
		SELECT @payment_method_code= isnull(code, '') FROM terms WHERE UPPER(rtrim(descript)) = UPPER(rtrim(@payment_Method_name))
	end 
	if isnull(@payment_method_code,'') <> ''
	begin
	if len(@payment_method_code) <=5
	begin
		SET @terms_code = @payment_method_code
	end
	else
	begin
	SELECT @terms_code= isnull(code, '') FROM terms WHERE UPPER(rtrim(descript)) = UPPER(rtrim(@payment_Method_name))
	end
	end
	else
	begin
		SET @terms_code = @terms
	end
	if isnull(@buyername, '') <> '' 
	begin
	set @buyer = @buyername
	end
	else
	begin
	SELECT @buyer = isnull(name, '') FROM contacts WHERE email = @shippingEmail 
	end
	/*update soheader */ 
	update soheader set closed = @closed_wfsytem3_opt,ordertype = 'E', orderdate = @date_created, shipdate = @date_ship_start, canceldate = @date_ship_end,
	buyer = left(@buyer,30), refno = cast(left(@order_id,15) as nvarchar(15)), total = isnull(@order_total,0), 
	custpo = cast(left(@customerpo,20) as nvarchar(20)),contact_email =left(@shippingEmail,255), 
	customer = left(@customer_code,10), blname = left(@billing_name,30), bladdr1 = left(@billing_addr1,30), bladdr2 = left(@billing_addr2,30), 
	blcity = left(@billing_city,20), blstate = left(@billing_state,3), blzip = left(@billing_zip,10),
	country = left(@billing_country,35), currency = left(isnull(@order_currency, 'USD'),4), exchange_rate = 1.00, user1 = left(@user1,10), user2 = left(@user2,15), 
	user3 = left(@user3,15),user4 = isnull(left(@user4,1),'A'), user5 = left(@user5,20), salesrep1 =@salesrep1, salesrep2 = @salesrep2, commpcnt1 = @commrate1, 
	commpcnt2 = @commrate2, shipvia = @shipvia_code, terms = left(@terms_code,4), pricelevel = isnull(left(@pricelevel,1), 'A'), warehouse = '00', 
	taxrate = @taxrate, memo_code = left(@memo_code,10), box_mode = 1, inhouse_memo = @invoice_memo, ups_shipper = left(@ups_shipper,10),
	store = @shipping_code, shname = left(@shipping_name,30), shaddr1 = left(@shipaddr1,30), 
	shaddr2 = left(@shipaddr2,30), shcity = left(@shipcity,20), shstate = left(@shipstate,3), shzip = left(@shipZip,10), shcountry = left(@shippingCountry,35), 
	tax = 0.00, phone = LEFT(@shipping_phone, 15),
	misc = CASE WHEN @LnDiscPercent >0 THEN 0 ELSE -1 * @order_discount END , freight = @order_shipping_total, created_user = isnull(left(@wfuserid,10), 'SQL'),
	soh_discpercent = isnull(@LnDiscPercent, 0.00) 
	WHERE orderno = @newOrderno


	declare @line_number INT, @rownumber_detail int
	SET @line_number = 1 
	declare @soline int, @tempsodetail_id int, @ls_style nvarchar(13), @ls_color nvarchar(12), @ls_season nvarchar(10)
	declare @ls_royaltor nvarchar(10), @totalqty int
	create table #temp_sodetail (sodetail_id int, rowno int, orderno int)
	insert into #temp_sodetail (sodetail_id, rowno, orderno)
	(SELECT sodetail_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sodetail_id), @newOrderno FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno)
	(SELECT @rownumber_detail = isnull(max(rowno), 0) FROM #temp_sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno) 
	WHILE @line_number <=@rownumber_detail
	begin
	SELECT @tempsodetail_id = sodetail_id FROM #temp_sodetail WHERE rowno = @line_number
	SELECT @soline = line FROM sodetail where sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id
	if @line_number<> @soline 
	begin
	update sodetail set line = @line_number WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id and orderno = @newOrderno
	if @line_number = 1 
	begin
	SELECT @ls_style = style , @ls_color = color, @ls_royaltor = isnull(royaltor, '') from sodetail WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id 
	SELECT @ls_season = isnull(season,'') FROM ivtf WHERE isnull(code, '') = @ls_style AND isnull(Color, '') = @ls_color AND isnull(royaltor, '')  = @ls_royaltor
	end
	end
	SEt @line_number = @line_number + 1
	end
	drop table #temp_sodetail 

	select @totalqty = sum(qty) from sodetail where orderno = @neworderno
	SELECT @totalprice = sum(isnull(qty,0) * price) from sodetail where orderno = @neworderno

	update soheader set season = @ls_season, subtotal = @totalqty, total = @totalprice WHERE orderno = @newOrderno
	update joor_orders SET process = 'Y', hfcno = @newOrderno WHERE order_id = @order_id
	UPDATE joor_temp_order SET processed = 'Y', processed_date= getdate(), wf_orderno = @newOrderno WHERE _id = @id 
	PRINT 'WF ORDER# ' + cast(@newOrderno as varchar(20))
 END TRY
 
 BEGIN CATCH
	SELECT ERROR_MESSAGE() AS [Error Message]
	      ,ERROR_LINE() AS ErrorLine
	      ,ERROR_NUMBER() AS [Error Number]  
              ,ERROR_SEVERITY() AS [Error Severity]  
              ,ERROR_STATE() AS [Error State]
 END CATCH
 ExitSP:
 Return
END


usp_joor_styles_method 
create procedure usp_joor_styles_method
(@style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @joor_style_id INT, @method nvarchar(10)) 
AS 
BEGIN
if @method = 'CREATE' 
begin
IF NOT EXISTS(select joor_styles_id FROM joor_styles WHERE wf_ivtf_code = @style AND wf_ivtf_color = @color AND joor_style_id = @joor_style_id) 
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO joor_styles(wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color, joor_style_id)
	VALUES(@style, @color, @joor_style_id)
END
end
if @method = 'DELETE' 
begin
	DELETE FROM joor_styles WHERE wf_ivtf_code = @style AND wf_ivtf_color = @color
end
END

usp_linesheet_html 
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_linesheet_html] (@EMAIL NVARCHAR(255), @season_code nvarchar(20), @subject nvarchar(max) = NULL ) 
AS
DECLARE @tableHTML  NVARCHAR(MAX),@ssubject varchar(50)
if isnull(@subject, '') = '' 
begin
set @ssubject = @season_code + ' Styles.'
end
else
begin
SET @ssubject = @subject
end
declare @ls_sql_get nvarchar(max),@l_style nvarchar(15),@color nvarchar(15),@descript nvarchar(50),@price int ,@season nvarchar(15)
declare @size1 nvarchar(3),@size2 nvarchar(3),@size3 nvarchar(3),@size4 nvarchar(3),@size5 nvarchar(3),@size6 nvarchar(3),@size7 nvarchar(3),@size8 nvarchar(3),@size9 nvarchar(3),@size10 nvarchar(3),@size11 nvarchar(3),@size12 nvarchar(3)
declare @intval int , @tbl1 nvarchar(max),@tbl2 nvarchar(max), @rcount int
declare @maintbl nvarchar(max)
declare @intval_html int 
set @maintbl = '' 
set @intval = 1 
set @intval_html = 0
begin


select u.style,u.color,u.descript,u.price,u.season,u.size1,u.size2,u.size3,u.size4,u.size5,u.size6,u.size7,u.size8,u.size9,u.size10,u.size11,u.size12,ROW_NUMBER() over (order by (select 1))AS rowid  into #temptbl1
 from uv_viewlist u  JOIN temp_style_season t ON u.style = t.style AND u.color = t.color 
 where u.color<>'.'  AND isnull(t.season_code,'' ) = @season_code AND isnull(t.email_sent, 'N') <> 'Y' order by u.id   
 select @rcount = count(*) from #temptbl1 --order  by rowid 

--while @intval <= 7 --test
while @intval <= @rcount
begin
select @l_style= style,@color= color from #temptbl1 where rowid = @intval
print @l_style +'		'+@color
declare @str_html nvarchar(max)

exec  usp_linesheet_tblHTML @intval_html, @l_style,@color,@season_code ,@tbl2 out

set @maintbl =CONCAT(@maintbl,@tbl2)

print @maintbl 
set  @intval = @intval +1 ;
set @intval_html = @intval_html + 1 ;
end 
declare @tbl_header nvarchar(max) , @div nvarchar(max) 

set @tbl_header = case @season_code when 'CLOSE OUT' then  N'<table align="left" style="font-size:12px;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;width:794px;margin-left:5px;border:1px solid #2d58a6" style="width:798px"><tr><td align ="left" style="width:260px"><img width="173" height="52" style="margin-left:15px;" src="http://chennai.winfashion.net:85/sample_linesheet2/linesheet_img/Giovanna_Gold_Logo_360x.jpg"/></td><td>'+
				N'<h1 align="left" style="width:200px;margin-left:55px;color:#FF0000">SALE</h1></td><td align = "left" style="width: 260px;"><span style="color:#2d58a6;">'+
				N'<span style="font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; GIOVANNA APPAREL CORP</span><br/>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 214 W 39TH STREET, SUITE #607<br/>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; NEW YORK, NY 10018 </span></td></tr> '

else N'<table align="left" style="font-size:12px;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;width:794px;margin-left:5px;border:1px solid #2d58a6" style="width:798px"><tr><td align ="left" style="width:260px"><img width="173" height="52" style="margin-left:15px;" src="http://chennai.winfashion.net:85/sample_linesheet2/linesheet_img/Giovanna_Gold_Logo_360x.jpg"/></td><td>'+
				N'<h1 align="left" style="width:200px;margin-left:15px;color:#2d58a6">'+@season_code+'</h1></td><td align = "left" style="width: 260px;"><span style="color:#2d58a6;">'+
				N'<span style="font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; GIOVANNA APPAREL CORP</span><br/>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 214 W 39TH STREET, SUITE #607<br/>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; NEW YORK, NY 10018 </span></td></tr> '

set @div  = N'<tr>' + @maintbl +'</tr></table>'

EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail @recipients =@EMAIL,

usp_linesheet_html_all 
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_linesheet_html_all] (@season_code nvarchar(20), @subject nvarchar(max) = NULL ) 
AS 
declare @email nvarchar(255), @minid int, @maxid int, @iCount int
BEGIN
CREATE table #temp_contacts (email nvarchar(255), _id int IDENTITY(1,1))

insert into #temp_contacts (email) 
(select email from contacts where isnull(email_catalog, 'N') = 'Y' GROUP  BY email)
SET @iCount = 0 

SELECT @minid= isnull(min(_id),0), @maxid = isnull(max(_id), 0) FROM #temp_contacts
if @maxid = 0 
begin
	Drop table #temp_contacts
	return
end
SET @iCount = @minid
WHILE @iCount <= @maxid
begin
SELECT @email = email FROM #temp_contacts WHERE _id = @iCount
if isnull(@email, '') <> '' 
begin
    select @subject = email_subject  from temp_style_season where season_code = @season_code AND  isnull(email_sent, 'N') <> 'Y'
		if ( @subject ='')
		begin
		set @subject = @season_code
		end
	exec usp_linesheet_html @email, @season_code, @subject
end
SET @iCount = @iCount + 1
end
Drop table #temp_contacts
UPDATE temp_style_season SET email_sent = 'Y' WHERE isnull(email_sent, 'N') = 'N'
END


usp_ltc_error_email CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_ltc_error_email] 
(@email_main nvarchar(500), @email_cc nvarchar(255) = NULL)
AS 
/*170727 Arun added to send email about the status of the inventory sync*/
 DECLARE @Style NVARCHAR(MAX)= '', 
 @ls_subject nvarchar(50);
 SET @ls_subject = 'LTC Error Log'
 /*
Define CSS for html to use
*/
SET @Style += +N'<style type="text/css">' + N'.tg  {border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;border-color:#aaa;}'
    + N'.tg td{font-family:Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;padding:10px 5px;border-style:solid;border-width:1px;overflow:hidden;word-break:normal;border-color:#aaa;color:#333;background-color:#fff;}'
    + N'.tg th{font-family:Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:normal;padding:10px 5px;border-style:solid;border-width:1px;overflow:hidden;word-break:normal;border-color:#aaa;color:#fff;background-color:#C3A0FA;}'
    + N'.tg .tg-9ajh{font-weight:bold;background-color:#BBF7FB}' + N'.tg .tg-hgcj{font-weight:bold;text-align:center}'
    + N'</style>';
DECLARE @tableHTML NVARCHAR(MAX)= '';
SET @tableHTML += @Style + @tableHTML + N'<H2>LTC Error Log' + '</H2>' 
	+ N'<table class="tg">' --DEFINE TABLE
/*
Define Column Headers and Column Span for each Header Column
*/
	+ N'<tr>' 
    + N'<th class="tg-hgcj" colspan="7">' +' LTC Error Log For Date ' + convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) +'</th>' 
	+ N'</tr>' 
/*
Define Column Sub-Headers
*/	+ N'<tr>'
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Modulename</td>'
    + N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Code/Number</td>' 
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">IN/OUT</td>'
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Date</td>'
    + N'<td class="tg-9ajh">Error Description</td>'
	
/*
Define data for table and cast to xml
*/
      + CAST(( SELECT td = modulename ,
					'',
                    td = code ,
					'',
					td = isnull(IN_OUT, '') ,
					'',
                    td = format(error_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:MM:ss'),
					'',
                    td = error_desc ,
					''
             FROM   ltc_file_error WHERE isnull(is_notified, 'N') <> 'Y'
			
             ORDER BY 1 ,
                    2
           FOR
             XML PATH('tr') ,
                 TYPE
           ) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'</table>';
		   
--PRINT @tableHTML
DECLARE @RtnCode INT
EXEC @RtnCode = msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail
@profile_name = 'WinFashion', 
@recipients = @email_main,
@copy_recipients = @email_cc,
@body = @tableHTML,
@body_format = 'HTML' , 
@subject = @ls_subject
--wait for 15 seconds for the email to be sent
WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:015';

if @RtnCode = 0
begin
UPDATE ltc_file_error SET is_notified = 'Y', notified_to_email = @email_main, notified_datetime = getdate() WHERE isnull(is_notified, 'N') <> 'Y'
end

usp_Nuorder_line_Item_Process 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Nuorder_line_Item_Process](@LineIemJson nvarchar(max), @order_id nvarchar(50))
AS
declare @json nvarchar(max) , @sizeJson nvarchar(max), @jsonSize nvarchar(max)
declare @ProductTable TABLE (styleNumber varchar(20), color nvarchar(20), color_descript nvarchar(35), 
upc varchar(20), size varchar(4), qty int, price decimal, tbl_id int IDENTITY(1,1), line_memo nvarchar(4000))
declare @lineMemo nvarchar(300)
declare @upc nvarchar(30) , @size nvarchar(10), @price decimal(10,3) 

declare @lineitemsTbl JSON_ParseTable, @sizetbl JSON_ParseTable
declare @styleNumber nvarchar(20), @colorcode nvarchar(20), @color_descript nvarchar(35)
BEGIN
--SET @json = N'[{"product":{"_id":"5a791c13a71f9c0001eeded7","style_number":"024-2WBX5","color":"OPTIC WHITE","color_code":"OPTIC WHITE","season":"CORE","department":"HANES"},"ship_start":"2022-07-12T00:00:00.000Z","ship_end":"2022-08-11T00:00:00.000Z","sizes":[{"size":"XS","quantity":2,"price":37.83,"original_price":39,"upc":"843733110093"},{"size":"S","quantity":2,"price":37.83,"original_price":39,"upc":"843733110109"},{"size":"M","quantity":2,"price":37.83,"original_price":39,"upc":"843733110116"},{"size":"L","quantity":1,"price":37.83,"original_price":39,"upc":"843733110123"}],"warehouse":"00","prebook":false},{"product":{"_id":"60edc930f4cd64dc31547c94","style_number":"R24-2WCRT","color":"OPTIC OVER","department":"ORIGINALS"},"ship_start":"2022-07-12T00:00:00.000Z","ship_end":"2022-08-11T00:00:00.000Z","sizes":[{"size":"XS","quantity":4,"price":33.95,"original_price":35,"upc":"019596121495"},{"size":"S","quantity":3,"price":33.95,"original_price":35,"upc":"019596121501"},{"size":"M","quantity":2,"price":33.95,"original_price":35,"upc":"019596121518"}],"warehouse":"00","prebook":false}]' 
SET @json = @LineIemJson

insert into @lineItemsTbl(parent_jsonKey, jsonKey, jsonValue)
select 'line_items', [key], [Value] from openJSON(@json, '$')

declare @min_id int, @max_id INT, @iCounter  int = 0

SELECT @min_id = min(table_id), @max_id = max(table_id) FROM @lineitemsTbl

SET @iCounter = @min_id
WHILE @iCounter <= @max_id
begin
select @json = JSONvalue from @lineitemsTbl where table_id = @iCounter
--select @json as productjson
select @styleNumber = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.product.style_number'), @colorcode = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.product.color_code') , @color_descript = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.product.color') 
SELECT @sizeJson = JSON_QUERY (@json, '$.sizes'); SELECT @lineMemo = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.notes')
insert into @sizetbl(parent_jsonKey, jsonKey, jsonValue)
select 'sizes', [key], [Value] from openJSON(@sizeJson, '$')

declare @minid int, @maxid int, @iCnt int = 0
SELECT @minid = min(table_id), @maxid = max(table_id) FROM @sizetbl

SEt @iCnt = @minid 
While @iCnt <= @maxId
begin

select @jsonSize = jsonvalue from @sizetbl where table_id = @iCnt

insert into @ProductTable(styleNumber, color, color_descript, line_memo, upc, size, qty, price)
(select @styleNumber, @colorcode, @color_descript,@lineMemo, upc, size, qty, price from openJSON(@jsonSize)
WITH(upc varchar(20) '$.upc', size varchar(10) '$.size', qty int '$.quantity', 
price decimal '$.price'))

SELECT @upc = JSON_VALUE(@jsonSize, '$.upc'), @size = JSON_VALUE(@jsonSize, '$.size'), @price = JSON_VALUE(@jsonSize, '$.price')
--if @iCnt = 1 
--begin
	--UPDATE @ProductTable SET line_memo = isnull(line_memo, '') + isnull(@lineMemo, '') 
	--WHERE styleNumber = @styleNumber AND color = @colorcode AND upc = @upc AND price = @price
--end
SET @iCnt = @iCnt + 1
end
delete from @sizetbl
SET @iCounter = @iCounter + 1
END
SELECT @Order_id, stylenumber, color, color_descript, upc, size, qty, price, line_memo FROM @ProductTable
insert into NuORDER_orders (Order_id, style_number, color, color_descript, upc, size_desc, qty, price, line_memo)
SELECT @Order_id, stylenumber, color, color_descript, upc, size, qty, price, line_memo FROM @ProductTable

END

/*processed meaning the order has been processed,processed meaning ready for shipping*/

AS

declare @nuroder_order_id nvarchar(50), @style_code nvarchar(13), @color_code nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(12),

@ls_nuorder_color nvarchar(20), @ld_exchange_Rate decimal(16,3), @comm_rate1 decimal(16,3), @comm_rate decimal(16,3),  @salesrep1 nvarchar(10), @salesrep2 nvarchar(10),

@distri nvarchar(10), @ls_orderType nvarchar(10), @ls_currency nvarchar(10), @pricecol char(1), @upcnotFound tinyint = 0, 
@iCount int, @minrow int, @maxrow int, @irow int = 0, @rep_name nvarchar(100), @retailer_name nvarchar(100), @retailer_code nvarchar(100), @order_total decimal(16,3), 
@date_created datetime, @date_ship_start datetime, @date_ship_end datetime, @buyer_name nvarchar(100), @notes nvarchar(max), @shaddr1 nvarchar(100), 
@shaddr2 nvarchar(100), @shcity nvarchar(100), @shstate nvarchar(10), @shzip nvarchar(20), @shcountry nvarchar(100), @rep_code nvarchar(50), @billing_address1 nvarchar(100), @billing_address2 nvarchar(100), 
@billing_city nvarchar(100), @billing_state nvarchar(10), @billing_zip nvarchar(20), @billing_country nvarchar(100), @shipto_code nvarchar(20), @customer_id nvarchar(50),
@customer_code nvarchar(100), @customer_name nvarchar(100), @customer nvarchar(10), @blname nvarchar(30), @bladdr1 nvarchar(30), @bladdr2 nvarchar(30), @blcity nvarchar(50),

BEGIN

select  @prodJson = JSON_QUERY(@json, '$.line_items'), @billingJson = JSON_QUERY(@json, '$.billing_address'), @shippingJson = JSON_QUERY(@json, '$.shipping_address'),
@retailerJson = JSON_QUERY(@json, '$.retailer')

billing_state nvarchar(4) '$.state', billing_zip nvarchar(10) '$.zip', billing_country nvarchar(20) '$.country')

SELECT @shaddr1 = shipping_address1, @shaddr2 = shipping_address2, @shcity = shipping_city, @shstate = shipping_state, @shzip = shipping_zip, @shcountry = shipping_country,
@shipto_code = shipto_code

shipping_state nvarchar(4) '$.state', shipping_zip nvarchar(10) '$.zip', shipping_country nvarchar(20) '$.country', shipto_Code nvarchar(10) '$.code')

rep_code nvarchar(10) '$.rep_code', additional_discount decimal '$.additional_percentage', order_type nvarchar(20) '$.order_type')

If Exists(Select orderno FROM soheader where refno= @orderno)
begin
	return
end

if isnull(@prodJson,'') <> '' 
begin

shstate = @shstate, shzip = @shzip, shcountry = @shcountry, line_discount = @line_discount, rep_code = @rep_code, additional_discount = @additional_discount, billing_address1 = @billing_address1,

billing_state = @billing_state , billing_zip = @billing_zip, billing_country = @billing_country
WHERE order_id = @order_id

If Exists(SELECT orderno FROM soheader WHERE rtrim(refno) = rtrim(@orderno) )
begin
SELECT @wfordernumber = max(orderno) FROM soheader WHERE rtrim(refno) = rtrim(@orderno) 
UPDATE nuorder_orders SET Processed = 'Y', wf_orderno = @wfordernumber where order_id = @order_id AND orderno = @orderno
UPDATE NuORDER_temp_order SET processed = 'Y', wf_orderno = @wfordernumber WHERE _id = @temp_id

usp_Nuorder_order_import_ALL /*221028 Arun - this can be used to import the not imported orders from the Nuorder_temp_orders table */
CREATE PROCEDURE usp_Nuorder_order_import_ALL 
AS
declare @minid INT, @maxid INT , @iCnt int = 0, @order_data nvarchar(max), @order_id nvarchar(50), @temp_id int 
BEGIN

BEGIN TRY
	DROP TABLE #temp_nuorder_temp_order_temp
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
END CATCH
Create Table #temp_nuorder_temp_order_temp (order_id nvarchar(50), json_data nvarchar(max), table_id INT, _id INT IDENTITY(1,1))
INSERT INTO #temp_nuorder_temp_order_temp(order_id, json_data, table_id)
(select order_id, order_data, _id FROM NuORDER_temp_order WHERE isnull(processed, 'N') <> 'Y' )

SELECT @minid = isnull(min(_id),0) , @maxid = isnull(max(_id),0) FROM #temp_nuorder_temp_order_temp
SET @iCnt = @minid 
WHILE (@iCnt <= @maxid)
begin
SELECT @order_data = json_data ,@order_id = order_id, @temp_id = table_id FROM #temp_nuorder_temp_order_temp WHERE _id = @iCnt

--exec usp_Nuorder_order_import @json = @order_data, @temp_id = @temp_id, @status = 'processed', @wfuser_id = 'SQL', @autopick = 'N'
exec usp_Nuorder_order_import @json = @order_data, @temp_id = @temp_id, @status = 'processed', @wfuser_id = 'SQL', @autopick = 'N'

SET @iCnt = @iCnt + 1
end

DROP TABLE #temp_nuorder_temp_order_temp


END 

usp_nuorder_process_download CREATE PROCEDURE usp_nuorder_process_download (@json_data nvarchar(max), @download_id INT) 
AS
declare @order_data nvarchar(max), @minid int, @maxid int, @iCnt int = 0, @order_id nvarchar(50), 
@temp_id int 
BEGIN

insert into NuORDER_temp_order(order_id, order_number, custpo, created_date, order_data)
select order_id, order_number, custpo, cast(created_on as datetime), json_data from openJSON(@json_data) 
WITH(order_id nvarchar(50) '$._id',
created_on nvarchar(30) '$.created_on',
order_number nvarchar(50) '$.order_number',
custpo nvarchar(30) '$.customer_po_number',
json_data nvarchar(max) '$' as JSON)

UPDATE ecomm_order_download SET processed = 'Y', processed_date = getdate() WHERE _id = @download_id

Create Table #temp_nuorder_temp_order (order_id nvarchar(50), json_data nvarchar(max), table_id INT, _id INT IDENTITY(1,1))
INSERT INTO #temp_nuorder_temp_order(order_id, json_data, table_id)
(select order_id, order_data, _id FROM NuORDER_temp_order WHERE isnull(processed, 'N') <> 'Y' )

SELECT @minid = isnull(min(_id),0) , @maxid = isnull(max(_id),0) FROM #temp_nuorder_temp_order
SET @iCnt = @minid 
WHILE (@iCnt <= @maxid)
begin
SELECT @order_data = json_data ,@order_id = order_id, @temp_id = table_id FROM #temp_nuorder_temp_order WHERE _id = @iCnt

--exec usp_Nuorder_order_import @order_data, @temp_id, 'approved', 'SQL', 'N'
--exec usp_Nuorder_order_import @order_data, @temp_id, 'processed', 'SQL', 'N'
exec usp_Nuorder_order_import @json = @order_data, @temp_id = @temp_id, @status = 'processed', @wfuser_id = 'SQL', @autopick = 'N'

SET @iCnt = @iCnt + 1
end

DROP TABLE #temp_nuorder_temp_order

END

usp_nuorder_process_download_ALL CREATE PROCEDURE usp_nuorder_process_download_ALL 
AS
BEGIN
Declare @_id INT, @json_data nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cur_nu CURSOR FOR SELECT order_json_xml, _id FROM ecomm_order_download with(NOLOCK) Where ecomm_platform = 'NUORDER' AND isnull(processed, 'N') <> 'Y'  ORDER BY _id ASC
OPEN cur_nu 
FETCH cur_nu INTO @json_data, @_id 
WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
begin
	exec usp_nuorder_process_download @json_data, @_id
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_nu INTO @json_data, @_id 
end
CLOSE cur_nu
DEALLOCATE cur_nu

END 


usp_order_export_import_email_log 
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_order_export_import_email_log](@date_import datetime, @status char(1) , @email nvarchar(255))

AS
 DECLARE @Style NVARCHAR(MAX)= '';
 /*
Define CSS for html to use
*/
declare @subject nvarchar(500) 
Set @subject = N'Order ' + case when @status = 'E' THEN 'Export' ELSE 'Import' END + ' Log For Date ' + format(@date_import, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.fff')

SET @Style += +N'<style type="text/css">' + N'.tg  {border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;border-color:#aaa;}'
    + N'.tg td{font-family:Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;padding:10px 5px;border-style:solid;border-width:1px;overflow:hidden;word-break:normal;border-color:#aaa;color:#333;background-color:#fff;}'
    + N'.tg th{font-family:Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:normal;padding:10px 5px;border-style:solid;border-width:1px;overflow:hidden;word-break:normal;border-color:#aaa;color:#fff;background-color:#97F097;}'
    + N'.tg .tg-9ajh{font-weight:bold;background-color:#BBF7FB}' + N'.tg .tg-hgcj{font-weight:bold;text-align:center}'
    + N'</style>';
DECLARE @tableHTML NVARCHAR(MAX)= '';
SET @tableHTML += @Style + @tableHTML + N'<H2>Order ' + case when @status = 'E' THEN 'Export' ELSE 'Import' END +' Log For Date ' + format(@date_import, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.fff')+ '</H2>' 
	+ N'<table class="tg">' --DEFINE TABLE
/*
Define Column Headers and Column Span for each Header Column
*/
	+ N'<tr>' 
    + N'<th class="tg-hgcj" colspan="7">Order ' + case when @status = 'E' THEN 'Export' ELSE 'Import' END + ' Log For Date ' + format(@date_import, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.fff') +'</th>' 
	+ N'</tr>' 
/*
Define Column Sub-Headers
*/	
	+ N'<tr>'
	+ N'<td class="tg-9ajh">customer</td>'
    + N'<td class="tg-9ajh">custpo</td></tr>' 
/*
Define data for table and cast to xml
*/	
	if @status = 'E' 
	begin
     SET @tableHTML += CAST(( SELECT distinct td = customer ,
					'',
                    td = custpo ,
					''
				
            FROM soheader 
			JOIN so_manual_alloc s2 ON soheader.orderno = s2.orderno 
			WHERE s2.export_date>= @date_import and status = @status
			GROUP BY custpo, customer
             ORDER BY 1 ,2
           FOR
             XML PATH('tr') ,
                 TYPE
           ) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'</table>';
		  
	End
	Else
	begin
		 SET @tableHTML += CAST(( SELECT distinct td = customer ,
					'',
                    td = custpo ,
					''
				
            FROM soheader 
			JOIN so_manual_alloc s2 ON soheader.orderno = s2.orderno 
			WHERE s2.import_date>= @date_import and status = @status
			GROUP BY custpo, customer
             ORDER BY 1 ,2
           FOR
             XML PATH('tr') ,
                 TYPE
           ) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'</table>';
	end
	
SELECT @tableHTML
PRINT @tableHTML

EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail
@profile_name = 'WIN', 
@recipients = @email,
@body = @tableHTML,
@body_format = 'HTML' , 
@subject = @subject

usp_pick_insert_order CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_pick_insert_order](@orderno INT, @pickno INT, @allocation bit = NULl)
AS
Declare @style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @royaltor nchar(10)
DECLARE @count INT, @remainqty INT, @qty INT, @ship_qty INT, 
@pick_qty INT, @sodetail_id INT, @line INT, @alloc_qty INT
SELECT @count = count(*) FROM pickheader WHERE orderno = @orderno
if @count > 0 
	BEGIN 
		SELECT 0
		return
	END
ELSE 
	BEGIN
	INSERT INTO pickheader(pickno, user4, customer, blname, bladdr1, bladdr2, blcity, blstate,blzip,
	store, shname,shaddr1, shaddr2, shcity, shstate, shzip, phone, fax, salesrep1, salesrep2,commpcnt1,
	custpo, terms, shipvia, user1, user2, user3, user5, pricelevel, taxrate, shdept, memo, inhouse_memo,
	memo_code, closed, discountrate,discountdays,fob,billto,factored, season, distri, shipto_store,
	warehouse, country, shcountry, shipdate, canceldate, factor_approval,  box_mode, currency,
	exchange_rate, x_warehouse_date, request_date,releaseno, merchandiser, ref_phc, vendorno, cust_div, 
	facility_id, product_grp, edi_3pl)
	(SELECT @pickno, user4, customer, blname, bladdr1, bladdr2, blcity, blstate,blzip,
	store, shname,shaddr1, shaddr2, shcity, shstate, shzip, phone, fax, salesrep1, salesrep2,commpcnt1,
	custpo, terms, shipvia, user1, user2, user3, user5, pricelevel, taxrate, shdept, memo, inhouse_memo,
	memo_code, closed, discountrate,discountdays, fob,billto,factored, season, distri, shipto_store,
	warehouse, country, shcountry, shipdate, canceldate, factor_approval,  box_mode, currency,
	exchange_rate, x_warehouse_date, request_date,releaseno, merchandiser, ref_phc, vendorno, cust_div, 
	facility_id, product_grp, edi_3pl FROM soheader WHERE orderno = @orderno)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
	SET @line = 0
		BEGIN
			if @allocation is NULL 
			SET @allocation = 0
			BEGIN
			DECLARE cur_sodetail CURSOR FOR 
			SELECT sodetail_id, qty, shipped_qty, pick_qty , alloc_qty FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @orderno ORDER BY line 
			OPEN cur_sodetail 
			FETCH cur_sodetail INTO @sodetail_id, @qty, @ship_qty, @pick_qty, @alloc_qty
			While(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
				BEGIN
					
					if @allocation = 0 
					BEGIN
					SET @remainqty = @qty - (@ship_qty +@pick_qty)
					if @remainqty > 0
						SET @line = @line +1
						BEGIN
							 INSERT INTO pickdetail (pickno, style, color, royaltor, label,prepack_code,
							 qty1, qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,setid,line, 
							 commpcnt1,commpcnt2,ordered_style,ordered_color,sodetail_id,po1_cb,po1_up,
							 po1_in,sku_cb,cutdetail_id,actual_cost,cutno,carton_type,memo,sku_in,
							 line_mode,msn_no,price,orig_price, orderno, closed)
							 (SELECT @pickno, style, color, royaltor, label,prepack_code,
							 isnull(qty1,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty1,0) + isnull(pick_qty1,0)), isnull(qty2,0) -(isnull(shipped_qty2,0) + isnull(pick_qty2,0))
							 ,isnull(qty3,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty3,0) + isnull(pick_qty3,0)),isnull(qty4,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty4,0) + isnull(pick_qty4,0)),
							 isnull(qty5,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty5,0) + isnull(pick_qty5,0)),isnull(qty6,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty6,0) + isnull(pick_qty6,0)),
							 isnull(qty7,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty7,0) + isnull(pick_qty7,0)),isnull(qty8,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty8,0) + isnull(pick_qty8,0)),
							 isnull(qty9,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty9,0) + isnull(pick_qty9,0)),isnull(qty10,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty10,0) + isnull(pick_qty10,0)),
							 isnull(qty11,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty11,0) + isnull(pick_qty11,0)),isnull(qty12,0) - (isnull(shipped_qty12,0) + isnull(pick_qty12,0)),
							 setid,@line, 
							 commpcnt1,commpcnt2,ordered_style,ordered_color,sodetail_id,po1_cb,po1_up,
							 po1_in,sku_cb,cutdetail_id,actual_cost,cutno,carton_type,memo,sku_in,
							 line_mode,msn_no,price,orig_price, orderno, 'N' FROM sodetail WHERE sodetail_id =@sodetail_id)
							 if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
								begin
									UPDATE sodetail SET pick_no = @pickno WHERE sodetail_id = @sodetail_id
								end
						END--remainqty
					END --allocation
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							if @alloc_qty > 0 
							BEGIN
								INSERT INTO pickdetail (pickno, style, color, royaltor, label,prepack_code,
							 qty1, qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,qty10,qty11,qty12,setid,line, 
							 commpcnt1,commpcnt2,ordered_style,ordered_color,sodetail_id,po1_cb,po1_up,
							 po1_in,sku_cb,cutdetail_id,actual_cost,cutno,carton_type,memo,sku_in,
							 line_mode,msn_no,price,orig_price, orderno, closed)
							 (SELECT @pickno, style, color, royaltor, label,prepack_code,
							 isnull(alloc_qty1,0), isnull(alloc_qty2,0),isnull(alloc_qty3,0),isnull(alloc_qty4,0),
							 isnull(alloc_qty5,0),isnull(alloc_qty6,0),isnull(alloc_qty7,0),isnull(alloc_qty8,0),
							 isnull(alloc_qty9 ,0),isnull(alloc_qty10,0),isnull(alloc_qty11,0),isnull(alloc_qty12,0),
							 setid,@line, 
							 commpcnt1,commpcnt2,ordered_style,ordered_color,sodetail_id,po1_cb,po1_up,
							 po1_in,sku_cb,cutdetail_id,actual_cost,cutno,carton_type,memo,sku_in,
							 line_mode,msn_no,price,orig_price, orderno,'N' FROM sodetail WHERE sodetail_id =@sodetail_id)
							END 
							if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
								begin
									UPDATE sodetail SET pick_no = @pickno WHERE sodetail_id = @sodetail_id
								end
						END
				END -- cursor
				Close cur_sodetail 
				Deallocate cur_sodetail
		END
	END
END

usp_process_dsco_webhook_all Create Procedure usp_process_dsco_webhook_all 
AS 
declare @dsco_webhook_id INT , @minid INT, @maxid INT, @iCount int
declare @temp_table table 
(dsco_webhook_id INT, _id INT IDENTITY (1,1))

insert into @temp_table
(dsco_webhook_id)
(SELECT dsco_webhook_id FROM dsco_webhook WHERE isnull(processed, 'N') <> 'Y' AND method_name = 'ORDER_CREATED'
ANd isnull(orderno, 0) = 0)

SELECT @minid = min(_id), @maxid = max(_id) FROM @temp_table

SET @iCount = @minid
WHILE @iCount <= @maxid
begin
	SELECT @dsco_webhook_id = dsco_webhook_id FROM @temp_table WHERE _id = @iCount
	exec usp_dsco_order_process_webhook @dsco_webhook_id, 'SQL', 'N'
	SET @iCount = @iCount + 1
end
