usp_ret_ecomm 
/*190130 Arun added replace char(10), char(13) to replace any carriage return or line feed 
which causes JSON to fail */
/* 180216 dan - created */ 
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_ret_ecomm] (@code nvarchar(13), @html nvarchar(max) output)
AS 
declare @attrib nchar(500) 
DECLARE con_curs CURSOR FOR
	SELECT attrib_value  
	FROM ivtf_attribute WHERE style = @code order by position FOR READ ONLY

OPEN con_curs
FETCH con_curs INTO @attrib

-- loop until meet end of selected row
--set @html=@html+'<ul>'
/*190326 siva added ecomm attribute*/
set @html =  '<ul style="list-style-type:square">'
WHILE (@@fetch_status=0) 
	BEGIN
		set @html = isnull(@html,'') + '<li style="color:#707070;"><span style="color:grey;">'
		+rtrim(replace(replace(isnull(@attrib,''), char(10),'' ),char(13),''))+'</span></li>'
		FETCH con_curs INTO @attrib
	END
CLOSE con_curs
DEALLOCATE con_curs
set @html=@html+'</ul>'
/*190326 siva commanded */ 
--SELECT @html


usp_ret_html 
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_ret_html](@code nvarchar(13), @html nvarchar(max) output)
AS 
/*180921 Arun - added case statement as per Dan Email*/
/* 171224 dan - modified adding VIMEO video url */ 
/*170817 Arun added video URL */
/*190326 siva added ecomm attribute*/
declare @attribhtml nvarchar(max) 
exec usp_ret_ecomm @code, @attribhtml OUT
SET @html = isnull(@attribhtml, '') + (
select  top 1 
'<ul style="list-style-type:square"> '
/*190326 siva added washing instruction*/
+ case when  isnull(cast(washing_instruction1 as nvarchar(max)),'') <> '' THEN
'<li style="color:#707070;"><span style="color:grey;">'+
rtrim(isnull(cast(washing_instruction1 as nvarchar(max)),''))+' </span></li>   ' else 
'' end+
+ case when  isnull(fab_name,'') <> '' THEN
'<li style="color:#707070;"><span style="color:grey;">'+
rtrim(isnull(fab_name,''))+' </span></li>   ' else 
'' end+
case when  isnull(fab_content,'') <> '' THEN
'<li style="color:#707070;"><span style="color:grey;">'+
rtrim(isnull(ivtf.fab_content,''))+'</span></li> '
else '' end +      
case when isnull(ivtf.descript,'') <> '' THEN
'<li style="color:#707070;"><span style="color:grey;">'+
rtrim(isnull(ivtf.descript,'')) + '</span></li>' else '' end +      
 
'<li style="color:#707070;"><span style="color:grey;">Imported</span></li>'+   
case when isnull(ivtf.cutting_info, '') <> '' THEN
'<li style="color:#707070;"><span style="color:grey;">'+ 
rtrim(isnull(ivtf.cutting_info,''))+'</span></li>'
else '' end
+ 
'</ul>'+(case WHEN isnull(video_url,'') <> '' 
 THEN '<iframe src='+ RTRIM(LTRIM(video_url))
 +' width=640 height=360 frameborder=0 webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen allowfullscreen></iframe>' 
 ELSE '' END)
from ivtf
LEFT OUTER JOIN category ON ivtf.category = category.code
LEFT OUTER JOIN grp ON ivtf.grp=grp.code 
LEFT OUTER JOIN division ON ivtf.division=division.code
WHERE ivtf.code = @code)

SELECT @html


usp_return_header_open_detail_closed 
create procedure usp_return_header_open_detail_closed 
AS 
declare @orderno INT , @i INT, @count INT
create table ##temporder (orderno INT, rowno INT) 

insert into ##temporder (orderno, rowno)
(select orderno, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY orderno ASC) from soheader where isnull(closed, 'N') <> 'Y') 

SET @i = 1
SELECT @count = count(*) FROM ##temporder
WHILE @i <= @count
begin
	SELECT @orderno = orderno FROM ##temporder WHERE rowno = @i 
	exec sp_close_soheader_if_all_detail_closed @orderno
	SET @i = @i + 1
end
Drop table ##temporder

usp_revcascade_variant_insert /*20210203 Arun - this will update ecomm_ivtf_attrib which will then be used for inventory update*/
CREATE procedure usp_revcascade_variant_insert(@ijson nvarchar(max))
AS
declare @jsontable Json_parseTable 
declare @min_id int, @max_id int , @iCnt int = 0
declare @imageid1 nvarchar(100),@imageid2 nvarchar(100), @imageid3 nvarchar(100), @imageid4 nvarchar(100),
@image_url1 nvarchar(255), @image_url2 nvarchar(255), @image_url3 nvarchar(255), @image_url4 nvarchar(255), 
@variant_id nvarchar(100), @productid nvarchar(100), @ecomm_var_id int, @wf_ivtf_code nvarchar(100), @wf_ivtf_color nvarchar(20),
@sku nvarchar(50), @upc nvarchar(20), @size nvarchar(4), @var_title nvarchar(100), @created_date datetime
declare @json nvarchar(max) 

BEGIN
insert into @jsontable(jsonkey, jsonvalue)
select [key], value from openJSON(@ijson, '$.results')

select @min_id = min(table_id), @max_id = max(table_id) FROm @jsontable

SET @iCnt = @Min_id 
while @iCnt <= @max_id
begin/*begin of the loop */
SELECT @json = jsonvalue FROM @jsontable WHERE table_id = @iCnt

SELECT @variant_id = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.id'), @productid = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.product_id'), 
	@imageid1 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.media[0].media'), @imageid2 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.media[1].media'),
	@imageid3 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.media[2].media'), @imageid4 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.media[3].media'), 
	@image_url1 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.media[0].url'), @image_url2 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.media[1].url'),
	@image_url3 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.media[2].url'), @image_url4 = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.media[3].url'), 
	@wf_ivtf_code = JSON_VALUE(@Json, '$.parent_identifier'), @wf_ivtf_color = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.color'),
	@sku = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.brand_identifier'), @upc = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.upc'), @size = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.size'),
	@var_title = JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.name'), @created_date= Cast(JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.active_permit.start_at') as datetime)

	if Not Exists(Select ecomm_product_id FROM zz_ecomm_ivtf_attrib WHERE Ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' AND Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND Ecomm_product_variant_id=@variant_id)
	begin
		INSERT INTO Ecomm_ivtf_attrib(Ecomm_platform, Ecomm_product_id, Ecomm_product_variant_id, ecomm_sku, ecomm_barcode, 
		wf_ivtf_Code, wf_product_variant, wf_product_barcode,  color, size, 
		ecomm_product_variant_title,
		created_date, ecomm_product_image_id1, ecomm_product_image_id2, ecomm_product_image_id3, ecomm_product_image_id4, division)

		(SELECT 'REVCASCADE', @productid, @variant_id, @sku, @upc, 
		@wf_ivtf_code, @wf_ivtf_color + '^'+ @size, @upc, @wf_ivtf_color, @size, 
		@var_title, @created_date, @imageid1,@imageid2, @imageid3, @imageid4, 'A')
	end
	If Not Exists(select wf_ivtf_code FROM ecomm_ivtf_image WHERE ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid)
	begin
		if isnull(@imageid1,'') <> '' 
		begin
			INSERT INTO ecomm_ivtf_image(ecomm_platform, Ecomm_product_id, wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color, ecomm_image_position, ecomm_image_id, create_date, image_src, division)
			VALUES('REVCASCADE', @productid, @wf_ivtf_code, @wf_ivtf_color, 1, @imageid1, getdate(), @image_url1, 'A')
		end
		if isnull(@imageid2,'') <> '' 
		begin
			INSERT INTO ecomm_ivtf_image(ecomm_platform, Ecomm_product_id, wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color, ecomm_image_position, ecomm_image_id, create_date, image_src, division)
			VALUES('REVCASCADE', @productid, @wf_ivtf_code, @wf_ivtf_color, 2, @imageid2, getdate(), @image_url2, 'A')
		end
		if isnull(@imageid3,'') <> '' 
		begin
			INSERT INTO ecomm_ivtf_image(ecomm_platform, Ecomm_product_id, wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color, ecomm_image_position, ecomm_image_id, create_date, image_src, division)
			VALUES('REVCASCADE', @productid, @wf_ivtf_code, @wf_ivtf_color, 3, @imageid3, getdate(), @image_url3, 'A')
		end
		if isnull(@imageid4,'') <> '' 
		begin
			INSERT INTO ecomm_ivtf_image(ecomm_platform, Ecomm_product_id, wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color, ecomm_image_position, ecomm_image_id, create_date, image_src, division)
			VALUES('REVCASCADE', @productid, @wf_ivtf_code, @wf_ivtf_color, 4, @imageid4, getdate(), @image_url4, 'A')
		end
	end
	else
	begin
		if isnull(@imageid1,'') <> '' 
		begin
			UPDATE ecomm_ivtf_image SET ecomm_image_id = @imageid1,  wf_ivtf_code = @wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color = @wf_ivtf_color, image_src = @image_url1
			WHERE ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND ecomm_image_position = 1
			
		end
		if isnull(@imageid2,'') <> '' 
		begin
			UPDATE ecomm_ivtf_image SET ecomm_image_id = @imageid2,  wf_ivtf_code = @wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color = @wf_ivtf_color, image_src = @image_url2
			WHERE ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND ecomm_image_position = 2
		end
		if isnull(@imageid3,'') <> '' 
		begin
			UPDATE ecomm_ivtf_image SET ecomm_image_id = @imageid3,  wf_ivtf_code = @wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color = @wf_ivtf_color, image_src = @image_url3
			WHERE ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND ecomm_image_position = 3
		end
		if isnull(@imageid4,'') <> '' 
		begin
			UPDATE ecomm_ivtf_image SET ecomm_image_id = @imageid4,  wf_ivtf_code = @wf_ivtf_code, wf_ivtf_color = @wf_ivtf_color, image_src = @image_url4
			WHERE ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE' and Ecomm_product_id = @productid AND ecomm_image_position = 4
		end
	end
	SET @iCnt = @iCnt + 1
end /*end of loop*/

END

usp_revcascade_variant_insert_all /*whatever has been downloaded to ecomm_product_Download use that to update in ecomm_ivtf_attrib it's needed for inventory updates*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_revcascade_variant_insert_all]
AS
declare @json nvarchar(max), @_id int 
begin
DECLARE cur_ecomm_product_id CURSOR FOR SELECT _id FROM ecomm_product_download WHERE isnull(processed, 'N') = 'N' AND ecomm_platform = 'REVCASCADE'
OPEN cur_ecomm_product_id 
FETCH cur_ecomm_product_id INTO @_id
WHILE(@@fetch_status = 0)
begin	
	SELECT @Json = [response_data] FROM ecomm_product_download WHERE _id = @_id
	exec usp_revcascade_variant_insert @json
	update ecomm_product_download SET processed = 'Y' where _id= @_id
	fetch next FROM cur_ecomm_product_id INTO @_id
END
Close cur_ecomm_product_id
Deallocate cur_ecomm_product_id
End

usp_search_email 


CREATE PROCEDURE usp_search_email (@srchText nvarchar(max))
AS 
BEGIN 
if CharIndex('@', @srchText) > 0 
Begin
	SELECT * FROM v_diff_emails_table WHERE email like '%'+ @srchText+'%'
End
ELSE
BEGIN
	SELECT * FROM v_diff_emails_table WHERE code like '%'+ @srchText+'%'
END
END

usp_send_ecomm_invoice_platform CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_send_ecomm_invoice_platform] (@ls_ecomm_platform varchar(20))
as 
begin
declare @invoiceno int, @ecomm_inv_process_id INT, @sent_856 char(1), @sent_810 char(1), @customer nvarchar(20), 
@ecomm_platform nvarchar(20), @shipment_id nvarchar(50) 

Declare cur_inv CURSOR FOR 
SELECT ecomm_inv_process.invoiceno, ecomm_inv_process_id, ecomm_inv_process.ecomm_platform 
FROM ecomm_inv_process JOIN invheader ON ecomm_inv_process.invoiceno = invheader.invoiceno 
JOIN ecomm_platform ON ecomm_inv_process.ecomm_platform = ecomm_platform.platform_name
WHERE isnull(ecomm_platform, '') =  @ls_ecomm_platform AND isnull(invoice_generated, 'N') = 'N'  
GROUP BY ecomm_inv_process.invoiceno, ecomm_inv_process_id, ecomm_inv_process.ecomm_platform --AND isnull(invoice_generated, 'N') = 'N'
OPEN cur_inv
FETCH cur_inv INTO @invoiceno, @ecomm_inv_process_id, @ecomm_platform
WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
begin
	SELECT @customer = customer, @sent_810 = isnull(sent_810, 'N')  FROM invheader WHERE invoiceno = @invoiceno 
	if @sent_810  = 'Y'
	begin
		UPDATE ecomm_inv_process SET invoice_generated = 'Y', invoice_generated_date = getdate() WHERE ecomm_inv_process_id = @ecomm_inv_process_id
	end
	else
	begin
		exec dbo.usp_ecomm_GenerateInvoice @invoiceno, @ecomm_platform,  @customer
		select @shipment_id =  isnull(ecomm_invoice_id, '') from invheader where invoiceno = @invoiceno
		if @shipment_id <> ''
		begin
		UPDATE ecomm_inv_process SET invoice_generated = 'Y', invoice_generated_date = getdate() WHERE ecomm_inv_process_id = @ecomm_inv_process_id
		end
	end
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_inv INTO @invoiceno, @ecomm_inv_process_id, @ecomm_platform
	waitfor delay '00:00:03'
end
CLOSE cur_inv 
DEALLOCATE cur_inv
end

usp_send_inventory_xml_Joor 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_send_inventory_xml_Joor] (@code nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12))
AS 
   Declare @Object as Int;
Declare @ResponseText as Varchar(8000);
Declare @serviceUrl as varchar(500)
Declare @joor_api_url varchar(500) 
Declare @joor_base64 varchar(150)
Declare @joor_sysbase64 varchar(150)
Declare @div varchar(10) 
Declare @authheader varchar(120)
declare @xml VARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @hResult int
DECLARE @source varchar(255), @desc varchar(255), @methodName varchar(50) = ''
SELECT @joor_api_url = rtrim(joor_api_url), @joor_sysbase64 = rtrim(joor_api_key_base64) FROM wfsystem2 WHERE wfsystem = 1; 
/*170408 find for the particular style and color*/
SELECT @joor_base64 = isnull(div.joor_api_base64,'') FROM div LEFT OUTER JOIN ivtf ON ivtf.user4 = div.code WHERE ivtf.code = @code
AND ivtf.color = @color;
/*if master color don't send*/
if @color = '.' 
begin
	Return
End

if isnull(@joor_base64,'') = ''
	begin
		set @joor_base64 = @joor_sysbase64
	end

Exec @hResult = sp_OACreate 'MSXML2.XMLHTTP', @Object OUT;
/*overwrite option is for replacing*/
set @serviceUrl = @joor_api_url+'bulk-inventory/?overwrite=1'
Set @authheader = 'OAuth2 '+ @joor_base64 

Exec @hResult  = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'open', NULL, 'PUT',
                @serviceUrl, --Your Web Service Url (invoked)
                 'false'
--Exec sp_OASetProperty @Object, 'Content-Type', 'application/xml'
Exec @hResult  = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'Content-Type', 'application/xml'
Exec @hResult  = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'Authorization', @authheader
--Exec sp_OASetProperty @Object,'Authorization', @authheader


SET @xml = (
SELECT --	'00' as 'warehouse',
	'IMMEDIATE' as 'inventory_date',
	--ivtf.descript as 'inventory_item/style_name'
	rtrim(style) as 'style_number',
	rtrim(style) as 'style_identifier',
	rtrim(color) as 'color_code',
	rtrim(size) as 'size',
--	Case WHEN isnull(onorder,0) < (isnull(wip,0) + isnull(onhand,0)) THEN 
--	Cast (isnull(onhand,0) + isnull(wip,0) - isnull(onorder,0) as int) ELSE
--	0 END as 'inventory'
	Case WHEN isnull(OnorderCheckQty,0) < (isnull(wip,0) + isnull(onhand,0)) THEN 
	Cast (isnull(onhand,0) + isnull(wip,0) - isnull(OnorderCheckQty,0) as int) ELSE
	0 END as 'inventory'

FROM uv_dematrix_ivtf_upc_joor WHERE style = @code AND color = @color
FOR XML PATH ('inventory_item') ,
ROOT('inventory_items'))


Exec @hresult = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'Send', NULL, @xml

IF @hresult <> 0
BEGIN
	EXEC sp_OAGetErrorInfo @object, @source OUT, @desc OUT 
	SELECT 	hResult = convert(varbinary(4), @hResult), 
		source = @source, 
		description = @desc,
		FailPoint = 'ResponseText failed',
		MedthodName = @methodName
	goto destroy
	return
END
Exec sp_OAMethod @Object, 'responseText', @ResponseText OUTPUT
destroy:
	exec sp_OADestroy @object

Declare @Response as XML

--Select @ResponseText as XMLList

SET @Response = CAST(@ResponseText AS XML);

SELECT @Response
PRINT @methodName + '- '+ @desc

usp_send_invoice_customer_all 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_send_invoice_customer_all] 
as 
begin
declare @invoiceno int, @dsco_inv_process_id INT, @sent_856 char(1), @sent_810 char(1), @customer nvarchar(20)
Declare cur_inv CURSOR FOR 
SELECT invoiceno, dsco_inv_process_id FROM dsco_inv_process WHERE isnull(invoice_generated, 'N') = 'N'
OPEN cur_inv
FETCH cur_inv INTO @invoiceno, @dsco_inv_process_id 
WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
begin
	SELECT @customer = customer, @sent_856 = isnull(sent_856, 'N') , @sent_810 = isnull(sent_810, 'N') FROM invheader WHERE invoiceno = @invoiceno 
	
	if @sent_810 = 'Y'
	begin
		UPDATE dsco_inv_process SET invoice_generated = 'Y', invoice_generated_date = getdate() WHERE dsco_inv_process_id = @dsco_inv_process_id
	end
	else
	begin
		if @sent_856 = 'Y'  /*200625 Arun - Check if the Shipment has been sent, If Invoice is being sent before Shipment it would be rejected*/
		begin
		exec usp_DSCO_Invoice_customer @invoiceno , @customer
		end
	--	UPDATE dsco_inv_process SET invoice_generated = 'Y', invoice_generated_date = getdate() WHERE dsco_inv_process_id = @dsco_inv_process_id
	end
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_inv INTO @invoiceno, @dsco_inv_process_id
	WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:03'
end
CLOSE cur_inv 
DEALLOCATE cur_inv
end

usp_send_invoice_html_email 
create procedure [dbo].[usp_send_invoice_html_email]
(@Invoiceno INT) AS
begin
declare @email nvarchar(max) , @shipvia_ref nvarchar(55),
@email_sent char(1) , @customer nvarchar(10)

SELECT @shipvia_ref = isnull(shipvia_ref, '') , @email_sent = isnull(email_sent, 'N'), 
@customer = customer FROM invheader WHERE invoiceno = @Invoiceno

if @email_sent = 'Y'
begin
return
End

if @shipvia_ref = '' 
begin
return
End

exec  usp_get_contact_email @code = @customer, @module = 'web_ar', @contactemail = @email OUTPUT

if @email = '' 
begin
return
End
exec sp_invoice_email_wider @invoiceno, @email

End

usp_send_shipment_invoice create procedure usp_send_shipment_invoice (@invoiceno INT, @dsco_inv_process_id INT = null)
As 
declare @shipmentdate datetime , @invoicedate datetime
exec usp_DSCO_Shipment @invoiceno 
SET @shipmentdate = GETDATE()
Waitfor Delay '00:00:02'
exec usp_DSCO_Invoice @invoiceno 
SET @invoicedate = GETDATE()
if isnull(@dsco_inv_process_id,0) <> 0 
begin
update dsco_inv_process SET shipment_generated = 'Y', shipment_generated_date = @shipmentdate, invoice_generated = 'Y', invoice_generated_date = @invoicedate WHERE dsco_inv_process_id = @dsco_inv_process_id
end

usp_send_shipment_invoice_all 
create procedure usp_send_shipment_invoice_all 
as 
begin
declare @invoiceno int, @dsco_inv_process_id INT, @sent_856 char(1), @sent_810 char(1)
Declare cur_inv CURSOR FOR 
SELECT invoiceno, dsco_inv_process_id FROM dsco_inv_process WHERE isnull(shipment_generated, 'N') = 'N' AND isnull(invoice_generated, 'N') = 'N'
OPEN cur_inv
FETCH cur_inv INTO @invoiceno, @dsco_inv_process_id 
WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
begin
	SELECT @sent_856 = isnull(sent_856, 'N') , @sent_810 = isnull(sent_810, 'N') FROM invheader WHERE invoiceno = @invoiceno 
	if @sent_856  = 'Y'
	begin
		UPDATE dsco_inv_process SET shipment_generated = 'Y', shipment_generated_date = getdate() WHERE dsco_inv_process_id = @dsco_inv_process_id
	end
	else
	begin
		exec usp_DSCO_Shipment @invoiceno  
		UPDATE dsco_inv_process SET shipment_generated = 'Y', shipment_generated_date = getdate() WHERE dsco_inv_process_id = @dsco_inv_process_id
	end
	waitfor delay '00:00:01'
	if @sent_810 = 'Y'
	begin
		UPDATE dsco_inv_process SET invoice_generated = 'Y', invoice_generated_date = getdate() WHERE dsco_inv_process_id = @dsco_inv_process_id
	end
	else
	begin
		exec usp_DSCO_Invoice @invoiceno  
		UPDATE dsco_inv_process SET invoice_generated = 'Y', invoice_generated_date = getdate() WHERE dsco_inv_process_id = @dsco_inv_process_id
	end

	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_inv INTO @invoiceno, @dsco_inv_process_id
end
CLOSE cur_inv 
DEALLOCATE cur_inv
end

usp_shopify_attrib_update 
/*170811 Arun - variants are color _ size 
so need to do inside a loop */ 
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_shopify_attrib_update]
(@style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @isInventoryAll int = NULL) 
As
declare @prod nvarchar(max), @size nvarchar(max),
 @finalized nvarchar(max),  @body_html nvarchar(max) 
Declare @Object as Int;
Declare @ResponseText as nvarchar(max);
Declare @serviceUrl as varchar(500)
Declare @shopify_api_url varchar(500) 
Declare @shopify_base64 varchar(150)
Declare @joor_sysbase64 varchar(150)
Declare @authheader varchar(120)
DECLARE @hResult int
DECLARE @source varchar(255), @desc varchar(255), @methodName varchar(50)
Declare @div nvarchar(1), @shopify_api_key varchar(100),@shopify_api_secret varchar (100), 
@shopify_api_access_token varchar(100), @shopify_store_address nvarchar(255), 
@shopify_password varchar(50), @shopify_private_app bit, @shopify_id varchar(50), 
@ecomm_title_option varchar(1), @StatusText as Nvarchar(max), @ll_status_code INT,
@ecomm_price_option varchar(1), @ls_temp_url varchar(500), @sizevar nvarchar(10), 
@error varchar(500), @totalerror nvarchar(max) 

BEGIN

SELECT @shopify_id = isnull(max(shopify_id),'') FROM ivtf WHERE code = @style

/*loop for the attributes*/ 
declare @cur_code nvarchar(13), @cur_color nvarchar(12), @ll int, 
@shopify_variant_id varchar(100)
DECLARE cur_ivtf_ecomm CURSOR FOR 
SELECT uv.style, uv.color, e.Ecomm_product_variant_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY uv.style,uv.color, 
 sizebucket), uv.size FROM uv_dematrix_ivtf_UPC_ecomm uv
 LEFT OUTER JOIN 
 Ecomm_ivtf_attrib e ON uv.style = e.wf_ivtf_code 
 AND uv.color_descript = e.color  AND uv.size = e.size
 where  uv.style = @style AND uv.color = @color
OPEN cur_ivtf_ecomm 
FETCH cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll  , @sizevar


SELECT @ecomm_title_option = isnull(web_ecomm_prod_title,'C'), 
@ecomm_price_option = isnull(web_ecomm_price_option, 'A') FROM webconfig WHERE wfsystem = 1


 SELECT @div = user4 FROM ivtf WHERE code = @style AND color = @color

 SELECT @shopify_api_key = isnull(rtrim(shopify_api_key),''), @shopify_api_secret = isnull(rtrim(shopify_api_shared_secret),''), 
							@shopify_api_access_token = isnull(rtrim(shopify_api_access_token),''), 
							@shopify_store_address = isnull(rtrim(shopify_store_address),''), @shopify_password = isnull(rtrim(shopify_api_password),''), 
							@shopify_private_app = isnull(is_own_private_app,0)
FROM div WHERE code = @div
SET @shopify_api_url = @shopify_store_address 
if right(@shopify_store_address,1) <> '/'
	begin
		SET @shopify_api_url = @shopify_store_address  + '/'
		SET @ls_temp_url = @shopify_api_url
	End
SET @ls_temp_url = @shopify_api_url
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
BEGIN
	set @size = (
	 select CAST(@shopify_id as BIGINT) as 'product_id', 
	rtrim(uv.color) + '/' + rtrim(uv.size)   as 'title', 
	 e.Ecomm_product_variant_id as 'id',
	Case @ecomm_price_option 
		WHEN 'R' Then rtrim(isnull(uv.retail_price,0)) 
		WHEN 'A' Then rtrim(isnull(uv.price,0))
		WHEN 'B' THEN rtrim(isnull(uv.priceb,0))
		WHEN 'C' THEN rtrim(isnull(uv.pricec,0))
		WHEN 'D' THEN rtrim(isnull(uv.priced,0))
		WHEN 'E' THEN rtrim(isnull(uv.pricee,0))
		WHEN 'F' THEN rtrim(isnull(uv.pricef,0))
		WHEN 'W' THEN rtrim(isnull(uv.web_price,0))	
	END as 'price',
	 rtrim(uv.style) + '_'+rtrim(uv.color) + '_' + rtrim(uv.size) as 'sku',
	Case when isnull(uv.onhand,0) + isnull(uv.wip,0) - isnull(uv.onorder,0) > 0 Then 
	CAST (isnull(uv.onhand,0) + isnull(uv.wip,0) - isnull(uv.onorder,0)  AS INTEGER) Else 0
	end as 'inventory_quantity',
	 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY uv.style,uv.color, 
	 sizebucket)  as position, uv.weight_lb as 'weight', 'lb' as 'weight_unit' ,
	 'deny' as inventory_policy, 
	 NULL as 'compare_at_price'
	 FROM uv_dematrix_ivtf_UPC_ecomm uv
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	 Ecomm_ivtf_attrib e ON uv.style = e.wf_ivtf_code 
	 AND uv.color_descript = e.color  AND uv.size = e.size
	 where  uv.style = @style AND uv.color = @color AND uv.size = @sizevar
	 FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER)

	 SET @finalized = '{"variant" :'+@size+'}'

	 SET @serviceUrl = @ls_temp_url + 'admin/variants/' + @shopify_variant_id + '.json'
	 /*171213 Arun - if something is not synced just skip it*/
	 if isnull(@serviceURL,'') = '' 
	 begin
		 FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll, @sizevar
		 Continue
		--FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll, @sizevar
	 end

	
	SET @shopify_base64 = dbo.f_BinaryToBase64(CONVERT(varbinary(max), @shopify_api_key+':'+@shopify_password))
	Set @authheader = 'Basic '+ @shopify_base64 

	print 'Size:' + @size + 'Service URL: ' +isnull(@serviceUrl, '')
	
	exec @hResult = sp_oACreate 'Msxml2.ServerXMLHTTP.6.0', @object OUT;
	if @hResult <> 0
	 Exec @hResult = sp_OACreate 'MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP.5.0', @Object OUT;
	if @hResult <> 0
	 Exec @hResult = sp_OACreate 'MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP.4.0', @Object OUT;
	if @hResult <> 0
	 Exec @hResult = sp_OACreate 'MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP.3.0', @Object OUT;
	if @hResult <> 0
	 Exec @hResult = sp_OACreate 'MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP.2.0', @Object OUT;
	 SET  @methodName = 'PUT'

	
	 Exec @hResult  = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'open', NULL, @methodName,
                @serviceUrl, --Your Web Service Url (invoked)
                 'false'
--Exec sp_OASetProperty @Object, 'Content-Type', 'application/xml'
	Exec @hResult  = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'Content-Type', 'application/json'

	Exec @hResult  = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'Cache-Control', 'max-age=0'

	if @shopify_private_app = 1 
		begin
			Exec @hResult  = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'Authorization', @authheader
		end
	Else
		begin
			Exec @hResult  = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'X-Shopify-Access-Token', @shopify_api_access_token	
		end
	Exec @hresult = sp_OAMethod @Object, 'Send', NULL, @finalized

	IF @hresult <> 0
	BEGIN
		EXEC sp_OAGetErrorInfo @object, @source OUT, @desc OUT 
		SELECT 	hResult = convert(varbinary(4), @hResult), 
			source = @source, 
			description = @desc,
			FailPoint = 'ResponseText failed',
			MedthodName = @methodName
			CLOSE cur_ivtf_ecomm 
			DEALLOCATE cur_ivtf_ecomm
		goto destroy
		return
	END

	Exec sp_OAMethod @Object, 'responseText', @ResponseText OUTPUT
	Exec sp_OAMethod @Object, 'statusText', @StatusText OUTPUT
	Exec sp_OAMethod @Object, 'status', @ll_status_code OUTPUT
	if isnull(@ResponseText,'') = '' 
	Exec sp_OAMethod @Object, 'responseBody', @ResponseText OUTPUT

	if isnull(@ResponseText,'') = ''
	Exec sp_OAMethod @Object, 'response', @ResponseText OUTPUT

	if @ll_status_code NOT IN ('200', '201')
	begin
		if isnull(@isInventoryAll, 0) = 1 
		begin
			SET @error = JSON_QUERY (@ResponseText, 'errors')
			SET @totalerror = @totalerror + 'size ' + @sizevar +' ' + @error +','
		end
	end

	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll, @sizevar
END
CLOSE cur_ivtf_ecomm 
DEALLOCATE cur_ivtf_ecomm
if isnull(@totalerror ,'') <> '' 
begin
	if isnull(@isInventoryAll,0) = 1 
	begin
	INSERT INTO ecommerce_inventory_sync(style, color,  response_code, comment, memo, updated_date, ecomm_platform)
			VALUES(@style, @color, '',  'FEW ERRORS ENCOUNTERED.', @totalerror, getdate(), 'SHOPIFY')
	End
End
Else
begin
	if isnull(@isInventoryAll,0) = 1 
	begin
	INSERT INTO ecommerce_inventory_sync(style, color,  response_code, comment, memo, updated_date, ecomm_platform)
			VALUES(@style, @color, '',  'SUCCESS', 'SYNCED SUCCESSFULLY', getdate(), 'SHOPIFY')
	End
end
destroy:
exec sp_OADestroy @object

Declare @Response as nvarchar(max)

--Select @ResponseText as XMLList

SET @Response = CAST(@StatusText AS nvarchar(max));

SELECT @Response
PRINT @methodName + '- '+ @desc
end

CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_shopify_inv_update_clr_allstyles]
AS
begin
DECLARE @style nvarchar(13)
DECLARE @color nvarchar(12) 
DECLARE @icount int, @row_count int, @rowno int,
@temp_id INT, @is_queue INT = 1;
create table #shopify_styles(style nvarchar(13), color nvarchar(12), rowno INT, 
id int identity(1,1), temp_id INT)

truncate table ecommerce_inventory_sync

INSERT INTO #shopify_styles(style, color, rowno, temp_id) 
(SELECT ecomm_inventory_update_temp.style,   
         ecomm_inventory_update_temp.color, 
		 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ivtf.code, ivtf.color) ,
		 ecomm_inventory_update_temp.ecomm_inventory_update_temp_id
FROM ecomm_inventory_update_temp JOIN ivtf ON ecomm_inventory_update_temp.style = ivtf.code AND ecomm_inventory_update_temp.color = ivtf.color
WHERE is_update = 'N' AND isnull(ivtf.shopify_id,'') <> '' and ecomm_inventory_update_temp.ecomm_platform = 'SHOPIFY')

SELECT @row_count = count(*) FROM #shopify_styles
SET @icount = 1 
WHILE @icount<=@row_count
begin
	SELECT @style = style, @color = color, @temp_id = temp_id FROM #shopify_styles WHERE rowno = @icount 
	exec usp_shopify_inv_update_clr @style = @style, @color =@color, @is_Queue = @is_queue, @inventory_temp_id = @temp_id
	
	SET @icount = @icount + 1
end 
DROP TABLE #shopify_styles
END

usp_shopify_inventory_update_allstyles /*sync inventory for all items*/
CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_shopify_inventory_update_allstyles]
AS
begin
DECLARE @style nvarchar(13)
DECLARE @color nvarchar(12) 
DECLARE @icount int, @row_count int, @rowno int, @joor_response XML 
--DECLARE @joor_styles TABLE(style nvarchar(13), color nvarchar(12), rowno INT)
create table #shopify_styles(style nvarchar(13), color nvarchar(12), rowno INT, 
id int identity(1,1))

truncate table ecommerce_inventory_sync

INSERT INTO #joor_styles(style, color, rowno) 
(SELECT ivtf.code, ivtf.color, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ivtf.code, ivtf.color) 
FROM ivtf JOIN color ON ivtf.color = color.code WHERE ivtf.color <> '.' 
AND charindex('ASSORT', ivtf.color) = 0)

SELECT @row_count = count(*) FROM #shopify_styles
SET @icount = 1 
WHILE @icount<=@row_count
begin
	SELECT @style = style, @color = color FROM #shopify_styles WHERE rowno = @icount 
	Exec usp_shopify_inventory_update @style, @color, 1
	PRINT @style +'-' + @color 

	SET @icount = @icount + 1
end 
EXEC usp_ecommerce_inventory_sync_Email 'SHOPIFY'

DROP TABLE ##shopify_styles
END


usp_shopify_inventory_update2_sql 
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_shopify_inventory_update2_sql]
(@style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @is_queue INT, @inventory_temp_id INT) 
As
declare @size nvarchar(max), @finalized nvarchar(max), @methodName varchar(50)
Declare @div nvarchar(1), @shopify_id varchar(50), 
@sizevar nvarchar(10), @shopify_store_address nvarchar(300), @shopify_api_url nvarchar(500)
declare @ls_temp_url nvarchar(500), @serviceUrl nvarchar(500)
BEGIN
SET @methodName = 'PUT'

--Create table #temp_error(style nvarchar(13), color nvarchar(12), shopify_id nvarchar(50), error_text  nvarchar(max), 
--json_data nvarchar(max), id INT IDENTITY(1,1))

SELECT @div = user4 FROM ivtf WHERE code = @style AND color = @color

SELECT @shopify_id = isnull(max(shopify_id),'') , 
@shopify_store_address = isnull(max(rtrim(shopify_store_address)),'')FROM 
uv_shopify_inventory_view WHERE code = @style AND color = @color AND div = @div


/*loop for the attributes*/ 
declare @cur_code nvarchar(13), @cur_color nvarchar(12), @ll int, 
@shopify_variant_id varchar(100)
DECLARE cur_ivtf_ecomm CURSOR FOR 
SELECT uv.style, uv.color, e.Ecomm_product_variant_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY uv.style,uv.color, 
 sizebucket), uv.size FROM uv_dematrix_ivtf_UPC_ecomm uv
 LEFT OUTER JOIN 
 Ecomm_ivtf_attrib e ON uv.style = e.wf_ivtf_code 
 AND (uv.color_descript = e.color or uv.color= e.color)  AND uv.size = e.size 
 AND e.division = uv.div

 where  uv.style = @style AND uv.color = @color --AND uv.shopify_id = e.Ecomm_product_id
 
OPEN cur_ivtf_ecomm 
FETCH cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll  , @sizevar

SET @shopify_api_url = @shopify_store_address 
if right(@shopify_store_address,1) <> '/'
	begin
		SET @shopify_api_url = @shopify_store_address  + '/'
		SET @ls_temp_url = @shopify_api_url
	End
SET @ls_temp_url = @shopify_api_url
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
BEGIN
	set @size = (
	-- select CAST(@shopify_id as BIGINT) as 'product_id', 
	 select @shopify_id as 'product_id', 
	 e.Ecomm_product_variant_id as 'id',
	Case when isnull(uv.onhand,0) - isnull(uv.onorder,0) > 0 Then 
	CAST (isnull(uv.onhand,0) - isnull(uv.onorder,0)  AS INTEGER) Else 0
	end as 'inventory_quantity'
 FROM uv_dematrix_ivtf_UPC_Ecomm_Shopify uv
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	 Ecomm_ivtf_attrib e ON uv.style = e.wf_ivtf_code 
	 AND uv.color_descript = e.color  AND uv.size = e.size
	 where  uv.style = @style AND uv.color = @color AND uv.size = @sizevar
	 FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER)
	 SET @finalized = '{"variant" :'+@size+'}'
	 print @style + '_'+@color + '_json:' +@finalized
	 SET @serviceUrl = @ls_temp_url + 'admin/variants/' + @shopify_variant_id + '.json'
	 print @style + '_'+@color + 'url:' +@serviceUrl
	 /*171213 Arun - if something is not synced just skip it*/
	 if isnull(@serviceURL,'') = '' 
	 begin
		 FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll, @sizevar
		 Continue
		--FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll, @sizevar
	 end
	 --call Shopify_InventorySync 
	 begin try
	 exec usp_shopify_inv_update_sql2_clr @serviceUrl, @methodName, @finalized, @style, @color, @div , @is_queue, @inventory_temp_id
	 end try
	 begin catch	 
		--insert into #temp_error(style, color, shopify_id, error_text, json_data) 
		--Values(@style, @color, @shopify_id, error_number(), @finalized)
	 end catch
	 FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll, @sizevar
END  --Cursor
	CLOSE cur_ivtf_ecomm 
	DEALLOCATE cur_ivtf_ecomm
	--select * from #temp_error
	--drop table #temp_error
END-- Main

usp_shopify_inventory_update2_sql_multidiv CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_shopify_inventory_update2_sql_multidiv]
(@style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @is_queue INT, @inventory_temp_id INT) 
As
declare @size nvarchar(max), @finalized nvarchar(max), @methodName varchar(50)
Declare @div nvarchar(1), @shopify_id varchar(50), 
@sizevar nvarchar(10), @shopify_store_address nvarchar(300), @shopify_api_url nvarchar(500)
declare @ls_temp_url nvarchar(500), @serviceUrl nvarchar(500), @colordesc nvarchar(50)

BEGIN
SET @methodName = 'PUT'
SELECT @shopify_id = isnull(max(shopify_id),'') , @shopify_store_address = isnull(max(rtrim(shopify_store_address)),'')FROM uv_shopify_inventory_view WHERE code = @style AND color = @color

--SELECT @div = user4 FROM ivtf WHERE code = @style AND color = @color
SELECT @colordesc = descript FROM color WHERE code = @color 

DECLARE Cur_div CURSOR FOR SELECT distinct division FROM ecomm_ivtf_attrib WHERE wf_ivtf_code = @style AND (color = @color OR color = @colordesc)
OPEN Cur_div 
FETCH cur_div INTO @div
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

SELECT @shopify_store_address = isnull(max(rtrim(shopify_store_address)),'') FROM div WHERE code = @div

/*loop for the attributes*/ 
declare @cur_code nvarchar(13), @cur_color nvarchar(12), @ll int, 
@shopify_variant_id varchar(100)
DECLARE cur_ivtf_ecomm CURSOR FOR 
SELECT uv.style, uv.color, e.Ecomm_product_variant_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY uv.style,uv.color, 
 sizebucket), uv.size FROM uv_dematrix_ivtf_UPC_Ecomm_Shopify_invt uv
 LEFT OUTER JOIN 
 Ecomm_ivtf_attrib e ON uv.style = e.wf_ivtf_code 
 AND uv.color_descript = e.color  AND uv.size = e.size
 LEFT OUTER JOIN div ON e.division = div.code
 where  uv.style = @style AND uv.color = @color AND isnull(uv.warehouse,'00') = isnull(div.default_wh,'00') 
 AND e.division = @div
OPEN cur_ivtf_ecomm 
FETCH cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll  , @sizevar

SET @shopify_api_url = @shopify_store_address 
if right(@shopify_store_address,1) <> '/'
	begin
		SET @shopify_api_url = @shopify_store_address  + '/'
		SET @ls_temp_url = @shopify_api_url
	End
SET @ls_temp_url = @shopify_api_url
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
BEGIN
	set @size = (
	 --select CAST(@shopify_id as BIGINT) as 'product_id', 
	 select CAST(e.ecomm_product_id as BIGINT) as 'product_id', 
	 e.Ecomm_product_variant_id as 'id',
	--Case when isnull(uv.onhand,0) - isnull(uv.onorder,0) > 0 Then 
	--CAST (isnull(uv.onhand,0) - isnull(uv.onorder,0)  AS INTEGER) Else 0
	Case when isnull(uv.whqty,0) - isnull(uv.whonorder,0) > 0 Then 
	CAST (isnull(uv.whqty,0) - isnull(uv.whonorder,0)  AS INTEGER) Else 0
	end as 'inventory_quantity'
 --FROM uv_dematrix_ivtf_UPC_Ecomm_invt uv
 FROM uv_dematrix_ivtf_UPC_Ecomm_Shopify_invt uv
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	 Ecomm_ivtf_attrib e ON uv.style = e.wf_ivtf_code 
	 --AND uv.color_descript = e.color  AND uv.size = e.size
	 AND (uv.color =e.color OR uv.color_descript = replace(e.color,'u0026', '&') ) AND uv.size = e.size
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN div ON e.division = div.code
	 where  uv.style = @style AND uv.color = @color AND uv.size = @sizevar AND isnull(uv.warehouse,'00') = isnull(div.default_wh,'00') 
	 AND e.division = @div
	 FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER)
	 SET @finalized = '{"variant" :'+@size+'}'

	 SET @serviceUrl = @ls_temp_url + 'admin/variants/' + @shopify_variant_id + '.json'
	 /*171213 Arun - if something is not synced just skip it*/
	 if isnull(@serviceURL,'') = '' 
	 begin
		 FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll, @sizevar
		 Continue
		--FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll, @sizevar
	 end
	 --call Shopify_InventorySync 
	 PRINT @finalized
	 exec usp_shopify_inv_update_sql2_clr @serviceUrl, @methodName, @finalized, @style, @color, @div , @is_queue, @inventory_temp_id
	 FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ivtf_ecomm INTO @cur_code, @cur_color, @shopify_variant_id, @ll, @sizevar
END  --Cursor
	CLOSE cur_ivtf_ecomm 
	DEALLOCATE cur_ivtf_ecomm

	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_div INTO @div
END
CLOSE cur_div 
DEALLOCATE cur_div
END-- Main

usp_shopify_line_items_json_process 
/*To Process the line Items and have then inserted into ecommerce_orders */
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_shopify_line_items_json_process](@json nvarchar(max), @order_id nvarchar(100)) 
As
begin

declare @json_parsetable dbo.json_parsetable, @min_count int, @max_count int, @icount int, @jsonvalue nvarchar(max),
@line_id nvarchar(50), @product_id nvarchar(50), @variant_id nvarchar(50), @title nvarchar(500), @quantity decimal, 
@price decimal (10,3), @sku nvarchar(500), @variant_title nvarchar(255) , @size nvarchar(50),@color_descript nvarchar(200), @color_code nvarchar(13),
@style_code nvarchar(20), @division nvarchar(5), @line_memo nvarchar(max)


create table ##line_items (line_id nvarchar(50), product_id nvarchar(50), variant_id nvarchar(50), title nvarchar(500), quantity decimal, 
price decimal(10,3), sku nvarchar(500), variant_title nvarchar(500), count_id INT, size_desc nvarchar(30), style nvarchar(50), color nvarchar(100),
line_memo nvarchar(max))

insert into @json_parsetable
select 'line_items', [key], [Value] from OPENJSON(@json) 

/*only for debugging purpose*/
--select 'line_items', [key], [Value] from OPENJSON(@json) 

--select * from @json_parsetable

select @min_count = min(table_id), @max_count = max(table_id) from @json_parsetable WHERE parent_jsonkey = 'line_items' 


/*only for debugging purpose*/
--select * from @json_parsetable WHERE parent_jsonkey = 'line_items'  

set @icount = @min_count
WHILE @icount <=@max_count
begin
	SELECT @jsonvalue = jsonvalue FROM @json_parsetable WHERE table_id = @icount
	if Isnull(@jsonvalue, '')  <> ''
	begin
		if isjson(@jsonvalue) >0 
		begin
			insert into ##line_items
			(count_id, line_id, product_id, variant_id, title, quantity, price, sku, variant_title )
			(select @icount, *  from openJson(@jsonvalue)
			WITH (line_id nvarchar(50) '$.id',
				  product_id nvarchar(50) '$.product_id',
				 variant_id nvarchar(50) '$.variant_id', 
				 title nvarchar(500) '$.title',
				 quantity decimal(10,3) '$.quantity',
				 price decimal(10,3) '$.price',
				 sku nvarchar(500) '$.sku',
				 variant_title nvarchar(255) '$.variant_title'
			))
			/*only for debugging purpose*/
			--print 'insert into ##line_items ' + @jsonvalue

			--select @icount, * from ##line_items

			print 'price ' + cast (@price as nvarchar(20))
			declare @variant_title1 nvarchar(500), @slash_occurence int
			declare @lastpos int, @firstpos int
			SET @variant_title1 = (SELECT * FROM OPENJSON(@jsonvalue) with (variant_title nvarchar(255) '$.variant_title' ))

			PRINT '@variant_title1' + isnull(@variant_title1, '@variant_title1')

			SELECT @slash_occurence = LEN(@variant_title1) - LEN(REPLACE(@variant_title1, '/',''))

			if @slash_occurence > 1
			begin
				select @lastPos = LEN(@variant_title1) - CHARINDEX('/',REVERSE(@variant_title1)), @firstpos = charindex('/', @variant_title1)
				--SET @size = (SELECT SUBSTRING(@variant_title1, @firstpos + 2 , @lastPos - (@firstpos + 1)))
				--from the last occurence the size must be started also the color descript should be changed
				SET @size = (SELECT SUBSTRING(@variant_title1, @lastPos + 2 , @lastPos - (@firstpos + 1)))
				SET @color_descript = (SELECT substring(@variant_title1, 1,@lastPos))
			end
			else
			begin
				--SET @size = (SELECT REVERSE(SUBSTRING(variant_title, charindex('/', variant_title) + 1, len(variant_title))) FROM OPENJSON(@jsonvalue) with (variant_title nvarchar(255) '$.variant_title' ))
				SET @size = (SELECT (REVERSE(REVERSE(SUBSTRING(@variant_title1, charindex('/', @variant_title1) + 1, len(@variant_title1))))))
				--181119 Arun - color descript also need to be changed on the number of occurences of slashes.
				SET @color_descript = (SELECT substring(variant_title, 1, charindex('/', variant_title) - 1) FROM OPENJSON(@jsonvalue) with (variant_title nvarchar(255) '$.variant_title' ))
			end
			SET @size = rtrim(ltrim(@size))
			SET @size = REPLACE(@size,' ', '')
			
			--SET @color_descript = (SELECT substring(variant_title, 1, charindex('/', variant_title) - 1) FROM OPENJSON(@jsonvalue) with (variant_title nvarchar(255) '$.variant_title' ))
			--SELECT 'COLOR Desript ', @color_descript
			--print isnull(@size, 'size')
			delete from shopify_order_ids where order_id + line_id + product_id + variant_id IN (SELECT @order_id + line_id + product_id + variant_id FROM ##line_items WHERE count_id = @icount)
			
			insert into shopify_order_ids (order_id, line_id, product_id, variant_id, variant_title, color_descript, size)
			(select @order_id, line_id, product_id, variant_id, variant_title, @color_descript, @size FROM ##line_items WHERE count_id = @icount)

			SELECT @product_id = isnull(product_id, ''), @variant_id = isnull(variant_id,''), @title = isnull(title, '') FROM ##line_items WHERE count_id = @icount

			SELECT @style_code = max(wf_ivtf_code) FROM ecomm_ivtf_attrib WHERE isnull(Ecomm_product_id,'') = @product_id AND isnull(Ecomm_platform, 'SHOPIFY') = 'SHOPIFY'

			PRINT 'STYLE CODE' + isnull(@style_code, 'NULL STYLE CODE')
			--select * from ecomm_ivtf_attrib WHERE isnull(Ecomm_product_id,'') = @product_id AND isnull(Ecomm_platform, 'SHOPIFY') = 'SHOPIFY'
			--PRINT 'STYLE TITLE' + isnull(@title, 'TITLE')
			print 'Size: ' + @size
			if isnull(@style_code,'') = ''
			begin
				SELECT @style_code = isnull(max(code), '') FROM ivtf WHERE isnull(code,'') = @title or isnull(descript,'') = @title 
				if isnull(@style_code,'') = ''
				begin
				PRINT 'STYLE CODE2' + isnull(@style_code, 'NULL STYLE CODE2') + ' Title ' + @title +' does not exist '
				/*
				SELECT 'DROPPING Table ##line_Items ', isnull(@style_code, 'NULL STYLE CODE 2'), @title
				drop table ##line_items
				return
				*/
			end
			end
			SELECT @color_code = code FROM color WHERE isnull(code,'') = @color_descript or isnull(descript,'') = @color_descript
			--SELECT 'color code:' + @color_code, @color_descript 'color descript'
			/*181030 Arun - if color code is not found use description as color */
			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			begin
				set @color_code = @color_descript
			End
			Set @line_memo = 'Product_id: ' + rtrim(@product_id) + ' , Style: ' + rtrim(@style_code) + ' , color: ' +
			rtrim(isnull(@color_code, @color_descript)) + ' , Size: ' + rtrim(ltrim(@size))
		--	print 'line_memo:' + @line_memo
			/*181030 Arun - if style not found just use the descript as style */
			update ##line_items SET style = LEFT(isnull(NUllIf(@style_code,''), @title),13), color = LEFT(isnull(Nullif(@color_code,''), @color_descript),12), size_desc = @size, line_memo = @line_memo WHERE count_id = @icount

		end
		--PRINT 'count ' + cast(@iCount as nvarchar(20))
	end
	SET @icount = @icount + 1
end

delete from Ecommerce_Orders where order_id = @order_id AND Ecomm_Platform = 'SHOPIFY'
--select * from ##line_items
insert into Ecommerce_Orders(Ecomm_Platform,order_id, product_id, sku, item_price, item_qty, size_desc, line_memo, style, color) 
(select 'SHOPIFY', @order_id, product_id, sku, price, quantity, size_desc, line_memo, style, color FROM ##line_items)

drop table ##line_items
END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[usp_shopify_order_email] (@processed_date datetime, @email_@recipients nvarchar(max), @email_cc nvarchar(max) = NULL, @email_bcc nvarchar(max) = NULL)
as
begin
declare @cmd varchar(4000) , @filename nvarchar(max), @processeddate nvarchar(25)

SET @processeddate =  format(@processed_date, 'yyyyMMdd')
SET @filename = 'C:\temp\Shopify_webhook_process_job_' + format(getdate(),'yyyyMMddhhmmss') + '.xls'

--set @cmd = 'bcp "select * from ' + db_name() + '..shopify_webhook_process_job where format(processed_date, ''yyyyMMdd'')=' + @processeddate +'" queryout "'+@filename+'" -S ' + @@SERVERNAME + ' -Usa -P15848 -c'

SET @cmd = 'bcp "select ' + db_name() + '.dbo.f_return_shopify_process(cast('''+@processeddate + '''as datetime), getdate()) " queryout "'+@filename+'" -S ' + @@SERVERNAME + ' -Uplugg -P15848@admi -c'
print @cmd 

EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmd 

exec msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail
@profile_name = 'WIN', 
@recipients = @email_@recipients,
@copy_recipients = @email_cc,
@blind_copy_recipients = @email_bcc,
@body = 'Shopify Webhook Daily Process Job Excel Sheet', 
@subject = 'Shopify Webhook Daily Process Job', 
@file_attachments = @filename
END

	PRINT '@ll_count ' + cast(@ll_count as nvarchar(10))
	if @ll_count = 0

	PRINT 'COLOR CODE' + isnull(@color_code, '@color_code  is NULL')
	PRINT 'Color Descript' + isnull(@color_descript, '@color_descript IS NULL')
	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
	set @color_code = LEFT(UPPER(rtrim(@color_descript)), 12)

	begin
		if @is_webhook = 'Y'

		insert into shopify_webhook_process_job (orderid, ordernumber,import_order_number, memo, processed_date, processed)
		values(@order_id, @order_number, 0, 'Color: ' + @color_descript + ' Not Found . Shopify Order# ' +
		@order_number + ' soheader order# ' + cast(@newOrderno as nvarchar(20)) + '. Webhook_id: ' + cast(@shopify_webhook_id as nvarchar(20)), getdate(), 'N')
		end
--		ROLLBACK;
		return
	end
	end
	else
	begin
	SET @color_code = UPPER(@color_descript)
	end
end 

Set @linecount = @linecount + 1

begin

	SELECT @division = division FROM ivtf WHERE code = @style AND color = @color_code
	SELECT @packet = pack FROM uv_dematrix_division WHERE code = @division AND size = @size_desc
	SET @spack = 'qty' + cast(@packet as varchar(5))
	print 'spack' + isnull(@spack, 'spack is NULL')

	SELECT @sodetail_id = isnull(min(sodetail_id),0) FROM sodetail WHERE orderno =@newOrderno AND style = @style AND color = @color_code AND price = @item_price

	if @sodetail_id = 0 
	begin
	SET @sqlstatement = N'insert into sodetail(orderno,line, style, color, royaltor, ' + @spack + ', price, actual_price, currency, exchange_rate, warehouse, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, memo, closed)
	values(' ++cast(@neworderno as varchar(10))+',' +cast(@linecount as varchar(10)) +',''' + @style +''','''+ @color_code+''',''' + @royaltor +''','+cast(@item_qty as varchar(10))+',' 
	+cast(@item_price as varchar(10))+',' +cast(@item_price as varchar(10))+','''+@currency+''',1.00,''00'',0.00,0.00, '''+@line_memo +''','''+@closed_wfsytem3_opt+''')'

else

if @sodetail_id = 0
begin

	currency, exchange_rate, warehouse, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, memo)

	@currency, 1.00, ''00'', 0.00,0.00, @line_memo)'

	currency, exchange_rate, warehouse, commpcnt1, commpcnt2, memo, closed)

declare @soline int, @tempsodetail_id int
create table ##temp_sodetail (sodetail_id int, rowno int, orderno int)
insert into ##temp_sodetail (sodetail_id, rowno, orderno)
(SELECT sodetail_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sodetail_id), @newOrderno FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno)
(SELECT @rownumber_detail = isnull(max(rowno), 0) FROM ##temp_sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno) 
WHILE @line_number <=@rownumber_detail
begin
SELECT @tempsodetail_id = sodetail_id FROM ##temp_sodetail WHERE rowno = @line_number

begin
update sodetail set line = @line_number WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id and orderno = @newOrderno

begin
SELECT @ls_style = style , @ls_color = color from sodetail WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id 
SELECT @ls_season = isnull(season,'') FROM ivtf WHERE isnull(code, '') = @ls_style AND isnull(Color, '') = @ls_color
end
end
SEt @line_number = @line_number + 1
end
drop table ##temp_sodetail

 INSERT INTO store(customer, name, code, addr1, addr2, city, state, zip, country, warehouse, shopify_id)
 Values(@customer_code,@shname, @storeCode, @shaddress1, @shaddress2, @shcity, @shstate, @shzip, @shcountry,'00', @customer_id)
end

@comm_rate1 decimal (10,3), @comm_rate2 decimal (10,3), @user1 nvarchar(10), @user2 nvarchar(10), @user3 nvarchar(10),

@box_mode tinyint, @invoice_memo nvarchar(max), @ups_shipper nvarchar(10), @memo nvarchar(max)

declare @llCustCount INT ,@customer_code nvarchar(10), @storeCode nvarchar(10),@ll_stCount int, @create_store int = 0

@blzip = isnull(blzip,''), @blcountry = isnull(blcountry,''), @shname = isnull(shname,''), @shaddress1 = isnull(shaddress1,''),

	  shipping_title nvarchar(100) '$.order.shipping_lines[0].title',
	  shipping_id nvarchar(50) '$.order.shipping_lines[0].id',

end
else
begin

SELECT @order_id = order_id, @order_number = order_number,
@created_date = CONVERT(date, created_date),
@note = isnull(notes, '') ,@token = isnull(token,'') , @total_price = total_price, @subtotal_price = subtotal_price,
@total_tax = total_tax, @total_weight = total_weight, @currency = currency, @financial_status = isnull(financial_status,'') ,

@blzip = isnull(blzip,''), @blcountry = isnull(blcountry,''), @shname = isnull(shname,''), @shaddress1 = isnull(shaddress1,''), 
@shaddress2 = isnull(shaddress2, ''), @shcity = isnull(shcity,''), @shstate = isnull(shstate,''), @shcountry = isnull(shcountry,''),

@discount_code = isnull(discount_code,''), @shipping_price = isnull(shipping_price,0), @shzip = isnull(shzip,''), @blstate = isnull(blstate, '')

WITH (order_id varchar(50) '$.id',

shaddr2 = left(@shaddress2,30), shcity = left(@shcity,20), shstate = left(@shstate,3), shzip = left(@shzip,10), shcountry = left(@shcountry,35), tax = @total_tax,
misc = -1 * @total_discounts , miscdesc = left(@discount_code,25), freight = @shipping_price, created_user = isnull(left(@wfuser,10), 'SQL')
WHERE orderno = @newOrderno
/*190105 arun took out subtotal = @subtotal_price, subtotal is total qty */

if @memo_opt = 'I' 
begin
update soheader set inhouse_memo = isnull(cast(inhouse_memo as nvarchar(max)),'') + @memo where orderno = @newOrderno
end
else
begin
update soheader set memo = isnull(cast(memo as nvarchar(max)),'') + @memo where orderno = @newOrderno
end
end
PRINT 'WF ORDER# ' + cast(@newOrderno as varchar(20))
update Ecommerce_Orders set processed = 'Y' where order_id = @order_id
--update the line correctly 
SET @line_number = 1 
declare @soline int, @tempsodetail_id int
create table ##temp_sodetail (sodetail_id int, rowno int, orderno int)
insert into ##temp_sodetail (sodetail_id, rowno, orderno)
(SELECT sodetail_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sodetail_id), @newOrderno FROM sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno)
(SELECT @rownumber_detail = isnull(max(rowno), 0) FROM ##temp_sodetail WHERE orderno = @newOrderno) 
WHILE @line_number <=@rownumber_detail
begin
SELECT @tempsodetail_id = sodetail_id FROM ##temp_sodetail WHERE rowno = @line_number
SELECT @soline = line FROM sodetail where sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id
if @line_number<> @soline 
begin
update sodetail set line = @line_number WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id and orderno = @newOrderno
if @line_number = 1 
begin
SELECT @ls_style = style , @ls_color = color from sodetail WHERE sodetail_id = @tempsodetail_id 
SELECT @ls_season = isnull(season,'') FROM ivtf WHERE isnull(code, '') = @ls_style AND isnull(Color, '') = @ls_color
end
end
SEt @line_number = @line_number + 1
end
drop table ##temp_sodetail 
if @create_store = 1 
begin
 INSERT INTO store(customer, name, code, addr1, addr2, city, state, zip, country, warehouse, shopify_id)
 Values(@customer_code,@shname, @storeCode, @shaddress1, @shaddress2, @shcity, @shstate, @shzip, @shcountry, isnull(@warehouse,'00'), @customer_id)
end
END
select @totalqty = sum(qty) from sodetail where orderno = @neworderno

update soheader set season = @ls_season, subtotal = @totalqty WHERE orderno = @newOrderno
/*if it's from Shopify Webhook just update the processed Column as well */ 
if @is_webhook = 'Y' 
begin
update shopify_webhook SET processed = 'Y', orderno = @newOrderno where shopify_webhook_id = @shopify_webhook_id
insert into shopify_webhook_process_job (orderid, ordernumber,import_order_number, memo, processed_date, processed)
values(@order_id, @order_number, @newOrderno, 'Shopify Order# ' + @order_number + 'imported. WF order# ' + cast(@newOrderno as nvarchar(20)) + '. Webhook_id: ' + cast(@shopify_webhook_id as nvarchar(20)), getdate(), 'Y')
end
/*also update transaction information */
exec usp_shopify_order_payment_info @orderno= @newOrderno, @shopify_id = @order_id
if @autopick = 'Y' 
begin
	Execute create_pick_from_salesorder @neworderno
end

usp_shopify_webhook_sync create procedure [dbo].[usp_shopify_webhook_sync] 
As 
begin
DECLARE @shopify_webhook_id INT, @jsonstr nvarchar(max), @i INT = 0
declare @min_id INT, @max_id INT, @iCounter INT = 0, @processed char(1), @date_processed datetime = Getdate()

SELECT @min_id = isnull(min(shopify_webhook_id),0) , @max_id = isnull(max(shopify_webhook_id),0) FROM shopify_webhook WHERE isnull(processed,'N') <> 'Y'
and format(response_date, 'MM/dd/yyyy') = format(getdate(), 'MM/dd/yyyy')

SET @iCounter = @min_id
if @iCounter > 0 
begin
WHILE @iCounter <= @max_id

SELECT @jsonstr = response_data, @shopify_webhook_id = isnull(shopify_webhook_id,0), @processed = isnull(processed, 'N') FROM shopify_webhook WHERE shopify_webhook_id = @iCounter
if @processed <> 'Y'
begin

SET @i =  @i + 1
SET @iCounter = @iCounter + 1

if @i > 0

	end

end

usp_so_detail_close_recalc_shipped --Update closed and recalc salesorder shipped based on Customer and Orderno. Range.
CREATE PROCEDURE usp_so_detail_close_recalc_shipped(@customer nvarchar(10), @beg_orderno INT , @end_orderno INT)
AS
declare @orderno INT 
BEGIN
declare zz_cur_update CURSOR FOR 
SELECT sodetail.orderno FROM sodetail JOIN soheader ON sodetail.orderno = soheader.orderno 
WHERE soheader.customer = @customer AND soheader.orderno BETWEEN @beg_orderno and @end_orderno
open zz_cur_update 
FETCH zz_cur_update INTO @orderno 
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
begin
	UPDATE sodetail set sodetail.closed = 'N' WHERE sodetail.orderno = @orderno
	exec recalc_sodetail_shippedqty_orderno @orderno 
	exec recalc_soheader_shipped_orderno @orderno
	FETCH NEXT FROM zz_cur_update INTO @orderno
end
close zz_cur_update
deallocate zz_cur_update

END

usp_Sync_Nuorder_InventoryAll create procedure usp_Sync_Nuorder_InventoryAll(@method nvarchar(15))
as
declare @style nvarchar(13)
declare @color nvarchar(12)
declare @nuorder_id nvarchar(100)
declare @i INT, @rcount INT
BEGIN
create table ##NuORDER_Temp
(style nvarchar(13), color nvarchar(12), nuorder_id nvarchar(100), rowno int)

insert into ##NuORDER_Temp (style, color, nuorder_id, rowno)
(select  code, color, nuorder_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Nuorder_id Desc) 
FROM ivtf WHERE isnull(nuorder_id,'') <> '') 
SET @i= 1 
SET @rcount = (select Count(*) FROM ##Nuorder_temp)

While @i<=@rcount
begin
	SELECT @style = style, @color = color, @nuorder_id = nuorder_id FROM ##NuORDER_Temp WHERE rowno = @i
	Exec usp_Nuorder_Inventory @method, @style, @color, @nuorder_id 
	set @i = @i+1
end

DROP table ##NuORDER_Temp
END

usp_temp_image_file_copy_2dir create procedure usp_temp_image_file_copy_2dir(@format nvarchar(300))
as 
declare @image_id int, @style nvarchar(13), 
@color nvarchar(12), @division nvarchar(1),
@minid INT, @maxid INT, @iCount int, 
@filelocation nvarchar(500) 

SELECT @minid = isnull(min(_id), 0), @maxid = isnull(max(_id), 0) 
FROM temp_image_file_copy(NOLOCK) 
WHERE isnull(processed, 'N') <> 'Y'

if @minid > 0 
begin
SEt @iCount = @minid 
WHILE @iCount <= @maxid 
begin
if Exists(select image_id FROM temp_image_file_copy(NOLOCK) WHERE _id = @iCount)
begin
SELECT @image_id = isnull(image_id,0), @style = style, @color = color FROM temp_image_file_copy(NOLOCK) 
WHERE _id = @iCount
if @image_id > 0
begin
SELECT @division = user4 FROM ivtf(NOLOCK) WHERE code = @style AND color = @color 
SELECT @filelocation = web_prod_image_url FROM div(NOLOCK) WHERE code = @division
exec sp_copy_image_file @image_id, @filelocation, @format
UPDATE temp_image_file_copy SET processed = 'Y', updated_date = getdate() WHERE _id = @iCount
end
end

SET @icount = @iCount + 1
end

end

usp_test_ipdm_users_task 


CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_test_ipdm_users_task] (@begDate date,  @endDate date, @email nvarchar(255), @status char(2))
AS 
declare @url nvarchar(max)
Declare @overseas char(1)
--declare @begDate date, @endDate date
 -- Added by Mani G -151228 - If use_overseas_server(company_directory) is checked ,use the overseas_url,otherwise pdm_url (wfuser table)
select @overseas=isnull(Use_Overseas_Server,'N')  from company_directory where email=@email

if  @overseas ='Y'
	  begin
	     select @url = isnull(ltrim(rtrim(overseas_url)), '') from wfsystem3
 	  end
	else
	  begin
	    select @url = isnull(ltrim(rtrim(pdm_url)), '') from wfsystem3
	  end

--if Exists(select * from sys.tables where name = '##temptable')
--begin
--	drop table ##temptable
--end
--Create table ##temptable (heading nvarchar(max) , cutno varchar(255), controlno nvarchar(255), contractor nvarchar(255), 
--   customer nvarchar(255), style nvarchar(20), qty nvarchar(10),duedate nvarchar(20), note varchar(max), status_done nvarchar(2), 
--   xFactory nvarchar(20), prod_merch nvarchar(500))

--   insert into ##temptable (heading, cutno, controlno, contractor, customer, style, qty, duedate, note, status_done, xFactory, prod_merch)
--   (
select * from (
select 'Heading' as 'Heading', 'Cutno' as 'Cutno', 'Controlno' as 'Controlno', 'Contractor' as 'Contractor', 'Customer' as 'Customer', 
'Style' as 'Style', 'Qty' as 'Qty', 'Duedate' as 'Duedate', 'Note' as 'Note', 'Done'  as 'Done', 'xFactory' as 'xFactory', 'Prod/Merch' as 'prod_merch', 'PDM Date' as 'pdmdate'
UNION ALL
select isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.heading1,'') as Heading , cast(isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.cutno,0) as varchar(20)) AS cutno,
isnull(cutheader.controlno,'') AS controlno, isnull(cutheader.contractor,'')  AS contractor, 
isnull(cutheader.customer,'')  AS customer, isnull(cutheader.style_header,'')  AS style, convert(char(8),isnull(cutheader.total,0))  AS Qty, 
isnull(convert(char(10),Webcutheaderpdm.date1,101),'')  AS Duedate, isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.memo1,'')  AS Note, isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.status1,'N')  AS Done,
isnull(convert(char(10),cutheader.duedate,101),'')  AS xFactory,isnull(cutheader.merchandiser_header,'')  AS 'Prod/Merch',convert(char(10),Webcutheaderpdm.DATE1,101)

from Webcutheaderpdm join cutheader on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=cutheader.cutno 
where 
(Webcutheaderpdm.heading1 in (select case when code = '*' Then
webcutheaderpdm.heading1 Else code end from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 
and 
 isnull(cutheader.user4,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end),'') and 
	isnull(cutheader.customer,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end),'') and
	isnull(cutheader.contractor,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end),'') 
	and
	isnull(cutheader.merchandiser_header,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' 
		then cutheader.merchandiser_header else (select name from company_directory where code=PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser) end),''))
   or '*' in (select code from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 and 
	isnull(cutheader.user4,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end),'') and 
	isnull(cutheader.customer,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end),'') and
	isnull(cutheader.contractor,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end),'') and
	isnull(cutheader.merchandiser_header,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser='*' then 
	cutheader.merchandiser_header else (select name from company_directory where code=PDMTask_notifications.cut_merchandiser) end),'') )
)
    And Webcutheaderpdm.DATE1 between @begDate and @endDate and isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.heading1,'')<>'' 
	AND isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.status1,'N')=@status and isnull(webcutheaderpdm.closed, 'N')<> 'Y' 

UNION ALL

select isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.heading2,'') as Heading , cast(isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.cutno,0) as varchar(20)) AS cutno,
isnull(cutheader.controlno,'') AS controlno, isnull(cutheader.contractor,'')  AS contractor, 
isnull(cutheader.customer,'')  AS customer, isnull(cutheader.style_header,'')  AS style, convert(char(8),isnull(cutheader.total,0))  AS Qty, 
isnull(convert(char(10),Webcutheaderpdm.date2,101),'')  AS Duedate, isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.memo2,'')  AS Note, isnull(Webcutheaderpdm.status2,'N')  AS Done,
isnull(convert(char(10),cutheader.duedate,101),'')  AS xFactory,isnull(cutheader.merchandiser_header,'')  AS 'Prod/Merch',convert(char(10),Webcutheaderpdm.DATE2,101)

from Webcutheaderpdm join cutheader on Webcutheaderpdm.cutno=cutheader.cutno 
where 
(Webcutheaderpdm.heading2 in (select case when code = '*' Then
Webcutheaderpdm.heading2 Else code end from PDMTask_notifications where CHARINDEX(UPPER(@email),UPPER(exception_email))>0 
and 
 isnull(cutheader.user4,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.div='*' then cutheader.user4 else PDMTask_notifications.div end),'') and 
	isnull(cutheader.customer,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.customer='*' then cutheader.customer else PDMTask_notifications.customer end),'') and
	isnull(cutheader.contractor,'')=isnull((case when PDMTask_notifications.vendor='*' then cutheader.contractor else PDMTask_notifications.vendor end),'')

usp_test_order_cut_allocation_style_color 
CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_test_order_cut_allocation_style_color]

(@cutdetail_id INT, @cutqty1 INT, @cutqty2 INT, @cutqty3 INT, @cutqty4 INT, @cutqty5 INT, @cutqty6 INT, @cutqty7 INT, @cutqty8 INT, @cutqty9 INT, @cutqty10 INT, @cutqty11 INT, @cutqty12 INT)
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @ordqty1 INT, @ordqty2 INT, @ordqty3 INT, @ordqty4 INT, @ordqty5 INT, @ordqty6 INT, @ordqty7 INT, @ordqty8 INT, @ordqty9 INT, @ordqty10 INT, @ordqty11 INT, @ordqty12 INT
DECLARE @allocqty1 INT, @allocqty2 INT, @allocqty3 INT, @allocqty4 INT, @allocqty5 INT, @allocqty6 INT, @allocqty7 INT, @allocqty8 INT, @allocqty9 INT, @allocqty10 INT, @allocqty11 INT, @allocqty12 INT
DECLARE @fallocqty1 INT, @fallocqty2 INT, @fallocqty3 INT, @fallocqty4 INT, @fallocqty5 INT, @fallocqty6 INT, @fallocqty7 INT, @fallocqty8 INT, @fallocqty9 INT, @fallocqty10 INT, @fallocqty11 INT, @fallocqty12 INT
DECLARE @remqty1 INT, @remqty2 INT, @remqty3 INT, @remqty4 INT, @remqty5 INT, @remqty6 INT, @remqty7 INT, @remqty8 INT, @remqty9 INT, @remqty10 INT, @remqty11 INT, @remqty12 INT
declare @rcount INT, @i INT, @sodetail_id INT, @warehouse nchar(2)
DECLARE @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(10)

SELECT @style = isnull(style,'') , @color = isnull(color,'') , @royaltor = isnull(royaltor,'') FROM cutdetail 
WHERE cutdetail_id = @cutdetail_id

create table #cuttemp 
( sodetail_id INT, warehouse nchar(2),
cutdetail_id INT,
qty1 INT, qty2 INT, qty3 INT, qty4 INT, qty5 INT, qty6 INT, qty7 INT, qty8 INT, qty9 INT, qty10 INT, qty11 INT, qty12 INT,
alloc_qty1 INT, alloc_qty2 INT, alloc_qty3 INT, alloc_qty4 INT, alloc_qty5 INT, alloc_qty6 INT, alloc_qty7 INT, alloc_qty8 INT,
alloc_qty9 INT, alloc_qty10 INT, alloc_qty11 INT, alloc_qty12 INT, rowno INT) 


INSERT INTO #cuttemp
(sodetail_id, warehouse, cutdetail_id, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12,alloc_qty1, alloc_qty2, alloc_qty3, alloc_qty4, alloc_qty5,alloc_qty6, alloc_qty7, alloc_qty8, alloc_qty9, alloc_qty10,  alloc_qty11, alloc_qty12 ,rowno )
(SELECT sodetail_id,isnull(warehouse,'00'), cutdetail_id, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12,alloc_qty1, alloc_qty2, alloc_qty3, alloc_qty4, alloc_qty5,alloc_qty6, alloc_qty7, alloc_qty8, alloc_qty9, alloc_qty10,  alloc_qty11, alloc_qty12, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sodetail_id)
FROM sodetail WHERE style = isnull(style,'') AND color = isnull(color,'') AND royaltor = isnull(royaltor,'') and isnull(closed, 'N') <> 'Y')

--FROM sodetail WHERE cutdetail_id = @cutdetail_id and isnull(closed, 'N') <> 'Y')

SELECT @rcount= count(*) FROM #cuttemp

SET @i = 1

SET @remqty1 = case when @cutqty1 < 0 THEN 0 else @CUTQTY1 end
SET @remqty2 = CASE WHEN @cutqty2 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty2 End
SET @remqty3 = CASE WHEN @cutqty3 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty3 END
SET @remqty4 = CASE WHEN @cutqty4 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty4 END
SET @remqty5 = CASE WHEN @cutqty5 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty5 END
SET @remqty6 = CASE WHEN @cutqty6 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty6 END
SET @remqty7 = CASE WHEN @cutqty7 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty7 END
SET @remqty8 = CASE WHEN @cutqty8 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty8 END
SET @remqty9 = CASE WHEN @cutqty9 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty9 END
SET @remqty10 = CASE WHEN @cutqty10 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty10 END
SET @remqty11 = CASE WHEN @cutqty11 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty11 END
SET @remqty12 = CASE WHEN @cutqty12 < 0 THEN 0 else @cutqty12 END

WHILE @i <= @rcount
begin
       SELECT @sodetail_id = sodetail_id, @warehouse = warehouse, @ordqty1 = qty1, @ordqty2 = qty2, @ordqty3 = qty3, @ordqty4 = qty4, @ordqty5=qty5, @ordqty6 = qty6, @ordqty7 = qty7, @ordqty8 = qty8, @ordqty9 = qty9,@ordqty10 = qty10, @ordqty11 = qty11, @ordqty12 = qty12 , @allocqty1 = alloc_qty1, @allocqty2 = alloc_qty2, @allocqty3 = alloc_qty3, @allocqty4 = alloc_qty4, @allocqty5 = alloc_qty5, @allocqty6 = alloc_qty6,@allocqty7 = alloc_qty7, @allocqty8 =alloc_qty8, @allocqty9 = alloc_qty9, @allocqty10 = alloc_qty10, @allocqty11 = alloc_qty11, @allocqty12 = alloc_qty12
	     FROM #cuttemp WHERE rowno = @i

		SET @fallocqty1 = @allocqty1
		SET @fallocqty2 = @allocqty2
		SET @fallocqty3 = @allocqty3
		SET @fallocqty4 = @allocqty4
		SET @fallocqty5 = @allocqty5
		SET @fallocqty6 = @allocqty6
		SET @fallocqty7 = @allocqty7
		SET @fallocqty8 = @allocqty8
		SET @fallocqty9 = @allocqty9
		SET @fallocqty10 = @allocqty10

usp_upd_invh_tot_sub_invd 
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_upd_invh_tot_sub_invd(@invoiceno INT) 
AS 
BEGIN 
declare @det_total decimal, @header_total decimal, @header_subtotal decimal,
@header_misc decimal, @header_Freight decimal, @totaltax decimal, @payment decimal 
SELECT @det_total = isnull(sum(invdetail.qty*price),0) FROM invdetail WHERE invoiceno = @invoiceno
SELECT @header_subtotal = isnull(subtotal,0), @header_total = isnull(total,0),@header_misc= isnull(misc,0) , 
@header_Freight = isnull(freight,0) , @totaltax = isnull(tax,0) + isnull(tax2,0) , @payment = isnull(payment,0)
FROM invheader WHERE invoiceno = @invoiceno

if @header_subtotal <> @det_total 
begin
	UPDATE invheader SET subtotal = @det_total WHERE invoiceno = @invoiceno
	UPDATE invheader SET total = @header_subtotal + @header_misc + @header_Freight + @totaltax - @payment WHERE invoiceno = @invoiceno
end

END

usp_update_boxqty create PROC usp_update_boxqty (@pickno INT )
AS 
BEGIN

update pickheader set boxqty =  (SELECT coalesce (SUM(
  (ISNULL(qty1, 0) + ISNULL(qty2, 0) + ISNULL(qty3, 0) + ISNULL(qty4, 0) + ISNULL(qty5, 0) + ISNULL(qty6, 0) + ISNULL(qty7, 0)
   + ISNULL(qty8, 0) + ISNULL(qty9, 0)+ ISNULL(qty10, 0)+ ISNULL(qty11, 0)+ ISNULL(qty12, 0)) * (endbox - begbox + 1)),0)
  FROM packlist p, invhead_box b
  where p.pickno = pickheader.pickno AND b.pickno = pickheader.pickno AND p.boxno = b.boxno AND b.pickno IS NOT NULL )
WHERE isnull(pickheader.pickno,0) = @pickno 
END

usp_update_ivtf_cost_cutdetail 
create procedure 
usp_update_ivtf_cost_cutdetail 
(@style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(11) ) 
as 
declare @actual_cost money, @ivtf_avgcost money, @ivtf_onhand int 
begin
select @actual_cost =  
isnull(actual_cost,0) from cutdetail where cutdetail_id = 
 (select max(cutdetail_id) from cutdetail  where style = @style and color = @color 
 AND isnull(royaltor,'') = isnull(@royaltor, '') and isnull(actual_cost,0) > 0)

 update ivtf set cost = @actual_cost, lstcost = @actual_cost WHERE code = @style AND color = @color 
 AND isnull(royaltor, '') = isnull(@royaltor,'')


 select @ivtf_avgcost=isnull(avgcost,0), @ivtf_onhand=ivtf.qty
from ivtf where  code=@style AND color=@color

if @ivtf_onhand <>0
update ivtf set avgcost = round( (@ivtf_avgcost*@ivtf_onhand + ivtf.qty*(lstcost))/@ivtf_onhand , 2 ) 
 WHERE code=@style AND color=@color AND isnull(royaltor, '') = isnull(@royaltor,'')

End

usp_update_ivtf_cost_discrepancy create procedure usp_update_ivtf_cost_discrepancy
as 
declare @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(11)
begin
declare cur_update_ivtf_cost_cutdetail CURSOR FOR 
SELECT code, color, isnull(royaltor,'') FROM ivtf 
where isnull(cost,0.00) <>
 (select 
 isnull(actual_cost,0.00) from cutdetail where cutdetail.style = ivtf.code AND 
 cutdetail.color = ivtf.color and cutdetail_id = 
 (select max(cutdetail_id) from cutdetail v2 where v2.style = cutdetail.style and v2.color = 
 cutdetail.color)) 
OPEN cur_update_ivtf_cost_cutdetail 
FETCH cur_update_ivtf_cost_cutdetail INTO @style, @color, @royaltor
while (@@FETCH_STATUS =0 )
begin
	exec usp_update_ivtf_cost_cutdetail @style, @color, @royaltor
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur_update_ivtf_cost_cutdetail INTO @style, @color, @royaltor
end
CLOSE cur_update_ivtf_cost_cutdetail 
DEALLOCATE cur_update_ivtf_cost_cutdetail
end

usp_update_ivtr_onorder 
CREATE PROCEDURE usp_update_ivtr_onorder (@podetail_id INT) 
AS
BEGIN
update ivtr set onorder = COALESCE(onorder,0) + COALESCE(podetail.qty1,0) - Coalesce(podetail.qty2,0) 
FROM ivtr JOIN podetail ON ivtr.type = podetail.type AND ivtr.code = podetail.style AND ivtr.color = podetail.color 
WHERE podetail.PODETAIL_ID = @podetail_id
END

usp_update_orderno 
Create Procedure usp_update_orderno(@fromOrderno int, @toorderno int) 
AS 
BEGIN 
DECLARE @ll_count INT
DECLARE @errorMessage varchar(255)
SELECT @ll_count = count(*) FROM soheader WHERE orderno = @toorderno 
if @ll_count > 0 
SET @errorMessage = 'ORDERNO ' + CAST(@toOrderno as Varchar(10)) +' ALREADY EXISTS. UPDATE FAILED.'
RAISERROR(@errorMessage , 16, 5000 )

update soheader set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno
update sodetail set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update soheader_cutdefault set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update soheader_buysheet set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno
update soheader_workorder set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update soheader_850 set reforderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno
update sodetail_850 set reforderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update Order_spec set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update cutheader set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno 
update cutdetail set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno 

update pickheader set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno
update pickdetail set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update invheader set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno
update invdetail set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update arcash set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno
update archeck set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update cc_transaction set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update soheader_notes set orderno =@toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update sodetail_findbulk_log SET orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update edi_850_summary set orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

update rmaheader set Orderno = @toorderno WHERE orderno = @fromOrderno

usp_update_prepack_upc_sku create procedure usp_update_prepack_upc_sku
(@code nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(10),@custid nvarchar(10), 
 @sku nvarchar(20), @sku_chk nvarchar(1), 
 @qty1 int, @qty2 int, @qty3 int, @qty4 int , @qty5 int, @qty6 int, @qty7 int, @qty8 int, 
 @qty9 int, @qty10 int, @qty11 int, @qty12 int) 
AS
declare @iCount int 
SELECT @iCount = count(*) FROM code_SKU WHERE rtrim(sku) = @sku AND custid = @custid
if @iCount = 0 
BEGIN
insert into code_sku (sku, upc_check_digit, style, color, royaltor, custid, pack1, 
pack2, pack3, pack4, pack5, pack6, pack7, pack8, pack9, pack10, pack11, pack12, prepack) 
VALUES(@sku, @sku_chk, @code, @color, @royaltor, @custid, @qty1, @qty2, @qty3, @qty4,
@qty5, @qty6, @qty7, @qty8, @qty9, @qty10, @qty11, @qty12, 'Y')
END
ELSE 
BEGIN 
update code_sku set pack1 = @qty1, pack2 = @qty2, pack3 = @qty3, pack4 = @qty4, pack5 = @qty5, 
pack6 = @qty6, pack7 = @qty7, pack8 = @qty8, pack9 = @qty9, pack10 = @qty10, 
pack11 = @qty11, pack12 = @qty12 WHERE sku = @sku AND custid = @custid 
AND style = @code AND color = @color
END 

usp_update_prepack_upc_sku_all create procedure usp_update_prepack_upc_sku_all 
as
declare @style nvarchar(13), @color nvarchar(12), @royaltor nvarchar(10), 
@upc nvarchar(20), @upc_chk nvarchar(1),  @spack nvarchar(20), @q1 int, 
@q2 int, @q3 int, @q4 int, @q5 int, @q6 int, @q7 int, @q8 int, @q9 int,
@q10 int, @q11 int, @q12 int, @iCount int , @cnt int
begin
DECLARE cur_upc CURSOR FOR SELECT code, color, royaltor, upc_prepack,upc_prepack_chk,
isnull(prepack_qty1,0), isnull(prepack_qty2, 0), isnull(prepack_qty3,0), isnull(prepack_qty4,0),
isnull(prepack_qty5,0), isnull(prepack_qty6,0), isnull(prepack_qty7,0),isnull(prepack_qty8,0),
isnull(prepack_qty9, 0), isnull(prepack_qty10,0), isnull(prepack_qty11,0), isnull(prepack_qty12,0)
FROM ivtf WHERE isnull(upc_prepack, '') <> '' 
Open cur_upc
FETCH cur_upc INTO @style, @color, @royaltor, @upc, @upc_chk, @q1, @q2, @q3, @q4, @q5, @q6, @q7,
@q8, @q9, @q10, @q11, @q12
select @cnt = 0
WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
BEGIN
--SELECT @iCount = 0
--SELECT @iCount = count(*) FROM code_SKU WHERE sku = @upc AND custid = 'UPC' 
--if @iCount > 0 

exec usp_update_prepack_upc_sku  @style, @color, @royaltor, 'UPC', @upc, @upc_chk, @q1, @q2, @q3, 
@q4, @q5, @q6, @q7, @q8, @q9, @q10, @q11, @q12

select @cnt = @cnt + 1
FETCH NEXT FROM cur_UPC INTO @style, @color, @royaltor, @upc, @upc_chk, @q1, @q2, @q3, @q4, @q5, @q6, @q7,
@q8, @q9, @q10, @q11, @q12
END
close cur_upc
deallocate cur_upc
SELECT @cnt
end

CREATE PROCEDURE usp_update_vendor_cost (@style nchar(13), @color nchar(12), @cutdetail_id INT, @cutno INT)
AS 
if isnull(@style,'') <> '' 
BEGIN
DECLARE @fob_Price money

DECLARE @issuedate datetime
DECLARE @priceTerms nchar(10)
DECLARE @count INT

SELECT @vendor = contractor, @issuedate=issuedate, @priceTerms=terms FROM cutheader WHERE cutno = @cutno
SELECT @fob_Price = fob_price from cutdetail WHERE cutdetail_id = @cutdetail_id

--SELECT @count = count(*) FROM ivtf_vendor WHERE code =@style
--/*160906 Arun added as per Dan Email to update ivtf_vendor table*/
--if @count = 0 
--begin
--	insert into ivtf_vendor(code, vend1, price1, note1,  selected1) values
-- 	(@style,@vendor, @fob_price, 'cut#' + convert(varchar(20),@cutno), 'Y')
--end
--else
--begin
--	update ivtf_vendor set vend1 =@vendor, price1 = @fob_price, note1 = 'cut#' + convert(varchar(20),@cutno), selected1 = 'Y' WHERE code =@style
--End
/*160906 Arun added as per Dan Email to update ivtf_vendor_cost table*/
if not exists(Select code from ivtf_vendor_cost where code=@style and color =@color)
	insert into ivtf_vendor_cost (code, color, vend1, price1, note1, selected1, priceTerms1, date1)
	Values(@style, @color, @vendor, @fob_price, 'cut #' + convert(varchar(20), @cutno), 'Y', @priceterms,@issuedate)
Else 
	update ivtf_vendor_cost set vend1=@vendor,price1=@fob_price,note1='cut #' +convert(varchar(20),@cutno),
	selected1 = 'Y', priceTerms1=@priceterms, date1 = @issuedate WHERE code = @style AND color = @color

END
