	DECLARE @color nchar(12)
	DECLARE @cutdetail_id INT, @cutno INT
	DECLARE @i int
	SET @i = 0
	DECLARE cur_sel_cut CURSOR FORWARD_ONLY FOR

	SELECT ivtf.code, ivtf.color,
	a.cutdetail_id, a.cutno from  ivtf JOIN 
	(select style , color as color, 
	max(cutdetail.fob_price) as fobprice, 
	cutheader.contractor as vendor,
	cutheader.terms,cutheader.cutno,
	max(cutdetail.qty) as cqty,
	max(cutdetail.cutdetail_id) as cutdetail_id,
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY style, color
	ORDER BY cutheader.cutno Desc) as rowno
	FROM cutheader JOIN cutdetail ON 
	cutdetail.cutno = cutheader.cutno 
	WHERE cutdetail.closed <> 'Y'
	GROUP BY cutdetail.style, cutdetail.color,
	cutheader.contractor, cutheader.terms,
	cutheader.cutno) a
	ON a.style = ivtf.code and a.color = ivtf.color 
	--WHERE ivtf.code = 'ZZTEST' and ivtf.color = '019'
	WHERE a.rowno = 1
	GROUP BY ivtf.code, ivtf.color,
	a.cutdetail_id, a.cutno
	OPEN cur_sel_cut 
	FETCH cur_sel_cut INTO @style, @color, @cutdetail_id, @cutno
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
	BEGIN
	SET @i = @i+1
		EXECUTE usp_update_vendor_cost @style, @color, @cutdetail_id, @cutno
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur_sel_cut INTO @style, @color, @cutdetail_id, @cutno
	END
CLOSE cur_sel_cut 
DEALLOCATE cur_sel_cut
END

usp_update_weight_rpsamsc CREATE procedure [dbo].[usp_update_weight_rpsamsc] as
update pickheader set weight = round(totqty * 1.2,0) 
where customer ='RPSAMSC' and closed  ='N' and isnull(weight,0) = 0 and isnull(boxqty,0) = 0  and user4 = 'S'



/* update the boxes */
/*220927 Arun added Case as sometimes they don't create PT*/
update invheader set boxes = (case when  isnull(invheader.pickno,0) > 0 ThEN (select count(pickno) from invhead_box where pickno=invheader.pickno)
ELSE (select sum(boxes) FROM invhead_box WHERE invhead_box.invoiceno = invheader.invoiceno) END)
  where   cast(create_date as date)= cast(getdate() as Date)

AND CUSTOMER='RPSAMSC' and user4 = 'S'
/*220927 Arun added Case */
AND (case when  isnull(invheader.pickno,0) > 0 ThEN (select count(pickno) from invhead_box where pickno=invheader.pickno)
ELSE (select sum(boxes) FROM invhead_box WHERE invhead_box.invoiceno = invheader.invoiceno) END) > 0

/* update the weight */
--221103 Arun commented 
--update invheader 
----set weight = convert(money, (totqty * 1.20))  where  cast(create_date as date)= cast(getdate() as Date)
--set weight = convert(money, ( select sum(qty * 
--case when style like'i%' then 1.2
--     --when style like'm%' then .86 /*221102 Arun changed as per ticket# 19514.
--	 when style like 'm%' then .92
--     else 1.2 end )
--from invdetail where invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno) ) where cast(create_date as date)= cast(getdate() as Date)
--AND CUSTOMER='RPSAMSC' and user4 = 'S'


--220929 Arun - Based on weight, uncomment only ater confirm from Anand.
update invheader 
--set weight = convert(money, (totqty * 1.20))  where  cast(create_date as date)= cast(getdate() as Date)
--set weight = convert(money, ( select sum(invdetail.qty * 
--case when style like'i%' then 1.2
--     when style like'm%' then .86
     --else 1.2 end )
set weight = convert(money, ( select sum(invdetail.qty * (case when isnull(ivtf.weight
,0) > 0 THEN ivtf.weight ELSE case when style like'i%' then 1.2
     when style like'm%' then .92
     else 1.2 end  END)) 
from invdetail JOIN ivtf ON invdetail.style = ivtf.code AND invdetail.color = ivtf.color AND invdetail.royaltor = ivtf.royaltor 
where invoiceno=invheader.invoiceno) ) where cast(create_date as date)= cast(getdate() as Date)
AND CUSTOMER='RPSAMSC' and user4 = 'S'



usp_updated_priceb_price2_percent create Procedure usp_updated_priceb_price2_percent 
AS 
BEGIN
declare @autopricing char(1), @priceBpercent money, @pricecpercent money, @pricedPercent money, @priceEpercent money, @pricefpercent money, 
@priceRetailpercent money 

SELECT @autopricing = isnull(autopricing, 'N') , 
@priceBpercent = priceBpercent, @pricecpercent = PriceCpercent, @pricedPercent = PriceDpercent, 
@priceEpercent = PriceEpercent, @pricefpercent = PriceFpercent, @priceRetailpercent = PriceRetailpercent
FROM wfsystem2 where wfsystem = 1
if @autopricing = 'Y'
begin

insert into ut_ivtf_price_log (style, color, royaltor, ivtf_id, update_column_name, oldvalue, newvalue) 
(select code, color, royaltor, id, 'priceb', priceb, Round((price * @priceBpercent /100),2) 
from ivtf where Round(priceb,2) <> (Round(price * @priceBpercent /100,2)) and isnull(priceb, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 )

update ivtf set priceb = (Round(price * @priceBpercent /100,2)),washing_instruction2 = isnull(convert(nvarchar(max), washing_instruction2),'') +
' old PriceB: '+ cast(priceB as nvarchar(10)) + ' , new PriceB: ' + cast(Round((price * @priceBpercent /100),2) as nvarchar(10))  
where Round(priceb,2) <> (Round(price * @priceBpercent /100,2)) and isnull(priceb, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 
--select id, price, priceb, Round((price * @priceBpercent /100),0.5) as calcprice,@priceBpercent,  * from ivtf where priceb  =  price 
/*<> ((price * @priceBpercent/100)) */and isnull(priceb, 0.00) > 0 
--and onorder_qty = 0 
insert into ut_ivtf_price_log (style, color, royaltor, ivtf_id, update_column_name, oldvalue, newvalue) 
(select code, color, royaltor, id, 'pricec', pricec, Round((price * @priceCpercent /100),2) 
from ivtf where Round(pricec,2) <> (Round(price * @pricecpercent/100,2)) and isnull(pricec, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 )

update ivtf set pricec = Round((price * @priceCpercent /100),2),washing_instruction2 = isnull(convert(nvarchar(max), washing_instruction2),'') +
' old PriceC: '+ cast(priceC as nvarchar(10)) + ' , new PriceC: ' + cast(Round((price * @priceCpercent /100),2) as nvarchar(10))  
where Round(pricec,2) <> (Round(price * @pricecpercent/100,2)) and isnull(pricec, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 
--select price, pricec, Round((price * @pricecpercent /100), 0.5) as calcprice,@priceCpercent,  * from ivtf where --priceb  =  price 
--pricec <> ((price * @priceBpercent/100)) and isnull(pricec, 0.00) > 0 
--and onorder_qty = 0 
/*priceD */
insert into ut_ivtf_price_log (style, color, royaltor, ivtf_id, update_column_name, oldvalue, newvalue) 
(select code, color, royaltor, id, 'priced', priced, Round((price * @priceDpercent /100),2) 
from ivtf where Round(priced,2)  <> (Round(price * @pricedpercent/100, 2)) and isnull(priceD, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 )

update ivtf set priced = Round((price * @pricedpercent /100),2) ,washing_instruction2 = isnull(convert(nvarchar(max), washing_instruction2),'') +
' old PriceD: '+ cast(priced as nvarchar(10)) + ' , new PriceD: ' + cast(Round((price * @priceDpercent /100),2) as nvarchar(10)) 
where Round(priced,2)  <> (Round(price * @pricedpercent/100, 2)) and isnull(priceD, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 
/*priceE */
insert into ut_ivtf_price_log (style, color, royaltor, ivtf_id, update_column_name, oldvalue, newvalue) 
(select code, color, royaltor, id, 'pricee', pricee, Round((price * @priceEpercent /100),2) 
from ivtf where Round(priceE,2) <> Round((price * @priceEpercent /100),2) and isnull(priceE, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 )

update ivtf set priceE = Round((price * @priceEpercent /100),2),washing_instruction2 = isnull(convert(nvarchar(max), washing_instruction2),'') +
' old PriceE: '+ cast(priceE as nvarchar(10)) + ' , new PriceE: ' + cast(Round((price * @priceEpercent /100),2) as nvarchar(10))  
where priceE <> ((price * @priceEpercent/100)) and isnull(priceE, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 
/*priceF */
insert into ut_ivtf_price_log (style, color, royaltor, ivtf_id, update_column_name, oldvalue, newvalue) 
(select code, color, royaltor, id, 'pricef', priceF, Round((price * @priceFpercent /100),2) 
from ivtf where Round(priceF,2) <> Round((price * @priceFpercent/100),2) and isnull(priceF, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 )

update ivtf set priceF = Round((price * @priceFpercent /100),2),washing_instruction2 = isnull(convert(nvarchar(max), washing_instruction2),'') +
' old PriceF: '+ cast(priceF as nvarchar(10)) + ' , new PriceF: ' + cast(Round((price * @pricefpercent /100),2) as nvarchar(10)) 
where priceF <> ((price * @priceFpercent/100)) and isnull(priceF, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 

/*Retail Price */
insert into ut_ivtf_price_log (style, color, royaltor, ivtf_id, update_column_name, oldvalue, newvalue) 
(select code, color, royaltor, id, 'price2', price2, Round((price * @priceRetailpercent /100),2) 
from ivtf where Round(price2,2) <> Round((price * @priceRetailpercent/100),2) and isnull(price2, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 )

update ivtf set price2 = Round((price * @priceRetailpercent /100),2), washing_instruction2 = isnull(convert(nvarchar(max), washing_instruction2),'') +
' old retail Price: '+ cast(price2 as nvarchar(10)) + ' , new retail Price: ' + cast(Round((price * @priceRetailpercent /100),2) as nvarchar(10))
where price2 <> ((price * @priceRetailpercent/100)) and isnull(price2, 0.00) > 0 and isnull(onorder_qty,0) = 0 

end
END

util_zero_inventory 
create procedure util_zero_inventory as 
/* recalc all styles first - including INACTIVE STYLES */
insert into logfdetail (logno, line, refno, style, color, warehouse, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12,
					cost, location, logdate)

select 0,1, 'ZERO130613',style,color,warehouse, -qty1,-qty2, -qty3, -qty4, -qty5, -qty6, -qty7, -qty8, -qty9, -qty10, -qty11, -qty12, 
					0, 'HOUS', getdate()  
 from ivtf_wh 
  where not ( qty1=0 and qty2=0 and qty3=0 and qty4=0 and qty5=0 and qty6=0 and qty7=0 and qty8=0 and qty9=0 and qty10=0 and qty11=0 and qty12=0 ) 
/* recalc styles again */ 

v_test --select * from soheader ;


CREATE procedure v_test
as

DECLARE @sql nvarchar(max);

SELECT @sql = ISNULL(@sql, 'DATENAME(MONTH, orderdate) As [Month]') + ', SUM(CASE WHEN DATEPART(YEAR, orderdate) = ' + 
              CAST(DATEPART(YEAR, orderdate) AS VARCHAR(5)) + ' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS [' + CAST(DATEPART(YEAR, orderdate) AS varchar(5)) + ']'
FROM soheader
GROUP BY DATEPART(YEAR, orderdate)
ORDER BY DATEPART(YEAR, orderdate);

SET @sql = 'SELECT ' + @sql + ' FROM soheader GROUP BY DATENAME(MONTH, orderdate), DATEPART(MONTH, orderdate) ORDER BY DATEPART(MONTH, orderdate)';

EXEC(@sql);
w_smartsearch 

CREATE procedure [dbo].[w_smartsearch] @searchtext nchar(20),@limit int, @pricelvel char(10)
as
declare @col1 nchar(1000) 
declare @col2 nchar(1000) 
declare @item int

select 'Style name'+v.code as searchfrom, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by v.style desc ) AS Row, 
v.id, v.code, v.descript, 

case when (@pricelvel) = 'priceb' then convert(decimal(10,2), v.priceb) 
	 when (@pricelvel) = 'pricec' then convert(decimal(10,2), v.pricec)
	 when (@pricelvel) = 'priced' then convert(decimal(10,2), v.priced)
	 when (@pricelvel) = 'pricee' then convert(decimal(10,2), v.pricee)
	 when (@pricelvel) = 'pricef' then convert(decimal(10,2), v.pricef)
	 else convert(decimal(10,2), v.price) end as price2,

 division.descript as divisionss, grp.descript as groups, category.descript as category
FROM view_list_styleonly v  
	left outer JOIN  division on v.division=division.code   
	left outer join grp on v.grp=grp.code
	left outer join category on v.category=category.code
	left outer join color on v.color=color.code 
WHERE 
v.code like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
v.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
division.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
color.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
category.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' or 
grp.descript like '%'+rtrim(@searchtext)+'%' 

--exec W_SmartSearch 'zztestw',90,'pricee'
web_adjust_inventory_sku CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[web_adjust_inventory_sku] 
@sku nchar(15),
@qty char(10),
@refno nchar(10),
@price nchar(10) 
AS
BEGIN
declare @style nchar(13)
declare @color nchar(12)
declare @qty1 int
declare @qty2 int
declare @qty3 int
declare @qty4 int
declare @qty5 int
declare @qty6 int
declare @qty7 int
declare @qty8 int
declare @qty9 int
declare @qty10 int
declare @qty11 int
declare @qty12 int

select @style=style, @color=color, 
@qty1=isnull(pack1,0)*@qty, 
@qty2=isnull(pack2,0)*@qty, 
@qty3=isnull(pack3,0)*@qty, 
@qty4=isnull(pack4,0)*@qty, 
@qty5=isnull(pack5,0)*@qty, 
@qty6=isnull(pack6,0)*@qty, 
@qty7=isnull(pack7,0)*@qty, 
@qty8=isnull(pack8,0)*@qty, 
@qty9=isnull(pack9,0)*@qty, 
@qty10=isnull(pack10,0)*@qty, 
@qty11=isnull(pack11,0)*@qty, 
@qty12=isnull(pack12,0)*@qty 
from code_sku where sku=@sku 

INSERT INTO logfdetail(logno, refno, line, style, color, qty1, qty2, qty3, qty4, qty5, qty6, qty7, qty8, qty9, qty10, qty11, qty12, 
	location,warehouse, cost, logdate) 
	VALUES( 0, @refno, 1, @style, @color, @qty1, @qty2, @qty3, @qty4, @qty5, @qty6, @qty7, @qty8, @qty9, @qty10, @qty11, @qty12, 
	'HOUS', '00', @price, getdate()  )
select 'OK'
END

	END

web_epdmhead /*060905 - raj*/

CREATE PROCEDURE web_epdmhead
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @productionid int
	SELECT @productionid= max(productionid) FROM eproductiontype

	--GETTING MAX HEADER ID FROM epdmheadmaster
	DECLARE @maxid int
	DECLARE @tempmaxid int
	SELECT @maxid= max(headerid)+1 FROM epdmheadmaster
	IF @maxid=0 OR @maxid IS NULL	
	BEGIN
		SET @maxid=1
	END
	SET @tempmaxid=@maxid
	

	--INSERTING 25 ROWS TO epdmheadmaster
	DECLARE @rowid int
	SET @rowid = 1
	WHILE	@rowid<26
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO epdmheadmaster(headerid,productionid)  VALUES(@maxid, @productionid)
		SET @maxid = @maxid + 1
		SET @rowid = @rowid + 1
	END
	

	--INSERTING 25 ROWS TO epdmheaddetails
	SET @maxid=@tempmaxid
	SET @rowid = 1
	WHILE	@rowid<26
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO epdmheaddetails(headerid,pdmhead,cutdate,eview,eadd,eedit) values(@maxid,'',0,0,0,0)
		SET @maxid = @maxid + 1
		SET @rowid = @rowid + 1
	END

END

web_insert_webcutheaderpdm 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[web_insert_webcutheaderpdm] AS
-- 140604 dan - added 'pdmstart' date 
Insert into webcutheaderpdm (pdmno,cutno,vendercode,productiontype, pdmstart,
heading1 ,
heading2 ,
heading3 ,
heading4 ,
heading5 ,
heading6,
heading7 ,
heading8 ,
heading9 ,
heading10 ,
heading11 ,
heading12 ,
heading13 ,
heading14 ,
heading15 ,
heading16 ,
heading17 ,
heading18 ,
heading19 ,
heading20 ,
heading21 ,
heading22 ,
heading23 ,
heading24 ,
heading25 
)  
select cutheader.cutno,cutheader.cutno,cutheader.contractor,cutheader.ms_type, cutheader.issuedate,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead1,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead2,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead3,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead4,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead5,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead6,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead7,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead8,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead9,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead10,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead11,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead12,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead13,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead14,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead15,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead16,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead17,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead18,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead19,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead20,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead21,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead22,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead23,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead24,
WebPdmHeads.PdmHead25
 from 
	cutheader left outer join WebPdmHeads on WebPdmHeads.code=cutheader.ms_type
where cutno not in (select cutno from webcutheaderpdm)

web_insertimage_specsheet CREATE PROCEDURE web_insertimage_specsheet 

@Style  nvarchar(13),
@Color nvarchar(13),
@ID1 integer,
@ID2 integer,
@Showimg image,
@PageNo nvarchar(2)

as
begin

--Page 1 = Spec_page0 & Spec_page1
if (@PageNo = '1')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page0) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
else
if (@PageNo = '2')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page2) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
else
if (@PageNo = '3')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page3) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End

if (@PageNo = '4')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page4) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '5')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page5) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '6')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page6) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '7')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page7) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '8')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page8) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '9')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page9) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '10')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page10) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '11')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page11) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '12')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page12) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '13')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page13) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '14')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page14) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '15')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page15) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End
if (@PageNo = '16')
	Begin
	Insert into  ivtf_image(style,color,id1,id2,Spec_page16) values (@Style,@Color,@ID1,@ID2,@Showimg)
	End


end

web_insertsodetail_hfc 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[web_insertsodetail_hfc]

@webuser nchar(3),
@orderno INT,
@style nchar(10),
@line SMALLINT,
@color nchar(12),
@qty1 INT,
@qty2 INT,
@qty3 INT,
@qty4 INT,
@qty5 INT,
@qty6 INT,
@qty7 INT,
@qty8 INT,
@qty9 INT,
@qty10 INT,
@qty11 INT,
@qty12 INT,
@price MONEY,
@size nchar(2)

AS
BEGIN
	IF @webuser='WEB' 
	BEGIN

		IF @size = '1'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty1,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty1,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '2' 
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty2,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty2,@price)
		END 

		IF  @size= '3'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty3,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty3,@price)
		END 

		IF  @size= '4'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty4,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty4,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '5'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty5,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty5,@price)
		END 

		IF  @size = '6'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty6,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty6,@price)
		END 

		IF  @size = '7'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty7,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty7,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '8'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty8,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty8,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '9'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty9,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty9,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '10'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty10,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty10,@price)
		END

		IF @size = '11'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty11,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty11,@price)
		END

		IF  @size= '12'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail_hfc(orderno,style,line,color,qty12,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty12,@price)
		END

	END

	ELSE

	BEGIN

		IF @size = '1'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty1,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty1,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '2' 
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty2,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty2,@price)
		END 

		IF  @size= '3'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty3,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty3,@price)
		END 

		IF  @size= '4'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty4,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty4,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '5'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty5,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty5,@price)
		END 

		IF  @size = '6'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty6,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty6,@price)
		END 

		IF  @size = '7'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty7,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty7,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '8'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty8,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty8,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '9'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty9,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty9,@price)
		END

		IF  @size = '10'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty10,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty10,@price)
		END

		IF @size = '11'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty11,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty11,@price)
		END

		IF  @size= '12'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO sodetail(orderno,style,line,color,qty12,price) VALUES(@orderno,@style,@line,@color,@qty12,@price)
		END

	END
END

web_insertstore 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[web_insertstore] 

@code nchar(10),
@name nchar(30),
@addr1 nchar(30),
@addr2 nchar(30),
@state nchar(3),
@city nchar(20),
@country nchar(35),
@zip nchar(10),
@phone1 nchar(15),
@fax1 nchar(15),
@shipvia nchar(4),
--@shiplAStname VARnchar(30),
@web_user nvarchar(30),
@web_password nvarchar(12),
@billname nvarchar(30),
--@billlAStname VARCHAR(30),
@billaddr1 nvarchar(30),
@billaddr2 nvarchar(30),
@billph nvarchar(15),
@billfax nvarchar(15),
@billcountry nvarchar(35),
@billcity nvarchar(20),
@billzip nvarchar(10),
@billstate nvarchar(3),
@contact1 nvarchar(30),
@gender nvarchar(1),
@grade_lvl nvarchar(10) 
AS
BEGIN

	INSERT INTO store(customer,code,name,addr1,addr2,state,city,country,zip,phone1,fax1,web_user,
	web_password,billname,billaddr1,billaddr2,billph,billfax,billcountry,billcity,billzip,billstate,contact1, gender, grade_lvl ) 
	VALUES('WEB',UPPER(@code),UPPER(@name),UPPER(@addr1),UPPER(@addr2),UPPER(@state),
	UPPER(@city),UPPER(@country),UPPER(@zip),UPPER(@phone1),UPPER(@fax1),UPPER(@web_user),@web_password,
	UPPER(@billname),UPPER(@billaddr1),UPPER(@billaddr2),UPPER(@billph),UPPER(@billfax),
	UPPER(@billcountry),UPPER(@billcity),UPPER(@billzip),UPPER(@billstate),UPPER(@contact1), left(@gender,1), @grade_lvl  )

END


web_select_for_barcode CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[web_select_for_barcode] 
@cutno int
AS
BEGIN
SELECT ivtf.code,ivtf.color,ivtf.descript,ivtf.division,
		ivtf.upc, ivtf.upc2, ivtf.upc3, ivtf.upc4, ivtf.upc5, 
		ivtf.upc6, ivtf.upc7, ivtf.upc8, ivtf.upc9,
		ivtf.upc10,ivtf.upc11,ivtf.upc12,
		ivtf.price2,cutdetail.qty1, cutdetail.qty2, cutdetail.qty3, cutdetail.qty4,
		cutdetail.qty5, cutdetail.qty6, cutdetail.qty7, cutdetail.qty8, cutdetail.qty9,
		cutdetail.qty10,cutdetail.qty11,cutdetail.qty12,cutdetail.style,
		division.size1,division.size2,division.size3,division.size4,division.size5,
		division.size6,division.size7,division.size8,division.size9,division.size10,
		division.size11,division.size12
FROM ivtf,cutdetail,division
WHERE 
	((ivtf.code = cutdetail.style) And 
	(ivtf.color = cutdetail.color) And 
	(cutdetail.cutno=@cutno) And
	(division.code=ivtf.division))
END

web_update_webcutheaderpdm 


--END --03/20/2005 - MIKE


--Start - Mike - 03/21/06

CREATE PROCEDURE web_update_webcutheaderpdm AS

update webcutheaderpdm set vendercode  = (select contractor from cutheader where cutheader.cutno = webcutheaderpdm.cutno)

update webcutheaderpdm set productiontype  = (select ms_type from cutheader where cutheader.cutno = webcutheaderpdm.cutno)

web_updatecustomer 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[web_updatecustomer]
@code nchar(10),
@name nchar(30),
@addr1 nchar(30),
@addr2 nchar(30),
@city nchar(20),
@state nchar(3),
@country nchar(35),
@zip nchar(10),
@phone1 nchar(15),
@fax1 nchar(15),
@shipvia nchar(4),
@email1 nchar(30),
@contact1 nvarchar(30)
AS
BEGIN
	UPDATE customer SET name=@name,addr1=@addr1,addr2=@addr2,city=@city,state=@state,country=@country,zip=@zip,phone1=@phone1,fax1=@fax1,shipvia=@shipvia,email1=@email1,contact1=@contact1 WHERE ltrim(rtrim(code))=@code
END

CREATE PROCEDURE web_updatecustomercredit

@addr2 CHAR(30),
@state CHAR(3),
@city CHAR(20),
@country CHAR(35),
@zip CHAR(10),

@fax1 CHAR(15),
@shipvia CHAR(4),
@email1 CHAR(30),
@credit_expdate DATETIME,

web_updatestore 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[web_updatestore]
@code nvarchar(10),
@name nchar(30),
@addr1 nchar(30),
@addr2 nchar(30),
@city nchar(20),
@state nchar(3),
@country nchar(35),
@zip nchar(10),
@phone1 nchar(15),
@fax1 nchar(15),
@shipvia nchar(4),
@billname nvarchar(30),
@billaddr1 nvarchar(30),
@billaddr2 nvarchar(30),
@billph nvarchar(15),
@billfax nvarchar(15),
@billcountry nvarchar(35),
@billcity nvarchar(20),
@billzip nvarchar(10),
@billstate nvarchar(3),
@contact1 nvarchar(30)
AS
BEGIN
	UPDATE store SET name=@name,addr1=@addr1,addr2=@addr2,city=@city,state=@state,country=@country,zip=@zip,
	phone1=@phone1,fax1=@fax1,shipvia=@shipvia,billname=@billname,billaddr1=@billaddr1,billaddr2=@billaddr2,
	billph=@billph,billfax=@billfax,billcountry=@billcountry,billcity=@billcity,billzip=@billzip,
	billstate=@billstate,contact1=@contact1 WHERE code=@code AND customer='WEB'
END

web_updatestorecredit 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[web_updatestorecredit]
@code nvarchar(10),
@name nchar(30),
@addr1 nchar(30),
@addr2 nchar(30),
@city nchar(20),
@state nchar(3),
@country nchar(35),
@zip nchar(10),
@phone1 nchar(15),
@fax1 nchar(15),
@shipvia nchar(4),
@billname nvarchar(30),
@billaddr1 nvarchar(30),
@billaddr2 nvarchar(30),
@billph nvarchar(15),
@billfax nvarchar(15),
@billcountry nvarchar(35),
@billcity nvarchar(20),
@billzip nvarchar(10),
@billstate nvarchar(3),
@credit_expdate DATETIME,
@credit_cardno nvarchar(50),
@cardtype nvarchar(15),
@contact1 nchar(30)
AS
BEGIN
	UPDATE store SET name=@name,addr1=@addr1,addr2=@addr2,city=@city,state=@state,country=@country,zip=@zip,phone1=@phone1,
	fax1=@fax1,shipvia=@shipvia,billname=@billname,billaddr1=@billaddr1,billaddr2=@billaddr2,billph=@billph,billfax=@billfax,
	billcountry=@billcountry,billcity=@billcity,billzip=@billzip,billstate=@billstate,credit_expdate=@credit_expdate,
	credit_cardno=@credit_cardno,cardtype=@cardtype,contact1=@contact1 WHERE code=@code AND customer='WEB'
END

wf_check_database create procedure wf_check_database as

/* check against style master */
select * from sodetail where style+color not in (select code+color from ivtf)
select * from invdetail where style+color not in (select code+color from ivtf)
select * from pickdetail where style+color not in (select code+color from ivtf)
select * from logfdetail where style+color not in (select code+color from ivtf)

/* check against raw master */
select * from bom where raw_code+raw_color not in  (SELECT code + color from ivtr)
select * from podetail where style+color not in  (SELECT code + color from ivtr)
select * from logr where code+color not in  (SELECT code + color from ivtr)

/* check against customer master */

/* check against vendor master */

Who_GetSeason 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Who_GetSeason]
	@season nvarchar(100) = null
   ,@category nvarchar(100) = null
   ,@filter char(3) = null   
   ,@PageIndex INT 
   ,@PageSize INT
   ,@PageCount INT OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN	

--create table #Results  (Rownumber int,id int,code char(50),descript char(80),shortdesc char(80) ,price2 decimal(10,2),searchfrom char(500))


Declare @cldetail char(100)
declare @sqll nvarchar(1000)

	
if(@season is not null)
begin
set @cldetail = 'v_grid.season=''' + @season
end
if (@category is not null)
begin
set @cldetail = 'v_grid.category=''' + @category
end


if  @filter = 'N'
begin
set @sqll = ' SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER 
            (
                 order by v_grid.code desc
            )AS RowNumber,' + 
      'v_grid.id,rtrim(v_grid.code) as code,v_grid.descript,v_grid.shortdesc,convert(decimal(10,2),price) as price2,convert(decimal(10,2),webprice) as webprice,
	  '''' as ''searchfrom''' +
	  
    'from v_grid where 1=1  and '+  + ' '+ rtrim(@cldetail)  + '''  and '+' color=( select min(color) from v_grid v2 where v2.style=v_grid.style) group by v_grid.code,v_grid.id,v_grid.descript,v_grid.shortdesc,v_grid.price, v_grid.webprice  order by v_grid.code desc'

	EXEC sp_executesql @sqll
	--exec(@sqll)
	--print @sqll
End

else if  @filter = 'L'
begin
set @sqll = ' SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER 
            (
                 order by v_grid.code desc
            )AS RowNumber,' + 
      'v_grid.id,rtrim(v_grid.code) as code,v_grid.descript,v_grid.shortdesc,convert(decimal(10,2),price) as price2,convert(decimal(10,2),webprice) as webprice,
	  '''' as ''searchfrom''' +
	  
    'from v_grid where 1=1  and '+  + ' '+ rtrim(@cldetail)  + '''  and '+' color=( select min(color) from v_grid v2 where v2.style=v_grid.style) group by v_grid.code,v_grid.id,v_grid.descript,v_grid.shortdesc,v_grid.price, v_grid.webprice  order by  v_grid.price asc'

	EXEC sp_executesql @sqll
	--exec(@sqll)
	--print @sqll
End

else if  @filter = 'H'
begin
set @sqll = ' SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER 
            (
                 order by v_grid.code desc
            )AS RowNumber,' + 
      'v_grid.id,rtrim(v_grid.code) as code,v_grid.descript,v_grid.shortdesc,convert(decimal(10,2),price) as price2,convert(decimal(10,2),webprice) as webprice,
	  '''' as ''searchfrom''' +
	  
    'from v_grid where 1=1  and '+  + ' '+ rtrim(@cldetail)  + '''  and '+' color=( select min(color) from v_grid v2 where v2.style=v_grid.style) group by v_grid.code,v_grid.id,v_grid.descript,v_grid.shortdesc,v_grid.price, v_grid.webprice  order by v_grid.price desc'

	EXEC sp_executesql @sqll
	--exec(@sqll)
	--print @sqll
End

END



zero_closed_sodetail_allocation 
create procedure zero_closed_sodetail_allocation as

DECLARE @sodetail_id int

DECLARE work_CURSOR CURSOR FOR 
 SELECT sodetail_id FROM sodetail where closed='Y' and 
 isnull(alloc_qty1,0)+isnull(alloc_qty2,0)+isnull(alloc_qty3,0)+isnull(alloc_qty4,0)+isnull(alloc_qty5,0)+isnull(alloc_qty6,0)+
 isnull(alloc_qty7,0)+isnull(alloc_qty8,0)+isnull(alloc_qty9,0)+isnull(alloc_qty10,0)+isnull(alloc_qty11,0)+isnull(alloc_qty12,0) > 0

OPEN work_CURSOR


WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
  UPDATE SODETAIL SET 
	alloc_qty1=0, alloc_qty2=0, alloc_qty3=0, alloc_qty4=0, 
	alloc_qty5=0, alloc_qty6=0, alloc_qty7=0, alloc_qty8=0, 
	alloc_qty9=0, alloc_qty10=0, alloc_qty11=0, alloc_qty12=0
       where sodetail_id = @sodetail_id
  FETCH NEXT FROM work_CURSOR INTO 
	@sodetail_id
END

CLOSE work_CURSOR
DEALLOCATE work_CURSOR
